13.title: FR - Archer - S13E08 - Dough, Ray and Me
13.plot: Archer and the gang knead proof in order to temper expectations and ice the mission.

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E01 - The Anglerfish Stratagem
14.plot: The Agency teams up with Interpol to take down a highly organized ring of jewel thieves. Archer’s skeptical as their Interpol contact seems to be treating the mission as more of an audition... but for which side?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E02 - 30 for 30
14.plot: Zara Khan thinks she’s a real knockout, but Archer wants to prove he is just as stunning. Pam and Gillette sit back and keep score.

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E03 - Plaque Removal
14.plot: Archer, Lana and Zara travel to England to stop a thief who is stealing possibly-cursed artifacts. Can Archer break the curse before it breaks him?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E04 - Chill Barry
14.plot: Barry’s back, but will he give the gang the cold shoulder in their quest to put Other Barry on ice?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E05 - Keys Open Doors
14.plot: An unplanned vacation forces Lana to accompany Archer, Pam and Cyril on a mission that quickly goes off the rails. Will Lana blow the mission when she crosses the line?

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E06 - Face Off
14.plot: Archer tries to find an elusive villain at an exclusive resort, while Lana learns some explosive truths about running a spy agency.

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E07 - Mission Out of Control Room
14.plot: Lana monitors simultaneous missions in her state-of-the-art control room, but Archer and the gang experience technical difficulties.

14.title: FR - Archer - S14E08 - Breaking Fabian
14.plot: A former adversary lends a hand as Archer and the gang bond together to try and stop a fleet of killer drones.

meta.plot: Sterling Archer is the world's most daunting spy. He works for ISIS, a spy agency run by his mother. In between dealing with his boss and his co-workers - one of whom is his ex-girlfriend - Archer manages to annoy or seduce everyone that crosses his path. His antics are only excusable because at the end of the day, he still somehow always manages to thwart whatever crises was threatening mankind.

Puberty Syndrome—a rumored, mysterious syndrome that only affects those in their puberty. For example, a bunny girl suddenly appeared in front of Sakuta Azusagawa. The bunny girl's real identity is Mai Sakurajima, a teenage celebrity who is currently an inactive high school senior. For some reason, her charming figure does not reflect in the eyes of others. In the course of revealing the mystery behind this phenomenon, Sakuta begins to explore his feelings towards Mai. Set in a city where the skies and seas shine, Sakuta unfolds the meaning behind his bizarre encounters on women with the said syndrome.

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My Senpai is a Bunny Girl
1.plot: Puberty syndrome – Abnormal experiences rumored on the internet to be caused by sensitivity and instability during adolescence. This year, Sakuta Azusagawa, a second-year student at a high school near Enoshima, meets several girls that are experiencing this “puberty syndrome.” For instance, he meets a wild bunny girl in the library. She turns out to be an actress on hiatus, Mai Sakurajima, who is also his senior at the school. For some reason, no one else can see this enchanting girl. How did she become invisible…? As Sakuta searches for answers to help Mai, they spend more time together, and he eventually learns of her hidden feelings… This is an unusual story that takes place in a town of bright skies and glistening seas, where Sakuta encounters various intriguing girls.

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - On First Dates, Trouble is Essential
1.plot: While looking for the cause of Mai's Adolescence Syndrome, Sakuta ends up scheduling a date with Mai. On the day they promised, Sakuta tries to help out a lost little girl on his way towards Fujisawa Station. But, he is misunderstood to be a perverted maniac by another girl, and because of that, he ends up arriving late to his appointed time to meet Mai. He somehow gains Mai's forgiveness and they proceed with their date, but Mai changes their destination, and takes Sakuta to Shichirigahama Beach...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The World Without You
1.plot: Even after leaving Fujisawa for Ogaki, not one person remembered anything about Mai Sakurajima. Sakuta and Mai return to school together, but even there they hear from Sakuta's friend Rio Futaba that nobody at school outside of her has any recollection about Mai. At the same time, Sakuta hears of a theory that losing memories concerning Mai is based on a certain action taken, and struggles so that he doesn't lose his memories of her. And seeing Sakuta act as such, Mai makes a certain decision of her own as well...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - There is No Tomorrow For a Rascal
1.plot: Soon after Mai's "puberty syndrome" is resolved, Sakuta encounters another strange phenomenon without respite. Day after day, it is the same day for Sakuta and there is no tomorrow. When he consults Rio, she raises the possibility of "Laplace’s demon" -- that someone may be repeating and redoing a day.

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - All the Lies I Have for You
1.plot: Because of the misunderstanding that she was dating Sakuta, Tomoe is able to resolve the agonizing situation of being asked out by the guy her friend is in love with. She pleads with Sakuta to continue acting like they are dating. Despite feeling indebted to Mai, Sakuta could not leave Tomoe alone as she was fearing that she would lose her presence within her class. So, he reluctantly agrees to play the role of Tomoe's fake boyfriend for a while.

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - This World You Chose
1.plot: It is now the last day of the first term, the promised day when pretending to be dating Tomoe ends. It seems as though everything has finally been resolved, but…

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Adolescence Paradox
1.plot: After agreeing to harbor an abandoned cat, Sakuta finds himself welcoming a look-alike to his old school crush into his home. This does not sit very well with Mai, who is trying her best to be with her boyfriend amidst a demanding work schedule. Meanwhile, something appears to be up with Futaba...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Wash It All Away on a Stormy Night
1.plot: Upon inducing a case of "Puberty Syndrome" where two copies of herself exists, Rio ends up staying at Sakuta's house for the time being. Meanwhile, "the other Rio" has been busy posting various unexpected photos on social media. After being informed about these activities by his classmate, Saki Kamisato, Sakuta decides to have a chat with "the other Rio." As he learns more about each of the Rio-s in hopes of discovering the reason for "the other Rio’s" actions and possibly a cure for her "Puberty Syndrome," Sakuta begins to realize the troubles each of them carries...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Sister Panic
1.plot: Sakuta had been unable to see Mai, who was not only busy with work but had an order from her agency forbidding her from going on dates. The second term finally begins, and Sakuta is eagerly looking forward to seeing Mai again at school. But upon seeing Mai in front of his house, she greets him with a shocking, "Who the heck are you?" Upon confirming what the circumstances are, it comes into light that Mai and her little sister Nodoka Toyohama have swapped bodies. Until this new Adolescence Syndrome is resolved, Mai will be living as Nodoka, and Nodoka will be living as Mai...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Complex Congratulations
1.plot: Unable to deal with a commercial filming well as the actress Mai Sakurajima, Nodoka gradually starts to feel a strong sense of inferiority. As their body-swapped lives continues on, the day arrives where Mai must perform in Nodoka's pop idol group "Sweet Bullet". Sakuta and Nodoka attend the concert as they were given tickets...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Kaede Quest
1.plot: With Nodoka's Puberty Syndrome resolved, Sakuta's expectations to spend sweeter times with Mai is growing. But then, a scandal is reported by the media about Mai Sakurajima having a new boyfriend. In the press conference for a movie she had a role in, Mai gives a sincere explanation. Seeing that, Kaede decides to set goals for the rest of the year, wanting to do her best for Sakuta's sake as well. One of the goals she writes down is to go back to school...

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Life is a Never-Ending Dream
1.plot: Sakuta unveils to Mai and Nodoka the details of his family's past, and the trauma that Kaede underwent. Meanwhile, Kaede continues her re-integration into society, but as more hurdles appear, Sakuta worries for his sister's well-being.

1.title: EN - Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Dawn After an Endless Night
1.plot: With Sakuta's help, Kaede is able to go to school at night. She is now enthusiastic about heading to school during the day. However, on the following day, the original Kaede's memory suddenly returns, eradicating all memories of the Kaede that had spent the last two years together with Sakuta. A certain person appears before Sakuta, who is overwhelmed with grief because Kaede was no longer around.

meta.plot: Fore! After Eve’s first meet-up with Aoi on the grass left her in defeat, she’s had her eyes set on a rematch to return the favor. Both these up-and-coming golfers are highly skilled, highly unique and most of all, highly competitive. With dreams of making it pro, a rivalry is getting in full swing as they both battle it out in the biggest tournaments.

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Rainbow Bullet
1.plot: Eve is an underground golfer who supports poor street orphans with the money she makes from illegal golfing matches. But her life is about to change forever when she meets a young golfer who's just arrived from Japan...

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Innocent Tyrant
1.plot: Eve battles the "Innocent Tyrant" Aoi on one of the course's toughest holes: a monstrous L-shaped par 5 with a thick forest surrounding the course. Can the "Rainbow Bullet" win out against this strange challenger from a faraway land?

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Match Between Just the Two of Us
1.plot: Eve wants to play Aoi badly, and she's willing to do whatever it takes. She pulls some strings to get invited to the last day of the world junior championship, and begins her game...

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Vipère
1.plot: After pulling strings to get into the championship, Eve owes the mob a favor. She'll have to duel it out on a huge, randomly generated golf course. Can she win and make it back to challenge Aoi before she leaves?

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - VR
1.plot: After she fails to catch up with Aoi, Eve thinks she's lost her chance to play together forever. But then she hears about VR golf...

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Rebellion's Cry
1.plot: When the mafia tries to bulldoze Eve's home to build a new casino, she's forced into a deadly game of golf to earn the money for a new home.

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Purple Bullet
1.plot: Eve faces her former boss, Rose, in a climactic battle inside a huge underground hall where golf courses are randomly generated by thousands of tons of machinery.

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Final Bullet
1.plot: Eve's battle with Rose reaches its conclusion. The winner wins enough prize money to be set for life, and the loser will be killed by the mob!

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Ichina Saotome Wants to Be a Pro Caddy!
1.plot: Now in Japan, Eve is forced to make her way alone, far from the world she's known. But before she can even settle in, she's already found herself challenged to a tough match of golf!

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Evangeline Is Frightfully Upset
1.plot: As she settles into her new life in Japan, Eve finds herself faced with unfamiliar surroundings and new people. As she sets out for a night on the town, she finds herself caught up in a tense game of... mini-golf?

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - No Matter How Tall a Weed Grows, It Will Never Reach the Sun
1.plot: After finally making it to Japan, Eve is all ready to play Aoi at last. But before she can, Aoi is spirited away to play a match in another prefecture. And then Eve gets caught up in an unexpected match of her own...

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Are Aoi and Eve Okay Together? The Doubles Championship Begins
1.plot: It's the day of the prefectural qualifiers, and Eve and Aoi are a shoo-in to win. That is, if they can keep their arguments from ruining the match!

1.title: EN - BIRDIE WING -Golf Girls' Story- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - I Think Who Gets What Room Is Very Important for Girls
1.plot: The Doubles Championship heats up as Eve and Aoi face off against the best high-school players in Japan. Can they take their first step towards worldwide fame and glory?

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E01 - The Avengers Protocol (1)
1.plot: When Captain America is apparently destroyed by Red Skull, Iron Man reunites the team to avenge him.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E02 - The Avengers Protocol (2)
1.plot: Red Skull steals Tony Stark's armor and The Avengers put aside their differences and stop him and M.O.D.O.K. from destroying New York City.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E03 - Ghost of a Chance
1.plot: The rookie Falcon stands alone to save his team and stop a full scale invasion of Earth after the Avengers fall victim to the body-swapping Space Phantoms.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E04 - The Serpent of Doom
1.plot: Thor believes he must sacrifice himself to save the world from Doctor Doom, who summons the Midgard Serpent using a powerful Asgardian weapon.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E05 - Blood Feud
1.plot: To save Black Widow, Captain America leads the team into battle against a former World War II ally who he struggles to convince the team is a real person.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E06 - Super Adaptoid
1.plot: The Avengers are out-gunned by the high-tech, power-mimicking Super-Adaptoid, and Captain America is the last man standing against the ultimate artificial intelligence!

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E07 - Hyperion
1.plot: Hyperion arrives to save the Earth but his methods become too extreme and the Avengers must stand up to him.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E08 - Molecule Kid
1.plot: Hawkeye and Black Widow take on a covert S.H.I.E.L.D. mission to bring in the son of a super-villain, but when he is revealed to have a world-bending weapon, they realize keeping their mission a secret may be a fatal mistake.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E09 - Depth Charge
1.plot: When Attuma tries to sink Manhattan, Hulk is forced to prove his strength or perish trying.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E10 - The Doomstroyer
1.plot: Doctor Doom takes command of the Asgardian Destroyer armor and Thor has to convince the team to trust the one person who may be able to stop him, Loki!

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E11 - Hulked Out Heroes
1.plot: The Avengers learn what it's like to walk a mile in Hulk's shoes when a Gamma attack by Red Skull turns them into raging monsters - the unlikely duo of Hulk and Black Widow are the last line of defense between the city and the Hulk-Vengers.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E12 - Avengers: Impossible!
1.plot: The Avengers' world is turned upside down when the shape-shifting mischief-maker Impossible Man makes Falcon the star of his own action movie, but the blockbuster puts all of Earth on the line.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E13 - In Deep
1.plot: Iron Man and Captain America disguise themselves as villains to infiltrate Red Skull's Cabal, but when their disagreements over strategy cause their cover to get blown, they're forced to take on the entire Cabal alone.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E14 - Hulk's Day Out
1.plot: When Hulk crash-lands on Earth with amnesia, The Avengers reconstruct a day-in-the-life of Hulk to find out what world-ending threat could have knocked out The Strongest There Is.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E15 - Planet Doom
1.plot: Thor returns to find Earth under the rule of Doctor Doom, who has changed the past drastically to ensure that the Avengers never formed.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E16 - Bring on the Bad Guys
1.plot: The Avengers start to see how tough the Cabal is and how much strength they'll need to take it down.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E17 - Savages
1.plot: Tony becomes too reliant on his tech so Cap challenges him to go without it for one full day.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E18 - Mojo World
1.plot: Hulk and Hawkeye suddenly find themselves stuck in a death match at the hands of the intergalactic broadcasting master, Mojo.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E19 - The Ambassador
1.plot: The Avengers put their lives at risk to protect none other than Doctor Doom.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E20 - All-Father's Day
1.plot: Odin comes to the Avengers Tower demanding his son cease his "fun" on Earth and return to Asgard. Thor promises that if he can't prove the good he does on Earth he'll return home forever.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E21 - By the Numbers
1.plot: The Avengers and the Cabal have a huge confrontation that leaves the team forever changed. Tony also learns that "the stats" can't be trusted every time -- there's no substitute for human intuition.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E22 - Guardians & Space Knights
1.plot: When Galactus attacks Earth, Iron Man is able to lead him to another planet but discovers that it is populated and under the protection of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E23 - One Little Thing
1.plot: While Iron Man and Ant-Man are trying to stabilize particles that can shrink or grow matter, Falcon gives them terrible news -- his mom is coming to visit, and she has no idea he's an Avenger.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E24 - Crime and Circuses
1.plot: When the Circus of Crime rolls into town, Hawkeye's dark past begins to surface and puts the Avengers in danger.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E25 - Exodus
1.plot: Iron Man's confidence is shaken after he inadvertently puts Falcon in harm's way. When the Cabal pulls the trigger on its final plan, Tony has to put aside his personal dilemma and be the leader he was born to be.

1.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S01E26 - The Final Showdown
1.plot: With the Tesseract now in the hands of the Cosmic Skull, the world is in catastrophic peril. Iron Man realizes teaming up with the rest of the Cabal might be their only chance for victory.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E01 - The Arsenal
2.plot: When Red Skull comes crashing to Earth with a fleet of alien ships chasing him, the Avengers learn there's a villain in their midst a thousand times more dangerous than the Cabal ever was: Thanos! Earth's Mightiest Heroes are forced to face the fact they're big fish in a small pond -- and this new villain wants to conquer the entire ocean! Will the mightiest superheroes on Earth be able to stop the super-villain of the galaxy... before he succeeds in becoming all-powerful?

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E02 - Thanos Rising
2.plot: With the help of Arsenal, a robot created by Howard Stark for Tony, the Avengers must stop Thanos from gaining the Power Stone - an energy force so powerful that it could cause mass destruction.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E03 - Valhalla Can Wait
2.plot: Hulk and Thor are tricked into a battle and transported to Valhalla to find out who is the strongest, once and for all. But under Hela's rule, only the loser of their contest may return to Earth while the winner will become her consort and champion.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E04 - Ghosts of the Past
2.plot: Red Skull has information that could help the Avengers save the world from Thanos, but an intruder kidnaps Skull before they can retrieve it. Cap discovers that the trespasser is none other than his old partner Bucky Barnes, now the Winter Soldier, who's back and seeks revenge.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E05 - Beneath the Surface
2.plot: When Hawkeye and Black Widow stumble upon the Serpent Crown, they must work together to stop Attuma's battalion from destroying Atlantis.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E06 - Nighthawk
2.plot: When a mysterious new villain uses the individualized counter measures Falcon created when he was at S.H.I.E.L.D. to take out the Avengers one by one, he must figure out a way to save his team.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E07 - The Age of Tony Stark
2.plot: When the Time Stone becomes attached to Tony's arc reactor, it causes him to de-age and brings dangers from other eras, including dinosaurs, into present-day New York City.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E08 - Head to Head
2.plot: Tony believes the Avengers have reached the pinnacle of perfection, but when M.O.D.O.K. uses the Mind Stone to assume control of S.H.I.E.L.D., the team is put to the test as they are forced to swap minds.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E09 - The Dark Avengers
2.plot: In a 'flipped reality,' the Avengers discover that their world has been reshaped by the Reality Stone, wielded by the Squadron Supreme. In this new reality the Squadron Supreme have made themselves the heroes and the Avengers the villains! Find out if the Avengers can take down the Squadron Supreme and prove that they're the real heroes.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E10 - Back to the Learning Hall
2.plot: When Thor is tricked into returning to Asgard, he and the Avengers discover they must defeat Loki and prevent Earth and Asgard from crashing into one another and foil Loki's plan to escape Valhalla and seek revenge on his brother.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E11 - Downgraded
2.plot: Stranded without his gear in a dangerous realm where technology doesn't work, Falcon must prove to himself and a skeptical Hawkeye that he's still a hero.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E12 - Widow's Run
2.plot: The Avengers must protect Widow and Thor as they carry out Widow's plan to rid the Earth of the Infinity Stones before Thanos arrives to claim them and control the Universe.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E13 - Thanos Triumphant
2.plot: With the power and might of all five Infinity Stones finally in his gauntlet, Thanos plans to wield his power over the Universe while the Avengers make a desperate attempt to stop him.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E14 - Crack in the System
2.plot: Iron Man and Captain America try to rebuild their relationship, until Cap discovers Iron Man's hiding dangerous information about an artificial intelligence unit named Ultron.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E15 - Avengers Disassembled
2.plot: An even more powerful Ultron resurfaces and takes control of Avengers Tower and Iron Man's Hall of Armors, leading to the destruction of the Avengers as we know them.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E16 - Small Time Heroes
2.plot: With the team divided and the Avengers Tower wiped out, Tony seeks help from Ant-Man. Learning he's busy fighting MODOK, Tony's team joins Ant-Man to stop the Pym Particle thief.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E17 - Secret Avengers
2.plot: Working for S.H.I.E.L.D. isn't everything Captain America's team had hoped when they're expected to unquestionably follow orders involving the Crimson Dynamo and The Winter Guard.

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E18 - The Ultron Outbreak
2.plot: The Avengers reunite when Captain America and Iron Man learn to appreciate their differences while trying to save the world from ultimate destruction at the hands of Ultron!

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E19 - The New Guy
2.plot: When Ant-Man joins the Avengers, Hawkeye resigns and trains his replacement on Monster Island, unaware that Red Skull is nearby planning to cloak himself using Dormammu's powers!

2.title: FR - Avengers Rassemblement - S02E20 - Terminal Velocity
2.plot: The Squadron Supreme's fastest member Speed Demon is on the loose and wreaking havoc throughout Avengers Tower. Hulk must save the day by fighting the high velocity villain. Meanwhile, the other Avengers face off against Hyperion.

meta.plot: Marvel’s Avengers Assemble est une série animée racontant des histoires directement en lien avec le film The Avengers. Iron Man est le leader de cette équipe réunissant les plus puissants des superhéros: Hulk, Captain America, Thor, Hawkeye, Black Widow et un nouveau venu, Falcon. Ils allieront leurs forces face à des menaces qu'un seul ne peut pas vaincre. Quand les Avengers se réunissent, le mal n'a aucune chance de l'emporter.

meta.plot: AJ est un mécano de 8 ans qui conduit son gros camion qu'il appelle « Blaze », le bolide le plus rapide d'Axle City. Les deux partent à l'aventure et trouvent sur leur chemin des problèmes de sciences et de maths. Ces problèmes, auxquels ils sont confrontés, sont causés par le rival de Blaze, Crusher, une semi-remorque qui fera tout pour vaincre ses rivaux jusqu'à la ligne d'arrivée.
Le devoir appelle, mais la princesse préférerait s'en jeter un... Bean l'électron libre énerve le roi quand elle met la pagaille avec ses acolytes, le démon et l'elfe.

meta.plot: Fifi Brindacier est une drôle de petite fille rousse au visage constellé de taches de rousseur, intrépide, joyeuse et dotée d'une force incroyable. Fille d'un pirate des mers du Sud, elle vit seule dans une grande maison en compagnie de son singe, surnommé « Monsieur Dupont », et de son cheval, surnommé « Oncle Alfred ». Ne connaissant aucune contrainte, elle entraîne ses petits voisins, Annika et Tommy, dans des aventures extraordinaires...

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E01 - Pippi Returns to Villa Villekula
1.plot: Pippi Longstocking arrives in a small Swedish town to take up residence in her Villa. The young girl lives with her companions, Horse and Mr. Nilsson (a monkey). All the townsfolk agree that the village will never quite be the same again. Annika and Tommy, Pippi's new neighbors, are excited about the adventures they are sure to share with their new friend; and the adults are certain that this eccentric little girl with her wild imagination, incredible strength and lack of parental supervision will cause no end of trouble.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E02 - Pippi Entertains Two Burglars
1.plot: Local crooks Thunder Karlson and Bloom are always looking for an easy and fast fortune. When they catch sight of Pippi's chest of gold, they are determined to get a share for themselves. Pippi proves to be more of an obstacle than they had bargained for.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E03 - Pippi Doesn't Sell Her House
1.plot: Two city slickers decide they want to buy Villa Villekulla. Thunder Karlson and Bloom set themselves up as real estate agents and try to sell Pippi's house, without her knowledge or consent. Pippi appears to be playing along, but all the while she is on top of the game and gets everyone so confused that the city folk vow never to step foot in a small town again. Thunder Karlson and Bloom are escorted to jail.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E04 - Pippi Goes Up in a Balloon
1.plot: Pippi finds a hot air balloon in the attic and decides to try it out with Annika and Tommy. They fly to the next town and inadvertently manage to assist in the capture of two crooks.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E05 - Pippi Goes to the South Seas
1.plot: Captain Longstocking docks in the village to pick up Pippi and take her with him to the South Seas. Annika and Tommy are given permission to go along and they all set sail for adventure on the high seas. Pippi teaches the Settergren's about life on board, teaching them to be look-outs and how to manage a pirate attack. Unbeknownst to the Captain and crew, Thunder Karlson and Bloom are castaways yet again in search of their fortunes. Unfortunately, they get very sea sick and the fortune is not as easy to access as they had hoped.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E06 - Pippi Meets Some Pearl Poachers
1.plot: When the Hoptoad docks on an exotic island, Pippi, Tommy and Annika are left in charge of the Island pearls. They have to use their wits and strength to outsmart a pair of Pearl Poachers. They travel the island foraging over the waterways and jungle to protect the pearls and their won safety.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E07 - Pippi Goes Home
1.plot: Following their stay on the exotic island it is time to go home. After rescuing Thunder Karlson and Bloom from a deserted island they set sail for home. En route they encounter many difficulties at sea including a windless channel and a tidal wave, until finally they are washed up on an unknown land. After settling this new continent they discover that perhaps they've seen this land before.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E08 - Pippi Enters the Big Race
1.plot: It is winter in the village and all the town is involved in winter sports. Each year there is a ski race between neighboring villages. Bengt the Bully challenges Pippi and we get the opportunity to see Pippi's skiing skills put to the test.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E09 - Pippi Enters a Horserace
1.plot: The local horse show attracts the very finest horses. Pippi decides to enter Horse. After much humiliation from the other contestants, and to the horror of Mrs. Prysselius, Horse comes through it all with flying colours. Although unconventional, he performs much better than the rest.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E10 - Pippi Meets a Master Criminal
1.plot: Thunder Karlson and Bloom consult a Criminal Manual in hopes of accomplishing the perfect crime and getting Pippi's gold. The Manual offers a lot of creative ways to carry out a crime. However, the Manual obviously didn't take into account Pippi Longstocking and her eccentric habits.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E11 - Pippi Is Shipwrecked
1.plot: Tommy and Annika are intrigued and their curiosity peaked by Pippi's tales of personal encounters with shipwrecks. They consider Pippi very lucky and their own lives quite boring. She tells them not to despair. If it's a shipwreck they want, then they'll just go find one right that very day. Pippi pulls a rowboat out of the sea, proceeds to repair it and they set off to encounter a shipwreck.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E12 - Pippi Saves the Old Folks
1.plot: When the Old Folks Home is being torn down and replaced by a newer, colder, less humane structure, Pippi comes to the rescue of the town's senior citizens. Not only does she prove that you can fight City Hall, but she also manages to save the lives of the Chairman's children in the process as the new building comes tumbling down.

1.title: FR - Fifi Brindacier - S01E13 - Pippi Goes to the Fair
1.plot: Annika and Tommy introduce Pippi to a local custom, the annual town fair. It is all a bit confusing to Pippi and she has her own unique interpretation for everything she encounters, including the fire breather, snake charmer, card reader, bumper cars and Ferris wheel. When Adolphe, the world's strongest man, challenges to take on anyone, he is not aware that Pippi Longstocking is in the audience. He regrets the challenge.

FR - Goldorak - S01E01 - Brothers of the Universe
1.plot: Koji Kaboto tries his OVT that he made with pieces of mecano. When flying, he is attacked by the UFOs of Vega. Fortunately Duke Fleed arrives on time to save the day (but not too quickly nonetheless). Koji does not actually know that Duke Fleed is the prince of Fleed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E02 - Prince of the Other World
1.plot: Koji discovers the identity of the Duke Fleed, but has no time to ask questions because Vega attacks. Duke Fleed and Koji unite their power and push back the enemy.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E03 - The Tragic Fiesta
1.plot: Dampee Makeeba organizes a party at the ranch and invites Koji and Duke Fleed. The latter has no time to eat anything because Vega attacks. Will he have the time to make it to Grendizer before the earth is ravaged? All bets are open...

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E04 - The Island of Fear
1.plot: Gandal wants to discover the hiding place of Grendizer. So he launches a massive attack. Koji tries to confront the enemies alone, but he only succeeds to crush himself on a deserted island. Finally Duke Fleed makes it there and saves the day.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E05 - The Pitfall of Death
1.plot: Koji, Hikaro, Goro and Bunta are taken in hostage. Actarus interrupts his siesta to free them.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E06 - Attack on Perlepolis
1.plot: Hikaro leaves for Perlepolis with Bunta. Their bus is attacked by a monster of Vega. Koji distracts the monster the time that Duke Fleed arrives (Grendizer has trouble to start up in winter).

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E07 - The Feast of the Wolves
1.plot: Janus, from the fearsome Ruins' Division, attacks Grendizer that is powerless in front of the brutality and the agility of his enemy.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E08 - The Radars are Off
1.plot: Blaki sets a trap to Grendizer by hiding mines in a cloud of spatial dust. Koji falls in the trap. Fortunately Duke Fleed helps him and destroys the Golgoth 8.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E09 - The Black Moon Camp
1.plot: Koji is captured with his UFO by the Vegans. Grendizer attacks the camp of the black Moon to save him.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E10 - Vega's Spy
1.plot: An inhabitant of the planet Rubi is contacted by Vega to explode the UFO carrier of Grendizer. The mission fails because of Duke Fleed and the Vegans try to kill the Rubinian. But Duke Fleed flies to his help.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E11 - The Day when the Sun will Stop
1.plot: The Vegans plan is to bring Grendizer to the shadow of the moon during the eclipse because Grendizer's systems will shut down temporarily under it and then destroy it.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E12 - Blood on Snow
1.plot: Daisuke and Kogi are sent to investigate an avalanche and to find survivors. They find a girl named Mirana who lost her memory. Back at Space Science Centre she begins to remember how a saucer destroyed her home.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E13 - By Iron and by Fire
1.plot: A new Vegan mecha comes to destroy Earth. It sucks power from the sun and burns everything in its path. Grendizer is damaged by it and has to withdraw. As the mecha attacks again Grendizer has to go to battle weaponless.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E14 - The Day of the Rising Sun
1.plot: Boss, Nuké, and Mocha are in this episode. They are visiting their old friend Koji Kabuto. The Vegans keep their eye on a mysterious orange robot that is found skiing near-by. Commander Blacki orders the Minifo to follow it and investigate.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E15 - Red Akerae
1.plot: Commander Yara is forced to create a mecha that creates earthquakes and use it on the city Kanto.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E16 - The Fiancé of Death
1.plot: A Vegan pilot lands near the Space Science Centre and makes Mr. Hayashi's fiancé, Kaori, a spy for him. She takes Dr. Umon as a hostage.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E17 - The Infernal Ride
1.plot: The Vegans begin building a base for their operations on Earth. The saucer "Giba Giba" begins to attack but Grendizer comes to save the day by saving a town and a mountain.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E18 - The New Time of the Caves
1.plot: Dr. Umon made a project so that Grendizer is able to launch without revealing his whereabouts to the enemy. Kabuto is control by the Vegans and fights Duke.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E19 - The Crushed Town
1.plot: A huge meteor is headed straight gives order to fire on the meteor and change its course to head for the planet Earth. The meteors are detected and Grendizer launches to intercept them before they hit land.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E20 - Earth in Danger
1.plot: Daisuke gets the suspicion that the Vegans may be planning to pull the moon down to Earth. Duke Freed launches Grendizer and follows Koji who already went to explore the area of Mount Kirofoki.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E21 - The Submerged Continents
1.plot: The Vegans plan to melt ice in the North Pole. This will cause the sea level to rise with catastrophic results to the shores on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E22 - The Slayers of the Sky
1.plot: The Vegans are planning to steal Dr. Chibana's new device so that they can use it to silence Duke Freed and his Grendizer.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E23 - The Flood of the New Worlds
1.plot: The Vegans continue their attempts to discover Grendizer's secret hideout as they are sure that the Space Science Centre has something to do with it. Hikaru finds out who Daisuke really is.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E24 - The Enforcer
1.plot: Commander Witer successfully sneaks into Earth as Dr. Space who is a well-known acquaintance of Dr. Umon and a reliable person so he can find Duke Fleed and kill him.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E25 - Fleed's Lovers
1.plot: uke Freed's childhood friends Nayda, brainwashed by the Vegans, attempts to put a bomb on Grendizer but Duke stops her. Nayda accuses Duke of being a traitor. Koji attempts to pilot Grendizer but is almost killed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E26 - The Edges of the Abyss
1.plot: Dr. Umon sends Koji and Hayashi on a mission in outer space to build a satellite station. At the same time, the Space Science Centre is surrounded by a huge Minifo saucer squadron.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E27 - Win or Perish
1.plot: Grendizer's delicate weapon systems malfunction and he finds himself struggling against the enemy. The Vegans arrive and descend upon the Center. Hikaru and Daisuke must fix Grendizer and save the Center.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E28 - The New Masters of Darkness
1.plot: General Zuril is a brilliant scientist who will try to find different ways of taking down Grendizer. Daisuke, Hikaru, and Goro are attacked by Vegans and Danbi puts on his gear and begins fighting them too.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E29 - The Fire Bird
1.plot: Vegans shrink the cells of the living body to make Harook become a young boy for a time so he can spy Space Science Centre. Harrok and Goro become friends but later the effects of the shrinking begin to wear off so Harook captures Goro.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E30 - The Lightning Rock
1.plot: A strange rock full of radiation energy lands on Earth and Dr. Umon can't make much of this new phenomenon. At the same time, the Vegans discover this strong source of energy and put it to use in their next saucer beast.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E31 - A Dreamer from Outer-Space
1.plot: The Boss, Koji, and Bunta go to the Boss Borot to begin their counterattack of the Vegan attack on them but will face some technical difficulties. Grendizer gets into some trouble while trying to help them but the Boss Borot will help Grendizer in the funniest way but will lose his Boss Spazer.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E32 - The Ghost Queen
1.plot: The Vegans send a woman by the name of Marian who looks identical to Duke Freed's mother who passed away on planet Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E33 - The Wings of Death
1.plot: The Vegans send a bird named "Zari Zari" to distroy Grendizer, but Duke remember a similar bird from his home planet Fleed and will use this knowledge to go and finish it off.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E34 - The Mercenary of Oppression
1.plot: Vega promised Commander Gos that if he kills Duke Freed then Vega would spare the Wolf Planet from Vegan brutality.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E35 - The First Raid
1.plot: General Gandal assigns Commander Beetle with his saucer beast to attack the Space Science Centre from underground. Meanwhile, Koji Kabuto's new Double Spazer ship has just been completed and Koji is ready to be air-born again.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E36 - The Invincible Cosmos
1.plot: Dr. Umon calls Daisuke and Koji to show them the way that Grendizer and Double Spazer can unite together and fly. The objective of this is to minimize the need for Grendizer to have to lock in and out of Spazer as these are Grendizer's weakest moments and he is helpless in them.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E37 - A Star is Dead
1.plot: The Vegan plan is to steal a huge capsule full of Super Uranium from Earth. Vegan forces are dispatched immediately to do just that.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E38 - Darkness Makers
1.plot: Hikaru becomes a pilot. Duke Freed faces another Vegan saucer beast loaded with Vegatron rays, and Koji nearly gets captured by the Minifo after gathering the energy but manages to escape very injured.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E39 - The Patrol of Eagles
1.plot: Danbi tells Daisuke that his daughter is outstanding and capable of helping him and Koji. Daisuke disagrees insisting that war and sport are two different things. Finally Daisuke will allow Hikaru to be part of the team after her vital help.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E40 - The Awakening of Volcanoes
1.plot: A series of explosions start to occur under the sea and General Zuril wastes no time in discovering that this is raw Uranium. Saucer beast "Boi Boi" is launched to go and get this energy as this saucer beast naturally collects Uranium. At the same time Dr. Umon is alerted by these explosions which are close to an island with a Uranium capsule.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E41 - Baptism of Fire
1.plot: Hikaru loses her consciousness during training and Duke Freed gets injured and his old wound gets worse. The Vegans begin their attack and Daisuke goes to the battle even though he is injured.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E42 - Peril in Abode
1.plot: Dr. Umon's Space Science Centre is undergoing some major changes to keep up with Vega's attacks. A super computer is installed in the base, and turning it on will be the final step. The Vegans plan to get rid of the base and leave Grendizer without a place to hide.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E43 - The Victory of Eagles
1.plot: A strange meteor heads slowly towards Earth and Koji will go unilaterally and see what it's all about. After nearly getting blinded by a ray that came out of the meteor, Koji's Double Spazer begins to exit the Earth's atmosphere.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E44 - When Dogs are Loosened
1.plot: A young man by the name of Hiyoshi is very interested in searching for ancient evidence to prove that spacemen came to Earth in the past. He goes to look at walls in a near-by cave for ancient scripts to prove his theory, but the villagers think he is crazy. Hundreds of years ago, the Vegans had sent some of their people to Earth. There still is a metal on the wall that they used for landing, and this metal cannot be detected by the radar.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E45 - Ants and Men
1.plot: With his telescope, Goro spots a meteor that splits in two with each piece landing in a different mountain. These actually contain eggs of the Vegan ants. When Goro tells everyone about it he is not taken seriously. Soon Grendizer and Drill Spazer will unite to face the new danger.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E46 - The Ballet of Sharks
1.plot: Vegan robot sharks land one night and are hidden in a public pool for their next plan. Koji finds himself a hostage of the Vegans who tell him about their plans to take all of the people as hostages.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E47 - The Ignited Lake
1.plot: Danbi induces a race between Daisuke and Koji. Koji takes it to seriously. The group goes camping near a lake. Vegans begin to descent in the lake and then the Space Science Centre suddenly gets attacked by missiles from the near-by lake where the Vegans stay hidden.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E48 - World in Fusion
1.plot: Duke Freed unites with Koji and the Drill Spazer to chase a Vegan saucer beast. The Vegans make an acid swamp to sink the Space Science Centre.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E49 - The Last Survivor
1.plot: Maria tries to kill Duke, thinking the person who pilots Grendizer is evil but during the fight Duke necklace falls and the siblings discover who each other is.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E50 - The Four-Headed Eagle
1.plot: Maria the new member on the team, is able to control Grendizer and Marine Spazer. She also has the ability to foresee events so she is able to save Koji from Vegans.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E51 - The Black Star
1.plot: The Vegan plan is to make this moon enter the Earth's atmosphere and cause a catastrophe. The battle between Vegans and Grendizer takes longer than anticipated and it is too late for Grendizer to fire the missile.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E52 - The Generation Of Monsters
1.plot: General Zuril orders a powerful attack with his latest saucer beast "Domo Domo" to defeat Grendizer before General Dantos gets the chance.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E53 - The Beast
1.plot: Duke Freed will go after Hikaru who is hostige on foot not using Grendizer and help her escape from the giant beast while Koji takes Grendizer back for repairs.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E54 - The Snake
1.plot: The Vegan built a base underwater knowing that Grendizer cannot withstand depths great than 400 meters.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E55 - The Loch Ness Monster
1.plot: Vegans gather some fuel from an industrial island. General Zuril instructs General Gandal on what to do but he doesn't listen and he gets into trouble because his unilateral action revealed that the Vegans have a base on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E56 - The Lynx of Outer-Space
1.plot: Dr. Umon launches a satellite into space to track Vegan movements on Earth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E57 - The Monster And The Child
1.plot: Koji and Maria are on their vacation in Tokyo, they get into a fight as usual and split up.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E58 - The Lookalike
1.plot: The Vegans make a false Grendizer that attacked Earth people so the real Grendizer will be hated.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E59 - The Commando
1.plot: A group of Vegan kids come to Earth and hold hostages the people inside the observatory.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E60 - Rats
1.plot: The Vegans attract a huge number of rats to use for their next mission. These rats are implanted with Vegatron bombs for the purpose of blowing up different targets in Tokyo.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E61 - Pegasus
1.plot: Toko 1, Toko 2, Toko 3, and Toko 4 are Vegan agents taking appearances of other people trying to distroy Space Science Centre.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E62 - Swans
1.plot: Swans are implanted with Vegatron missiles for the next Vegan plan. Duke Freed is forced to kill the swans and must head to the city and face saucer beast "Go Go".

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E63 - The Polar Bear
1.plot: Kirika, a Vegan scientist, is sent to freeze with her new weapon Duke Fleed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E64 - 5 Minutes To Die
1.plot: The Vegans invent a bomb and General Gandal threatens to blow up Tokyo is Grendizer does not surrender.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E65 - A Great Between The Greats
1.plot: The Vegans fire a big group of missiles towards Tokyo. The Grendizer Team launches to destroy the missiles before they hit the city.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E67 - Diving Operation
1.plot: General Zuril launches an attack on the Space Science Centre with air balloon bombs. Koji gets caught by the Vegans and held as hostage.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E68 - The Great Pain
1.plot: A young man from Freed named Kane is a loyal soldier of the Vegans. He comes to Earth to fight. Maria tries to face him and they both crash. Soon she will realize that Kane was her childhood friend from Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E68 - The Great Pain
1.plot: A young man from Freed named Kane is a loyal soldier of the Vegans. He comes to Earth to fight. Maria tries to face him and they both crash. Soon she will realize that Kane was her childhood friend from Freed.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E69 - Like Father, Like Son
1.plot: The son of Zouril,Zuril Jr. wants to fight Grendizer but Zouril doesn't want him to. Zuril Jr. sacrifice himself for his father in the end.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E70 - The Imposter
1.plot: Maria has a nightmare about her father being hostage. She goes to the cave where she saw her father in her dream along with Koji where she learns the truth.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E71 - Best Friend
1.plot: Moros, Duke's best friend from Freed was made to believe that Duke Freed destroyed Freed by Vega and now comes to Earth to kill Duke.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E72 - Princess In Love
1.plot: Princess Rubina, Duke Fleed's fiancé comes to Earth to tell Duke that his planet is no longer polluted but dies after being shoot by one of Vega's generals.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E73 - For The Love Of Earth
1.plot: King Vega prepares to attack Earth but Duke and company are ready to stop him with the help of Grendizer and Spazers.

1.title: FR - Goldorak - S01E74 - This Is Not Goodbye
1.plot: Duke finally destroys King Vega but he and Maria must return to planet Fleed.

meta.plot: Vega, Grand Stratéguerre de la planète Stykadès, s'empare d'Euphor, une planète pacifique qu'il va ravager avec sa flotte de soucoupes et de robots géants. Durant l'attaque qui mènera à la destruction finale d'Euphor, la famille royale est exterminée. Actarus, fils du roi et prince, parvient à s'échapper après s'être emparé de Goldorak, le plus perfectionné des robots mis au point par les scientifiques de la planète, et s'enfuit vers la Terre. Il est recueilli par la professeur Procyon qui dirige le Centre de recherches spatiales. Poursuivant sa conquête de nouvelles planètes, Vega établit une base sur la face cachée de la Lune, à partir de laquelle il compte lancer l'offensive sur la planète bleue. Actarus se voit alors dans l'obligation d'utiliser Goldorak afin d'éviter que la Terre subisse le même sort que sa planète natale.

1.plot: It is Christmas Eve of 2025. BF showcases their new product. Everyone praises Jayu, the CEO, but the primary industry suffers because of BF. Two other incidents occur on the same day. A stockbreeder falls on Jayu's vehicle...

1.title: EN - Blood Free [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Chaewoon becomes Jayu's bodyguard. They attempt to fix the hacking but realize governmental power is needed. Jayu asks Seonu Jae, the prime minister, for help. A BF chief researcher gets in a car accident. Jayu suspects these incidents are related, and Chaewoon finds something suspicious about the hacking.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Just when Chaewoon thinks he found a lead, he faces with an even bigger tragedy.

1.title: FR - Blood Free (SUB) - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: The police suspect Chaewoon and arrest him. Seonu Jae takes interest in Chaewoon.

meta.plot: After diving down a rabbit hole of tangled leads, a former bodyguard finds himself recruited to protect the CEO of a controversial lab-grown meat company who is also a survivor of the fateful attack that changed his life.

Anna and Henrik are thrust into a dangerous underworld when their son brings a heinous crime to their doorstep. Parental instincts quickly overcome morality as the couple does everything in their power to protect their family and future.

1.title: FR - A Good Family - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Anna covers up her son’s crime to protect her family. Henrik wants Niko to leave the country so that Anna won’t find out what Niko has done.

1.title: FR - A Good Family - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Anna and Henrik both protect their son, each in their own way, without telling each other the truth. Anna smuggles Niko away and begins to lie to the other cops to save her son.

1.title: FR - Carpe DM with Juanpa - S01E01 - Ride a Bronco
1.plot: Juanpa and fellow social media star and close friend, Mario Ruiz, dive into cowboy culture when they travel to Texas and Oklahoma to work as ranch hands and train with a professional rodeo coach. Ultimately, both Juanpa and Mario attempt to cram a lifetime of arduous training into a 3-day adventure with the goal of accomplishing one of the most difficult and dangerous sports feats in the world: riding a bucking bronco for 8 seconds.

1.title: FR - Carpe DM with Juanpa - S01E02 - Mt. Rainier
1.plot: In a harrowing and dangerous adventure, Juanpa and his girlfriend, Macarena Achaga, head to just outside Seattle, Washington to attempt to climb the tallest mountain in the Cascade Mountain range.

1.title: FR - Carpe DM with Juanpa - S01E03 - Monster Jam
1.plot: Juanpa goes on an adventure to live out a childhood dream in the world of monster trucks. Joining him is his friend Juca Viapri, a car and truck expert. Together, they travel to Cleveland, Ohio where they take giant construction vehicles through an obstacle course, meet a monster truck superfan who builds his own behemoth machines, and ultimately train with Monster Jam champion Tom Meents, who gives Juanpa a chance to prove that he is capable of jumping a 14,000-pound monster truck.

meta.plot: Nous sommes en 1536. L'avocat Matthew Shardlake voit sa vie bouleversée lorsque Thomas Cromwell l'envoie enquêter sur un meurtre suspect au sein du monastère isolé de Scarnsea. Mensonges, leurres et corruption sont légion et il devient rapidement clair que le meurtre n'est pas le premier à avoir eu lieu. Shardlake se retrouve pris dans un filet de mensonges menaçant son intégrité, mais aussi sa vie.

1.title: FR - Shardlake : Détective de l'ombre - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Shardlake travels to Scarnsea to begin his investigation into a brutal murder at a remote monastery.

1.title: FR - Shardlake : Détective de l'ombre - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Shardlake hears a shocking allegation that incriminates Cromwell, and could put himself in danger.

1.title: FR - Shardlake : Détective de l'ombre - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Another death leads Shardlake to a gruesome discovery, changing the course of the investigation.

1.title: FR - Shardlake : Détective de l'ombre - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Shardlake feels the wrath of Cromwell, but he returns in hope that he may finally unravel the truth.

meta.plot: Adam Price mène une vie idyllique : il a un bon travail, deux fils merveilleux et son mariage semble sans faille. Mais son bonheur va soudainement voler en éclats lorsque « The Stranger » dévoile un secret choquant au sujet de sa femme.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A stranger approaches Adam Price with a disturbing allegation about his wife, Corinne. Meanwhile, detectives Johanna and Wes take on a bizarre case.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E02 - Episode 2

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: While the police question Mike, Daisy makes a confession to Thomas. Adam's search for clues about Corinne leads him to another victim of the stranger.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The boys make a discovery that sets Adam on Corinne's trail — and dredges up an old secret of his own. Kimberly gives Johanna a lead about Heidi.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Adam tells Johanna about his encounter with the stranger. The kids spy on Olivia's house. Martin's appeals finally run out.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: A shocking confession sends Adam reeling. Armed with new information, Johanna sets up a meeting — putting Katz in the hot seat.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: With help from an unlikely ally, Adam uncovers a startling secret. Backed into a corner, Katz makes a rash decision.

1.title: FR - Intimidation - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: A violent confrontation leads to new revelations, and the truth about Corinne's disappearance finally emerges.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E01 - Saddlebags
1.plot: On the heels of a lavish birthday blowout, Charlie suddenly finds his business empire in jeopardy as those around him contend with crises of their own.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E02 - The Big Squash
1.plot: Charlie races to entice a potential investor. Roger devotes his attention to his first criminal case. Raymond tries to flip a setback into a settlement.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E03 - The Takedown
1.plot: A shocking spectacle breeds tensions at Turpmtine. Roger's aspirations to help Conrad take a hit. At a charity gala, old acquaintances reconnect.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E04 - Tick Tick
1.plot: Conrad adjusts to his new reality. Raymond takes a huge gamble. Charlie finds strength after surgery only to be reminded of his ongoing financial woes.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E05 - Push Comes to Shove
1.plot: With his options dwindling, Charlie considers taking a dubious deal. Conrad's bail hangs in the balance. Raymond's manipulative game loses momentum.

1.title: FR - Un homme, un vrai - S01E06 - Judgment Day
1.plot: Roger demands justice at Conrad's trial. Raymond exploits his enemy's weakness. After a stunning press conference, Charlie fights to protect his own.

meta.plot: Au bord de la faillite et aux prises avec des ennemis sans pitié, un magnat de l'immobilier d'Atlanta fait tout pour remonter la pente alors que son empire s'effondre.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E01 - Our 17th Spring
1.plot: Shun is now a Second year High School student, together with his childhood friends Yūta, Yūki, and Kaname. During their break at the rooftop, Kaname wants Yūki to join a club, but turns out to be a bit difficult for them to find him one.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E02 - The Day the Tulips Bloomed
1.plot: Shun, waiting for his friends to eat lunch together finds a girl with a scraped knee. He attempted to confront her, but she ran away. While the girl was stunned at the hallway, Shun succeeded in chasing her, and gives her a bandage. The next day, Shun finds a letter that states that he will get cursed.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E03 - The Boy With Straw-colored Hair
1.plot: A new student came to Yūki and Kaname's class. His name is Chizuru Tachibana, a half-Japanese student from Germany. He, seated next to Yūki, stated that they were played together when they were kids. However, Yūki doesn't remember him at all.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E04 - Noisy Medicine
1.plot: After an evening with his friends, Kaname catches a cold in which was not the worst of his troubles for today.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E05 - Sometime During Summer
1.plot: It's the first day of summer. Chizuru decides on inviting some of his friends to go out, but ended up being rejected. Shun decides to invite everyone to the summer festival.

1.title: EN - You and Me - S01E06 - Glasses and Et Cetera
1.plot: At Kaname's house, Shun, and his friends decided to cut Shun's hair. While preparing to study, they then talk about when did Kaname started wearing glasses.

meta.plot: The story revolves around four teens - the good-looking twins Asaba Yuuta and Yuuki, the effeminate Matsuoka Shun, and the class head Tsukahara Kaname - who have known each other since early childhood. While they are not necessarily good or bad friends, they continue to hang out well into high school. The half-Japanese transfer student Tachibana Chizuru joins the circle of friends in this comedy about the everyday life of adolescence.

1.title: FR - Prisoner - S01E01 - Episode 1

FR - Prisoner - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Prisoner - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Prisoner - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Prisoner - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Wrongfully accused of a crime she didn't commit, 13 year old Guadalupe Santos is sentenced to 30 years in jail, while in jail she gives birth to a baby girl who is taken from her by her older sister Milagros. 15 years later she escapes jail and meets with Daniel Moncada who turns out to be the brother of the man she was accused of killing.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E01 - Refined Aggression
1.plot: When the Duke of Halstead dies, his second son inherits everything, including the title, house and grounds — plus a whole heap of trouble.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E02 - Tackle Tommy Woo Woo
1.plot: The toffs and their gamekeeper hunt a new kind of prey. Susie enlists some help to clean up the mess, and Halstead Manor is blessed with a holy visitor.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E03 - Where's My Weed At?
1.plot: Jimmy gets distracted on the job. As supply chain issues delay deliveries, the Horniman brothers take a risky ride to placate a dissatisfied customer.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E04 - An Unsympathetic Gentleman
1.plot: Susie is keen to expand the business. Eddie is determined that it won't be on his estate, so the Hornimans search for alternative locations.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E05 - I've Hundreds of Cousins
1.plot: Distribution issues in Europe and a theft on the farm cause a headache for Eddie and Susie — until they make a new acquaintance who can help them out.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E06 - All Eventualities
1.plot: Eddie's doubts about Susie continue to grow. But there's 15 million pounds of dirty money to be laundered before she'll consider leaving the estate.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E07 - Not Without Danger
1.plot: Bent on vengeance, Susie goes against her father's orders. Eddie offers to help her but is less certain than ever about where his allegiances lie.

1.title: FR - The Gentlemen - S01E08 - The Gospel According to Bobby Glass
1.plot: A familiar face returns to settle a score with Freddy. Bobby decides it's time to retire and wants Eddie and Susie to make the necessary arrangements.

meta.plot: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to an enormous weed empire — and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E01 - Aang
1.plot: An Airbender comes to grips with his new reality as war erupts. A century later, a pair of Water Tribe siblings make a discovery that changes everything.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E02 - Warriors
1.plot: Aang, Katara and Sokka arrive at a small Island, home to elite warriors named after Avatar Kyoshi. The Fire Nation gets wind of the Avatar's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E03 - Omashu
1.plot: News of a traitor puts the trio at odds in Omashu, where a mechanist and rebels with a charming leader muddle their plans to protect the Earth Kingdom.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E04 - Into the Dark
1.plot: In captivity, Aang meets a king with a taste for games. To find their friend, the siblings must navigate a dark tunnel — and put their differences aside.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E05 - Spirited Away
1.plot: When the group lands in the Spirit World for a rescue mission, they come face to face with dangerous threats, painful memories and a mysterious entity.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E06 - Masks
1.plot: A desperate Aang visits Avatar Roku for help on his journey as the Fire Nation closes in on him. At their fortress, a masked intruder breaks Aang out.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E07 - The North
1.plot: As an attack on the Northern Water Tribe looms, Katara challenges a master Waterbender, Sokka meets a princess, and Aang takes Kuruk's words to heart.

1.title: FR - Avatar: The Last Airbender - S01E08 - Legends
1.plot: Zhao leads the Fire Nation into the North with a bold plan to weaken the Water Tribe. When the battle takes a dark turn, Aang enters a powerful state.

meta.plot: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.
Carina brings her family together for a traditional Swedish midsummer, but the happy occasion goes awry when long-held secrets start to come to light.

1.title: FR - Midsummer Night - S01E01 - Break-ups and Falling in Love
1.plot: Carina invites the entire family to celebrate midsummer and prepares to share some major news.

1.title: FR - Midsummer Night - S01E02 - Lust
1.plot: Confused that Lysander also has been invited to the party, Hanne has questions that need answers. Darius and his parents show who they really are.

1.title: FR - Midsummer Night - S01E03 - Envy
1.plot: Secrets flare up in every corner of the garden. Lysander faces life-changing news, while Håkan and Sara disagree on the future.

1.title: FR - Midsummer Night - S01E04 - Reconciliation
1.plot: Johannes is tired of keeping up the facade. Petronella takes a step to open up to him. Helena decides to make a confession.

1.title: FR - Midsummer Night - S01E05 - Forgiveness
1.plot: The family comes together as they grapple with Carina and Johannes' news. Darius and Hanne make a big decision, and the party changes course.

meta.plot: An old case is wrenched open when a reporter goes missing, leading his web sleuth daughter to a small mountain town haunted by a sect, secrecy and death.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E01 - Still on Fire
1.plot: Convinced that her missing dad is in danger, Ida follows his trail to a town in the French Alps. A second disappearance brings an old case to light.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E02 - The 13th Disciple
1.plot: As Ida and Jaro look to old VHS tapes for clues, a suspicious Giovanna visits the Arcacia lab. Trouble brews ahead of the annual festival of Lévionna.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E03 - Trust No One
1.plot: Gio and Ida find common ground as they explore hidden mountain terrain. Jaro and Roméo seek out a recluse who may know the truth about Roxane Vial.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E04 - Levia Borelis
1.plot: Gio's theories create cracks in her marriage. Ida tries to make sense of DNA tests as Jaro and Roméo visit a psychiatric hospital in a state of chaos.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E05 - A Darker Shadow
1.plot: Jaro and Gio pair up after her son makes a disturbing discovery in the mines. Roméo is the guest of honor at a tense dinner with Hari and his mother.

1.title: FR - Anthracite - S01E06 - The Point of Equilibrium
1.plot: As terror ensues inside the mine, a riot breaks out at the Arcacia lab. Gio desperately attempts to locate the group in the tunnel before it's too late.

meta.plot: A grifter in 1960s New York is hired to convince a wealthy man's son to return home from Italy and begins a life of deceit, fraud and murder.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E01 - I A HARD MAN TO FIND
1.plot: Tom Ripley's life of petty crime in New York City detours with an offer to bring a wealthy man's wayward son home from Europe.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E02 - II SEVEN MERCIES
1.plot: On Italy's Amalfi Coast, Tom settles into Dickie's grand villa, but not without arousing suspicion from his girlfriend Marge.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E03 - III SOMMERSO
1.plot: With funds low and his future in Italy in jeopardy, Tom puts a dark scheme into motion.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E04 - IV LA DOLCE VITA
1.plot: Tom must deal with Marge's deep skepticism before embarking on a new, fictitious life in Rome.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E05 - V LUCIO
1.plot: Ensconced in a lovely Rome apartment, Tom's perfect life is threatened by the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E06 - VI SOME HEAVY INSTRUMENT
1.plot: A ghastly discovery leads Rome police to Tom's doorstep, beginning a game of cat and mouse with its lead investigator.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E07 - VII MACABRE ENTERTAINMENT
1.plot: As Inspector Ravini expands his murder investigation, an elusive Tom plots his next moves from Sicily.

1.title: FR - RIPLEY - S01E08 - VIII NARCISSUS
1.plot: Tom reinvents himself again, creating an enviable life in Venice — as long as his lies hold.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E01 - Superpower
1.plot: Porn icon Rocco Siffredi makes a shocking announcement. Even at the top of his career, demons dating back to his childhood in Italy still haunt him.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E02 - The Flesh
1.plot: Young Rocco leaves everything behind to join Tommaso in Paris, starting a journey of self-discovery through the force that rules the world: sex.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E03 - The Beast
1.plot: In the '80s, torn between a turbulent career kickoff and an increasingly unstable relationship with Tommaso, Rocco feels a lack of purpose in his life.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E04 - The Dream
1.plot: Rocco Siffredi is born. As he navigates his new identity, his old self is still on the back of his mind. Tommaso and Lucia deliver great news.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E05 - The Island
1.plot: After a revealing on-set encounter, Rocco realizes that balancing his love life with his career will be harder than he'd expected.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E06 - Resurrection of the Bodies
1.plot: As his mother's health deteriorates, Rocco returns home. Lucia prompts him to reconsider his relationships with women. Tommaso continues to spiral.

1.title: FR - Supersex - S01E07 - The Cock Comes Last
1.plot: In Cannes in 1994, Rocco finds a woman to lead his next movie — and she ends up changing his life. A decade later, someone reappears with a proposal.

meta.plot: Inspired by true events, this is the story of how Rocco Siffredi escaped a humble life and emerged as the world's greatest porn star.

Kaoruko Moeta is a 15-year-old high school student and 4-panel manga artist. After moving to a dorm especially for female manga artists, she meets shoujo manga artist Koyume, teen romance manga artist Ruki, and shounen manga artist Tsubasa. Every day, they'll work all through the night trying to ink and finish their work!

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Got the Worst Results on the Survey?!
1.plot: Kaoruko Moeta (Pen name: Kaos) is a brand new 4-panel manga artist, trying to get into the business. However, she finds out that her series had gotten the worst survey results. Her editor worries about her wellbeing and suggests that she go live at an all-girls dorm for manga artists.

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Back to School
1.plot: After Kaos and Koyume start living at the dorm for a while, they all decide to go take a trip into the city together. There, they decide to go to a crepe shop and a huge art store and enjoy their time together.

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Jiggle Jiggle Bounce
1.plot: After her experience at the crepe shop, Kaos creates a new manga storyboard and takes it to Amisawa, but it’s immediately declined because of the shape it’s in. She goes back to the dorm to ask everyone what she did wrong and...

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Scuffling Wildly Rendezvous
1.plot: Because of a deadline coming up, Ruki ends up staying up two nights in a row. She ends up going to school in this condition and can’t help but feel sleepy, despite how earnestly she usually tries at school. However, this dazed state she’s in makes her look sexier than usual, causing a stir in class...

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Amisawa-san, Do You Cosplay?
1.plot: Kaos and the other girls end up at the beach, solely because Koyume tells them, “Because it’s summer!” However, Koyume was the only one who brought a swimsuit, because she’s the only one who had the idea of actually having fun at the beach, so she takes them to the rental shop so they can all get swimsuits.

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I'll Go Shave All My Hair Off
1.plot: One hot summer night, Kaos spots someone suspicious while she’s in the bath. She looks in that direction again, but no one’s there. Kaos is terrified and heads back to her room with Koyume... But then a mysterious dark shadow chases them from behind!

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Is This Heaven!?
1.plot: Koyume lands a serialized series ! Kaos is happy for her but is sad that her own skills aren’t improving. She then decides to help Fuura-senpai with her manga and ends up with surprising results.

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Woof Meow Meow Woof Festival
1.plot: Kaos ends up having another storyboard rejected. She thought she finally had something really good, so she’s rather shocked. All the girls back at the dorm try to make her feel better. Meanwhile, all the girls have tests coming up, but will they be okay?

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Kaospiral
1.plot: No matter how hard she tries to come up with a new idea, Kaos can’t seem to draw a new storyboard and she descends into the Kaospiral. Meanwhile, Koyume also hasn’t finished her storyboard, so she plans to go out for a change of pace. Kaos is amazed that Koyume has all these ideas that she would never think of so she tries to adopt the Koyumethod herself and goes out with her.

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - It's Not Fair That Michiru Gets All The Love
1.plot: It’s now Christmas season. Kaos, Koyume, and the matron are all busy setting up the Christmas tree. Meanwhile, Ruki keeps walking back and forth in front of the dorm with a grim face for some reason...

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - My Life Has Reached Its Peak
1.plot: The girls receive an occupational survey at school and of course, they all choose “manga artist” as their first choice. However, they’re supposed to write down at least one other option. They talk about what their other options could be, but Tsubasa doesn’t seem to want to do anything else...

1.title: EN - Comic Girls [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Farewell, You Wonderful Manga Artists
1.plot: Kaos gets her first guest spot! The first part did really well and was popular with readers, but the other girls at the dorm helped her draw it. She has to now draw the second part, but everyone has to leave the dorm so it can be remodeled, so she’s on her own. Kaos feels rather down, when she gets a visit from a rather unexpected visitor...

meta.plot: The world can be healed through music, and these three girls want to make it happen. Meet Kana Fujii, Reimi Itsushiro, and Hibiki Morishima—three healers-in-training at the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic learning the art of healing patients’ illnesses and injuries by singing. Join them on this musical adventure of kindhearted, powerful miracles sung to heal the world.

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kana Fujii, Healer (Apprentice)
1.plot: First-year high school students Kana, Reimi, and Hibiki are apprentices at the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic, where the power of healing through song is combined with conventional medicine. One day when the girls' teacher is out, one of the clinic's patients takes a sudden turn for the worse. Is there nothing these apprentices can do to help?

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Can I Take a Picture? Or Maybe a Video?
1.plot: Sonia Yanagi, a C-rank healer who sees Ria as a rival, meets up with Kana to take her measure. While they're out, they find a pregnant woman suffering in the park. Sonia begins treatment with Kana as her assitant, but when the woman's condition takes a turn for the worse...

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Cleanup, Run • Run • Run
1.plot: After a study party and lots of prayer, the girls take their provisional license exam! But the minute the test is over, they feel completely drained. Ria takes them out to the town's annual sports day to cheer them up... where they happen to run into Sonia, who has competition in mind!

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - First Steps, Horror, and a First Job
1.plot: Having passed their provisional license exam, the girls are called in to support a surgeon with their song. But before they accept the job, they have some training to do...

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Blue Skies, Green Mountains, River Battles and the Galaxy Station
1.plot: The girls of the Karasuma Phoniatric Clinic visit Hibiki's family in the country. While wandering the countryside, the girls' friendship grows deeper as they learn more about Hibiki's past and the reason they each became healers.

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Become My Servant • Russian Food and Sweet Dreams
1.plot: The Karasuma Girls help out at the Honosaka Clinic where they see a surprisingly hard-working side of Sonia. But it turns out Sonia also has plans for Kana at their school's upcoming culture festival...

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Culture Festival Full of Surprises
1.plot: The culture festival is a huge success! ...Or so it appears. At the last moment, something happens to threaten the final stage performance. Can the healer girls step in to fill the hole in the schedule?!

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Love Maids • You're Fired
1.plot: Reimi's caregiver, Aoi, has received an invitation to follow her dream of studying piano overseas. When she seems reluctant to take it, Reimi takes action of her own.

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Best Guarantee • Buy the CD
1.plot: The girls have been asked to support Ria during a surgery... but the patient is Ria's old teacher, and the hospital's director! Despite their nerves, the girls are determined to give it their best shot!

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Halloween • Masquerade • Butterfly!
1.plot: Halloween is just around the corner and the girls aim to make the event memorable. But first everyone needs to go shopping!

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Sharks and Training Camp! Let's Climb Together!
1.plot: The three apprentices of Ria Karasuma are about  to become true healer-sisters, but as the test approaches, they can no longer sing harmoniously. Ria therefore offers to send them to a training course, under the benevolent supervision of Aoi.

1.title: EN - Healer Girl [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - We're C-Rank Healers!
1.plot: Having passed the exam to become a C-rank cured-sister, the apprentices of the Karasuma clinic go on a training course each on their own. Reimi will train in Sonia's clinic and Hibiki will work in the hospital. Kana goes much further, to the United States, to pursue her dream.

meta.plot: These small girls are ready to make it big! All 12 or younger and under 149 centimeters tall (4'11"), these aspiring pop idols dream of performing for thousands of people.
