Teru and Dimple run into trouble after a strenuous battle, and the boss from Claw finally shows himself...

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S01E11 - Master ~Leader~
1.plot: Mob, Ritsu, and Teru are trapped in a room where they can't use their powers. And then, someone rather unexpected shows up in front of them: Mob's master and self-proclaimed psychic, Reigen. Somehow, Reigen is mistakenly thought as the boss of Claw, and easily manages to get inside and successfully saves Mob and the others. However, there is no way that Ishiguro would let them get away with this. As they try to escape the 7th Division, the upper echelon stands in their way.

1.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S01E12 - Mob and Reigen ~A Giant Tsuchinoko Appears~
1.plot: Mob is finally pushed to his limit when he has to face Sakurai, Muraki, Matsuo and Ishiguro of the upper echelon. But then, he comes to a rather surprising decision...

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E01 - Ripped Apart ~Someone Is Watching~
2.plot: Reigen received a phone call at his office, the Spirits and Such Consultation Office. The client asked him to find out what the black shadow that kept destroying his fields actually was. Meanwhile, back at Salt Middle School, Kamuro announces that he's going to resign from the position of student council president. Elections to decide a new student council president are going to be held and Mezato convinces Mob to run as a candidate, but...

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E02 - Urban Legends ~Encountering Rumors~
2.plot: Because of the lack of clients visiting or calling his office, Reigen decides to take his business on the road. They go to Cuticle City where there seems to be various urban legend sightings. They immediately get a request to deal with something called the Dragger. With the help of a local psychic they happened to meet named Shinra Banshomaru they go to take care of the Dragger as well as the other urban legends that plague the city.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E03 - One Danger After Another ~Degeneration~
2.plot: Reigen sets up an official homepage for his Spirits and Such Consultation Office and he immediately starts to get jobs left and right, including a middle-aged man asking Reigen to curse someone and a woman who's being haunted by a ghost. As he was listening to their problems, Mob realizes something. Why do people treat humans and spirits so differently? Meanwhile, Reigen gets another request from a group of college students that want to take a photo at a haunted location, but...

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E04 - Inside ~Evil Spirit~
2.plot: Reigen and Mob receive a new job. This time, their client is a wealthy man named Asagiri Masashi. He's not just rich, but super rich, so Reigen and Mob head to his mansion only to find other self-proclaimed psychics there as well. One of the psychics there happens to include the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union, Jodo Kirin. The job is apparently to exorcise the evil spirit that is apparently possessing his daughter, Minori.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E05 - Discord ~Choices~
2.plot: Mob gets trapped inside a parallel world created by Mogami Keiji. Minori ends up transferring to his class, and Mob becomes the target of bullying. He can't ask anyone for help, and his negative emotions start to build inside. The truth behind the tragedy that Mogami went through when he was alive comes to light. Meanwhile, Reigen and the others were waiting for Mob to regain consciousness back at the Asagiri mansion. Dimple attempts to save Mob by infiltrating Minori's body.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E06 - Poor, Lonely, Whitey
2.plot: After hanging out with the Body Improvement Club and Telepathy Club more, Mob starts to feel joy like he'd never felt before. One day while he's having fun with them, he gets a call from Reigen, spoiling his fun. Mob asks Reigen to stop summoning him so suddenly, and Reigen just handles the situation in his usual overbearing manner. And because of something very minor, a gap forms between them. Reigen is forced to go on jobs without Mob, forcing him to reexamine himself.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E07 - Cornered ~True Identity~
2.plot: After splitting up with Mob, Reigen starts doing a lot of the jobs on his own. He then gets an offer to appear on a TV program. Reigen is ecstatic and accepts the offer, but this was all a trap set by Jodo Kirin, the president of the Rising Sun Spiritual Union. Jodo corners him during the live filming of the show and the fact that Reigen is a fraud comes to light. Reigen gets bashed from all sides and ends up having to hold a press conference...

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E08 - Even Then ~Continue Forward~
2.plot: The day for the annual marathon and Salt Middle School was drawing nearer. Mob proclaims that if he places in the top 10 he'll tell Tsubomi how he feels about her. Everyone around him cheers Mob on and he starts training hard every day until the day of the event. Meanwhile, Tsubomi and her friend Miki go to Reigen's Spirits and Such Consultation Office with a request. Ritsu happened to be at the office, helping out in Mob's absence, but he hears Tsubomi say something rather surprising.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E09 - Show Me What You've Got ~Band Together~
2.plot: With his house up in flames, Mob and Dimple find something that resembles his family burnt within the fire. They immediately go to find who's behind this and run into members of the mysterious group, the Claw. Unable to control his rage, Mob disposes of them immediately, but then Koyama and Sakurai from the 7th Division appear before him. They end up meeting up with Teru and Reigen, who were also attacked by members of the Claw, at a secret lair. What could the Claw be plotting?

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E10 - Collision ~Power Type~
2.plot: The boss of the Claw, Suzuki Toichiro barricades himself into Seasoning City Culture Tower after declaring war on the world. After instantly getting rid of the police barriers, they make their next move. Meanwhile, back at the hideout, Reigen and the others were making their move, as well. The former members of the 7th Division and the Awakening Lab head to the tower under Reigen's instruction. Sho and Ritsu also make their move to stop Suzuki's plans.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E11 - Guidance ~Psychic Sensor~
2.plot: Sho finally arrived at Seasoning Cultural Tower and was greeted by Shimazaki, one of the Ultimate 5. Ritsu faces off with Shimazaki and urges Sho to go ahead. However, Shimazaki is able to teleport and he gets ahead of him. Meanwhile, Mob has woken up and is heading to the tower and is also approached by one of the Ultimate 5, Minegishi. Mob has a difficult time dealing with Minegishi, who controls plants, but then someone rather unexpected comes to his aid.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E12 - The Battle for Social Rehabilitation ~Friendship~
2.plot: Three years ago, Serizawa was troubled with about his psychic powers. One day, he was visited by the boss, Suzuki Toichiro. Serizawa ends up trusting him since he's the first person to understand what he's going through. But Mob then brings up the fact that Serizawa is being used and tells him, "I'll be your friend." Hearing Mob say that, Serizawa... Meanwhile, after defeating Sho, the boss starts gathering up the energy he was sharing with his followers and turns into an energy monster.

2.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S02E13 - Boss Fight ~The Final Light~
2.plot: The Cultural Tower floats above Seasoning City. The final battle between Mob and Suzuki was about to begin. Mob is almost overwhelmed by the fact that he's able to completely release his powers, but then, he sees his younger brother, Ritsu. Mob regains his composure and he faces off with Suzuki, but Suzuki's power is too great. Mob finally gives up on trying to talk things out and puts everything he has into this battle. Who will be the victor?

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E01 - Future ~Career Paths~
3.plot: A giant broccoli known as the Divine Tree grows in the middle of the city and looks down upon Seasoning City. It's time to fill out surveys about career paths at Salt Middle School and the students are filled with various feelings. While they all talk about their hopes and dreams, Mob can't seem to think of anything himself.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E02 - Yokai Hunter Amakusa Haruaki Appears! ~The Threat of a Hundred Demons!!~
3.plot: Mob is very busy preparing for the cultural fair that's coming up in two weeks. Meanwhile, Serizawa is trying to start over, and is thinking about going to night school.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E03 - Getting Carried Away ~100%~
3.plot: Mob is in a great mood because he got to talk to Tsubomi for the first time in a while. As he's walking through town, he feels the stares of other girls...

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E04 - Divine Tree 1 ~The Founder Appears~
3.plot: After Psycho Helmet's appearance, tree roots start emerging all around the city. Sensing danger, Mob goes with Reigen and Ritsu to destroy the Divine Tree, but eventually, they are overwhelmed by the members of the Psycho Helmet Religion.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E05 - Divine Tree 2 ~Peace~
3.plot: Mob heads into the Divine Tree, only to have to face off with Teru. Mob finds himself speechless, having to confront even Teru who has been completely brainwashed by Psycho Helmet.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E06 - Divine Tree 3 ~Dimple Is~
3.plot: Mob's attitude seems to change once he hears what Dimple says. Mob ends up apologizing to Dimple because he had gotten carried away from the thought of being popular and didn't hear what Dimple had to tell him before.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E07 - Transmission 1 ~Winter Break~
3.plot: Kurata Tome has always dreamed about communicating with the universe through telepathy, and now, her high school graduation was drawing nearer. When they are about to start winter break, she tells the Telepathy Club that she is going to disband them.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E08 - Transmission 2 ~Encountering the Unknown~
3.plot: The group somehow finally makes it to the summit of Mt. Mudboat. Takenaka had been up all night reading all the texts about UFOs and the Telepathy Club comes together to send a telepathic message into space, but there is no UFO in sight.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E09 - Mob 1 ~Moving~
3.plot: After winter break is over, Mob is hit with shocking news. Tsubomi is actually going to transfer within the next month.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E10 - Mob 2 ~Rival~
3.plot: Mob tries to save a child that is about to be run over by a car and is run over himself. People start to gather but Mob stays silent.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E11 - Mob 3 ~Trauma~
3.plot: Mob continues to walk to the park where Tsubomi is waiting as he destroys everything around him, but the former upper echelon members from the Claw, Koyama, Sakuragi, and their boss, Suzuki stand in his way.

3.title: FR - Mob Psycho 100 - S03E12 - Confession ~The Future~
3.plot: Mob continues down his path of destruction. Amongst all of the destruction and chaos, Reigen finally reaches Mob with the help of Serizawa, and he desperately tries to talk to him.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E01 - The Duel
1.plot: A wandering stranger with a mysterious past defends a village from powerful bandits.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E02 - Tatooine Rhapsody
1.plot: A band with big dreams must save one of their own from Jabba the Hutt and Boba Fett.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E03 - The Twins
1.plot: Twins born into the dark side clash aboard a massive Star Destroyer.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E04 - The Village Bride
1.plot: A Jedi on the run takes in the unique customs of a remote village under threat by a warlord.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E05 - The Ninth Jedi
1.plot: The daughter of a lightsaber-smith is pursued by dark forces while on a dangerous mission.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E06 - T0-B1
1.plot: A cybernetic boy, who dreams of being a Jedi, discovers a dangerous truth about his creator.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E07 - The Elder
1.plot: A Jedi and his Padawan pursue a dark and powerful presence.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E08 - Lop & Ochō
1.plot: A family is torn about what to do when the Empire encroaches on their planet.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S01E09 - Akakiri
1.plot: A Jedi returns to his forbidden love to help defend her kingdom from a Sith-like Shogun.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E01 - Sith
2.plot: A former Sith apprentice, leading a peaceful, but isolated life, is confronted by the past when her old master tracks her down.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E02 - Screecher's Reach
2.plot: A young girl, seeking reprieve from her days in a rural workhouse, discovers a legendary haunted cave with her friends. The cave’s dark pull will change the trajectory of her life forever.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E03 - In the Stars
2.plot: Two sisters, the last of their kind who live in hiding on their ravaged land, squabble about how to survive with the Empire encroaching. On a water run, the sisters must fight back when they are discovered.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E04 - I Am Your Mother
2.plot: Young pilot Anni, who is embarrassed by her sweet, but clingy mum, must team with her for a madcap family race at the academy. Along the way, their relationship is tested by the elements, their old ship, other racers...and each other!

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E05 - Journey to the Dark Head
2.plot: A hopeful mechanic and disillusioned young Jedi team up for a risky and unlikely quest to turn the tide of the galactic war, but dark forces tail them.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E06 - The Spy Dancer
2.plot: The premier dancer at a famous, Imperial-frequented cabaret uses her unique skill-set to spy for the Rebellion, but the presence of a mysterious officer threatens to derail her mission.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E07 - The Bandits of Golak
2.plot: Fleeing from their village by train and pursued by ferocious Imperial forces, a boy and his force-sensitive younger sister seek refuge in a vibrant and dangerous dhaba.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E08 - The Pit
2.plot: A fearless young prisoner, forced to dig for kyber by the Empire, plans a risky escape for he and his people.

2.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S02E09 - Aau's Song
2.plot: An alien child who longs to sing is raised by her loving, but stern father to stay quiet because of the calamitous effect her voice has on the crystals in the nearby mines.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E01 - The Bounty Hunter
3.plot: A rogue bounty hunter takes on a job for a shady industrialist that has unexpected consequences for her and her droid.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E02 - The Duel: Payback
3.plot: With the help of some unexpected allies, Ronin faces off against his greatest foe – a twisted Jedi known as the Grand Master who is bent on revenge

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E03 - The Song of Four Wings
3.plot: A princess-turned-rebel protects a child from the might of the Empire on a snowbound planet.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E04 - The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope
3.plot: Pursued by Jedi Hunters, and blasted adrift into space, Kara encounters a seemingly abandoned ship tended to by a mysterious droid.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E05 - The Smuggler
3.plot: A smuggler, desperate for a quick payday, agrees to take on a job to bring a wanted young prince to safety as the Empire pursues.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E06 - Yuko's Treasure
3.plot: A sheltered orphan teams with a street rat kid to rescue his droid caregiver and find a long lost treasure.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E07 - The Bird of Paradise
3.plot: After she is blinded in battle, a hot headed Jedi padawan must undergo a series of spiritual trials in order to overcome the temptation of the Dark Side.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E08 - The Lost Ones
3.plot: After assisting refugees escape a natural disaster, an incognito F is forced to confront the ghosts of her past when their refugee ship is intercepted by the Empire.

3.title: FR - Star Wars: Visions - S03E09 - BLACK
3.plot: A psychedelic battle between past and present, light and dark, and life and death plays out in the haunted psyche of an Imperial trooper who is on the cusp of defeat.

meta.plot: This anthology of animated shorts from around the world celebrates the myth of Star Wars through unique cultural lenses.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E01 - I Have Called You by Name
1.plot: Two brothers struggle with their tax debts to Rome while a woman in the Red Quarter wrestles with her demons.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E02 - Shabbat
1.plot: Matthew validates Simon's claims with Praetor Quintus, Nicodemus investigates the miracle reported in the Red Quarter, and Mary receives surprise guests at her Shabbat dinner.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E03 - Jesus Loves the Little Children
1.plot: Jesus befriends and teaches the group of children who discover His camp on the outskirts of Capernaum.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E04 - The Rock on Which it is Built
1.plot: With his life and family under threat from Rome, Simon spends one last night fishing in a desperate attempt to square his debts. Andrew spots a familiar face waiting for them on the shores of Galilee.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E05 - The Wedding Gift
1.plot: Nicodemus interrogates John the Baptizer while Jesus and his students make their way to a wedding celebration in Cana. When the wine runs low, Mary asks her son to intervene on behalf of the bridegroom's family.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E06 - Indescribable Compassion
1.plot: After witnessing the healing of a leper on the road to Capernaum, a woman forces her paralytic friend through the crowd to meet Jesus.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E07 - Invitations
1.plot: Matthew struggles to reconcile the miracles he has witnessed with reality. Nicodemus meets with Jesus by night.

1.title: FR - The Chosen - S01E08 - I Am He
1.plot: Jesus and His students complete their preparations and leave Capernaum for Samaria. Jesus meets with a suffering woman at Jacob's Well and announces that He is the Messiah.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E01 - Thunder
2.plot: Tension builds among the disciples as they wrestle with the increasing fame of Jesus in Samaria. Jesus rebukes Big James and John for their prejudice and, after a near-violent encounter, gives them a new nickname.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E02 - I Saw You
2.plot: A mysterious visitor seeks to meet Jesus, but the disciples are hesitant. Tension builds between Simon and Matthew. As the group heads to a new city, word arrives that Jesus’ fame is growing.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E03 - Matthew 4:24
2.plot: A long, exhausting day turns into night as the disciples help Jesus deal with a large crowd hoping to be healed. Around the campfire, over dinner, the group tried to get to know each other better. But tensions erupt.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E04 - The Perfect Opportunity
2.plot: As Jesus and the disciples head to Jerusalem to celebrate the Feast of Tabernacles, a new enemy follows them, while a familiar enemy awaits.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E05 - Spirit
2.plot: After stirring the water, Jesus is now pursued by Simon the Zealot, Atticus, and Shmuel. John the Baptizer visits the group and tells Jesus his dangerous mission. Meanwhile, back at the camp, Mary Magdalene is devastated by an encounter with a mysterious and dangerous stranger.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E06 - Unlawful
2.plot: Matthew and Simon try to get along as they search for Mary in dark places. The group fears for Mary as they struggle with lack of food and bad news about John the Baptist. Meanwhile, Jesus continues to upset Pharisees across multiple regions.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E07 - Reckoning
2.plot: After learning of Jesus' whereabouts, Quintus sends Gaius to arrest him. The disciples lose control as they argue about how to respond. While seeking information about where Jesus has been taken, Andrew and Philip encounter old friends.

2.title: FR - The Chosen - S02E08 - Beyond Mountains
2.plot: While Jesus and Matthew prepare the content of the big sermon, the disciples spread the word while fighting amongst themselves. A high-ranking Sanhedrin member is shocked by Shmuel’s reports on Jesus. Thousands arrive for the sermon, including familiar faces.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E01 - Homecoming
3.plot: Jesus delivers the most life-altering sermon in history. The result? More followers, more enemies, and disciples ready to follow Jesus anywhere. Simon and Eden reunite, Matthew faces his past, and Andrew visits John the Baptist in prison.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E02 - Two by Two
3.plot: Jesus is a problem for the Romans. With pilgrims from everywhere setting up a tent city at the gates of Capernaum to see Jesus, tensions rise. Jesus officially sends the twelve apostles on an exciting but dangerous mission, causing Little James to ask why he hasn’t been healed.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E03 - Physician, Heal Yourself
3.plot: Jesus returns to his childhood home for the big Jewish new year celebration. His childhood friends and family are all buzzing with what they’ve heard about Jesus…until he tells them the truth of who He is.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E04 - Clean, Part 1
3.plot: Two by two, the disciples carry out Jesus’ mission to heal, cast out demons, and preach his  words. But upon returning, they struggle with understanding what happened while Simon and  Eden struggle to reconnect.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E05 - Clean, Part 2
3.plot: As tensions mount at home, Simon and Gaius work together to fix the water problem in Capernaum. Meanwhile, Jairus and Veronica are equally desperate to find Jesus as the only hope for their crises.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E06 - Intensity in Tent City
3.plot: Andrew and Philip discover their previous mission resulted in devastation that will require a return. Simon Z is finally forced to confront his past, but then two disciples of John the Baptist come to Capernaum with an important question for Jesus.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E07 - Ears to Hear
3.plot: "Having ears to hear." Jesus leads the disciples into a dangerous region, where they will face a crowd armed with sharp tongues and dull ears… but even his closest followers are finding it very hard to hear.

3.title: FR - The Chosen - S03E08 - Sustenance
3.plot: Thousands arrive to first argue with, then listen to Jesus as he preaches. Shmuel and Atticus hear what’s happening and journey towards the Decapolis to catch Jesus in the act of a possible revolt. Meanwhile, as the preaching extends to the next day, the disciples realize they have a significant problem: the thousands are hungry, and there’s no food.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E01 - Promises
4.plot: An intoxicating dance leads Herod to put an end to John the Baptizer, but no one can stop what-or Who-he's ushered in.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E02 - Confessions
4.plot: Jesus founds his church on unholy ground and Simon goes public with Jesus' true identity, getting a new name in the process. But can the new "Peter" forgive old wrongs?

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E03 - Moon to Blood
4.plot: When Jesus heals a blind man on the Sabbath, religious leaders confront him, drawing a riotous crowd. Gaius defies a direct order leading Quintus to take matters—and someone’s life—into his own hands.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E04 - Calm Before
4.plot: Beginning with a funeral procession, time marches rapidly toward the final days of Jesus’ ministry. While the disciples seek status for themselves, a Roman ruler comes with a humble request.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E05 - Sitting, Serving, Scheming
4.plot: Roman soldiers demand the disciples carry their armor, but Jesus goes one step farther. Frustrated by the direction of Jesus’ ministry, Judas visits an old friend for advice.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E06 - Dedication
4.plot: Jesus and the disciples celebrate Hanukkah. Matthew confronts Judas about irregularities, and the festival turns into a fight, then flight. The disciples escape with their lives, but learn a friend hasn’t been so lucky.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E07 - The Last Sign
4.plot: Jesus brings Lazarus back to life—and sets off the chain of events that will lead to His own death.

4.title: FR - The Chosen - S04E08 - Humble
4.plot: Jesus refuses to look and act like the Messiah everyone expects—arriving like a lamb instead of a lion and riding a donkey instead of a war horse.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E01 - Entry
5.plot: Jesus rides into the holy city as king, but finds that the rulers have turned His Father’s house from a place of prayer to a corrupt market.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E02 - House of Cards
5.plot: Why kill Jesus when Rome can do it for you? As the Jewish High Priest schemes to bring Him down, Jesus strikes first: turning the tables.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E03 - Woes
5.plot: Jesus preaches one last time to the massive Passover crowd, and the religious leaders try to trap him in his words.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E04 - The Same Coin
5.plot: Afraid of public outcry—and further embarrassment—Caiaphas resolves to arrest Jesus quietly at night. Only one problem: no one knows how to find Him.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E05 - Because of Me
5.plot: The decision to arrest Jesus leads to a fiery debate. Roman soldiers track down a troublemaking crowd. Shmuel finds help from an unexpected source.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E06 - Reunions
5.plot: As Jesus’ followers gather for the Passover meal, His enemies assemble for a man hunt. Judas holds a secret meeting.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E07 - The Upper Room (1)
5.plot: Jesus arrives at the Last Supper. The disciples fear for their safety as Jesus’ enemies close ranks around them.

5.title: FR - The Chosen - S05E08 - The Upper Room (2)
5.plot: Pilate summons Atticus to read him the riot act. The Sanhedrin boils over. The Last Supper ends.

meta.plot: The life of Christ through the eyes of those who encountered him called The Chosen.
Kind of famous and sort of rich, rapper and actor Vince Staples navigates the challenges and surprises of everyday life in his hometown of The Beach.

1.title: FR - The Vince Staples Show - S01E01 - Pink House
1.plot: After getting pulled over for speeding, Vince lands behind bars and meets an aspiring singer, inquisitive cops and a hostile inmate with a grudge.

1.title: FR - The Vince Staples Show - S01E02 - Black Business
1.plot: When an armed robbery breaks out at the bank where Vince is applying for a small-business loan, he seizes an opportunity to negotiate a lucrative deal.

1.title: FR - The Vince Staples Show - S01E03 - Brown Family
1.plot: Tensions flare up over mac and cheese at a family reunion. As aunties bicker and hard truths emerge, Vince has a heart-to-heart with Uncle James.

1.title: FR - The Vince Staples Show - S01E04 - Red Door
1.plot: At a theme park, a mission turns into a misadventure for Vince, who encounters a menacing mascot. Deja gets into a heated argument at the gift shop.

1.title: FR - The Vince Staples Show - S01E05 - White Boy
1.plot: A run-in with a longtime enemy at Vince's old school escalates into a cat-and-mouse game all over Long Beach.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E01 - There's No Creature Like Snow Creature
1.plot: In the opener, the amateur sleuths travel to a mountain resort to watch a snowboarding competition and end up investigating rumors of a snow creature that is attacking the participants. Olympic snowboard medalist Chris Klug provides the voice for his animated alter ego.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E02 - 3-D Struction
1.plot: Daphne's uncle sends the gang to Costa Rica for the opening of a museum exhibit on dinosaurs.  When our heroes meet archeologist Melbourne O'Reilly, he reveals the legend of a dinosaur-spirit who's supposed to get revenge on anyone who disturbs these bones.  So when the gang sits down to enjoy a new 3-D dino-film in the museum's theatre, it's not that surprising when the dinosaur jumps off the screen -- and into the audience.  It's up to the gang to figure out who's really "behind this devastating dinosaur disaster."

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E03 - Space Ape at the Cape
1.plot: The gang must stop a shape-shifting alien before NASA's shuttle mission is aborted.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E04 - Big Scare in the Big Easy
1.plot: Ghosts re-enact a duel every night in a New Orleans graveyard.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E05 - It's Mean, It's Green, It's the Mystery Machine
1.plot: When the Mystery Machine comes to life and begins driving by itself, the gang tries to find the clues....  Which leads them to The Mystery Kids, the band who formerly owned the Mystery Machine.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E06 - Riva Ras Regas
1.plot: The gang goes to Las Vegas to meet teen pop singer Lindsay Pagano, but they soon end up trying to uncover the mystery of a deceased magician who's haunting the theater that Lindsay's performing at.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E07 - Roller Ghoster Ride
1.plot: The crew goes to a roller coaster park because of Scooby and Shaggy having their new ride built there and they run into some ride mischief with a ghost called The Roller Ghoster and it seems to break rides around the park.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E08 - Safari, So Goodie!
1.plot: When the gang travels of the safari, They discover the animals changing to a yellow color and doing strange things. They have to solve the mystery or else that stuff might happen to Scooby.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E09 - She Sees Sea Monsters by the Sea Shore
1.plot: The gang attempts to have a relaxing vacation but abandons their plans when a scaly sea serpent surfaces.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E10 - A Scooby-Doo! Christmas
1.plot: Scooby and his pals arrive in a town where Christmas is not celebrated because a headless snowman terrorizes the residents, so the amateur sleuths set out to solve the mystery. NOTE: This episode is swapped on the DVD releases with S03E03 A Scooby-Doo Valentine appearing on the Season One collection and S01E10 A Scooby-Doo Christmas appearing on the Season Three collection.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E11 - Toy Scary Boo
1.plot: The gang investigate on this mystery where activated toys are taking over the toy store. They suspect a really interested fanatic is involved with the case. When he actually comes clean, the gang thought they were right all along. But they weren't.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E12 - Lights! Camera! Mayhem!
1.plot: A purple phantom starts threating the production of "Spy Me A River" and the gang set out to find the villain.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E13 - Pompeii and Circumstance
1.plot: While visiting Italy the gang battles a zombie gladiator who appears to be responsible for causing volcano erruptions.

1.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S01E14 - The Unnatural
1.plot: The ghost of an old baseball player named Cab Craig starts haunting the baseball stadium. Scooby and the gang have to find out who it is.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E01 - Big Appetite in Little Tokyo
2.plot: Shaggy & Scooby are on the run! After Velma wins a contest for the best invention (a robotic dog) the gang gets to travel to Tokyo, Japan. When a mystical person zaps a pizza with a growing spell and Shaggy eats it! Shaggy starts to grow whenever he goes to sleep and he starts eating everything in sight. Now the gang are running around tokyo trying to get away from the police who want to put Shaggy in jail.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E02 - Mummy Scares Best
2.plot: While in Egypt on an archeological dig with Melbourne O'Reilly, the gang encounters Pharaoh Scamses the 15th, a mummy who has a knack of turning tourists into his zombie minions.  So the gang sets out to solve the mystery - that is, until Fred, Daphne and Velma get turned into zombies too!

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E03 - The Fast and the Wormious
2.plot: Thanks to Freddy, the gang enters a 24 hour off road race, only to deal with crazy drivers, a giant worm named El Gusanu, and the cult that honors the worm.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E04 - High-Tech House of Horrors
2.plot: The gang visits a state fair in order to see all the inventions "of the future."  But they get more than they bargained for when they set their sights on a "House of the Future," which is allegedly haunted.  Things seem pretty normal within... until Daphne mysteriously vanishes.  Is it two prankster kids, a reality TV personality, the creator of the gadgets or the high-tech house of horrors itself that's responsible for the strange goings-on?

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E05 - The Vampire Strikes Back
2.plot: The Scooby gang travels to an old Transylvanian castle on a rainy night to watch the shoot of the Hex Girls new music video ''Wanna Wed, But I Fled'', but they find out that the band is breaking up, since there's a vampire on the loose. Fred decided go straight to trapping the vampire. They do so, only to discover there's another vampire lurking around, so they go through the whole thing all over again to reveal a surprise twist to this mystery.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E06 - A Scooby-Doo Halloween
2.plot: The gang goes to Banning Junction to visit Velma's family for Halloween, but they meet the ghostly robots who try to ruin the festivities. Hopefully they can save the town before the ghost of Hank Banning shows up.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E07 - Homeward Hound
2.plot: In this episode Scooby has to choose between going to a museam or a dog show. He chooses the dog show. While at the dog show they find that a mysterious cat creature is haunting the show. The cat creature appears during the show and while Fred, Daphne, Shaggy and Velma go fight the creature, Scooby protects the 6 pups and the mother.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E08 - The San Franpsycho
2.plot: During a visit to San Fransisco for the Grind Games, a world famous skateboarding competition, Scooby and the gang discover a monster known as the San Franpsycho. WHO is stalking the skaters?

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E09 - Simple Plan and the Invisible Madman
2.plot: Traveling through a Canadian ghost town, Scooby and the gang encounter the rock group, Simple Plan. As members of SP are kidnapped one by one by the Inivisible Madman, everyone one of the locals has an aliby for not being the Invisble Madman. Who is the Invisible Madman that is haunting them?

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E10 - Recipe for Disaster
2.plot: There's an Ooze Monster haunting the Scooby Snacks factory and Scooby and the gang have to stop it.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E11 - Large Dragon at Large
2.plot: The gang visits a renaissance fair but gets overwhelmed by a dragon.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E12 - Uncle Scooby and Antarctica
2.plot: Scooby and Shaggy befriend a penguin while working at a zoo. When they (as well as Velma, Daphne, & Fred) are invited to join him on a trip back to his home, Antarctica, they find that an ice ghost is haunting the way station there. He even has pushed the head scientist there into the ice. Velma is baffled by the increasing amount of suspects but eventually figures out who the villain is.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E13 - New Mexico, Old Monster
2.plot: A giant Wakumi bird is stealing sculptures that are to be put in a museum.

2.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S02E14 - It's All Greek to Scooby
2.plot: Scooby and the gang find a medallion while in Greece and are pursued by a centaur who's after the medallion.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E01 - Fright House of a Lighthouse
3.plot: The ghost of a Lighthouse Keeper is haunting an old lighthouse and causing terror to ships out on the water. Who is behind the Creepy Keeper?

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E02 - Go West, Young Scoob
3.plot: The gang travels to a western town where the majority of the residents are robots.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E03 - A Scooby-Doo Valentine
3.plot: The gang investigates some mysterious disappearances of teenagers on Lovers Lane while Shaggy and Scooby catch up with old girlfriends. But the culprits behind it all turn out to be the gang themselves!

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E04 - Wrestle Maniacs
3.plot: A weird wrestler known as Titanic Twist with two arms on one side is terrorizing wresting matches.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E05 - Ready to Scare
3.plot: The gang is in Paris to see Daphne's cousin Dannika win "Model of the Year", but they discover she has been abducted when a Gargoyle from Notre Dame cathedral has come to life. Now the kids must find her by searching the Paris catacombs, the sewers, and the cathedral before the fashion expo starts.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E06 - Farmed and Dangerous
3.plot: The gang goes to visit the Secret Six Puppies, but soon discover something terrible. A mysterious Demon Farmer haunts their farmhouse that was built over an ancient graveyard, and wants the puppies gone. The gang stays to help, when all the farm workers have quit.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E07 - Diamonds Are a Ghoul's Best Friend
3.plot:
In Russia, the gang discovers the Frozen Fiend, a ghoul creature that stolen the Emperor Cup, which would be give

the Internation Hockey Tourmants's winner?

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E08 - A Terrifying Round with a Menacing Metallic Clown
3.plot: The International Putt-Putt Contest is treated by its own 18-th hole--and MONSTER-style Clown--but that is good and bad news for Mystery Inc. on the screen. The bad news, the genius of the gang, Velma, has a clown phobia--but good news is that Norville "Shaggy" Rogers is ACTING BRAVE! Holy reservals, Scooby-Doo!  Can the gang solve the mystery and get the regular Velma and Shaggy back?

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E09 - Camp Comeoniwannascareya
3.plot: A monster known at The Toxic Terror is attacking the favorite camping ground of Shaggy, Scooby, and 3 kids.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E10 - Block-Long Hong Kong Terror
3.plot: Mystery Inc gets involved in a mystery featuring a wig-out ex-worker, a stolen candy ring, an American cop, and mutant giant toys. Can Velma figure out who's behind this insane mystery?

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E11 - Gentlemen, Start Your Monsters
3.plot: The Mystery Kids head for a NASCAR-like championship race where mayhem is taking place on the racetracks.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E12 - Gold Paw
3.plot: Once again, the gang visits the Secret Six puppies but come to discover that a Gold Monster is haunting Fort Knox. Meanwhile, Shaggy and Scooby do everything in their power to keep the Gold Ade factory open.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E13 - Reef Grief!
3.plot: A creature made of the coral reef attacks a sand castle competition in Australia. People start disappearing through sand.

3.title: FR - What's New, Scooby-Doo? - S03E14 - E-Scream
3.plot: The gang visits a video game convention to play the video games, but the cute Osomon creatures that were the highlight of the show turn into monsters.

meta.plot: Scooby-Doo and the Mystery, Inc. gang are launched into the 21st century, with new mysteries to solve.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E01 - WHAT'S YOUR NAME?
1.plot: Bounty hunter Chateau runs into an assassin named Ryang-ha Song while on a job. After their meeting, he ends up giving her information on other bounties. One day, a different job comes in and Ryang-ha ends up being the target.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E02 - TARGET
1.plot: Despite knowing that her boss is beginning to suspect that she might be in contact with Ryang-ha, Chateau goes on to carry out a hit that he had tipped her off to.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E03 - ROOM
1.plot: Chateau wakes up in a motel after being helped out of a pinch by Ryang-ha. She passes on to him the warning that Hou had given for the "traitor." What was his crime five years ago?

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E04 - REAL FACE
1.plot: Chateau goes to church on the anniversary of her father's death. She runs into Ryang-ha, who is his usual self, before they are met by an attacker. Meanwhile, Chateau's boss is meeting with her mother to try to understand her past.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E05 - LIMIT
1.plot: Chateau is being held hostage in a car filled with explosives, and so Ryang-ha confronts Hou. This is Chateau and Ryang-ha's most dangerous situation yet.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E06 - DARK DREAM
1.plot: Chateau boards a luxury cruise ship for a mission. There, she runs into Ryang-ha, who makes things difficult for her once again. They spend a night in a room together, in part so that Chateau can keep an eye on him.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E07 - BULLET
1.plot: Chateau tries to determine Euripedes' whereabouts, but is bothered by Ryang-ha's suspicious behavior. He lets a mysterious attacker escape, and when he meets with Chateau, she pulls out a gun.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E08 - CONFUSION
1.plot: Chateau leaves herself with Jinon and his associate, Nikka, in order to carry out her operation. Meanwhile, both the boss and Jim are put in danger.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E09 - A WAR TRIGGER
1.plot: Ryang-Ha confronts Donny, who had brought him here with some unresolved business. Meanwhile, Chateau makes a commitment to finding Ryang-Ha.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E10 - HELP
1.plot: With some help, Ryang-Ha and Chateau hide out in a tent under a bridge. Chateau is concerned about Ryang-Ha's wounds. They pretend to be married in order to hide their identities.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E11 - WORST
1.plot: 17 years ago. Ryang-Ha was assisting Donny, when he takes in a boy who was being chased. A job Donny gives him leads him to another fateful encounter.

1.title: FR - Love of Kill - S01E12 - MY NAME
1.plot: Two "Ryang-Has" survive desperately with a young Chateau. But Ryang-Ha is cornered by his enemies, and the other Ryang-Ha, too, is severely injured.

meta.plot: Two assassins face off at a certain "workplace." The cool bounty hunter Chateau and the mysterious and powerful Ryang-Ha. Chateau and Ryang-Ha become enemies after this fight—at least, they should have, but for some reason Ryang-Ha takes a liking to Chateau and begins following her around. Little by little, Chateau develops a cooperative partnership with Ryang-Ha, which gets her caught up in the struggle against the organizations hunting him down. Furthermore, that battle is related to her past as well. Why did Ryang-Ha approach Chateau? What is Chateau's secret past?

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E01 - Maritime Pilot
1.plot: A mysterious castaway appears while Charlie, Mike and their dads search the ocean for mythical creatures, throwing all their plans into chaos.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E02 - The Last Blank Space on the Map
1.plot: As they adjust to wild new surroundings, Mike and Charlie realize that getting to shore was the easy part. Cap encounters another explorer.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E03 - What's Up, Croc?
1.plot: On the run from a terrifying predator, the boys glimpse an unbelievable sight. Irene leads her team deeper into the island. Mike makes a confession.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E04 - Breakfast Fit for a Kong
1.plot: Annie and Dog stage a subterranean rescue operation. Irene gets better acquainted with the island's wildlife. Cap explains an intriguing theory.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E05 - Doggone It
1.plot: A risky plan pays off, leading to a reunion — and new revelations. Stuck in a precarious situation, Charlie and Dog form an uneasy alliance.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E06 - Terms of Endearment
1.plot: Mike's injury catches up with him, while Annie and Irene unpack their complicated histories. Dog and Charlie's journey across the island continues.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E07 - You're Not a King, You're Just a Stupid Animal
1.plot: Years in the past, Kong roams the island with a beloved human friend. But when his temper gets the better of him, the consequences could be dire.

1.title: FR - Skull Island - S01E08 - You'll Never Catch a Monkey That Way
1.plot: Charlie proposes a daring plan to defeat the sea monster and save Mike's life. But it will take all his courage — and Kong's strength — to pull it off.

meta.plot: Shipwrecked in the South Pacific, a group of explorers encounter a menagerie of fearsome creatures — including the giant ape who rules the island: Kong.

In the thick of the French Revolution, members of the so-called lower classes are rising up to fight inequality. Meanwhile, Richter Belmont senses a far grimmer and greater danger. He's picked up his family's long-held tradition of vampire hunting, a vocation that goes back almost as long as a vampiric life span (in other words, forever) but he's never seen anything quite like what he's witnessing now.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E01 - A Common Enemy in Evil
1.plot: An attack on their camp spurs vampire hunter Richter and young mage Maria to seek the help of the Abbot of Machecoul. Strangers bring news from abroad.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E02 - Horror Beyond Nightmares
1.plot: As the threat of a Vampire Messiah looms, Tera's past holds dark omens for the future. Annette, Edouard, Richter and Maria head for the château.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E03 - Freedom Was Sweeter
1.plot: In shock after a loss, Annette shares the story of her escape from slavery and her journey from Saint-Domingue. Chaos erupts at a public gathering.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E04 - Horrors Rising from the Earth
1.plot: Olrox voices doubts to Mizrak about the Abbot's alliances. Desperate to help a friend, Annette leads a risky mission over Richter's objections.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E05 - The Natural Order
1.plot: Drolta makes a persuasive pitch to Olrox, and Annette encounters an old enemy. Revelations shed new light on Maria and Richter's family histories.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E06 - Guilty Men to Be Judged
1.plot: While Richter learns about the Belmont legacy, Annette searches for the wisdom of her own ancestors. Edouard attempts to get through to a comrade.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E07 - Blood Is the Only Way
1.plot: Emboldened by her victories, the Vampire Messiah steps into the spotlight. Richter flexes new abilities. Olrox makes a surprising proposal.

1.title: FR - Castlevania: Nocturne - S01E08 - Devourer of Light
1.plot: With the Abbot poised to make an unthinkable sacrifice and Erzsebet's plans already in motion, Richter and his allies hurl themselves into battle.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E01 - The Young Jedi
1.plot: Jedi younglings Kai, Lys and Nubs go on their first adventure.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E02 - Yoda’s Mission
1.plot: Yoda gives the younglings a mission.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E03 - Nash's Race Day
1.plot: Nash’s Jedi friends help her compete in a race.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E04 - The Lost Jedi Ship
1.plot: The young Jedi find a long-lost Jedi ship.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E05 - Get Well Nubs
1.plot: Kai and Lys seek out a cure for Nubs’ illness

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E06 - The Junk Giant
1.plot: The young Jedi set out to catch a thief.

1.title: FR - Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures - S01E07 - Lys and The Snowy Mountain Rescue
1.plot: The younglings help wrangle creatures.

meta.plot: Set during the High Republic era and the prime of the Jedi Order, follow Jedi younglings as they study the ways of the Force, explore the galaxy, help citizens and creatures in need, and learn valuable skills needed to become Jedi along the way.

The Malto Family’s world turns upside down when the Terrans, the first Earthborn Transformers robots, spark to life. The Terrans will forge an alliance between the human Malto family and the legendary Autobots, uniting them in a shared mission.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E01 - Secret Legacy (1) / Secret Legacy (2)
1.plot: Robby has trouble adjusting after their family's big move to the rural town of Witwicky, until he and his sister, Mo, discover the first-ever Earthborn Transformers.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E03 - Moo-ving In
1.plot: As the Malto family get used to its new members, Bumblebee quickly learns that his mission to train the Terrans won't be as easy as he thought.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E04 - House Rules
1.plot: Thrash is impatient with the family rules and convinces Mo to push their boundaries. But when a Decepticon needs their help, Mo and Thrash find themselves playing by a far more dangerous set of rules.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E05 - Classified
1.plot: G.H.O.S.T. Special Agent Schloder pursues Twitch after mistaking her for a Deception. Meanwhile, Dot is put through G.H.O.S.T. orientation, where she learns that her employer's intentions may not be what they seem.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E06 - Traditions
1.plot: Robby backs out of Alex's traditional Wakwak hunt, so Alex shares his family history with Bumblebee, while Twitch, eager to gain her own traditions, encounters "Dad2" - Wheeljack.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E07 - Family and Friends
1.plot: The Terrans' erratic behavior may be affecting Mo and Robby's anxiety about their first day at their new school. Or it could be something far worse...

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E08 - Decoy
1.plot: While out on a mission to capture three Mini-Cassette bots, Megatron and Optimus Prime have a disagreement about G.H.O.S.T.'s treatment of Decepticons.

1.title: FR - Transformers: EarthSpark - S01E09 - Age of Evolution (1) / Age of Evolution (2)
1.plot: Twitch and Thrash wonder if they're the only Terrans on Earth. Their family, Optimus Prime, and Bumblebee help seek answers and find new allies! Meanwhile, Mandroid captures Dot and Megatron. Can the larger group become a team and save their friends?

meta.plot: Wakana Gojo is a high school boy who wants to become a kashirashi--a master craftsman who makes traditional Japanese Hina dolls. Though he's gung-ho about the craft, he knows nothing about the latest trends, and has a hard time fitting in with his class. The popular kids--especially one girl, Marin Kitagawa--seem like they live in a completely different world. That all changes one day, when she shares an unexpected secret with him, and their completely different worlds collide.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Someone Who Lives in the Exact Opposite World as Me
1.plot: Wakana Gojo is a high school student who dreams of becoming a kashirashi for hina dolls one day. Because his life is all about making hina dolls, he has a hard time fitting into his class because his interests are so different than anyone else’s. His classmate, Marin Kitagawa, is always at the center of attention and from another world. One day, they both end up on classroom cleaning duty and…

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Wanna Hurry Up, and Do It?
1.plot: After seeing how passionate Marin is about the things she loves, Wakana decides to help her with making outfits. He decides to help her out in making a cosplay for Shizuku Kuroe-tan from the game "Slippery Girls 2." They had planned to reconvene later to get the measurements started, but Marin couldn't wait and ends up coming to Wakana's house over the weekend.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Then Why Don't We?
1.plot: Marin and Wakana start to grow closer as he helps her create her cosplay. Though he's happy about the fact that Marin treats him the same way at school as anywhere else, he also starts to worry about the fact that other people think it's weird that they're hanging out. Despite that, Marin takes Wakana shopping so they can look for materials needed for her cosplay.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Are These Your Girlfriend's?
1.plot: Wakana felt relieved just for a moment after they got all of the materials they needed for Marin's cosplay, but then he's shocked to find out that he needs to finish the cosplay in two weeks. On top of that, his grandfather, Kaoru, hurts his back, so Wakana has to run the shop and he also has midterms. Wakana feels overwhelmed and gets depressed, wondering if he'll ever actually become a kashirashi at this point.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - It's Probably Because This Is the Best Boob Bag Here
1.plot: Wakana finally completes the Shizuku cosplay. Marin is super excited that she gets to dress as her beloved Shizuku-tan and suggests that the two of them go to a cosplay event the next day. Even though it's her first time at a cosplay event, Marin gets requests for photos left and right. Wakana is overwhelmed with feelings as he watches over Marin, but...

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - For Real?!
1.plot: Marin and Wakana have a successful first cosplay event. Because of something Wakana said, Marin's mental and emotional state starts to change a little. Even though she was just spending time at the Gojos' home with Wakana and Kaoru to wash her outfit, she can't seem to calm down. Meanwhile, a certain person comes to Gojo Dolls after seeing the photos Marin posted onto social media of her Shizuku cosplay.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Home Date With the Guy I Wuv Is the Best
1.plot: Marin is going to do a group cosplay with her idol, the cosplayer "Juju," whose real name is Sajuna Inui, and they're going to cosplay as Black Lobelia and Black Lily from the magical girl anime "Flower Girl Blaze!!". Wakana heads over to Marin's home so that he can borrow the "Blaze!!" DVDs for research to make the outfits for them.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Backlighting Is the Best
1.plot: Juju's photographer and younger sister, Shinju Inui, meets Wakana and Marin for the first time. They're shocked at how opposite her appearance is to Sajuna, but they quickly become closer when they excitedly talk about cameras. Later on, Sajuna suggests that they check out the abandoned hospital that they'll be using for their group cosplay but...

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Lot Happened After I Saw That Photo
1.plot: Gojo is able to complete the Black Lobelia and Black Lily cosplays thanks to Marin's help. Both Marin and Sajuna try on their cosplays and they're both excited about how nicely they turned out, and Marin is even more excited about their upcoming group cosplay. When the day finally arrives, Marin and Sajuna get an unexpected visitor.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - We've All Got Struggles
1.plot: Wakana and Shinju's secret plan was a success, which added to the success of their first group cosplay photoshoot. As Juju and Shinju look through the photos from the photoshoot, the sisters find out how they both feel. Meanwhile, Marin and Wakana are enjoying their summer vacation. They were preparing Marin's cosplay for a fighting game character named Veronica-tya, but then a problem arises...

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I Am Currently at a Love Hotel
1.plot: ﻿Liz is a succubus who appears in one of Marin's favorite slice of life series, "SuccIDK." Marin had some interest in cosplaying Liz-kyun but didn't think she could pull it off until Wakana gave her a little push. With the cosplay ready, they head to a studio for a photoshoot, but the studio happened to be a rather unexpected location.

1.title: EN - Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi wo Suru [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - My Dress-Up Darling
1.plot: Summer vacation is coming to a close. Wakana received an SOS from Marin, who hadn't finished her homework, so he ended up helping her study at her house. They later realize that Marin had forgotten some math drills at school, so they go to get them. While alone at the school, Marin and Wakana make plans to go to a summer festival together. And when that day finally arrived...

meta.plot: A stout, weak, yet highly passionate Sora Kurumatani enters Kuzuryuu High School with hopes that he’ll fulfill his mother’s wishes to dominate his first high school tournament. However, the basketball club—turned den for delinquents—does anything but play basketball! Its club members, Momoharu Hanazono, a skilled blocker who can do power jumps but is horrible at shooting, and his twin brother Chiaki, a talented point guard, has also lost interest in the sport. With just one game overwhelmed with adrenaline rush and excitement, and Sora’s pure love for the game, the youth’s burning out spirit for basketball rekindles.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Ugly Duckling
1.plot: Sora is determined to join the basketball club, but the club’s members are determined to goof off instead of practice. Sora’s solution? A five-on-one game, winner takes all.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Boys Without Talent
1.plot: Sora’s skill and enthusiasm remind Momoharu of what it means to be passionate about basketball — but will Momoharu keep his promise to get serious about the game again?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Momoharu’s Wings
1.plot: Punks from Maru High have challenged Sora’s team to a basketball match, but how good is their team, anyway? Sora goes undercover to investigate.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - First Flight
1.plot: The day of the match against Maru High is here, and Sora can’t wait to hit the court. But do the punks of Kuzu High stand a chance against their more experienced opponents?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Broken Wings
1.plot: Tokitaka thinks he’s found a way to shut Sora out of the paint, but the pint-sized powerhouse still has a trick up his sleeve that could turn this game around.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Now’s the Time
1.plot: Sora’s new strategy has put him in the crosshairs of the defense, and things are looking bleak. Luckily for him, Kuzu High’s secret weapon is ready to take the court.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Troublesome Freshman
1.plot: After taking an exhausted Sora home post-game, Madoka learns the truth about Sora’s basketball-star mother and the reasoning behind his grand ambitions.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Duck and the Kite
1.plot: Kite only cares about two things: the ball and the basket. Team bonding? He’ll pass, thanks — but will he change his tune when he learns he shares a common dream with Sora?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Kite, His Ball, and the Team’s Pain
1.plot: Kite’s fate was sealed the moment he laid hands on those upperclassmen. Luckily for him, Sora has never been one to give up without a fight.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Manager
1.plot: All Sora wanted was to get his "wings" repaired. He didn’t count on getting a super cute, super clumsy team manager in the bargain.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Boys’ Stubbornness and Girls’ Pride
1.plot: Winning the match against the girls’ team should be a piece of cake, but Nao’s tactical abilities — not to mention the value of teamwork — shouldn’t be taken lightly.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Team
1.plot: When Nao abruptly resigns as manager, Sora learns that there is more to her basketball background than meets the eye. Later, the need for team funds rears its expensive head.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Differing Enthusiasm
1.plot: True passion for the game drives players like Sora to succeed. But can passion for basketball be taught — especially to players still new to the sport?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Towards Victory
1.plot: It’s hard to stay motivated when the inter-high tournament is so far away, but Nao has a plan to keep the team on its toes. First item on the agenda: learning how to screen.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Boys’ Spirit
1.plot: The players of Kuzu High have just one practice game to prove they’re worth taking seriously. Has their training camp paid off, or will Kitasumi High dominate the court?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Best Start and the Worst Start
1.plot: As Kitasumi High gets serious, Nao unveils Kuzu High’s super secret defense strategy. It’s time to knock out the competition — and Sora is the key to victory.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Versus
1.plot: Although guarding Taro is exhausting, Sora’s intense eyes make it clear that he’s ready to face the challenge head on. But can Chucky say the same when he takes to the court?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Now…
1.plot: With Sora on the sidelines, Tobi becomes the target of Kitasumi High’s latest defense strategy: the insidious 2-2-1 zone press.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Higher Than Anyone
1.plot: Dedication. Perseverance. Commitment. These are the qualities that make a basketball champion — and thanks to Konishi, Momoharu isn’t sure if he possesses any of them.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Last Play
1.plot: As Sora steps into the role of pointguard, Chiaki steps into the spotlight. The fate of the game hangs in the balance, but will their change-up lead to victory or defeat?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Tears
1.plot: A final shot will decide the fate of the match against Kitasumiyoshi High. As the dust settles, Madoka makes a difficult decision.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Last Piece
1.plot: The school basketball tournament pits teammate against teammate. As Sora and Tobi face off, a towering new player steps onto the court.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Moon and the Hoop
1.plot: Mokichi’s height gives him an undisputed advantage on the court, but when it comes to basketball, height alone can’t outpace the pressure of lofty expectations.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Light
1.plot: Midterms have arrived, and the team will have to hit the books if they all want to enter the tournament preliminaries. Meanwhile, Madoka makes a shocking discovery.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - Undiscovered Talent
1.plot: After a sleepless night, the first match of the tournament has arrived. But Kuzu High isn’t the only team pinning their dreams on this game.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - Rush and Rush
1.plot: Hobble a key player, and the entire team will fall apart. Chiaki learns this lesson the hard way when the players of Shinjo High render his passing abilities obsolete.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E27 - The Hard Play
1.plot: Kuzu’s early lead makes no difference to Shinjo High, who quickly takes control of the game. Subbed in as pointguard, can Sora turn the tide back in his team’s favor?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E28 - Vow
1.plot: As pressure builds and halftime approaches, Chiaki makes a decision that could shake the entire team. Will he leave Kuzu high and dry or rally in time for the second half?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E29 - Bonds
1.plot: As Kuzu dominates the court, the prospect of winning fades for Shinjo High — but help is on the way from the team’s most unlikely player.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E30 - Reason for Living
1.plot: Despite his terrible knee injury, Kojima’s skill are formidable, but he isn’t the only member of Shinjo High that Kuzu should keep on their radar…

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E31 - What Must Be Protected
1.plot: As the end of the game draws near, the players of Kuzu High push themselves to the limit. Only one thing’s for certain: Stamina will decide their fate.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E32 - Time Limit
1.plot: With only seconds on the clock, the pressure of defending the lead falls squarely on Kuzu High. But winning the match isn’t the only thing Sora needs to worry about…

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E33 - Life
1.plot: Reunited at long last, Sora and his mother have a lot to talk about — and time is of the essence. Elsewhere, Sora’s teammates deal with the aftermath of their recent match.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E34 - Light Trails
1.plot: Sora is nowhere to be found, and in his absence, the basketball team must pick up the pieces. Whether they will succeed depends on the fire burning in their hearts.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E35 - Stand
1.plot: A new challenger with mysterious motivations approaches Tobi for a game of one-on-one. Meanwhile, Sora returns, but the basketball team isn’t the same club he left behind.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E36 - Kids Are Allright
1.plot: The team must find a new advisor, so they take matters into their own hands — but will Satsuki be willing to return to the basketball club? Better yet, will Momoharu?

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E37 - Tender
1.plot: It may be raining, but nothing can douse Sora and his teammates’ fiery passion for basketball. Proving that passion to the administration, however, is another matter entirely.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E38 - Earring
1.plot: Restless and unfocused, Madoka takes the night off to hang out with friends. But fun turns to fear when Madoka realizes she’s lost something important in the pouring rain…

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E39 - Fight For Rock For Life
1.plot: Chiba is determined to take Maru High to the top! And with only one more chance to reach the inter-high, they’ll have to pull out all the stops to beat Yokohama Taiei.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E40 - Stop & Go
1.plot: Yokohama Taiei is a force to be reckoned with, but not everyone is suited for a spot on this infamous team. Elsewhere, Sora seeks out a previous opponent for guidance.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E41 - Challenger
1.plot: The day of the match against Yokohama Taiei descends along with a wave of unprecedented heat… and Tobi is nowhere to be found.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E42 - War Declaration
1.plot: After a rocky start, Kuzu plays surprisingly well again Yokohama Taiei — but when a new player enters the game, the tide abruptly turns.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E43 - The Best Lineup
1.plot: At rock bottom, the only way to go is up. Tobi knows this all too well, and he’s determined to take Kuzu High all the way to the top! But first they need to take Taiei down…

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E44 - Fuse
1.plot: What’s a pint-sized point guard to do when the opposition shuts down every play? Advice on the matter comes from an unexpected source, but it may do more harm than good.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E45 - Break
1.plot: Tobi and Sora have something in common: rivalries with other players. Too bad Tobi’s rivalry seems so one-sided… for now, at least.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E46 - Certain Proof
1.plot: Once they find the spark that sets them alight, Kuzu High will not be stopped. The spark that sets Sora ablaze? Another player who will bring out his full potential.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E47 - Sora the Duck
1.plot: Sora gets a run for his money when a pokerfaced new player leaps onto the court — and into the role of the opposition’s point guard.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E48 - The Straight Story
1.plot: Some players run toward the finish line; others stop or slow down along the way. With Chiaki’s help, Tobi intends to sprint straight to winning against Yokohama Taiei!

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E49 - The Last Period
1.plot: It’s the final period of their match against Yokohama, and the fate of the Kuzu High basketball team hangs entirely upon their performance in the last few seconds of the game.

1.title: EN - Ahiru no Sora [MULTI-SUB] - S01E50 - Bridge
1.plot: The match is finally over, and one question remains: Have the players of Kuzu High done enough to save the basketball club, or have their inter-high dreams come to an end?

meta.plot: Year 198 of the Solar Era in Tokyo, special fire brigades are fighting against a phenomenon called spontaneous human combustion where humans beings are turned into living infernos called "Infernals". While the Infernals are first generation cases of spontaneous human combustion, later generations possess the ability to manipulate flames while retaining human form. Shinra Kusakabe, a youth who gained the nickname Devil's Footprints for his ability to ignite his feet at will, joins the Special Fire Force Company 8 which composes of other flames users as they work to extinguish any Infernals they encounter. As a faction that is creating Infernals appears, Shira begins to uncover the truth behind a mysterious fire that caused the death of his family twelve years ago.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Shinra Kusakabe Enlists
1.plot: On his first day with Special Fire Force Company 8, Shinra Kusakabe, a third-generation pyrokinetic who is able to produces flames from his feet, meets his fellow company members and begins to fulfil his wish of becoming a hero.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Heart of a Fire Soldier
1.plot: Arthur Boyle, the self-professed “Knight King,” arrives at Company 8, and immediately, there are tensions between him and Shinra. With the Rookie Games coming up, Hinawa wants to see what the two new recruits are really capable of.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Rookie Fire Soldier Games
1.plot: Shinra and Arthur compete in the Rookie Fire Soldier Games, a contest to test the abilities of each year’s newest recruits. However, they are interrupted at the goal by the mysterious man who created explosions at their last fire scene.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Hero and the Princess
1.plot: A call mistakenly comes in to Company 8 to rescue a dog out of a tree, to which Shinra and Arthur respond. However, when an Infernal suddenly appears at the district courthouse, the two must play catch-up to join the rest of the company.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Battle Begins
1.plot: While jogging, Shinra inadvertently disturbs Iris’s purification rite, and sees that she is troubled. When Iris later turns up missing, the other members of Company 8 rally to Company 5’s compound, to which Iris had secretly slipped away.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Spark of Promise
1.plot: Shinra confronts Hibana in an attempt to rescue Iris, and must once again deal with her ability to make his body shut down. The story of Hibana and Iris’ youth as orphans, as well as Hibana’s rise to prominence, is revealed.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Investigation of the 1st Commences
1.plot: The members of Company 5 and 8 get together for a cookout, ostensibly to celebrate a successful nighttime training exercise. Using the bylaws of the Special Fire Force, Obi gets Shinra and Arthur temporarily assigned to the 1st to investigate it.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Infernal Insects
1.plot: Obi goes over Hibana’s research, and learns that the artificially-created Infernals she dissected all had traces of insect DNA in them. Shinra and Arthur’s investigation at the 1st continues, and they finally get their first lead on a culprit.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Spreading Malice
1.plot: Tamaki watches on as Shinra confronts Rekka over his actions, and reminisces about how she once looked up to the lieutenant. Rekka reveals his objective in seeking out compatible children, one which could spell disaster for the entire world.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Promise
1.plot: A captains’ conference is convened to allow the Special Fire Force to discuss the situation with the Evangelist and the White-Clad. Shinra once again has an encounter with Joker, in which startling information about Shinra’s brother is revealed.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Formation of Special Fire Force Company 8 / The Mightiest Hikeshi
1.plot: While Company 8 searches for clues about the Evangelist, Hinawa recounts the tale of how the company originally came into existence. A lead prompts the crew to pay a visit to Company 7’s jurisdiction in Asakusa, and its captain, Benimaru.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Eve of Hostilities in Asakusa
1.plot: Company 8 pitches in to help rebuild Asakusa after the latest Infernal incident, helping to gain the trust of its people. However, a White-Clad plot threatens to undo all of their goodwill, prompting Obi to take matters into his own hands.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Trap is Set
1.plot: With Konro’s help, the members of the 8th begin investigating events in the 7th’s jurisdiction. Chaos breaks out one dozens of cases of mistaken identity crop up, and the town’s people turn on each other. The 8th comes under White-Clad attack.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - For Whom the Flames Burn
1.plot: As Asakusa burns around them, Konro encourages Benimaru to step into his role as a community leader. Benimaru devises a way for the townspeople to foil the designs of the impostors among the crowd. Konro reaches out to Shinra for help.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Blacksmith’s Dream
1.plot: Viktor Licht is assigned to Company 8 as its forensic scientist, but he is viewed with suspicion, since the assignment came from Haijima. Obi sends Shinra, Arthur and Iris to speak to a man named Vulcan about joining the 8th as its engineer.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - We Are Family
1.plot: Vulcan teaches Yu a lesson in the importance of forging things that cannot be broken, and his hope to create similarly unbreakable family ties. Sensing a threat to Vulcan, the members of Company 8 take up positions to keep him safe.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Black and White and Gray
1.plot: While Dr. Giovanni continues to search Vulcan’s workshop, Hibana comes to Shinra’s aid, allowing him to rush back to help Vulcan. Meanwhile, Arthur has his hands full trying to deal with Mirage’s illusions, and Iris resists in her own way.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - The Secrets of Pyrokinesis
1.plot: Vulcan gets settled in at the 8th, while Captain Obi meets with Hibana, Konro, and Karim to exchange data on the White-Clad matter. Konro proposes that Shinra and Arthur be given combat training in Asakusa to improve their fighting skills.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Into the Nether
1.plot: Licht’s analysis of the attack on Vulcan’s workshop reveals that the Evangelist’s men have been in the “Nether,” the area beneath Tokyo. Company 8 proceeds underground in search of the White-Clad and the secrets behind human combustion.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Wearing His Pride
1.plot: Hinawa comes upon an abandoned subway station, where he gets into a shootout with Arrow. Arthur and Mirage find themselves in a rematch, as Arthur gets the chance to put the training he received from Benimaru and Konro to the test.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Those Connected
1.plot: Obi and Vulcan face off against Dr. Giovanni and Lisa, during which Giovanni tells Obi more about the nature of Adolla Bursts. Shinra has an unusual experience that leads him to find Sho, but their reunion proves more volatile than hoped for.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - A Brother’s Determination
1.plot: As Shinra and Sho continue to share their Adolla Link, Shinra learns a startling truth about the origin of his Adolla Burst flame. Shinra comes to understand the Link’s nature further, developing his skills even more in his effort to reach Sho.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Smile
1.plot: Shinra revisits his childhood to share his memories with Sho, to try to forge a deeper connection. When one of their own is critically injured, the members of the 8th rally to the rescue, and turn to Captain Huang of the 6th for assistance.

1.title: EN - Enen no Shouboutai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - The Burning Past
1.plot: Before being discharged from the hospital, Shinra is visited by Captain Burns, who offers to tell him all about the fire that happened 12 years ago, but only if Shinra can demonstrate that he is strong enough to hear the whole truth.

meta.plot: As his classmates celebrate their middle school graduation, troubled Mirai is mired in darkness. But his battle is just beginning when he receives some salvation from above in the form of an angel. Now Mirai is pitted against 12 other chosen humans in a battle in which the winner becomes the next god of the world. Mirai has an angel in his corner, but he may need to become a devil to survive.

1.title: EN - Platinum End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Gift from an Angel
1.plot: Having lost the will to live, Mirai Kakehashi decides to kill himself on the day of his middle school graduation. However, Nasse the angel suddenly appears and saves his life. Furthermore, Nasse grants him Wings and Arrows to inspire hope in him. Mirai initially rejects Nasse's offer, but after acquiring the Wings, he slowly begins to regain his lost hope. However, Nasse reveals some shocking information to him... In order to verify the truth, Mirai confronts his aunt who is raising him.

1.title: EN - Platinum End [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Hero of Justice
1.plot: Nasse informs Mirai that he has been chosen to be a "God candidate." Only one out of the thirteen God candidates will be selected to become the next God. Mirai has trouble believing the news at first, but he decides to take the first step towards living a happy life. However, one day, he learns another God candidate died under mysterious circumstances.
