1.plot: Having seized Gran Crevasse, emissaries are sent out to demand the surrender of the klaxosaurs' leader. Meanwhile, the Nines visit Squad 13, and there a shocking discovery is made.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - When the Sakura Blooms
1.plot: Squad 13 is told they will be abandoning Mistilteinn soon, and they decide to go out with a bang by making one last memory of their lives there.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Inhumanity
1.plot: Dr. Franxx confronts the APE brass about what they did to Kokoro and Mitsuru, and their attitude makes him reflect on his past, the choices he and humanity made, and the path they took.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - A New World
1.plot: Humanity's operation to wipe out the klaxosaurs once and for all begins, and APE sends Strelizia to take control of Star Entity, the enemy's biggest weapon. However, the klaxosaur princess has other ideas.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - For You, My Love
1.plot: There appears to be no escape from the impending destruction of Earth. But at the end of the world, Zero Two decides that she will keep her promise, no matter what.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Stargazers
1.plot: Hiro is left shattered with an unresponsive Zero Two, and the children struggle to come to terms with the aftermath. Left all alone to battle for their survival, what path will they choose to take?

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - DARLING in the FRANXX
1.plot: The gang heads off to space to fight in what they believe to be the final battle. Meanwhile, Kokoro and Mitsuru stay behind to fight a battle of their own.

1.title: EN - DARLING in the FRANXX [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Never Let Me Go
1.plot: While Hiro and Zero Two head to VIRM's home planet to defeat them, the rest of Squad 13 do their best to get life on Earth back on track.

Two ninja clans, Tsubagakure of the Iga and Manjidani of Kouga, battle each other to determine which grandson of Tokugawa Ieyasu will become the next shogun. The deadly competition between 10 elite ninja from each clan unleashes a centuries-old hatred that threatens to destroy all hope for peace between them.

meta.plot:
Sometime after the events of Kamen Rider W, Shotaro Hidari and Philip continue to solve crimes and fight evil as superhero detectives in the windy city of Fuuto.

Produced as one of 3 projects to celebrate Kamen Rider's 50th anniversary along with Kamen Rider Black Sun and Shin Kamen Rider.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Beware of t / The Man Who Loved a Witch
1.plot: In the windy city of Fuuto, private detective Shotaro Hidari works with his friends to protect the citizens... in more ways than one. But a chance encounter with a bewitching femme fatale might spell a whole new kind of trouble for him, and his city.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Beware of t / The Culprit Is Right There
1.plot: The hunt for Tokime continues, but Shotaro begins to have growing doubts about her guilt, which leads to friction with his partner, Philip.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Beware of t / The Masked Defender
1.plot: The identity of the Road Dopant has been made clear, and Kamen Rider W is here to save the day. But questions still remain. Who is Tokime, and what happened to her memories?

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Terrible m / Wings of Death
1.plot: When a popular video game company's idol-spokeswoman/head developer starts receiving death threats, the Narumi Detective Agency is brought in to protect her.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Terrible m / The Sound of a Leak
1.plot: Shotaro is injured defending the video game idol, Megu Kazamatsuri, leaving Philip in charge of the investigation. But can he and Tokime put aside their differences to protect their client?

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Terrible m / White Fangs
1.plot: The final confrontation with the Meganeura Dopant is at hand, and just as Tokime starts to settle in at the Narumi Detective Agency, a threatening force in the city's underworld begins to stir.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Closed k / Dynamic Duo, Deserted
1.plot: After a flight of fancy leaves Shotaro and Philip stranded in the mountains during a blizzard, they stumble onto a mansion that hosts a bizarre ritual.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Closed k / A Chain of Malice
1.plot: Shotaro and Philip struggle to discover the truth behind the Alcohol Dopant's attacks before there's another death.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Closed k / The Ultimate Two Halves of One
1.plot: A confrontation erupts when the Alcohol Dopant's true identity is revealed, while Kamen Rider Accel battles the gruesome Scream.

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Superhuman r / A Passport to Shadow Fuuto
1.plot: A young girl contacts the Narumi Detective Agency about her missing grandfather. But what does her case have to do with Shadow Fuuto?

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Superhuman r / In Search of a Connection
1.plot: W and Accel are forced out of Shadow Fuuto by the nuclear-powered Nikaido and his army of monstrous Road Dopants. Will they find their way back in time to rescue Tokime and Rentaro?

1.title: EN - Fuuto Tantei [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Superhuman r / Death, and......
1.plot: Tokime tries to help Rentaro escape Shadow Fuuto, as the Kamen Riders track down Reactor's hideout.

meta.plot: When her engagement to the prince ends unceremoniously, details of the young noblewoman Aileen's past life come rushing back and help her realize she's living inside the world of one of her favorite otome games—as the heroine's greatest rival! However, her memory has more plot holes than bad fan fiction…and the only certainty is that if she doesn't do something quick, her death is all but assured. The hero/main-love-interest can't be relied on, so why not see what the last boss has to say?

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Wicked Heiress's Story Begins
1.plot: During her public denouncement, Aileen Lauren Dautriche suddenly remembers her past life. She's the villainess from an otome game she once played that will die in terrible ways! She must survive! The best way to ensure her survival? Tame the last boss!

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Villainess May Have Many Enemies, but She Also Has Many Underlings
1.plot: After breaking off the engagement, Prince Cedric seizes all of Aileen's businesses. Aileen is in danger of being disowned and becoming a commoner if she doesn't recover the financial losses of the Dautriche family before the ball in two months...

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Villainess Is Greedy and Goes for the Win
1.plot: Aileen finds out that Cedric's new fiancée, Lilia Rainworth, has received threatening letters that were signed by herself. Since she has no memory of doing so, she has her friends help her find out the truth. On the night of the ball, Aileen attends wearing the dress and accessories given to her by Claude. At the same time, Lilia appears at the demon lord's castle.

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Villainess Should Be Able to Tame the Final Bos
1.plot: Aileen finds out that Claude's aide, Keith Eigrid, has been selling demons. Keith tells Aileen about the reason why and reminisces about their past. Now that Aileen knows his true feelings, she decides to cooperate with Keith to prevent Claude from despairing about humanity and turning into a demon. At the same time, Cédric and Lilia visits the demon lord's castle to tell Claude Keith's secret?!

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Villainess Tricks Her Fiancé
1.plot: Aileen overcame all the difficulties and got engaged with Claude. Just when she thought she found her happily ever after, she receives news that a demon named Ashtarte attacked a human village in the Mirchetta region. Sensing new dangers, Aileen infiltrates Mische Academy in the Grand Duchy of Mirchetta to investigate the situation. There, she meets James Charles, the last boss of Regalia of Saints, Demons, and Maidens 2 as well as the other quirky members of the student council.

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Villainess Is Unforgiving of Evil
1.plot: James turns into a demon at a different point from the original game, but Aileen decides he can still revert back and lets him escape. However, the student council member Walt Lizanis witnesses the scene and begins to doubt Aileen's identity. In turn, she exposes Walt and Kyle Elford's true identities and their mission. They decide to temporarily work together to solve the vampire case. Meanwhile, Mische Academy receives another statement from Ashtarte...

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Villainess Steals the Show
1.plot: "James is suspicious of Aileen since she knows of his demon form. However, Ribbon's existence and Aileen's words ""I want to protect you"" softens his heart and he decides to work with her on the case. The day of the school festival finally arrives and Aileen patrols the area with James in duck costumes. Meanwhile, Claude tosses his work to the side and goes to the school festival to have some fun. He meets a certain duck again when he entering the swordsmanship tournament."

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Crimes of the Villainess Are Revealed
1.plot: Knowing that the prize of the contest for White Lily Princess is demon incense that's harmful to demons, Aileen removes her male student disguise and enters the contest dressed as a woman. While others are overwhelmed by her beauty, James asks her to dance. The light dance steps of the pair fascinates the audience and Aileen is chosen to be the White Lily Princess. However, right after that, the mastermind has demon incense scattered throughout the venue. Aileen and the others struggle in vain as James turns into a demon.

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Villainess Should Just Be Forgotten
1.plot: Aileen and the others infiltrate a black market auction that is trading demon incense. She meets the sorcerer Elephas Levi when she tries to sneak into the host's room. The final boss of the Regalia of Saints, Demons, and Maidens fan disk wishes to meet with Claude. Levi hopes that Claude will reconsider the treatment of the Levi family. That night, Aileen receives a report that Claude is stabbed in the abdomen by someone?!

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Love of the Villainess Doesn't Reach
1.plot: Claude loses his memory and magical powers, returning him into a normal human being. In order to show the appeal of that aspect to the public, he goes on an inspection of the third zone of the imperial capital. During this time, Aileen follows Claude and tries to confirm her position as his fiancée. However, she just ends up experiencing the bitter feelings of a one-sided love. When she returns to the demon lord's castle, she finds the heroine of Regalia Of Saints, Demons, and Maidens 2, Selena Gilbert, fighting for demon incense with Auguste Zelm, the official hero...

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Villainess Always Gets Condemned
1.plot: Aileen and Claude get separated by a misunderstanding. Aileen stubbornly decides she can avoid getting executed if she just dissolves her engagement with Claude and buries herself in work. Soon, she receives a dress from Claude for the upcoming ball. He's cold when she tries to seduce him, but he chases after her once she gives up...... The confused Aileen shows up to the ball dressed as a duck, but is blown away by the words that comes out of his mouth.

1.title: EN - Akuyaku Reijou nano de Last Boss o Katte Mimashita [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Even the Villainess Can Be the Main Character If There Is Love
1.plot: Aileen falls into the sorcerer's village. While she is imprisoned, she finds out that this is all part of a coup d'état planned by the Levi family and that Lilia instigated their actions. Aileen discovers that Lilia has been secretly serving the empress dowager and she escapes the prison after winning Elephas, who has been branded as a traitor, over to her side. The two of them rush to the imperial palace to save the doomed Levi family and Claude. However, Lilia stands in their way with another holy sword in her hands.

meta.plot:
The world is ruled by spirits, goblins, and all manner of strange creatures. Human beings are persecuted, to the very point of extinction. One day, a golem and a lone human girl meet.

This is a record of the pair, one a member of a ruined race, the other a watchman of the forest. It tells of their travels together and of the bond between father and daughter.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Journeying Parent and Child
1.plot: In a world ruled by monsters, a golem takes a human child on a journey in search of her own kind. In a city, the people express surprise at seeing a golem leave its forest, and a curious Somali strays from Golem's side.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Edible Herbs and the Oni's Dwelling
1.plot: When Somali gets injured, the dwarf oni doctor Shizuno invites them back to his house for treatment. Golem asks Shizuno to teach him how to make medicine to use on their journey going forward.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Sea at the Bottom of the Cave
1.plot: In order to earn travel funds, Golem gets a job working for Kokilila in Anthole City. As Somali watches him at work, she begins to fear he's trying to end their journey as soon as possible. Kokilia's son, Kikila, then leads her into an underground world to cheer Somali up.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Wishing Flower and the Promise Request
1.plot: With Kikila and Muthrica's help, Somali finds a flower that will grant wishes. But Golem scolds her for coming home late, and tells her they may not be able to travel together anymore. The psychological trauma collides with Somali's building exhaustion from the journey, and causes her to collapse.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Wandering Birds
1.plot: When Golem and Somali need to travel across a large desert, two bird travelers, Uzoi and Haitora, offer them free transport. But these travelers harbor secrets, and they could possibly be a danger to Somali.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Dying Flowers Look Up at the Birds
1.plot: Hoping to cure Haitora's illness, Uzoi attacks Somali, but realizes she can't bring herself to hurt her. That night, Haitora reveals an important secret to Golem... which Uzoi happens to overhear.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Footsteps That Stalk the Witches
1.plot: After leaving the desert, Somali and Golem travel to a witch village in search of a library that holds books from around the world, in which they have hopes of finding books about humans that may provide clues of their current whereabouts. After learning of a book about humans called "The Story of Haraiso" in the witches' library, they work with the librarian, Hazel, to find the book.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Meeting and Bonds Prayed For
1.plot: Somali and Golem meet the head librarian of library since she was the last one to possess "The Chronicle of Haraiso". Upon meeting her, they learn she's also the author of the book and they listen as she shares the story of her ancestor, Feodora, and her first encounter with humans ages before.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Memories of Minor Days
1.plot: Somali and Golem stay for the night at an empty lodge when it starts raining. The two spend time baking together when Somali finds a cookbook. During the night, two friends appear before them.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Infant Child and the Green Boulder
1.plot: Golem recalls back to the time he first met Somali in his forest. Later, when Golem and Yabashira begin their jobs as bodyguards, Somali and Shizuno do arts and crafts when Somali decides she wants to make a gift for Golem.

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Those Who Protect and Those Who Threaten
1.plot: Somali finishes her fita band with Auntie Rosa's help, and exchanges presents with Golem. But that night, hunters attack...

1.title: EN - Somali to Mori no Kamisama [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Bonded Father and Child
1.plot: Golem transforms and fights off the human hunters to protect Somali. But when he continues to rampage, the others stop him from doing anymore harm. After the incident, Golem questions if he can still continue his role as Somali's father.

meta.plot: Shinjuku Ward, east side… The center of the street with the most chaos, there's Kabuki-chō, full of neon lights. When the light is stronger, the shadow is deeper. The story begins when certain bizarre murder happens one night! Suspense? Or Comedy? Drama that cannot be identified begins!

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Hello Detectives
1.plot: Something strange has been happening to John Watson. He goes to the detectives in Kabukicho for help, but they're even weirder!

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Why Not Join the Staring-At-Eye-Moles Squad?
1.plot: A woman is hired as an idol for her beautiful moles under her eyes. But when the day of her big show comes, the producer disappears! Is a crime involved?

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Dream of Fuyuto Kyokgoku, the Ace
1.plot: A nephew is framed for the murder of his uncle, and it's up to Sherlock to clear his name.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Water's Usually Hot
1.plot: Now that he's broke, Watson has to use the public bath. But there's murder waiting for him there, too!

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Offside is the Best Side
1.plot: Mary's decided she wants to go to an expensive school, and Lucy decides to raise the money. But getting big money fast means taking big risks...

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Kobayashi the Man, Giving It His All
1.plot: Kobayashi runs into his old boss from his time in the Kaneko Gang. When one of the Kabukicho Irregulars steals a valuable sticker from the gangster, he'll have to risk it all to help them out.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Wife Looks Into the Future
1.plot: Watson gets his first solo case as Sherlock sends him to investigate the home of the mysterious Irene Adler.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Don't Take Off the Swimsuit
1.plot: Irene joins the team as they track down a medical chart in the possession of an infamous blackmailer, while Sherlock gets stuck with childcare duties.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - That Woman's Pad
1.plot: Jack the Ripper is after Irene's life, and Sherlock and Watson must take extraordinary steps to protect her.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Now Hiring Psychics
1.plot: A badly depressed Watson struggles to come to terms with his new life, as Sherlock vows vengeance on Jack the Ripper.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Jack the Ripper
1.plot: The identity of Jack the Ripper is revealed when Sherlock finally makes his move.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - No More Nyan-Nyan
1.plot: The detectives try to cheer up after a hard week. Mrs. Hudson sends them after her missing cat to keep their minds occupied.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - First Moonlit Night
1.plot: While James has a difficult time in prison, Mycroft arrives at the row house and reflects on how Sherlock got his start in rakugo.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Take Back Your Melon Heart
1.plot: Fuyuto is in shock and not himself for several weeks after the events with Jack the Ripper. Sent to the hospital, he is met with a new case.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Where Is He?
1.plot: Watson and Mary do their best to stop the scammers that are planning a horrific upcoming terrorist attack.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Michel and Dopey
1.plot: Michel finally reunites with his long-lost daughter, but she is promptly arrested for murder soon after.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Looking Back on Saudade
1.plot: Ten months after the business with Michel's daughter, Sherlock cracks a mysterious code that leads to an even deeper mystery.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Lots of Animals
1.plot: What starts off as an investigation into an animal killer, escalates into something far more sinister and dangerous.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The Curtain Rises on the Grand Guignol
1.plot: New information comes to light about all of the strange incidents, and the true cause of everything is finally revealed.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Moriarty Savors
1.plot: As the villain makes his move, Watson finds himself in serious danger; Mary is caught in a compromising position.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Not Breathing
1.plot: With Watson's disappearance accomplished, the villain is prepared to execute the next phase of his master plan.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Thread Where We Talk About Yeast
1.plot: A Santa with a purple beard drops off some presents and a suspicious Sherlock chases after him before receivnig an invitation to a clandestine meeting.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Everybody Be There at Eight
1.plot: Watson desperately tries to find Sherlock before he reaches the point of no return. He even tries to hire the other detectives, but they refuse to help.

1.title: EN - Case File N° 221: Kabukicho [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - See You in Kabukicho!
1.plot: Following the investigation into Moriarty, Sherlock performs his final rakugo entitled Moriarty the Living.

meta.plot: The story centers on a little girl called Sana, who is one of the children that holds the power of "Alice's Dream," an ability that enables her to materialize anything she imagines. After escaping a lab where she was a test subject, Sana ends up in a normal world where she encounters an old man named Zouroku, but will he help her?

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Red Queen Escapes
1.plot: In a deep, remote forest, a blond-haired girl runs amidst heavy rain and wind. Some pursue her, while others extend a hand to help her. As various motives tangle together, the girl, named Sana, makes her flight to the outside world for the first time in her life. In the end, Sana arrives at the bustling district of Kabukicho in Tokyo's Shinjuku Ward. In a convenience store there, she meets Kashimura Zoroku, the quintessential "stubborn old man."

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Dreams of Alice
1.plot: Since Sana had nowhere to go, Zoroku decided to let her stay in his own home for the time being. After he finds out that the previous day's incident isn't being covered by any media, he makes a call to an old friend. Meanwhile, Sana awakens to find Zoroku's granddaughter, Sanae, watching over her. Sanae says her grandpa asked her to keep an eye on Sana while he went to work. Sana was untrusting at first, but they eventually warm up to each other. Then Sana recalls her time spent at the research facility...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Cards
1.plot: Kashimura Floral is in an uproar after Sana uses her Dream of Alice, suddenly landing herself and Sanae in the shop. Even after things quiet down, Zoroku scolds Sana for breaking her promise not to use her power. Then Naito, an old acquaintance of Zoroku's, enters the scene with a proposal for Zoroku. Meanwhile, Kito and his team in pursuit of Sana are steadily closing in...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Something Not Human
1.plot: Minnie C and her group took advantage of a moment's negligence to kidnap Sana. Left behind at his office, Zoroku demands answers from Naito as to just what Sana really is. Meanwhile, the giant "arms" controlled by Minnie C have Sana completely trapped, and Minnie C asks her, "Did you think that you were human?" Just when it seems all hope is lost, Sana's powerful thoughts take the situation in an unexpected direction...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Home to Return to
1.plot: When Sana and Zoroku are loaded onto a cargo ship, the one who appears to rescue them is Cabinet Information Research Office agents Ichijo Shizuku and Yamada Noriko. As they all plan their escape, Minnie C stand before them once again. As she attacks with the invisible arms that she can control freely, Ichijo links with Yamada to unleash various abilities of her own. As this battle between Dreams of Alice rages on, Sana tells Zoroku what she truly wishes for.

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Kashimura Family
1.plot: The seasons have quickly turned to winter. The matter of the research facility has been resolved, and life is normal again in Zoroku's household. Sana seems to have fully adjusted to being a member of the Kashimura family, as well. After seeing Sanae off on her way to school, she heads for the flower shop with Zoroku, where she sometimes helps with his work. She still has some trouble with stamina, but she has adapted well to the outside world. Then, one day, Sana goes out with Zoroku to get her overgrown hair cut...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Friends
1.plot: Zoroku is making a trip to Yokohama to meet a client, so he takes Sana with him. Accompanied by Ichijo, Sana is impressed by the sight of the ocean and the robot-operated factory that she visits, and enjoys her day out to the fullest. Rejoined by Zoroku, the trio visits Chinatown, but then Asahi and Yonaga suddenly appear after being unseen ever since the research facility incident was resolved. The twins run away as Sana and Ichijo chase after them...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Evil Witch
1.plot: Shikishima Hatori is a completely ordinary grade school girl. Then, one day, she develops a "Dream of Alice" power. Hurt by the sight of her parents constantly fighting over her future schooling, Hatori prays that they'll go back to being her kind mom and dad again... and that dream is realized in a way she never expected. Meanwhile, Sana is helping out at the flower shop as usual, waiting excitedly for Asahi and Yonaga to come for a visit...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Where the Cheshire Cat Smiles
1.plot: Sana collapsed after meeting Hatori and Ayumu, and Asahi and Yonaga brought her back to Zoroku's house. The three girls are now having a great time playing together for the first time in so long. Then Sana comes up with a plan to teach Hatori a lesson for doing something so awful to Zoroku. Meanwhile, Hatori's emotional state has changed yet again after her encounter with Sana. She tells her best friend, Ayumu, that she's used her power too much and can't go to school again. So a concerned Ayumu returns to Harajuku to search for Sana.

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Little Queen
1.plot: A collision with a "Dream of Alice" power has left Sana and Hatori trapped in the deepest part of Wonderland. They wander all over this world so unlike their own, but there's no sign of an exit anywhere. Meanwhile. after learning what's happened to Sana, Zoroku and Sanae head to Wonderland with Ichijo. They can't help gazing with wonder at their first sight of Wonderland, the place where Sana was born. But they've barely begun the search before Ichijo...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Queen and the Witch
1.plot: Ten days have passed in the outside world since Sana and Hatori got trapped in Wonderland. Ayumu, remembering a promise they once made, begins to worry that Hatori won't ever come back. As he and Sanae search, Zoroku looks back on on all the things that have happened since they met Sana. Meanwhile, Sana and Hatori finally find an exit out of Wonderland, but it has already begun expanding at an accelerated rate, to the point that it's affecting the outside world...

1.title: EN - Alice & Zoroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I'm Home
1.plot: As Hatori's parents desperately search for Hatori, it is revealed that she and Sana have been missing for ten days in the real world. In Wonderland, the two girls attempt to find a new exit and come across a rabbit that is holding Hatori's cell phone.

meta.plot: In the beginning, an "orb" is cast unto Earth. "It" can do two things: change into the form of the thing that stimulates "it"; and come back to life after death. "It" morphs from orb to rock, then to wolf, and finally to boy, but roams about like a newborn who knows nothing. As a boy, "it" becomes Fushi. Through encounters with human kindness, Fushi not only gains survival skills, but grows as a "person". But his journey is darkened by the inexplicable and destructive enemy Nokker, as well as cruel partings with the people he loves.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Last One
1.plot: An orb is tossed upon the earth. It transforms to match its surrounding environment: first a rock, then moss, then a dying wolf. The wolf returns to its last remaining family, a boy living alone in a small home in the snow.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Rambunctious Girl
1.plot: The orb, having morphed into a boy, finds its way to Ninanna, where he is attacked. He is discovered by a girl, March, who may not achieve her goal of becoming a grown-up.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Small Evolution
1.plot: March is escorted to the altar to be sacrificed to Oniguma. Along the way, she tends to Fushi, who, despite having the body of a young man, doesn’t seem to have the mind of one.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Large Vessel
1.plot: Hayase, interested in Fushi’s inability to die, brings him along with March, Parona and Pioran to the nation of Yanome. They are shown around town and treated well, but things are not as they seem.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Those Who Follow
1.plot: Fushi, March and Parona continue their escape from Yanome and back to Ninanna. Hayase chases after them, especially in order to capture Fushi.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Our Goals
1.plot: Having gained a semblance of humanity, Fushi sets off on his own. He encounters Pioran again, who teachers him words and writing, helping him live as a human being.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Boy Who Wants to Change
1.plot: Fushi and Pioran arrive at Takunaha, where they meet Booze Man and a boy named Gugu. Gugu, who had been living with Booze Man for several months following an accident, warms up to Fushi.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Monster Brothers
1.plot: Fushi explains to Gugu how his form as the wolf, Joaan, and March, came to be. Gugu explains death to Fushi. Together, they come to understand the meaning of family.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Deep Memories
1.plot: Fushi tells Gugu about the wolf, Joaan, and the boy he took on the form of. Gugu explains death to Fushi, recalling his own past, working for a wealthy family with his brother.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - New Family
1.plot: Fushi and Gugu fight against the Nokkers that they encountered in the forest. Though the situation is grim, Gugu has a trick up his sleeve.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Gift From the Past
1.plot: Four years after their encounter with the Nokkers, Fushi and Gugu have grown into fine young men. They’re invited to Rean’s birthday party after a brief reunion with Gugu’s brother.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Awakening
1.plot: Just as Gugu and Rean come to understand each other, the Nokkers emerge, causing panic in the party hall. Fushi and Gugu are forced to fight.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Aspiring to Go Higher
1.plot: Fushi leaves Booze Man’s home and sets out to wander aimlessly around Takunaha. He has many questions for the Observer, but can’t seem to get any straight answers.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Jananda, Island of Freedom
1.plot: Fushi and Pioran are separated on the prison island of Jananda. He enters a tournament where, if he survives until the end, he will be granted the right to do anything he wants – including leaving the island with Pioran.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - A Girl Named Tonari
1.plot: Fushi transforms into Parona of Ninannah in the middle of the tournament. He is shocked when he realizes what this implies. Meanwhile, Tonari, desperate to have Fushi join her and her friends, offers to help rescue Pioran.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Children's Dreams
1.plot: Fushi just barely manages to take down the Nokkers. He opens up to the others, and they discuss their dreams and pasts.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Defeated
1.plot: Having defeated Fushi, Hayase makes a surprising proposal to the people of the island of Jananda.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - To Continue On
1.plot: Tonari returns to Jananda to rescue Fushi. Before setting out again, they stay the night in a cave, and Tonari shares her past.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Wandering Rage
1.plot: Fushi, Tonari and their friends fight the Nokkers, who have taken over corpses.

1.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Echoes
1.plot: Fushi parts ways with Tonari and heads to the port where Pioran is waiting for him. He worries that he may attract the Nokkers again and endanger her.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Infatuation Reborn
2.plot: Fushi, having spent several decades alone on an island, learns that a village was attacked by the Nokkers.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Beating Will
2.plot: Things do not go well when Tonari tries to remove the Nokker from Hisame's arm.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Awaited
2.plot: Kahaku, the sixth of Hayase's descendants, introduces himself to Fushi. Much time has passed, and the Guardians have expanded their influence.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - The Young Man Who Can See
2.plot: Fushi must stay on the move in order to keep the Nokkers from attacking, so Prince Bon accompanies him out of the castle town.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - The Holy Man's Voyage
2.plot: Fushi, along with Kahaku, Bon and Bon's army, travel through several towns, spreading word of the Nokkers along the way.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Heretics Betrayed
2.plot: Kahaku asks Fushi to marry him. He seems confident that they can overcome the complications of Fushi being a shape-shifting immortal, but Fushi isn’t. Cylira returns.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Crime and Forgiveness
2.plot: Fushi attempts to escape from his iron cell, while Bon and Todo await their trial in their own cells.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Beyond Dreams
2.plot: The Kingdom of Ularis, along with Fushi, Todo, Bon's family, and Baron Spring Roll, prepare for life without Bon.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Expanding Consciousness
2.plot: As warned by Kahaku’s arm, the Nokkers attack the head church of the Church of Bennett, causing terrible devastation.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Resonance
2.plot: Fushi trains his senses in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack on Renril. He discovers a strange girl in a circus tent.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - The Value of Flesh
2.plot: Having finished training on the derelict ship, Fushi travels to Renril, where the Nokkers are threatening to attack.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Secret Behind the Veil
2.plot: Fushi and his allies work to win over the trust of the people of Renril in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - The Wise Man's Identity
2.plot: The team works to prevent the Nokkers from making use of the waterways and sewers. Fushi works non-stop rebuilding all the homes, and the exhaustion begins to show.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - Morning of Rebirth
2.plot: The city of Renril bands together around Fushi in preparation for the Nokkers’ attack. The princess introduces him to her father, King Boldron of Sonia.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - The Self, Worn Down
2.plot: Fushi fends off the Nokkers miles away from Renril, but the Nokkers had already devised a more cunning plan.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - Three Eternal Warriors
2.plot: The death of his three friends turns Fushi mad, and he begins defeating the Nokkers at a furious pace. But as it turns out, he may not be the only immortal.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - What You Want to Protect
2.plot: Amidst the brutal battle against the Nokkers, Bon and Kahaku both share a desire to protect Fushi’s humanity. How they go about it, however, puts them at odds.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - Death of the Deathless
2.plot: March begins her desperate search for Fushi, whose absence has led to the city being overrun by the Nokkers.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - And Then, Dawn
2.plot: In the beginning, it was an orb. And Fushi was an orb once again. But though there was no certainty, there was hope.

2.title: EN - To Your Eternity - Fumetsu no Anata [MULTI-SUB] - S02E20 - End of an Era
2.plot: With the Nokkers defeated, the people of Renril rejoice, and Fushi and his friends discuss their hopes for the future.

meta.plot: Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an ordinary salaryman, is suddenly transported to another world one day. The unique skill he gains upon arrival in this world is the seemingly useless "Online Grocery." Mukohda is discouraged at first, but the modern foods he's able to bring to his new world using this skill prove to have some unbelievable effects!

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My Absurd Skill Is Unexpectedly Useful
1.plot: One day, Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an extremely ordinary salaryman, gets caught up in a hero summons being performed in another world. At the time of his summoning, he receives a unique skill known as "Online Grocery", that allows him to bring food ingredients and seasonings from his original world. Even though this skill seems plain at first glance, the food he brings into this new world has an absurd effect...!?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Salient Familiar Is a Living Legend
1.plot: After the legendary wolf monster Fenrir got attracted to the delicious smell of Mukohda's food and signed the Familiar Contract with him, Mukohda decides to register with the Guild in Fallières his next stop.

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - My Super Power Is All About Cooking
1.plot: After registering with both the Merchant's and the Adventurer's Guilds, Mukohda immediately decides to take on a beginner’s quest. However, when they deliver the monsters that Fel caught during their quest to the Guild, they find out that most of these monsters are B-rank or higher.

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Cannot Start the Journey Without a Map
1.plot: Mukohda asks Fel to teach him how to use magic after witnessing his wind magic. However, when things do not seem to go well, Fel decides to start a Spartan training regimen for him.

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Goddess of Wind Has a Sweet Tooth
1.plot: Mukohda  and Fel arrive at a large lake, where they catch some fish and have their usual meal. But right when they start eating inside the barrier that keeps monsters at bay, a baby slime appears out of nowhere...?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Growth Happens Out of Nowhere
1.plot: The place Fel decides to bring Mukohda to get some battle experience ends up being a creepy dungeon. Even so, Mukohda gets ready for battle and increases his stats by eating a meal from his original world using the “Online Grocery”. However...

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Dances with Wolves and Monsters
1.plot: Mukohda and his familiars dash through the forest, after strengthening their bonds in the dungeon. However, they soon find themselves in the territory of dangerous monsters and, just like Mukohda expected, surrounded by a pack of orthros...

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - All of the Boss Monsters Are Tasty
1.plot: After Mukohda rescues a traveling caravan from a band of bandits, they set out together for the great city of Karelina. But when Mukohda visits the Adventurer’s Guild in the city, he gets notified that his membership was revoked...?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Hunting Quests Are All About Meat and Money
1.plot: Mukohda gets summoned by the guild master after defeating an entire settlement of goblins while finishing a guild request. Although Mukohda didn't want to make a big deal out of it, he receives a high-ranking quest directly from the guild master...?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - My Two Familiars Are Too Overpowered
1.plot: Mukohda and his familiars receive a request to head towards a mine and hunt down the metal lizard that inhabits it. Instead, they run into a rare mithril lizard. After Mukohda defeats the lizard, with the help of Fel and Sui, Fel turns his interest towards a different and tastier prey...?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Doing Business for The Missus
1.plot: Lambert consults Mukohda about a gift for his wife. When Mukohda suggests a certain product he purchased from the online grocery, it leads to an unexpected situation. Meanwhile, a pack of dangerous monsters, called wyverns, are approaching the town...?

1.title: EN -Campfire Cooking in Another World with my Absurd Skill - Tondemo Skill de Isekai Hourou Meshi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Adventures Are as Countless as Varieties of Food
1.plot: After easily defeating the pack of dangerous yet powerful wyverns, Mukohda and his familiars receive praise not only from the guild, but also from the entire town. Unfazed by the attention, Mukohda goes out to look for a certain thing that he's always wanted to get in ever since he got summoned to this world.

meta.plot: Young Dai embarks on an epic journey to become a legendary hero, training with his loyal companions to save the world from the resurrected Demon King.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Dai, The Tiny Hero
1.plot: Young Dai lives on Dermline Island, where he dreams of being a Hero. One day, a Hero and his companions come to the island. Dai is excited at first, but their true intent is to steal his best friend, Gomechan, the mythical Golden Metal Slime.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Dai and Princess Leona
1.plot: Dai must take Leona to the Earth Cave for a ritual. At first, Dai dislikes Leona, but they slowly come to understand each other. Suddenly, a giant Evil Scorpion attacks. Dai defeats it, but Leona is poisoned. As Dai’s wishes to save her...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Hero's Tutor
1.plot: A dark power affects Dai’s monster friends, driving them berserk. Brass tries to get Dai to leave. As they argue, a Hero trainer arrives to inform Dai that the Dark Lord has returned. To save those he cares about, Dai undergoes Hero training.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Dark Lord Hadlar's Return
1.plot: Avan turned into a dragon and attacks Dai. Dai fights back to no avail. To defeat Avan’s flames requires Wave Slash. As Dai clears his objective, someone enters the island. Who should appear before Avan but the worst possible being...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Insignia of Avan
1.plot: Avan is overpowered by Hadlar, who is now stronger than ever. To protect his students and the world, Avan gathers the last of his strength and faces Hadlar. Dai can do nothing but watch. Finally, the showdown between Avan and Hadlar is concluded.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Crocodine, the Beast King
EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Maam's Turmoil
1.plot: Thanks to Maam’s help, Dai goes on the offensive against Crocodine. Popp joins in and the battle intensifies. Seeing Dai and Popp fight, Maam remembers Avan’s words to her when she was young and comes to a decision.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Furfang Full Assault
1.plot: Dai and company arrive late at night to the castle town of Romos. The next morning, Crocodine attacks with the Furfang Legion. In Romos Castle, Dai faces Crocodine. Crocodine decides to use the weapon that Zaboera gave him.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A Single Shard of Courage
1.plot: Dai is heavily wounded by Crocodine’s Beast King Anguish Blast. Maam tries to save Dai, but is bound by a Heyedra. Masopho, the Mage from the fake Hero’s party shows this to Popp, who remains paralyzed by fear. Masopho then speaks of his past...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Onto Papnica Kingdom
1.plot: Having won the battle with Crocodine, Dai and company head to Papnica Kingdom, which is under attack by the Undead Legion of the Dark Army. Upon arrival, Dai sees an unbelievable sight. Meanwhile, Hadlar summons all Legion Commanders, but...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Hyunckel, the Dark Swordsman
1.plot: Dai’s Avan Strash had no effect on Hyunckel. Hyunckel dons his “Dark Armour Blade” to face Dai and his companions. Just why does Hyunckel hate Avan so much? Hyunckel reveals his past with Avan to answer Maam’s question.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Collaborative Raidein
1.plot: Thanks to Crocodine, Dai and Popp managed to escape. Popp says to Dai that if they don’t defeat Hyunckel, they won’t be able save Maam or Leona. Morning comes. Popp has come up with a plan to defeat Hyunckel and suggests the use of a certain spell.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Deciding Moment
1.plot: Hyunckel withstands the Zapple spell. His spell thwarted, Dai falls prey to Hyunckel’s Bloody Scryde. At that moment, Maam appears and hands a Soul Shell found in a hidden room to Hyunckel. It contains a shocking truth about Hyunckel’s past.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Blizzblaze General Flazzard
1.plot: After their fierce battle against Hyunckel, Dai and friends set out to find Leona. They launch signal flares and are met by Amy of the Papnica Troika, who takes them to where Leona is hiding, but Blizzblaze General Flazzard reaches her first...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Terrifying Curse Field
1.plot: Dai faces off with Flazzard. His Magic Sword is effective, but Flazzard fires off the rocks in his body in both an attack and a signal to activate the Blizzblaze Curse Field. The surrounding area is encased in a field, and Dai’s group is weakened.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Grand Sorcerer Matoriv
1.plot: Matoriv is a Grand Sorcerer living in a cave. At first, he’s resistant to helping, but upon learning that Dai is Avan’s last student, he agrees to help save Leona. Meanwhile, Hadlar’s Dark Army prepares a scheme.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Death-Defying Savior
1.plot: Dai and Baduck reach the Dark Flame Spire to find Zaboera, Mystvearn, and their Legion monsters waiting for them. Waiting for Popp and Maam at the Dark Ice Spire is Hadlar. Dai and his friends are in danger. Just then, an unlikely savior appears.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Hyunckel Versus Hadlar
1.plot: Popp and Maam are shocked by the appearance of Hyunckel. It turns out he was saved by Crocodine. Having come to help the Disciples of Avan, Hyunckel sends Popp and Maam off to Valge Tower and faces off with Hadlar.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The Final Avan Style Technique
1.plot: Dai, Popp, and Maam reach Valge Tower where they are stopped by Flazzard. Realizing he is at a disadvantage, Flazzard shatters himself into bullets of rocks and launches himself as projectiles. Just then, the words of Avan flash through Dai’s mind!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Now I Slice Everything
1.plot: With his core destroyed by Dai’s Air Slash, Flazzard splits his body. Mystvearn appears and gives Flazzard the Shadow Legion’s ultimate armour. Flazzard attacks Dai. But having completed his Avan Style Sword Technique, Dai remains unfazed...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Maam's Decision
1.plot: Dai and his friends prepare for their next battle as Papnica rebuilds. Maam hears the words of Matoriv and comes to a decision. Meanwhile, Vearn’s personal assassin, Killvearn and his companion Piroro appear before Hadlar. What will they say to him?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Off To the Department Store
1.plot: Dai and Leona head to Bengarna Kingdom to get Dai a new weapon. Freed from her duties as princess, Leona enjoys her shopping. Dai and Popp spend their time amazed by all the new sights. New encounters and new threats await them.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Dragon Knight
1.plot: Dai faces the Dragons attacking Bengarna. His sword shatters. Dragons that Popp failed to defeat join in. All prepare for defeat, but Dai unleashes the power of the Dragon Crest. Nabara and Merle realize a truth that Dai himself doesn’t yet know.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Dragon Master General Baran
1.plot: Baran reveals the duty of a Dragon Knight: to wipe out the humans. Baran explains why Dragon Knights were born. Dai rejects Baran’s words. Growing impatient, Baran blows Dai away with a powerful attack. Baran then reveals a shocking truth…!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - The Terrifying Draconic Aura
1.plot: With the secret to the Dragon Knights’ supremacy, the “Draconic Aura” deployed, Baran is invulnerable to Crocodine’s attacks. Crocodine continues to stand up to Baran. And Dai, as well. They attack Baran together, but Baran forms a plan.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - The Dragon Masters Approach
1.plot: Baran summons the Dragon Masters, three powerful Dragon Riders, and heads to Teran Kingdom to reclaim Dai. Leona and the others shelter Dai in a prison cell. Detecting Baran and the Dragon Masters, the group is at a loss. Just then, Popp acts.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E27 - Land Rider Larhart
1.plot: Popp faces the Dragon Masters alone and falls into peril. Hyunckel arrives to save him. Popp and Hyunckel defeat Galdandy and Borahorn. Popp loses consciousness and Hyunckel faces Larhart. But Larhart is far more powerful than Galdandy or Borahorn.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E28 - Dai's Secret
1.plot: Baran approaches Teran Castle where Dai is kept. Leona gives Dai his knife and encourages him to fight before heading off to face Baran with Crocodine. Meanwhile, Hyunckel lies beaten by Larhart. Larhart tells him Baran’s tumultuous past...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E29 - Baran's Rage
1.plot: With Popp as his hostage, Borahorn threatens Hyunckel. Larhart takes unexpected action. Larhart reveals his past. Meanwhile, Baran appears at Teran Castle. Hearing of Popp’s actions, Crocodine employs a desperate strategy against Baran!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E30 - Popp's Resolve
1.plot: As a Dragonoid, Baran’s power is beyond imagination. Just as everyone prepares to die, Dai appears. When the meeting between father and son that they had hoped to prevent happens, Popp remembers the final moments of his master, Avan.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E31 - A Father and Son Clash
1.plot: The Dragon Crest appears on Dai’s right hand. Is it a miracle brought on by his mother, Soala...? By focusing his power, Dai gains power beyond Baran’s. Baran wields his Draconic Aura and fights back. The two Dragon Knights clash in an epic battle.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E32 - Farewell To the Father
1.plot: With his weapon lost, Dai must defend himself. Baran lacks the Magic Power for his full Gigabreak. Dai is given Hyunckel’s Dark Armour Blade and faces off with Baran one last time. Meanwhile, Popp remains unresponsive to Leona’s Zing spell...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E33 - Zaboera's Scheme
1.plot: With one final chance from Vearn, Hadlar himself heads out with Zaboera to kill Dai. Dai and his friends rest their wounds in Merle’s cottage. As Popp stands guard outside, someone makes an unexpected appearance.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E34 - The Romos Martial Arts Tournament
1.plot: Dai and his friends return to Papnica. They learn of a Martial Arts Tournament in Romos where the winner will receive a legendary weapon. Dai and Popp head to the tournament where a certain contestant’s fighting catches their eyes.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E35 - The Incident At the Finals
1.plot: Dai and Popp were reunited with Maam. Maam promises to win the Sword of Champions. Maam wins her way through the preliminary fights. But an evil plot unfurls behind the scenes... As the finals are about to begin, one man springs into action.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E36 - The Superior Being Versus Chiu
1.plot: A giant body, unbelievable speed, unparalleled strength, and rapid regeneration... The Superior Being, Zamza, is a terrifying threat. Dai faces him but loses stamina too quickly. Dai falls. All hope seems lost. But only Chiu refuses to give up...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E37 - All In An Instant
1.plot: The Refractor Fist is effective against the seemingly invincible Superior Being. Using her nimble skills and the Refractor Fist, Maam succeeds in freeing Dai. Dai sees her fight and discovers a clue. Dai prepares a final counterattack.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E38 - The World Summit
1.plot: To fight the Dark Army, Leona gathers world leaders for a summit. Dai hopes to learn of a new legendary weapon. In Zaboera’s hideout, Hadlar is hooked up inside a large bio-chamber. Hadlar is letting Zaboera perform a certain experiment on him...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E39 - The Landing of Sovereign Rock Castle
1.plot: Lon Beruk, begins forging the greatest sword in the world for Dai. Meanwhile, in Papnica, the world summit of the world’s leaders begins. But the talks drag on without progress, troubling Leona. Just then a giant enemy appears...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E40 - Master of Darkness Against His Pupil
1.plot: With Mystvearn’s declaration of war, the battle begins. The companions fight, but against an endless enemy, they’re slowly forced back. Help arrives, reigniting the weakened flame in everyone’s hearts. At last, Mystvearn himself appears...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E41 - The Strongest Sword
1.plot: Hyunckel unleashes a strike with the Aura of Justice. Enraged, Mystbearn unleashes his Dark Aura to tear Popp and the others apart. Sovereign Rock Castle heads for the Grand Chapel. Meanwhile, Lon Beruk finally completes the sword for Dai.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E42 - The Field of Death
1.plot: The Sword of Dai cuts Sovereign Rock Castle in half. Mystvearn tries to reveal his true power, but Killvearn appears. With Mystvearn’s anger quelled, and the two retreat. Popp gives chase. Popp reaches the dark island known as the Field of Death.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E43 - The Clash of Powerful Swords
1.plot: Hadlar was more powerful than ever. Along with an indomitable Superior Being body and an unbreakable will, he also has the ability to cast spells. Dai could only defend himself. Cornered, Dai unleashes an Avan Strash with the Sword of Dai.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E44 - The Hero Lost in the Glacier
1.plot: Dai and Hadlar’s battle ended in a draw, with Dai lost in the ocean. Killvearn attacks the despondent Popp. Popp remembers the words of Matoriv and retreats, but Killvearn pursues. Can Popp escape? And what happened to Dai...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E45 - The Orichalcum Warrior
1.plot: Popp, Crocodine, and Chiu search for Dai. Zaboera also leads his servants to find Dai, causing the parties to clash. Popp rescues Dai, but Zaboera unleashes his Super Spell. Just then, a mysterious shining warrior appears between them and...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E46 - The Extreme Annihilation Spell, Medoroa
1.plot: The showdown with Vearn is in five days. Dai and his friends head out to spend the remaining time training. Popp visits Matoriv to find a way to counter the Hadlar Royal Guard. Matoriv decides to teach Popp a spell that he himself fears to use.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E47 - To the Final Battleground
1.plot: The members return, having completed their training. Dai and his friends head to Carl Kingdom. There’s a change in the Field of Death and they land with a heightened sense of tension. Meanwhile, in a remote cave, Baran and Killvearn face off...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E48 - The Hadlar Royal Guard
1.plot: Nova is General Bowson’s son. Refusing to fight together with Dai, he heads off to fight the Dark Army. Dai and Popp hurry after him, but Nova arrives first. Nova fights valiantly, but the Orichalcum warriors reveal their true terror...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E49 - The Team Battle Begins
1.plot: Zababa becomes the stage for the battle between Dai, with his friends, and the Hadlar Royal Guard. Our heroes fight using their individual strengths, but the Orichalcum warriors are powerful enemies. Just who will prevail in this fierce battle...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E50 - We're The Beast King Commandos
1.plot: Popp’s Medroa was strong enough to carve out the ground. Dai and his friends celebrate their victory. Meanwhile, Chiu forms the Beast King Commandos and works to uncover the secret of the enemy stronghold. But the evil hand of the enemy closes in.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E51 - The Avan Style Ultimate Technique
1.plot: Popp, Hyunckel, and Crocodine find the wounded Chiu. Hyunckel deduces it was Fenbren who fought him, and Baran who saved him. Hyunckel sends Popp home and calls out to Baran. Sensing a change in Baran’s demeanor, Hyunckel attempts to stop him...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E52 - Father and Son Dragons Set Out
1.plot: Though shocked by Baran’s sudden appearance, Leona decides to accept his assistance. The Hadlar Royal Guard is lured to the surface while Dai and Baran head to destroy the Dark Citadel Gate. But someone awaits them at the Dark Citadel Gate.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E53 - Hadlar's Challenge
1.plot: Popp and his friends face the Hadlar Royal Guard. Meanwhile, Dai and Baran battle Fenbren, and Dai instinctively saves his ally, Baran. The battle with Fenbren ends. Beyond the Dark Citadel Gate, they find Hadlar ready to battle the Dragon Knights.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E54 - Hadlar Verus Baran
1.plot: Hadlar’s Black Core could explode at any moment, leaving Dai and Baran unable to attack. Unaware of his own situation, Hadlar unleashes an even more intense barrage of attacks at the two. To resolve the situation, Baran attempts a risky maneuver.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E55 - The Black Core
1.plot: After putting Dai to sleep, Baran turns into the Dragonoid for the final fight with Hadlar. Hadlar focuses all his strength to combat Baran. Meanwhile, from his throne, Dark King Vearn watches their battle with a cool gaze.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E56 - The Inherited Heart
1.plot: Popp and the others have managed to survive the Black Core’s explosion. Realizing that the explosion happened while Dai and Baran were fighting, the group rushes to find Dai and Baran. There, they see a shocking sight.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E57 - The God of the Underworld
1.plot: Dai and his friends finally face off against Vearn, who uses his Dark Aura to blast Dai away and casts powerful spells with his overwhelming Magic Power. Vearn is in control even against five opponents. Do Dai and his friends stand a chance...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E58 - The Unlikely Savior
1.plot: Dai’s Avan Strash hit Vearn, but it’s not enough to defeat him. Vearn rises again and summons the Staff of Edacity, which converts Magic Power into raw attack power. With Vearn’s Magic Power, its attack is strong enough to shake the heavens and...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E59 - The Survivors
1.plot: Dai and his friends faced absolute defeat. Dai is taken away by the Holy Mother Dragon and Hyunckel and Crocodine are missing. Popp and Maam wash up on a beach in Carl Kingdom. The two learn that Vearn has begun his attack on the Surface World.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E60 - Dai and Popp
1.plot: The missing Hyunckel and Crocodine are prisoners of the Dark Army. A meeting is held in which it’s decided that Dai should rally the forces. Meanwhile, Dai awakens, but is unable to bear the weight of being a Hero and runs. He ends up in...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E61 - Avan, The Hero
1.plot: A story of Avan when Hadlar was still the Dark Lord. The Order of Carl faces the Dark Army with its princess, Flora. A young Avan protects the princess. Hadlar attacks Carl Castle to capture Flora and...? How Avan and Hadlar’s rivalry began...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E62 - The Cave of Trials
1.plot: Seeking the legendary spell Kaglimmer, Leona, Maam, Merle, and Flora brave the Cave of Trials. Dai sets out to train until Leona returns. As they prepare, Flora tells Maam a secret of the Insignias of Avan. When Popp overhears them...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E63 - The Sacred Inheritance
1.plot: Dai trains with Nova and masters both types of Avan Strash, leading him to create a new attack. Leona and the others search the Cave of Trials to attain Kaglimmer. Popp grows desperate that his Isignia of Avan is the only one which will not glow...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E64 - The Night Before the Battle
1.plot: Lon Beruk brings the restored Sword of Dai and new weapons. The group renews their resolve. Maam is shaken by Amy’s feelings for Hyunckel and Popp is frustrated his Insignia of Avan won’t shine. As the final battle approaches, things grow shaky...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E65 - The Dark Hyunckel
1.plot: The execution day has arrived. As noon approaches and Vearn Palace arrives in the sky above, Mystvearn appears before Hyunckel and Crocodine. Mystvearn makes Hyunckel an offer: accept his Dark Aura or die. Hyunckel makes an unexpected choice.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E66 - The Five Colors of Light
1.plot: The five Disciples of Avan have gathered. Mystvearn attempts to intervene, but Lon Beruk stops him. Crocodine and the others fight the army of monsters. The Disciples of Avan prepare the ritual to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp remains uncertain...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E67 - The Peril of the Great Purification Spell
1.plot: The Disciples of Avan try to cast Kaglimmer. But Popp’s Insignia won’t glow. Maam tries to encourage Popp, but only increases his pain. Powerful monsters enter the fray. As Dai and friends begin to panic, Zaboera schemes.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E68 - The Last Challenge
1.plot: Popp’s soul is awakened. He realizes his abilities as a Sage and heals Merle. Dai and friends continue the ritual to cast Kaglimmer and nullify Vearn’s magic field to enter Vearn Palace, where some unexpected individuals appear before them.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E69 - The Clash of Love
1.plot: Maam’s plea for a truce goes unheard and she is attacked relentlessly by Albinass’s true form. Maam sees Albinass’s strong devotion to Hadlar, but soon remembers Avan’s words, which motivate her to fight back...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E70 - Victory Or Annihilation
1.plot: The Disciples of Avan continue to fight the Hadlar Royal Guard. Maam defeats Albinass and Hyunckel defeats Hym. But Popp struggles against Sigma. The two battle over the only spell that has any effect on Sigma, Medroa.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E71 - Battle of True Dragons
1.plot: Popp and the others return to Dai. There, they witness an unbelievable clash between Dai and Haldar. The sight is a recreation of the legendary “Battle of True Dragons.” The others can only stand back and observe. The moment of truth arrives...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E72 - The Last Attack
1.plot: Hadlar rises again out of sheer force of will to face his true final battle. Dai accepts this challenge and chooses his Magic Sword. Though weaker than his Avan Strash Cross, Dai still has one ace up his sleeve...!? Their final attacks clash...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E73 - The Hope in the Flames
1.plot: Killvearn’s trap imprisoned Dai, Popp, and Hadlar. Powerful flames gradually eat away at their stamina and spirits. Dai and Popp begin to lose hope. Just then, a single ray of light shines through. Can they escape this hopeless situation...?!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E74 - Return of the Great Hero
1.plot: It was Avan, returned from the dead, who saved Popp and Hadlar! Dai, Popp, and Maam embrace their Master in tears. But Hyunckel, caught between conflicting emotions, is unable to face Avan. The party welcomes their new ally and heads towards Vearn’s palace!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E75 - The Secret Way of Purification
1.plot: Hyunckel refuses to proceed with Avan and stays behind. Dai and the others are bewildered but advance without him. The party reaches the doors to Vearn Palace. At a loss as to how to breach the doors, Avan steps forward…

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E76 - The Steady Advance of Justice
1.plot: Leaving Hyunckel to guard the rear, Dai and his friends enter Vearn Palace. Avan scouts ahead and asks a favor of Leona. Back on the surface, the humans overcome Zaboera’s monster horde. The tide of battle is turning, then Zaboera executes a plan.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E77 - The Other Hero
1.plot: Zaboera reveals his ace, the Superior Being Zombie. Crocodine and the humans are out of options. As morale fades, Nova, Hero of the North, risks his life to face the enemy.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E78 - The Survivor From Hell
1.plot: After the battle of Loroi Valley, Crocodine finds Zaboera who managed to survive. Meanwhile, Hyunckel battles the monster horde. Then an unexpected individual appears...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E79 - The Silver-Haired Hym
1.plot: Hym returns from hell stronger than ever. Hyunckel faces Hym using only his fists and Aura. Who will be the victor in the clash between fists of fortitude and implacability?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E80 - Checkmate
1.plot: A new enemy, the king Maximum appears with an Orichalcum Army. Hyunckel and Hym are in peril. Hyunckel stands his wounded body up and burns his fortitude to face their enemy!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E81 - The Battle in the White Garden
1.plot: Larhart appears before Hyunckel and Hym, and takes the Dark Armour Spear before leaving to protect Dai. Meanwhile, Dai, Popp, and Maam face off against Mystvearn.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E82 - The Successor of Justice
1.plot: Avan is taken by Killvearn and challenged to a duel. Meanwhile, Dai and his friends challenge Mystvearn in hopes of finding out how to save their Master, but...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E83 - Baran's Last Will
1.plot: Mystvearn captures Popp and Maam and all seems lost. But Land Rider Larhart appears and rescues them before kneeling before Dai and relaying Baran’s last wish to him...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E84 - Rise, Knight of Destiny
1.plot: Leona is captured. Dai chases after her and arrives at a “living engine", the Dark Force Reactor. Dai attempts to rescue Leona, but is stopped. What will happen to her...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E85 - Vearn, The Dark King
1.plot: Dai and Leona reach the top of the Tower of Supremacy. Facing Vearn, Dai recalls his past loss against him and is struck with fear. Vearn is wary of Dai’s Twin Dragon Crests.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E86 - Killvearn's Trap
1.plot: Dai’s power could match or exceed Vearn’s. Vearn invites Dai to serve him. Meanwhile, Avan and Killvearn continue to fight. Can Avan win against the Reaper?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E87 - The Deciding Attack
1.plot: Hym unleashes attacks against the heretofore invulnerable Mystvearn. Dai holds the upper hand against Vearn, but feels overwhelmed by his confidence. How will each fight end?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E88 - The Shadow Raiment
1.plot: The consecutive Doruoras swallowed Dark King Vearn. Popp and the others decide to regroup with Dai. The fallen Mystvearn stands again and removes his Shadow Raiment.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E89 - The Secret Spell of Frozen Time
EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E90 - Myst and Kill
1.plot: With Popp and Brokeena gone, the others lose their will to fight. Then, Killvearn appears, announcing Avan’s death. But something about Killvearn is different...?

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E91 - Vearn's Truth
1.plot: Avan reveals Mystvearn’s true identity and Dark King Vearn’s greatest secret. Meanwhile, in the Tower of Supremacy, dark clouds gather above Dai and Leona...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E92 - The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth
1.plot: Myst tries to make Hyunckel’s body his own. Meanwhile, Dai faces off with Vearn, the True Dark King. Dai’s strongest attack, Giga Strash, is met with an unknown stance...

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E93 - The Eye Jewel
1.plot: The Demonic Guard of Heaven and Earth beats Dai’s Gigastrash. When Leona refuses to become Vearn’s servant, he takes away her freedom. Just then, Popp and the others arrive!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E94 - On This Bond
1.plot: Popp tries to uncover the secret of the Dark King’s ultimate skill. He stands strong despite being battered by Vearn’s offensive, bolstering the morale of Hym and Larhart.

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E95 - The Greatest, Final Comeback
EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E96 - Like a Bright Flash
1.plot: The Black Cores in the Pillars of Vearn begin counting down to the world’s end. Dai is broken, and Popp loses the will to fight... Suddenly, a voice rings in Popp’s ears!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E97 - The Tear of the Gods
1.plot: To Vearn’s confusion, Dai and Popp rise up again and again. The Dark King tries to detonate the Black Core below, but suddenly the unbelievable happens!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E98 - Dai's Decision
1.plot: With Gomechan’s miracle, the hearts of all the people of the world have been united. They all work together to stop the Black Cores... What will happen to the Surface World?!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E99 - Victory By These Hands
1.plot: Having become the Dragonoid, Dai pummels Vearn. Meanwhile, Popp and the other heroes have been dropped into the heart of Vearn Palace, where they face a new threat...!

1.title: EN - Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai [MULTI-SUB] - S01E100 - Farewell, This World That I Love
1.plot: In the conclusion to the epic battle between the Hero and the Dark King, Dai fights with his father’s Demon Dragon Blade, and Vearn counters with beams and his rigid body.

meta.plot: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his true family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E01 - Are You Happy in Your Life?
1.plot: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E02 - Trip of a Lifetime
1.plot: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense—he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E03 - The Box
1.plot: Leighton and Amanda show Jason his groundbreaking invention. Daniela and Jason2 throw a dinner party.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E04 - The Corridor
1.plot: Jason and Amanda fight to stay alive in the dangerous Corridor. Jason2 makes some life changes and visits an old friend.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E05 - Worldless
1.plot: As they learn more about the Box, Jason and Amanda see alternate versions of their lives. Jason2 begins training a potential investor.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E06 - Superposition
1.plot: Daniela suspects something's not right with her husband. Jason and Amanda grow closer.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E07 - In the Fires of Dead Stars
1.plot: Jason and Amanda visit a breathtaking world. To hide the truth from Daniela, Jason2 takes desperate action.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E08 - Jupiter
1.plot: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

1.title: EN - Dark Matter [MULTI-SUB]	 - S01E09 - Entanglement
1.plot: The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

meta.plot: A.S. (Ad Stella) 122― An era when a multitude of corporations have entered space and built a huge economic system.
