meta.plot: Oreki Houtarou is a minimalistic high school boy. One day, he joins the Classic Literature Club at his elder sister's request. There he meets Chitanda Eru, Fukube Satoshi, and Ibara Mayaka. Chitanda is a calm beautiful girl but she turns into an embodiment of curiosity once she says, "I'm curious." Fukube is a smiling boy with a fantastic memory who calls himself a database. Ibara is a short girl and is strict with others and herself. They begin to investigate a case that occurred 45 years ago. Hints of the mystery are buried in an old collection of works of the former members of Classics Club. The collection is titled "Hyouka."

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Revival of the Time-Honored Classic Lit Club
1.plot: "Energy conservationist" Hotaro Oreki joins the Classic Lit Club at his high school at his sister's behest, to keep it from being shut down. Also joining the club are his best friend, Satoshi Fukube, and Eru Chitanda, a curious girl who enjoys mysteries.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Activities of the Esteemed Classic Lit Club
1.plot: Eru grows bored of the club's lack of activities, and suggests that they prepare an anthology to submit for the school's culture festival in the fall. While tracking down previous anthologies, the club discovers a mystery in the school's library.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Inheritors of the Classic Lit Club and Its Circumstances
1.plot: Over coffee, Eru opens up to Oreki to explain why she joined the club, and asks him for his help with a personal matter. Still unable to locate any anthologies, the club members run into an obstacle when trying to search the club's previous room.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Old Days of the Classic Lit Club and Its Glory
1.plot: Eru decides to solicit Satoshi and Mayaka's help hypothesizing what happened to her uncle. The club members meet at the Chitanda estate, where they present their research and surmise what they believe happened 45 years ago.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Truth of the Classic Lit Club and Its Past
1.plot: Hotaro is torn between continuing with his "gray" life and the "rosy" life that the others live. A phone call from Hotaro's sister leads him to believe that there are pieces missing to his theory regarding the events of Sekitani's expulsion.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - To Commit a Grave Sin
1.plot: Hotaro's history class is interrupted by an outburst coming from Eru's math class, prompting a discussion in the Classic Lit Club about the nature of the seven deadly sins, and what might provoke Eru to become angry.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Upon Seeing the True Colors
1.plot: During summer vacation, the Classic Lit Club members take a trip into the mountains to stay at a hot springs resort inn run by Mayaka's relatives. While there, Eru and Mayaka see what appears to be the ghost of a man who hanged himself!

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Let's Go to the Screening!
1.plot: One of Eru's acquaintances invites the Classic Lit Club to a screening of a student film made by the members of Class 2-F so they can offer their opinions. When the movie takes an unexpected turn, the club is called on to help find a solution.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Furuoka Deserted Village Murder Case
1.plot: In search of a conclusion to their movie, the assistant director, the prop master, and the publicist meet with the Classic Lit Club members one at a time to propose their solutions to the unfinished murder mystery.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Blind Spot to All
1.plot: After meeting with Irisu, Hotaro has a change of heart, and sets his mind to solving the murder mystery. Hotaro and Satoshi discuss the nature of their own potential, and what each of them might be able to accomplish.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Closing Credits of the Fool
1.plot: When the others ask Hotaro about his solution to the murder mystery, he begins to have doubts about it himself. Hotaro confronts Irisu regarding the reason why she called the Classic Lit Club in to help finish the film.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Practically Piled to the Ceiling
1.plot: It is the first day of the school culture festival, and the club members look forward to it with both longing and dread. They must come up with a way to sell all of the copies of "Hyouka" that were printed, as dauntless as the task seems.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - A Corpse by Evening
1.plot: Satoshi tries to use the Quiz Club's quiz show event to promote the Classic Lit Club. Eru goes around beating the bushes for ways to help sell all of the copies of "Hyouka." More and more items end up missing from various clubs.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Wild Fire
1.plot: The Classic Lit Club cooking team competes against three other teams in the Cooking Club's timed "Wild Fire" competition. However, Mayaka is delayed drawing posters for the Manga Club. Will she be able to finish in time to compete?

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - The Juumonji Case
1.plot: Eru's curiosity is drawn by the rash of thefts from the various clubs, and when Hotaro discovers a pattern to the crimes, Satoshi comes up with a way to publicize the Classic Lit Club through the school newspaper so they can sell their anthologies.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - The Last Target
1.plot: Satoshi is ready for Jumoji to strike, but when the anticipated target is passed over, he must reconsider his strategy. Tomoe gives Hotaro a copy of "A Corpse By Evening," and Eru notices that the art style is similar to one she has seen elsewhere.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Kudryavka Sequence
1.plot: Eru appears on a school radio show, asking all the other students to stand with the Classic Lit Club against the phantom thief. Hotaro confronts the person he believes to be Jumoji. Satoshi comes to terms with his expectations.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Does the Sun Shine on the Peaks?
1.plot: While chatting in the club room after school, Hotaro remembers how one of his teachers in middle school famously liked helicopters. But when the others dispute the characterization, Hotaro wonders if there is something more to it.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Those Whom It May Concern
1.plot: Hotaro tells Eru that he can come up with a plausible explanation for any situation she can think of, so when a seemingly mundane schoolwide announcement is made, she challenges him to figure out the reason behind the announcement.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Sappy New Year
1.plot: At New Year's, Eru invites Hotaro to join her in paying her family's respects at the town shrine. When Eru agrees to run a quick errand, however, she and Hotaro find themselves in an unexpected and compromising situation.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - The Case of the Handmade Chocolate
1.plot: While in middle school, Satoshi rejected Mayaka's Valentine chocolate, so this year, she works even harder to present him with a Valentine's Day masterpiece. But when it turns up missing, the search is on to discover what happened to it.

1.title: EN - Hyouka [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Doll That Took a Detour
1.plot: Hotaro is enlisted by Eru to appear in a Dolls' Festival parade that her local shrine holds every year. When construction work unexpectedly causes a last-minute detour, it leaves the participants wondering what went awry.

meta.plot: "A girl in a lower grade just made me cry!" One day, Senpai visits the library after school and becomes the target of a super sadistic junior! The name of the girl who teases, torments, and tantalizes Senpai is "Nagatoro!" She's annoying yet adorable. It's painful, but you still want to be by her side. This is a story about an extremely sadistic and temperamental girl and you'll feel something awaken inside of you.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Senpai is a bit... / Senpai, don't you ever get angry?
1.plot: Senpai is a nerdy high schooler whose manga work is discovered by some loud girls in the library. They all tease him, but one among them, Nagatoro, takes it further than the others.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - You Got Your Wish, Senpai! / 'Sup, Senpai?!
1.plot: Nagatoro torments Senpai by threatening to suck his blood like a vampire and by making him play a nipple-finding game. Senpai escapes to a family restaurant, where he runs into Nagatoro and her friends and discovers something surprising.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Let's Play Again, Senpai / Over Here, Senpai
1.plot: Senpai and Nagatoro get caught in the rain. She invites him over to wait for the rain to pass. Senpai sits with Nagatoro and her friends for lunch, and things get awkward.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - You're All Red, Senpai / Senpai, You Could Be a Little More...
1.plot: Gamo-chan and Yosshi offer to let Senpai touch their breasts, but there’s a twist. Nagatoro offers a reward if Senpai does a good drawing of her.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Senpai's Poofball / Thanks, Senpai!
1.plot: Nagatoro offers to cut Senpai’s hair. Just as she’s about to get started, she gets a call from her friends, and things take an odd turn. Senpai and Nagatoro line up for ice cream on a scorching summer day.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - You're Such a Wimp, Senpai ♥ / Senpai! Let's Go to the Beach!!
1.plot: Senpai awakens in another world, where he and Nekotoro set out on an adventure to defeat the demon king. Nagatoro invites Senpai to the beach.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Senpai, Want to Go to the Festival? / It's Like a Date, Huh, Senpai? / Let's Go Home, Senpai
1.plot: The summer festival is coming up. Senpai is expecting Nagatoro to invite him, but that’s not how either of them end up going.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - That Might Actually Be Fun, Senpai♥ / Let's Play Rock-Paper-Scissors, Senpai!!
1.plot: Senpai should be studying for midterms, but he’s hooked on a game. Questions arise about what might happen if he were to flunk. Senpai and Nagatoro play rock-paper-scissors to see who has to carry their bags home.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Senpai's Such a Closet Perv!! / There's No Way Creepy Senpai Could Go on a Proper Date!!
1.plot: Nagatoro makes a bet that Senpai has lewd books in the club room, but things don’t go quite as she plans. Sakura has a stalker, and she asks Senpai for help getting rid of him.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - You Seem Pretty Stiff, Senpai / I'll Do It For You, Senpai!!
1.plot: After seeing Senpai get mocked for his inability to run, Nagatoro takes him out jogging to try to whip him into shape. The culture festival is coming up, and Senpai needs something to present for the arts club.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - What Do You Think, Senpai? / You Could Be More Honest, Senpai ♥
1.plot: Senpai doesn’t have any confidence that he can win against the art club president. Nagatoro and the gang try to cheer him up, but the president’s art is just too powerful. Nagatoro offers to model for Senpai.

1.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Has Spring Come Even for You, the Unpopular Loner Louse Senpai? / Did You Hear Her Talk About Love, Senpai?
1.plot: Senpai isn’t sure he can beat the art club president in popularity at the culture festival. Nagatoro and the gang do everything they can to help him.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - It's You and Me, Senpai~
2.plot: Nagatoro is still torturing Senpai, laughing at his choice of manga and at how he talks to girls, and trying to get a reaction out of him by having him put her stockings on her.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - You're Inviting Me, Senpai?!
2.plot: The club president gives Senpai tickets to the zoo, insisting that he takes Nagatoro with him to practice life drawing together.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Senpai... Were You... Listening to What I Said...?
2.plot: Nagatoro forgets her phone in the club room. Senpai tries to bring it back to her but gets himself into a situation.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Why Don't You Come Inside, Senpai-kun?
2.plot: Senpai visits Nagatoro’s home to deliver handouts from school. Her sister lets him in and decides to mess with both him and Nagatoro.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - So This Is Your Room, Huh, Senpai?
2.plot: Senpai gets sick, so Nagatoro comes over to check on him. His family happens not to be home.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - How Are Your Fortunes This Year, Senpai?
2.plot: Senpai has a Christmas gift for Nagatoro, but The Friends get in the way of him handing it to her.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - I Figured That's How You'd Ski, Senpai
2.plot: Senpai, Nagatoro and their classmates go skiing. Nagatoro is a good skier, but Senpai doesn't fail to disappoint.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Why Don't You Try Bulking Up a Little, Paisen?
2.plot: Senpai sketches Nagatoro in an athletic stance that seems very natural to her. Wait, is Nagatoro into judo...?

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - That Is, If You Win at Least Once, Senpai
2.plot: The school judo tournament is coming up. Senpai and Nagatoro are both reluctant to participate.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Hachioji-senpai Taught Me a Lot
2.plot: It's the start of a new school year. Nagatoro is planning to join the judo club and the art club gets a new member.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Don't You Miss Me, Senpai?
2.plot: Sunomiya encourages Senpai to ask Nagatoro out on a date. On a late walk home Senpai tries to ascertain if Nagatoro has anywhere she'd like to go on her next school break.

2.title: EN - DON'T TOY WITH ME, MISS NAGATORO [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Wanna Do Something to Make It Not a Dry Run?
2.plot: Pursued by Gamo and Yoshi who aim to preserve Senpai's virginity and Sunomiya and the President who aim to protect and fight for Senpai's love, Nagatoro and Senpai set off on their date to the aquarium.

meta.plot: Yuya is part of the idol duo ZINGS, but his laziness and disdain for fans puts him in danger of getting blacklisted. That is, until he meets Asahi, the ghost of a former idol who’s eager to stage her own comeback by possessing Yuya's willing body!

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - STAGE.1
1.plot: Yuya’s career is about to go down in flames! But he may have a ghost of a chance if he lets Asahi possess his body and do the hard work for him.

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - STAGE.2
1.plot: Yuya’s attitude change catches everyone off guard and it’s all thanks to Asahi’s intervention! But his luck may turn when she insists he does things without her help.

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - STAGE.3
1.plot: Asahi and Yuya need to learn more about each other to succeed. Which begs the question: how well does Asahi know Yoshino, the other half of ZINGS, anyway?

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - STAGE.4
1.plot: Yuya has dedicated and loyal fans, but only one of them can win the coveted prize they all seek. May the truest fan win!

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - STAGE.5
1.plot: ZINGS has the honor of attending Farmer's Handsome this year and meet the members of Cgrass! They seem nice enough, but there’s something about their leader, Hikaru, though.

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - STAGE.6
1.plot: Hikaru accuses Yuya of plagiarizing the late Asahi’s performances and demands that he quit being an idol!

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - STAGE.7
1.plot: Hikaru is following Yuya’s every move so he can expose that fraud for what he truly is. It’s not like he’s turning a fan or anything!

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - STAGE.8
1.plot: Yuya’s fans must make a life-altering decision: what should he wear during his photo shoots? No matter the outcome, it is not a choice they can make lightly.

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - STAGE.9
1.plot: Yuya finds himself on the cusp of an important realization as ZINGS’ second anniversary concert approaches.

1.title: EN - Phantom of the Idol [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - STAGE.10
1.plot: Yuya understands what Asahi and Yoshino don’t: ZINGS doesn’t have two members. It has three.

meta.plot: After disappearing from the underworld, the legendary yakuza known as the "Immortal Dragon" resurfaces — as a fiercely devoted stay-at-home husband.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Miku rushes off to work but forgets her bento. Tatsu tracks down a Policure Blu-ray for Miku’s birthday. Gin takes a walk around the neighborhood.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Masa realizes that housewives — and househusbands — have a lot in common with the yakuza. Tatsu takes a yoga class and thoroughly enjoys himself.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Tatsu and Masa bump into Torajiro, a fellow ex-gangster now running a crepe truck. The cops grow suspicious of Tatsu’s balcony herb garden.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Miku’s dad tries to bond with Tatsu over a game of catch. A cockroach infiltrates the apartment. The Immortal Claus stops by a kids’ Christmas party.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Tatsu takes a part-time job at a cafe. Then he bumps into a deceased yakuza boss’s wife, who’s now working at the supermarket. It’s Tatsu’s birthday!

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: While at the mall, Tatsu catches a live Policure show. Later, he goes on a date with Miku to an amusement park, then takes a trip to the beach.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Torajiro hits up Tatsu for some street-level information on the latest craze: bubble tea. Tatsu takes Masa on a confusing trip to the 100-yen shop.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Tatsu gets pulled into a rap battle, then enters a Halloween costume contest with Miku. Things get intense during a trip to a buffet restaurant.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: A battle ensues inside Tatsu's body when he catches a fever. Masa stops by for New Year's. In a baking class, Tatsu drives home the value of heart.

1.title: EN - The Way of the Househusband [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: To buy Miku a limited edition Policure DVD, Tatsu has to memorize a confusing discount code catchphrase. Tatsu and Miku dogsit; Gin takes another walk.

meta.plot: Hitori Bocchi, a girl with extreme social anxiety, has had only one friend throughout elementary school. When Bocchi learns they'll be split up after graduation, she makes a promise to her: "By the time of my middle school graduation, I'll make friends with everyone in my class." And if she can't... they won't be friends anymore?! But Bocchi has a hard time talking to people. When she gets nervous, her legs cramp. She can't look other people in the eye. She doesn't even know how to make friends! Every way she thinks of to make friends ends up failing. Will her friend-making plan pay off?!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - My First Confession
1.plot: April. A young girl stands alone, acting suspiciously in front of the entrance to a middle school... That girl is Hitori Bocchi, a new first year student at the school. And starting today, she's going to become friends with everyone in her class... hopefully!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Actually, Thank You
1.plot: I made my very first friend, Nako-chan, mad!! But I don't know why she's mad or how to even apologize! What do I do?! What should I do...?! That's when--!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Getting It Across by Spinning Your Wheels
1.plot: "I want to go home with Honshou-san. I want to go home with Honshou-san..." As Bocchi keeps muttering her desire, Nako offers her some advice: "First you need to go invite her."

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I'll Be Your Apprentice
1.plot: "I've been searching for you this whole time. You can't fool my eyes." The road to school is full of danger! As Bocchi tries to hide her presence and make it to school she runs into a bright foreigner?!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Happens All the Time
1.plot: Aru attempts to save face in front of her friend Hanako Yamada after she accidentally brings an elementary school backpack to school with her. Things become more difficult for her the next day when she ends up wearing a full elementary school uniform. Later, Aru is challenged to a tennis match by Nako, finding it difficult due to all the times she's been skipping tennis club.

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Summer Comes in 5-7-5
1.plot: Bocchi becomes nervous about presenting a haiku in front of her class while Nako ends up having to take supplemental lessons after failing her maths test. Meanwhile, Teruyo, trying to get over her fear of Nako, makes the assumption that Bocchi is a secret gang leader.

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Gentle Tears
1.plot: Feeling she needs to make one more friend before summer break starts, Bocchi attempts to befriend disciplinary committee member Kako Kurai, only to fail miserably. During summer break, the girls go to the pool, where Bocchi teaches Nako how to swim. When the girls go to karaoke afterwards, Bocchi comes across Kai, who is relieved to see that Bocchi has made some friends and remembers her promise to her. On the way home, Sotoka expresses her desire to become friends with Bocchi to the others.

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Welcome Back from Elsewhere
1.plot: After many hurdles, Bocchi manages to get on talking terms with Kako, only to learn that she has a policy against making any friends. The next day, as Bocchi helps Kako clean the classroom, Kako explains that her policy is to prove herself strong enough to live on her own. Meanwhile, Sotoka worries about asking to be Bocchi's friend while remaining as her apprentice. In the end, she decides to focus on her apprentice training to show her appreciation towards Bocchi.

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Perfect Curry Pancakes
1.plot: During cooking class, Bocchi ends up having to work with an unfamiliar group of classmates. With some help from Aru, Bocchi manages to impress her group by making them some whipped cream for their pancakes. Afterwards, Bocchi works up the courage to introduce her friends to Kako before asking her to join her group for making curry during an outdoor class. After a successful curry, Kako acknowledges Bocchi's determination to become stronger and declares herself as her rival.

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - No One Said That Before
1.plot: Strong Bocchi powers up! Today she's Super Strong Bocchi! And Sotoka becomes Super Strong Sotoka too! What's making her stronger than usual? ...Her shoe?? Natto?!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - From Tap-Tap to Print-Print
1.plot: If she doesn't talk to all of her friends every day, they'll forget her! While Bocchi has more friends now, she has more worries too. What should she do to ensure she remains friends with everyone? Make her CD Debut?!

1.title: EN - Hitoribocchi no Marumaruseikatsu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Maybe I Just Might
1.plot: Finally... Finally... Bocchi has a smartphone! Now Bocchi can join the smartphone tap-tap group too. Yet first she takes her friend's advice and greets her phone. So when it responds and she asks it to be her friend...?

meta.plot: Avid bookworm and college student Motosu Urano ends up dying in an unforeseen accident. This came right after the news that she would finally be able to work as a librarian as she had always dreamed of. When she regained consciousness, she was reborn as Main, the daughter of a poor soldier. She was in the town of Ehrenfest, which had a harsh class system. But as long as she had books, she didn't really need anything else. However, books were scarce and belonged only to the nobles. But that doesn't stop her, so she makes a decision... "If there aren't any books, I'll just create some."

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A World Without Books
1.plot: Motosu Urano, a college student and a bookworm of the highest order, loses her life in an avalanche of books and wakes up in another world as a sickly girl named Main. Nevertheless confident that she can deal with any situation as long as she has books to read, she looks all over her new home for one, but doesn't find any. To make matters worse, she couldn't see any writing in town when out with her mother Eva. She realized that she found herself in a world with a low literacy rate, one where books were prohibitively expensive.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Life Improvements and Slates
1.plot: Having learned how expensive books are in this world, Main resolves to make books of her own. However, she soon finds out just how frail her new body is when she and her elder sister, Turi, decide to go to the gate to deliver something their father forgot—she can hardly take a few steps before running out of breath. But that's when Lutz, a neighborhood kid the same age as Main, offers his help. Main is touched by this and soon makes it to the gate. There, Otto gives her his old slate, letting her experience the joy of writing once again

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Events of Winter
1.plot: While everyone is snowed in by the harsh winter, Main has a plan: a plan to craft pseudo-papyrus as the first step towards making a book. Meanwhile, Eva teaches Turi a bunch of skills in order to prepare her for her upcoming baptism in the summer. Main is told to think about where she wants to apprentice, but as always, books are the only thing on her mind. As winter rolls on, however, the family bonds and grows closer together, and Main hits upon the perfect gift to give Turi to wear on her baptism day.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Forests and Clay Tablets
1.plot: Spring has arrived, and Main is raring to go make clay tablets in the forest. But first, she must convince her family that she can handle the journey.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Baptisms and Strange Fevers
1.plot: The season has shifted to summer, and the day of Turi's baptism has arrived. Turi attracts attention with a hair ornament made by Main. Main, who has more opportunities to go to the forest, starts making wooden tablets with the help of Lutz. Meanwhile, Lutz asks Main Lutz to let him meet Otto. Lutz had a dream of becoming a traveling merchant. However, Main, shocked by her repeated failures at making paper, collapses from a high fever before the meeting with Otto.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Meeting
1.plot: Lutz and Main prepare for the meeting with Otto. But Otto brings someone with him, turning a casual meeting into an interview that will decide both Lutz and Main's futures.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Seeds of Suspicion
1.plot: With the paper-making process about to begin, Main can't hide her excitement as she and Lutz go to meet Benno as per his invitation. He reveals that he is willing to arrange for all the equipment and materials they need to make paper, but the ensuing conversation makes Lutz see Main in a very different light.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Lutz's Main
1.plot: As Main and Lutz begin making their paper for real, Main's excitement gets the better of her, and Lutz's suspicions come to a head. He resolves to talk to her about it after the paper is finished.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Guild Master's Granddaughter
1.plot: Benno looks to have Main and Lutz registered with the Merchant Guild, but the guild master proves to be an obstacle. This results in them making plans to meet Frieda, his granddaughter.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - To the Second Winter
1.plot: Main learns from Frieda that the illness she has is called the Devouring, and that it will flare up if she ever feels anxiety or loses hope. Almost on cue, her fever starts acting up...

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Life-or-Death Choices and Family Meetings
1.plot: With Main collapses, everyone she knows comes together in a bid to save her life. But soon, she is faced with a life-or-death decision, one that she must discuss with her family.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Baptism and Divine Paradises
1.plot: The day of Main and Lutz's baptism has arrived. Wearing a fancy dress and a new hair ornament, Main appears a clear standout from the rest of the kids, but soon she loses her way and finds herself in what she sees as heaven on earth.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Choice To Be an Apprentice Priestess
1.plot: When Main brings up wanting to become an apprentice priestess to her family, she learns the truth about the role and what it entails and soon comes to realize that she is in for the fight of her life.

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Conclusions
1.plot: Main, Gunther, and Eva head to the cathedral for their fateful meeting, knowing that Main's life is riding on a successful negotiation. But will things really go so smoothly for them?

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Apprentice Priestess
1.plot: Main is now an apprentice priestess at the cathedral. How will she adapt to a new life in new surroundings, and how will they react to her?

1.title: EN - Ascendance of a Bookworm [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Blue Robes and Uncommon Sense
1.plot: The stark contrast of the values at the church compared to life downtown continues to bewilder Main, as she butts heads with her retainers and her expected duties at the church.

meta.plot: Un personnage mystérieux, connu sous le nom de la Reine de l'Arnaque, se fait passer pour de puissantes dirigeantes d'Hollywood, attirant ses victimes par des promesses d'opportunités de carrières qui changeraient leur vie. Un journaliste et une enquêtrice privée entreprennent de découvrir l'auteur de cette arnaque.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When he's hired at Acapulco's hottest resort, Maximo thinks he's scored his dream job—but quickly learns there's more to it than he thought.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E02 - Jessie's Girl
1.plot: Maximo strives to master the art of the upsell while attempting to help a wealthy young man propose to his girlfriend.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E03 - Invisible Touch
1.plot: Don Pablo teaches Maximo how to become an elite waiter so he can work an important dinner. Julia tries to impress a fashion editor.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E04 - Crazy Little Thing Called Love
1.plot: A pop superstar staying at the resort takes an interest in Julia, which concerns Maximo. Nora goes on her first date in a long time.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E05 - All Night Long
1.plot: Maximo and Chad go on an all-night journey outside the resort, while the staff must come together for a never-ending wedding reception.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E06 - Uptown Girl
1.plot: Maximo has a magical dream date with an American tourist. Memo bonds with his coworkers over a soccer match.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E07 - For Your Eyes Only
1.plot: When he learns that an eye doctor is staying at the resort, Maximo sneaks Nora in for the day. Diane discovers problems with the hotel.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E08 - Time After Time
1.plot: As Diane shows a group of journalists a photo exhibit of Las Colinas' history, the story of Don Pablo's long tenure at the resort is revealed.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E09 - The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
1.plot: Chaos erupts at the Christmas staff dinner when Maximo and Memo's plans backfire. Julia pieces together the truth behind her birthday gift.

1.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S01E10 - You Should Hear How She Talks About You
1.plot: Las Colinas hosts a big New Year's Eve bash. Maximo tries to dazzle Diane so he'll earn a promotion. Chad makes a bold gesture.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E01 - Break My Stride
2.plot: Maximo is determined to start the new year with a clean slate. Julia struggles with Chad's surprise proposal.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E02 - Hit Me With Your Best Shot
2.plot: Desperate to pay off his family's debt, Maximo seizes an opportunity to wait on rival tennis stars. Diane tries to derail Julia and Chad's nuptials.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E03 - Glory Days
2.plot: Maximo gets swept up in a busy night with Isabel‘s family. Chad's fraternity brothers surprise him.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E04 - Love Is a Battlefield
2.plot: On Valentine‘s Day, Maximo and Julia have to decorate a romantic suite together. Memo and Lorena beg Lupe to let them spend time alone.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E05 - We Don't Need Another Hero
2.plot: Maximo takes Memo to a club to find his favorite soccer star. Sara spends an eventful night at Las Colinas.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E06 - Hollywood Nights
2.plot: Diane‘s past catches up with her as Las Colinas hosts the wrap party for a big Hollywood movie. Maximo faces a moral dilemma.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E07 - Always Something There to Remind Me
2.plot: Chaos ensues on the night of Chad and Julia's joint bachelor and bachelorette party.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E08 - Money Changes Everything
2.plot: Maximo is tasked with taking care of a billionaire investor. Chad and Julia discover a secret about Diane.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E09 - The Power of Love
2.plot: Maximo doubles down on his new life with Isabel. Sara receives a potentially life-changing offer.

2.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S02E10 - Against All Odds
2.plot: Maximo gets a second chance at Las Colinas. Julia learns to go after what she wants.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E01 - Just the Two of Us
3.plot: Maximo learns a hard lesson of how to balance being a manager and friend to the staff at Las Colinas.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E02 - Mamma Mia
3.plot: On Mother's Day, Maximo wrestles with an opportunity to get closer to Diane despite his promise to spend the day with his mom.

3.title: FR - Acapulco (SUB) - S03E03 - Dead Man's Party
3.plot: Don Pablo comes to Maximo with a task that puts his training to the test. Julia faces a tough decision over whether to be honest with Nora.

meta.plot: In 1984, Maximo Gallardo's dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at Acapulco's hottest resort, Las Colinas. But he soon realizes that working there will be far more complicated than he ever imagined.

After dying in the act of stopping a crime in modern Japan, our hero is reincarnated as Cain von Silford, third son of a noble family in a world of swords and sorcery. In his new life, all children receive a blessing from the gods...but Cain is unexpectedly blessed with an absolutely enormous, over-the-top cornucopia of magical powers. If his dream of traveling the world as a free spirit is to come true, he can't reveal too much of his potential to the wrong people. A light-hearted, escapist adventure in another world begins!

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Reincarnated
1.plot: Shiina Kazuya dies protecting two young girls and reincarnates as a young noble named Cain in a world of swords and magic. He's excited to be in a fantasy world, but then the gods grant him some insane protections and status...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - My Tutors Are Adventurers
1.plot: Adventurers Millie and Nina arrive to be Cain's tutors, but they're overwhelmed by his insane status. His power with both magic and the sword is so great that they decide to train him outside the mansion.

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - To the Royal Capital
1.plot: Cain and his family leave for the capital. Along the way, they encounter two noble maidens beset by a horde of monsters.

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Debut in the Royal Capital
1.plot: Cain visits the church, where the gods tell him there's no entertainment in this world and ask him to invent some. Then Cain runs into Parma, an old friend who's training at her uncle's shop. So Cain asks Parma's uncle to help him create a certain item...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Welcome to My Off-the-Charts Mansion
1.plot: Cain has been named a baron and given a mansion—an old, dilapidated one. But with his magic, he's able to fix it up like new in no time, and he immediately starts preparing to host a debut party to introduce his mansion to noble society.

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A Date With the Strongest Captain of the Knights
1.plot: Cain impresses Daim, vice captain of the Chivalric Order, with the monsters he hunted alone. Daim then asks Cain to train with the rest of the Order. As Cain anxiously faces thirty knights alone, a lovely elf woman leaps to his rescue...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Cain, the Rookie Adventurer
1.plot: Cain finally reaches his twelfth birthday, the day he can register as an adventurer. He heads straight to the guild to sign up, but some older adventurers pick a fight with him, and he's saved by a red-haired man who looks very familiar...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Royal Academy
1.plot: It's the day of the Royal Academy entrance exams. Cain whizzes through the written exam, then heads outside for the magic and swordsmanship exams, but they don't go quite as smoothly...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Training
1.plot: Cain finds himself before Hirasawa Yuuya, the first king of Esfort. Yuuya tells Cain that the seal on the evil god Aaron is weakening, and Cain must fight him. Cain is hesitant, but then Yuuya tells him that Aaron is linked to Shiina Kazuya...

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Trials of an A-Rank Adventurer
1.plot: Cain must subjugate some bandits in order to advance to rank A in the guild. His handling of the quest makes his senior adventurers worry that he doesn't fit in at the academy, so they come up with a plan to help.

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Omen of an Onslaught
1.plot: Cain finally gets to participate in a magic class, this time to learn summon magic... and he ends up summoning the Prince of Darkness. Meanwhile, signs of a monster onslaught have been observed in the Forest of Monsters.

1.title: EN - Tensei Kizoku nosekai Boukenroku [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Then I Became Lord of a Domain
1.plot: With the help of his companions, Cain confronts Aaron and the horde of monsters attacking the town of Gracia.

meta.plot: Only 39 years into a life full of bad luck, Ryoma Takebayashi passes away in his sleep! Taking pity on him, three divine beings show compassion by reincarnating him as a young boy to a magical, new world. Now he spends his time researching and caring for slimes in the forest. But after healing an injured traveler, Ryoma decides to set out with his new friends on a journey to use his power to help others. A whole new world awaits him, where his skills as a magic user and slime tamer continue to elicit surprise and admiration.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ryoma, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma Takebayashi is a young boy living by himself in a forest, who, in a previous lifetime, used to be a tortured middle-aged Japanese office worker. He meets a group of distressed travelers in the forest, and decides to save them.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Departure, with the Slimes
1.plot: It turns out that the travelers Ryoma saved were the local duke and his family. Impressed by Ryoma's various skills and enamored by his personality, they offer to take Ryoma along on their journey.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - First Time in Town, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma and the Jamil family travel to Gimul, a mining town. There, Ryoma and Eliaria take the first steps in becoming professionals in their crafts. Ryoma is given another opportunity to flex his new powers.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Clean-Up Duty, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma arrives at Miya's house, overflowing with trash from a nearby dump. Ryoma and his slimes show a remarkable ability to clean, a skill that, as it turns out, the town of Gimul desperately needs.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Lady's Training Session, with the Slimes
1.plot: Eliaria and Ryoma practice magic and combat in Gimul. They practice fighting against the weak but numerous monsters now infesting the abandoned mine shafts.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Monster Hunting, with the Slimes
1.plot: The Adventurer's Guild sets up a large-scale group of adventurers to deal with the massive monster infestation discovered in the abandoned mines. Ryoma joins them.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Starting the Business, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma decides to strike out on his own as an adventurer and business owner. He discusses his plans with the ducal family, and works with Serge the merchant to put his business plans in motion.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Laundry Business, with the Slimes
1.plot: The laundry business is ready to open. Ryoma hires new employees to help get his business started, and throws a party to express his thanks to the friends who have supported him thus far.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The New Coworkers, with the Slimes
1.plot: The laundry business explodes in popularity, so Ryoma rushes out on day two to hire more help. He meets Fei and Li Ling, foreigners with a hidden past.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The New Slimes, with the Slimes
1.plot: With the business going more smoothly than Ryoma ever imagined, Ryoma is able to go back to studying his slimes and adventuring. He discovers several new types of slimes.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Taming Training, with the Slimes
1.plot: The Jamil ducal family are all experts in the art of monster taming magic. Ryoma and Eliaria receive the Jamil elders' tutelage to further hone their taming magic.

1.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Beginning of a New Era, with the Slimes
1.plot: Ryoma and Eliaria make another attempt to tame the limour birds. If they succeed, it would be a great milestone in their careers as monster tamers. However, whatever the outcome, their separation is inevitable as Eliaria leaves for school.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Ryoma and the New Plan
2.plot: After a small incident in his store involving a couple of unruly customers, Ryoma decides to create reinforced glass in the mines. It's also there that Ryoma discovered the evolved form of a Poison Slime called the Medicine Slime. He would later also meet a new god that had taken a liking to him named Tekun.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Ryoma and the Crime Prevention Drill
2.plot: Ryoma learns that people are targeting his shop because he has associated himself with the head of the Tamer Guild, Taylor. To combat this, Ryoma has new positive rumors spread about his shop and deals with any assailant who tries and attack him. Ryoma also learns that he's gained enough finances to open up a second shop in a different city.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Ryoma and the Poster Girl
2.plot: Arriving in Lenaf, Ryoma doesn't waste any time and meets with Pioro, the head of the town Merchant Guild, and his daughter Miyabi. From there, Ryoma sets up his second shop with the help of his Slimes and later does a quest for the Adventurers Guild, where a Smash Boar confront him.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Ryoma and the Second Shop
2.plot: Ryoma hunts a Smash Boar, and after he does, Callum arrives at Lenaf with Tony, Caulkin, Lobelia, and new hires to help open the second shop. Sometime after it opens, Ryoma returns to Gimul where he meets with Serge to talk about the Magical Item Market he plans on visiting.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Ryoma and the New Acquaintance
2.plot: Seeking to take on some adventurer quests from the Adventurer Guild to raise his rank, Ryoma accepts a delivery quest to someone in Keleban. The quest makes Ryoma gain a new acquaintance there and perhaps a future business opportunity.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Ryoma and the Magic Item Market
2.plot: Ryoma attends the Magical Item Market, where he meets Fedele, Dionme's grandson, and instantly bonds with him. He later develops some new deodorant pouches from the newly evolved Deodorant Slime and would soon become acquainted with G-Ranked adventurers Wist and Beck. Fernobelia would also meet with Ryoma for the first time too.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Ryoma and the Local Cuisine
2.plot: A curious Ryoma learns about a certain upcoming festival through Eliaria's letter and decides to run a food stall at the festival.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Ryoma and the Traveling Entertainer
2.plot: Ryoma is introduced to the Semroid Troupe leader Prenance and, from him, learns about Tunnel Ants nesting in the Southern Fields outside of Gimul. Hence Ryoma decides to hunt the Tunnel Ants and, amid this, runs into Beck and his adventuring pals, which he later hires them as temporary staff to help with the upcoming Founder festival.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Eliaria and the New Friends
2.plot: Elia's first month at the magical academy is uneventful, but she meets new friends, Michelle, Miyabi, Feila, and Kanan. After forming a group with them, they go on a two-day camping trip, which their individual skills manage to help out their student peers.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Ryoma and the Flying Slime
2.plot: Following a request from Worgan, Ryoma and some of his fellow adventurer friends take on a quest in a nearby forest to harvest Treant materials. They get more than what they bargained for when they have to face off against an evolved version of the Treant monster, an Elder Treant.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Ryoma and Busy Days
2.plot: After completing the quest to collect Treant wood from a nearby forest, Ryoma finds that the work for the upcoming Founders Festival is coming along nicely.

2.title: EN - By the Grace of the Gods [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Ryoma and the Town of Gimul
2.plot: It's finally the day of the Founding Festival, and Ryoma's food stall is a hit with the people of Gimul. Once Ryoma has time for himself, he encounters a lost boy who he decides to take to the Guard Station. When the festival was over, Ryoma participated in one last performance held by the Semiroid Troupe.

meta.plot: 16-year-old super-studier Nagi Umino, second-year student at the Megurogawa Academy high school, was switched at birth. On his way to a dinner to meet his birth parents, he accidentally meets the brash, outspoken, Erika Amano, who is determined to make Nagi her fake boyfriend as she never wants to actually marry. But once Nagi makes it to dinner, he finds his parents have decided to resolve the hospital switch by conveniently having him marry the daughter his birth parents raised...who turns out to be none other than Erika herself!

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - You're going to be my boyfriend.
1.plot: Umino Nagi was swapped with another child at birth. He’s going to meet his real parents today, but on his way to school, he meets a girl who is threatening to die to get out of her engagement.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I'm not going to marry you.
1.plot: Nagi and Erika are now engaged, but Nagi can’t wrap his head around how loaded Erika is, and Erika seems to have concerns of her own.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - You aren't going to beat me!!!!
1.plot: Living together with Erika gives Nagi an opportunity to focus on exam prep, except when they run into trouble.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Would you please go out with me...?
1.plot: Having scored higher than anyone else in his grade, including Hiro, Nagi decides to finally confess to her.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Can we do our morning study sessions together...?
1.plot: Hiro and Nagi begin studying together in the mornings, but unexpected circumstances put a wrench in their relationship.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I thought you live by yourself.
1.plot: Erika joins Nagi’s and Hiro’s morning study sessions to wingman for Nagi, and Hiro wants to come hang out at her place.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Is my fate going to change?
1.plot: Nagi invites Hiro to join his group for a school field trip. The group is plunged into chaos with the addition of a couple more members.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Are you going to marry him?
1.plot: Sachi notices something going on between Erika and Nagi and decides to try to get to the bottom of it. Both she and Nagi are on the verge of a big decision.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Kuroshio currents beckon to me.
1.plot: Hiro and Nagi go on date at the amusement park. Sachi is not amused.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Don't treat me like your kid sister.
1.plot: Sachi and Nagi go shopping together for a Mother’s Day gift, but they can’t think of anything their mother would appreciate

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - I can't forget that just happened.
1.plot: Erika and Nagi are stuck in a power outage. Nagi goes to the front door to find an emergency kit, when the unthinkable happens.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - It's not that I like you, yet.
1.plot: Nagi tries to redeem himself after embarrassing himself in front of Hiro on their amusement park date.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Things aren't quite working out, are they?
1.plot: Nagi is beginning to question his own feelings, and he has trouble even focusing on midterms.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Walls exist to be overcome!!
1.plot: Erika’s parents want her to come home if she fails her make-up exams. She asks Nagi for help, but it may not be that easy.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - We have to tell her... about our secret!
1.plot: Erika and Nagi walk around the festival together, and she shocks him with how out-of-touch she is.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - I want to talk about now.
1.plot: Sachi is worried about Hiro, so she brings Erika along to follow her and learn about her.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Anything could happen right now!
1.plot: Erika, Hiro, Sachi and Nagi make plans to study at Erika’s vacation house, but there ends up being a slight change in the roster.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Who is that person?
1.plot: Nagi is hoping to do the test of courage with Hiro, but Erika takes him instead. Nagi can’t figure out what it is that’s bothering her.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - You must have noticed by now.
1.plot: Erika reveals who it is that she’s been trying to reach through social media.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - I want to grow up already!
1.plot: Nagi discusses with Erika what he learned – or tried to learn – from her father.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - It's a secret between you and me.
1.plot: Having topped his grade in the term exams, Nagi confesses to Hiro once again.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - I'll Be There With You
1.plot: Erika, Hiro, Sachi, and Nagi spend more time at the beach home retreat, and eventually, clues about Erika's missing older brother are found. This incites Nagi to search for him around the nearby town with Erika by his side.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - What Should We Do Now?
1.plot: On the day Nagi, Erika, Sachi, and Hiro are to return home, Nagi and Hiro decide to stay behind to collect a shrine stamp from the local temple. However, become of this, their train ride home is canceled due to the stormy weather, thus forcing them to stay at a local inn where things get strangely intimate.

1.title: EN - A Couple of Cuckoos [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - All That Matters Is That You Two Are Happy
1.plot: The household visits the diner to attend Yohei's birthday party and learn some family secrets surrounding them. The next day after a study session, Erika succumbs to a cold that she caught, and the household, including Hiro, scrambles to help her through it.

meta.plot: So long as people have hearts, there will be those with worries and concerns. Those hearts are then invaded by something strange, causing them to show strange physical symptoms. These ailments, called "mysterious diseases", exist unseen to most people. Modern medicine offers no cure, but there is one doctor who fights these diseases along with his pupils. His name is Ramune. He looks nothing like a doctor, is foul-mouthed, and does whatever he pleases, but he has the ability to pinpoint the cause of the troubles hidden deep within his patients' hearts and cure their mysterious diseases.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Condiment Tears
1.plot: People become afflicted by "mysterious diseases" when their hearts and minds are affected by "the mysterious." Koto, a girl who produces mayonnaise from her eyes, visits Dr. Ramune, who specializes in these diseases that can't be explained by modern medicine. She was brought to the clinic by Ramune's apprentice Kuro. Koto explains that she also cries condiments other than mayonnaise, and Ramune offers her a mysterious treatment.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Chikuwa Penis
1.plot: Ramune is visited by Kengo, a young man whose penis has turned into a chikuwa fish cake. Though there must be some reason for it, Kengo refuses to talk. When Kengo begs Ramune to fix it, even if it's only temporary, Ramune hands him a certain mysterious item. Kengo accepts the item and begins talking to a woman named Yui about going on a date, but...

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Mysterious Item Shop Akatsuki
1.plot: Ramune uses his Shoji Vision to invite Kuro to a mysterious item shop. Kuro discovers the mysterious item shop Akatsuki at his destination. At first glance, the store appears to be a candy shop, but mysterious items are sold in the back. Kuro meets shopkeeper Nico and his great-grandmother and former shopkeeper Ayame, a girl who remembers her past lives, and is watching her make mysterious items with great interest when a strange man appears.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Chili Pepper Fingertips
1.plot: Takaharu, a high school student whose fingertips have turned into chili peppers, comes to see Ramune. He seems to have some idea as to why he's haunted by the mysterious. The mysterious nail clippers Ramune lends to him can be removed from their bag once Takaharu stops hiding his true self. Initially Takaharu can't even untie the drawstring, but...

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Pot Sticker Ears (Part One)
1.plot: A boy named Rio comes to the shrine. His mother is afflicted by a mysterious disease that has turned her ears into pot stickers. His mother claims not to know what the cause is, but she is distraught because they are preventing her not only from hearing the voices of others, but Rio's voice as well. Ramune explains that there are voices she can hear and voices she can't, and that it's an emotional problem. He decides to wait and see how her condition changes.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Pot Sticker Ears (Part Two)
1.plot: Rio learns that his mother's ears have turned into pot stickers because his older brother Yuu was kidnapped, and Rio feels responsible for what happened. When Rio nearly falls off a cliff while searching for Yuu, Ramune throws himself in harm's way to protect him and ends up badly injured. In order to save Ramune, Rio uses the Pearl of Night Voices he received from Ramune to treat his mother, desperately calling out to his mother, who can't hear his voice.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Popcorn Head (Part One)
1.plot: Kuro's classmate Aona is troubled by the popcorn that keeps popping out of his head. Aona says it makes him sad when the popcorn disappears, so Ramune lends him a bag that can be used to store the popcorn. Why is Aona's head producing popcorn, and why does he feel sad when it disappears? Ramune tells Aona that the treatment method will become clear if he asks himself those questions...

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Popcorn Head (Part Two)
1.plot: Aona's head began producing popcorn because his father prohibited him from making the creations he loved. Concerned for Aona's wellbeing, Kuro heads to the hospital where Aona's mother is staying in order to seek her help. However, Aona ties balloons to the bag that's now full of popcorn and releases it into the sky. Kuro and Ramune rush out of the hospital in order to recover the bag.

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Mysterious Labyrinth
1.plot: Upon receiving an invitation to a treasure hunt from the famous mysterious item artist Reinette, Ramune and Kuro visit Reinette's mansion. There they encounter Ayame and Nico, who have also come to participate in the treasure hunt. However, when Ramune sees the man with them, his expression freezes, and he attempts to flee the scene. That man is Ramune's master Momiji!

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Toru's Deeply Mysterious Story - Part One
1.plot: When he was young, Kuro could see things that ordinary people couldn't. After being taken to the hospital, he pretends that he can't see anything so that his family won't worry about him. However, the things remain visible even after years pass. Furthermore, Kuro begins coughing up sand and can no longer eat. Desperately clutching at straws, he visits a certain place...

1.title: EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Toru's Deeply Mysterious Story - Part Two
EN - Dr. Ramune: Mysterious Disease Specialist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Dr. Ramune -Mysterious Disease Specialist-

meta.plot: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Dio the Invader
1.plot: England, 1868. A thief tries to raid an overturned carriage, but discovers that two of the occupants, a man and his young son are still alive. The man, George Joestar, proclaims he will forever be indebted to his savior, who reveals himself to be Dario Brando.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A Letter from the Past
1.plot: Seven years later in 1888, JoJo and Dio are supposedly getting along, though JoJo is still fearful of Dio. Meanwhile, Dio plots to liberate the Joestar family of their fortune.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Youth with Dio
1.plot: JoJo prepares to turn Dio in to the police.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Overdrive
1.plot: Three days after the incident, JoJo awakens to find Erina nursing him back to health in the hospital. As they rekindle their friendship, they encounter a strange man named Will A. Zeppeli.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Dark Knights
1.plot: A talented young pickpocket named Poco unwittingly lures JoJo and company into an encounter with Dio, Tarukus, and Blueford.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Tomorrow's Courage
1.plot: The encounter between JoJo and the Knights continues.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Sorrowful Successor
1.plot: The encounter against Tarukus comes to an end. Poco's family is in grave danger. JoJo meets Dire, Straizo, and Tonpetty.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
1.plot: The party are received by Doobie. Dire faces off against Dio. Straizo takes on Pajyu, Jones, Pluton, and Barnum.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Final Ripple!
1.plot: As Dio falls following his battle with JoJo, he decapitates himself before the ripple reaches his head, which is recovered by his zombie servant Wang Chung.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - New York's JoJo
1.plot: In 1938, 49 years after Jonathan Joestar's death, Speedwagon and Straizo travel to Mexico, where they discover an underground room filled with similar looking masks and a petrified body believed to be the being who created them.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Game Master
1.plot: As expected, Straizo recovers from Joseph's attack and uses the laser eye attack Dio used to seemingly pierce through JoJo's head and neck. However, this turns out to be a clever trick by Joseph.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Pillar Man
1.plot: Joseph is confronted by one of Stroheim's men, Donovan, but manages to subdue him, learning that Speedwagon is still alive.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - JoJo vs. the Ultimate Lifeform
1.plot: As Joseph begins to fight against Santana, Joseph finds his Ripple to not be effective against Santana, but it still helps protect him from the Pillar Man's attacks. Joseph appears to be unconscious after receiving a powerful hit.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Ultimate Warriors from Ancient Times
1.plot: Speedwagon brings statued remains of Santana to the headquarters of his foundation in Washington, D.C., where it is shown Santana is still alive, but his scientists are able to keep him dormant through the use of ultraviolet light.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - A Hero's Proof
1.plot: Caesar engages Wamuu in battle for killing Mark, using his Bubble Launcher technique to surround the Pillar Man in Ripple enfused bubbles.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Lisa Lisa, Hamon Coach
1.plot: Wanting to teach JoJo to control his Ripple powers, Caesar takes him to Venice to meet his teacher, Lisa Lisa.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Deeper Plan
1.plot: Lisa Lisa explains to JoJo and Caesar how the creator of the Stone Mask, Kars, is seeking a perfectly cut Red Stone of Aja known as the Super Aja to power the Stone Mask and become the ultimate life form.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Von Stroheim's Revenge
1.plot: As JoJo awaits to warn Lisa Lisa about the Pillar Men, Esidisi's brain takes over the body of Suzi Q and sends the Super Aja off on a boat bound for Venice before confronting Lisa Lisa.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - A Race Toward the Brink
1.plot: Stroheim starts using his new mechanical body, which was designed to surpass Santana, to fight against Kars. However, it proves futile against Kars' Light Mode.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Young Caesar
1.plot: Lisa Lisa tells JoJo of Caesar's childhood, in which he took to crime at a young age after being abandoned by his debt-ridden father, Mario.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - A Hundred Against Two
1.plot: Whilst following Wamuu's trail of blood, JoJo and Lisa Lisa encounter another vampire named Wired Beck.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - A True Warrior
1.plot: Before JoJo's and Wamuu's race begins, it is revealed that during each lap, there will be a different weapon for whoever can grab it from a pillar first.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Warrior of Wind
1.plot: Launching his Final Mode attack, Gathering Gale, which starts peeling away his own body, Wamuu begins firing a stream of wind capable of cutting stone towards JoJo.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - The Ties That Bind JoJo
1.plot: Being forced to cling onto a rope to stop Lisa Lisa from falling to her death, JoJo is at a huge disadvantage against Kars.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - The Birth of a Superbeing
1.plot: Kars demonstrates his new powers, turning his hand into a flesh-eating squirrel that deals damage to Stroheim. The sun rises, leaving a shocking discovery.

1.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S01E26 - The Ascendant One
1.plot: JoJo's victory, along with his arm, is cut short when Kars manages to survive the volcano by forming a shield of air bubbles to protect him from its deadly lava.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - The Man Possessed by an Evil Spirit
2.plot: In 1987, in Japan, a boy named Jotaro Kujo has willingly turned himself into jail, refusing to leave. Jotaro's mother, Holly, requests help from her father, Joseph Joestar, who travels to Japan alongside an acquaintance, Mohammed Abdul.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Who Will Be the Judge!?
2.plot: Jotaro heads to school and encounters a mysterious transfer student named Noriaki Kakyoin.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Curse of DIO
2.plot: Jotaro is able to defeat Kakyoin. He takes the wounded Kakyoin back to his house, hoping to get some information about DIO.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Tower of Grey
2.plot: If they do not defeat DIO within 50 days, Holly could die - Jotaro and crew head to Egypt, where they think DIO is hiding. While on the plane, they run into another one of DIO's assassins.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Silver Chariot
2.plot: DIO's next assassin, Polnareff attacks Jotaro and crew, Abdul faces him with his Magician's Red.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Dark Blue Moon
2.plot: With a new person in their party, they head to Singapore with the boat the Speedwagon Foundation provided them, during their journey Jotaro is targeted by an enemy Stand from within the water.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Strength
2.plot: A giant ship shows itself. On board, they realize they can't seem to find a crew, but an orangutan.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Devil
2.plot: Arrived in Singapore, Jotaro's group stays at a hotel individually. A new Stand owner who is known as "Devo the Cursed" is awaiting Polnareff in his room. Devo's Stand increases its power as its user's hatred towards the opponent increases. Polnareff gets into a desperate situation as he starts fighting front. Does Polnareff have a chance to win the battle against Devo who keeps attacking him in a cruel and brutal way?

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Yellow Temperance
2.plot: Joseph uses Hermit Purple to create a message using the TV, which tells them that Kakyoin is a traitor.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - The Emperor and the Hanged Man (1)
2.plot: The group travels to India. In a restaurant Polnareff is attacked by a mysterious Stand that is inside a mirror.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - The Emperor and the Hanged Man (2)
2.plot: In an effort to save Polnareff, Abdul is injured by the enemy. Then J. Geil's Stand, Hanged Man attacks.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Empress
2.plot: The group heads toward Varanasi. On the way, Joseph realizes his arm is quite swollen.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - Wheel of Fortune
2.plot: Jotaro and the others head toward Pakistan in a car. Polnareff is driving the car on a very dangerous mountain road, and recklessly passes a slow moving vehicle that was in front of him.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - Justice (1)
2.plot: Jotaro and the others successfully survive another attack from the enemy Stand users and make it into Pakistan. However, they decide to find an inn at a nearby village because of the dense fog they suddenly hit. The village they get to is rather quiet and all of the inhabitants seem rather odd.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - Justice (2)
2.plot: Polnareff finally realizes that Enyaba is another assassin from DIO. He tries to warn the others, but Enyaba's Stand, Justice, has the ability to take control of people's bodies and corpses, and he is pursued. The whole village had already been under Enyaba's control.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - Lovers (1)
2.plot: After surviving Enyaba's attack, Jotaro and crew make it to Pakistan's capital, Karachi. There, they encounter DIO's next assassin, Steely Dan. Following DIO's orders, Steely Dan ruthlessly kills Enyaba in front of them. Jotaro and the others can't help but feel conflicted about that happening, and end up in a battle with Steely Dan.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - Lovers (2)
2.plot: Steely Dan's Stand, The Lovers, has entered Joseph's brain. Dan puts himself at an advantage, with having Joseph's life on the line, and tells Jotaro to do various things for him, knowing Jotaro has no choice but to obey. Meanwhile, Kakyoin and Polnareff also enter Joseph's brain with their Stands and find the Stand that is using brain cells as food.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - Sun
2.plot: Jotaro and the others continue their journey through the desert, trying to get to Cairo. They travel with camels and can't shake the feeling that someone is following them, but no one is in sight. Traveling in the killer heat, they realize that it's still bright out at 8pm and the sun is actually rising rather than setting.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - Death 13 (1)
2.plot: Kakyoin is dreaming and dreams about being in a strange amusement park, where he encounters the Death tarot card. While in the dream, he witnesses Death 13 cut down a dog. Kakyoin wakes up screaming, but can't remember what his bad dream was about.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E20 - Death 13 (2)
2.plot: Kakyoin tries to convince the others that the baby is suspicious, but that backfires and his friends start to doubt his sanity. Kakyoin then tries to convince them that he's not crazy, and shows them his arm that has "Baby Stand" carved into it... but that just makes them believe he really is crazy. Kakyoin then tries to use his Stand to attack, but is knocked out by Polnareff. Eventually, Jotaro and the others wake up in the nightmare and the truth finally comes out.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E21 - Judgement (1)
2.plot: While on an island on the edge of the Red Sea where Mohammed Abdul's father is said to live, Polnareff uncovers a magic lamp and its genie Cameo offers him three wishes, although all is not as it seems.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E22 - Judgement (2)
2.plot: Polnareff must find out a way to escape the attacks of Cameo and his Stand Judgement who has apparently turned his sister Cherie and Abdul into zombies.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E23 - High Priestess (1)
2.plot: Jotaro and the others obtain a submarine as a new means of travel. Through the Red Sea, they try to head toward Egypt where DIO awaits. Using the sonar to detect any threats on the outside, the submarine quietly dives in. They however realize that if they're attacked underwater, there is nowhere to escape, so they are on their guard. Finally, when they are about to surface, a coffee mug that was in the cabin transforms and cuts off Joseph's artificial hand.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E24 - High Priestess (2)
2.plot: The group must find a way off of the submarine and away from the attacks of High Priestess.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E25 - Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul, Part (1)
2.plot: Jotaro's group encounters N'Doul's Stand "Geb", and Iggy's "The Fool".

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E26 - Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'Doul (2)
2.plot: The group's encounter with "Geb" and "The Fool" continues.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E27 - Oingo's Divine Khnum and Boingo's Divine Thoth
2.plot: As the Joestar group arrives in Aswan they encounter Oingo's Stand "Khnum" and Boingo's Stand "Thoth".

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E28 - Anubis (1)
2.plot: Jotaro's group encounters the Stand "Anubis".

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E29 - Anubis (2)
2.plot: The encounter with the Stand "Anubis" continues.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E30 - Mariah's Divine Bastet (1)
2.plot: Jotaro and the others arrive in Luxor. While heading there, Joseph notices an electrical outlet in a rock. Obviously fascinated by the electrical outlet in the rock, Joseph gets closer, and he gets shocked.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E31 - Mariah's Divine Bastet (2)
2.plot: Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetised. While chasing after the woman that seemed to be the Stand user, Abdul also touches the electrical outlet and becomes magnetised as well.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E32 - Alessi's Divine Set (1)
2.plot: While Joseph and Avdol were fighting with Mariah, Jotaro gets concerned that they haven't shown up yet, and goes to look for them around Luxor. Then, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E33 - Alessi's Divine Set (2)
2.plot: Because of the power of Alessi's Stand, Set, Polnareff is turned back into a child. The one who came to his aid amidst his confusion was a woman named Marena. However, Alessi's evil hands followed Polnareff into her house.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E34 - D'Arby the Gambler (1)
2.plot: After a long journey, Jotaro and the others finally reach Cairo. They go to a cafe and ask if anyone knows where DIO's mansion is located by showing the picture around. Then, someone says that they have seen the building before.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E35 - D'Arby the Gambler (2)
2.plot: Souls are on the line as a game of poker continues.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E36 - Hol Horse and Boingo (1)
2.plot: Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. That partner, is none other than Boingo.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E37 - Hol Horse and Boingo (2)
2.plot: Hol Horse and Boingo followed Jotaro and the others to Cairo and as Boingo's book said, Hol Horse stuck his fingers into Polnareff's nose... but he didn't know what to do from there. Then Jotaro and the others, who were looking for Polnareff, show up, but things seem to be going the opposite way of the premonition.

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E38 - The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop (1)
2.plot: Jojo and the others continue to look for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Abdul's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, who is wandering the city alone, gets confronted by two large dogs. The dogs are freaked out by Iggy's power, and decide to go after a bird that's at a nearby mansion instead. However, as soon as the dogs go into the mansion, they are impaled by a giant icicle. Iggy is shocked by the occurance, and sees a falcon appear...

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E39 - The Gatekeeper of Hell, Pet Shop (2)
2.plot: Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against the falcon that guards DIO's mansion, Pet Shop. Pet Shop shows no mercy, and goes after Iggy at a frightening speed. Iggy, despite being injured, runs into the river, making a dome made out of dirt to shield him. However, he underestimates Pet Shop's abilities, and...

2.title: EN - JoJo's Bizarre Adventure [MULTI-SUB] - S02E40 - D'Arby the Player (1)
