meta.plot: In feudal Japan, half-demon twins Towa and Setsuna are separated from each other during a forest fire. While desperately searching for her younger sister, Towa wanders into a mysterious tunnel that sends her into present-day Japan, where she is found and raised by Kagome Higurashi’s brother, Sota, and his family. Ten years later, the tunnel that connects the two eras has reopened, allowing Towa to be reunited with Setsuna, who is now a demon slayer working for Kohaku. But to Towa’s shock, Setsuna appears to have lost all memories of her older sister

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Inuyasha: Since Then
1.plot: Towa Higurashi learns about an incident that took place decades ago involving a half demon named Inuyasha and a priestess named Kagome.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Three Princesses
1.plot: Half-demon twins Towa and Setsuna are separated from each other when a mysterious tunnel sends Towa into the future, where she is found and raised by Kagome Higurashi’s brother Sota.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Dream Butterfly
1.plot: In the present day, a demon emerges through the Sacred Tree at Higurashi Shrine with Setsuna, Towa’s twin, and the bounty hunter Moroha in tow. Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha struggle to battle the demon, whose powers have been strengthened with two Rainbow Pearls, but seeing Setsuna in trouble awakens Towa’s latent demon powers.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Gateway To The Past
1.plot: Towa decides to return to the feudal era to help Setsuna regain her memories. The trio enter the corridor leading to the feudal era, but within it awaits the spirit of a certain priestess.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Jakotsumaru of the Red Bone Palace
1.plot: Safely back in the feudal era, Moroha heads to the corpse dealer to claim her bounty. Meanwhile, Towa and Setsuna take on a request to slay Jakotsumaru, a boy who has been extracting bones from humans and beasts in order to revive his father, the demon beast Tokotsu.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Cat Juan at the Old Temple
1.plot: Travelers are going missing one after another. Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha head to the northern mountains to crack the case, but instead they find a village completely overrun by ghost cats!

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Meeting through an Apple
1.plot: On her way to search for the Dream Butterfly, Towa meets a strange young man named Riku. Towa offers him an apple, and in thanks, Riku presents her with the genuine Kikujumonji sword.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Dream Gazing Trap
1.plot: After fleeing from the deputy shogun’s estate, Yotsume borrows the power of a Rainbow Pearl to unleash his Dream Gazing spell upon the Half-Demon Princesses, who are hot on his trail.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Meifuku, the Meioju
1.plot: Moroha accepts a job to slay Konton, a member of the Four Perils said to have defeated Meioju, a demon beast with the ultimate armored shell.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Gold and Silver Rainbow Pearls
1.plot: The Half-Demon Princesses are tasked with slaying Kinka and Ginka, conjoined twins of the Ka Demon Tribe whose battles for dominance have been wreaking havoc everywhere.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Curse of the Man-Eating Pond
1.plot: Something wicked lurks in the Man-Eating Pond, devouring any human, beast or bird that comes near. Towa and Setsuna meet Hikomaru and Chiyo, siblings who lost their parents to the pond.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Night of the New Moon and the Black-haired Towa
1.plot: The demon Nikosen was a sage before evil consumed his soul. Konton orders him to kill the Half-Demon Princesses. Towa struggles as her demon powers fade and she turns into a human.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Delicious Feudal Monks
1.plot: When a demon begins to devour virtuous monks and Shinto priests in the region, Hisui is assigned to guard his father, Miroku, who has been undergoing harsh training for the past two years.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The One Behind the Forest Fire
1.plot: Towa and Setsuna set off to slay Homura, an evil mountain god who has abducted a beautiful maiden. The twins learn that Homura was involved in the forest fire that separated them.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Farewell Under the Lunar Eclipse
1.plot: The truth behind the night that sealed the fate of Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha’s parents is finally revealed.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Double-Edged Moroha
1.plot: Moroha once had a master named Yawaragi, who was keeping a life-threatening secret. In order to resolve the secret and protect her pupil, Yawaragi made an agreement with Jyubei.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - The Two Evil Traps
1.plot: Konton devises a plan to destroy the Half-Demon Princesses. Riku offers to help him out. The three girls are lured into a ravine and fall right into Konton’s trap.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Sesshomaru and Kirinmaru
1.plot: Konton learns of the origins of the Rainbow Pearl and the connection between Kirinmaru and the Dream Butterfly. He summons an ogre to attack the Half-Demon Princesses.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Princess Aiya’s Beniyasha Hunting
1.plot: The deputy shogun’s daughter Aiya offers to employ the demon slayers if they win in a battle against the bounty hunters.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Hidden Village for Half Demons
1.plot: Setsuna opens up to Towa about the hidden village for half-demons where she was raised for most of her childhood.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Secret of the Rainbow Pearls
1.plot: On the night of the new moon, Riku pays Towa a visit to chat. Unfortunately, he’s not the only one planning to drop by.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Stolen Seal
1.plot: Zero removes the seal that Miroku placed on Setsuna to suppress her demon powers, awakening the latent demon blood within.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - The Three Princesses Strike Back
1.plot: Setsuna and Towa hire Moroha to help slay Zero. The trio successfully track Zero down, but Riku stands in their way.

1.title: EN - Yashahime: Princess Half-Demon [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Sesshomaru's Daughter
1.plot: Towa, Setsuna, and Moroha are left to confront Kirinmaru, but in the face of overwhelming power, they must pay a great price.

meta.plot:
Kakeru and Suguru are brothers who both have a flaming passion for soccer. However, while Suguru becomes a rising star in the Japanese youth soccer system, Kakeru decides to take on a managerial role after struggling on the field. But due to a cruel twist of fate, Kakeru ends up reevaluating the role he has chosen.

In hopes of one day being able to enter the World Cup by becoming a member of the national team, Kakeru trains harder than anyone else. He isn’t alone in this quest for glory, though. Kakeru's childhood friend, Nana, is a soccer prodigy of her own, with the wicked nickname “Little Witch”. She is a top-ranked player and is already playing for Nadeshiko Japan, the Japanese women’s national team. Nana's success gives Kakeru the extra push he needs to reach for his goals.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Love Soccer
1.plot: Kakeru Aizawa is the manager for his middle school soccer team and younger brother to soccer prodigy Suguru Aizawa. His childhood friend, Nana Mishima, returns from America and enrolls into his class. That night, Kakero secretly practices soccer at the park and is challenged to a match by a masked stranger. The next day, Suguru has Kakeru enter a soccer match for the chance to join the regulars as a forward.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Knight in the Area
1.plot: Kakeru displays his skills as a forward by predicting and receiving Suguru's skilled passes. Whenever Kakeru has a chance to score, he changes his footing and hits the ball with his right leg reducing the power of the shot and prevents him from scoring. That night, Kakeru meets the masked stranger and explains how he injured a classmate with his left leg during a soccer match which is the cause to his playing style. That morning on the way to school, Suguru attempts to tell Kakeru he is the only forward able to receive his passes. In the middle of the conversation, they are hit by a truck.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - A Brother`s Pulse
1.plot: In the coma, Kakeru relives the day he, along with Suguru and Nana, promise to join Japan's national soccer team. Meanwhile, Suguru is pronounced brain dead and his family agree to the hospital's decision to transplant his heart into Kakeru to save his life; Nana happens to overhear the decision. After several days, Kakeru is discharged from the hospital and resigns from the soccer team. At the park, a girl is almost hit by a car but is saved when Kakeru kicks a ball and stops the driver.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Last Pass
1.plot: Kakeru is unable to recall what happened when he kicked the ball, leading Nana to suspect Suguru's heart is the cause. At the hospital, Suguru's sport counselor, Ayaka Mine, examines Kakeru and reminds him to exercise for his heart. She secretly tasks Nana to watch for Suguru-like behavior from Kakeru possibly resulted from the transplant. That night, Kakeru learns that the masked stranger is Nana and that he received a heart transplant from Suguru. As Kakeru reads through Suguru's dairy, he discovers his brother's frustration with the forwards in Japan's national team and how he desires Kakeru to fill that position. The next day, Kakeru tells Nana he will enroll in Enoshima High where Ryuichi Araki, a passer with skills like Suguru, is located.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Enoshima High School's Soccer Club!?
1.plot: A year passes and Kakeru and Nana are now students in Enoshima High school. They enroll in a soccer club, discovering that their club is the school's unofficial soccer team dubbed FC. They learn that before nationals tournament, FC competes with the official soccer team, dubbed SC, to determine who represents the school. Kakeru and Nana remain on the team after realizing FC's unconventional training is more effective than SC's. Meanwhile, Kakeru attempts to persuade Ryuichi to rejoin FC, who quit soccer and become overweight after losing to SC. Ryuichi explains the same frustration he felt as Suguru about the lack of skilled forwards to accept his passes but is inspired by Kakeru who offers to accept that position.

1.title: EN - The Knight in the Area - Area no Kishi [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Clash! FC vs. SC!!
1.plot: The match between FC and SC to decide who will represent the school for nationals begins. Ryuichi fails to show up during the match and the team plays without him. After the first half, SC leads by two points. A player on FC is injured and is forced to stop playing. Kota Nakatsuka, Kakeru's middle school friend, quits the SC team and joins the FC team to sub for the player. The game resumes and Kakeru scores a goal as does SC ending the second half with 1:3 lead by SC. Ryuichi, having lost weight, joins FC and subs in for a player for the final half of the game.

meta.plot: One day, a gamer played video games until he fell asleep...and when he woke up, he found himself in the game world—as a skeleton! Equipped with the powerful weapons and armor of his avatar but stuck with its frightening skeletal appearance, Arc has to find a place for himself in this new, fantastical land. All his hopes for a quiet life are dashed when he crosses paths with a beautiful elven warrior, setting him on a journey full of conflict and adventure.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Wandering Knight Sets Out to Make the World a Better Place
1.plot: A video game lover awakes to find himself in a medieval fantasy world as his character, a Holy Knight named Arc. As exciting as the opportunity seems at first, he realizes that his comical selection of the skull face for his avatar has resulted in a ghastly appearance that will make him a target if revealed. Will Arc be able to undertake the daring life of an adventurer without revealing his identity?

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - A First Job, a Girl's Wish and an Approaching Shadow
1.plot: Arc begins his days an adventurer-for-hire, but in spite of his fearsome strength, he still needs to keep a low profile. Luckily, he finds the perfect inaugural quest for his inconspicuous new life... or does he?

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - An Austere Elf Dances for Her Comrades
1.plot: Arc encounters the elf warrior Ariane, who is suspicious about humans due to the bigotry that elves face in the realm. But when a slave ring that captures elf children surfaces, Arc's desire for an inconspicuous lifestyle and his compulsion to do the right thing will be weighed against each other.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Infiltrating the Slave Market!  In Search of the Worlds Evil
1.plot: With the help of one of Ariane's comrades, she and Arc head to the town of Diento to break up the local elf slave trade.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - A Secret Revealed, and a Bond Forged
1.plot: Arc and Ariane make their way into the palace of Marquis Diento. What kind of political fallout will there be from one of the Rhoden nobles possessing enslaved elves?

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Learning About the Darkness of This World at the Elf Village
1.plot: While Ariane and her father travel to the elvish city of Maple to discuss her ongoing mission, Arc finds himself getting an unexpected lesson from her mother, Glenys.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Miracle for the High-Minded Princess
1.plot: Arc and Ariane set out for Olav in Rhoden Kingdom in search of slave traders. As they take a shortcut through the forest, they are attacked by the Hounted Wolves. Meanwhile, Yuriarna and her guards are attacked by assassins on their way to Limbult.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Allied! Dashing Through the Darkness with the Beastpeople!
1.plot: Arriving at the royal capital of the Kingdom of Roden, Ark reunites with Chiyome, a girl with animal ears. Ark, who was begged by Chiyome and helped rescue the captive beast humans, participated in an assault operation on the royal capital's largest slave trader, Etuat Shokai. The night of the decisive action ── Ark teams up with Goemon, a ninja who is a fellow of Chiyome and has a muscular bone, and sets out a frontal breakthrough against a company with strict guards.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - The Capital in Chaos and a Maiden's Oath
1.plot: Arc, Ariane, Chiyome, and Goemon launch an attack on the Etzat Market, the single largest slave market in the kingdom of Rhoden.

1.plot: Arc and Ariane head to the Holy Revlon Empire to hunt elf slave traders, but without a clear way forward their path could be perilous. Luckily, a stranger approaches them with a job offer that could make the way forward clearer.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Monster-Taming Barbarian Laughs in the Darkness
1.plot: Arc and Ariane have followed the trail of kidnapped elves to a fortress within the Holy Revlon Empire, but they have no way of knowing the vicious threats waiting inside.

1.title: EN - Skeleton Knight in Another World [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Shall Cut Through the World’s Evils!
1.plot: Arc and his friends must face Fumba, the monster tamer, who uses his greatest asset, a hydra that is capable of destroying an entire nation.

meta.plot:
The story follows the "indecipherable" daily life of the short and quiet Reina Aharen and Raidou who sits next to her in class. Aharen is not so good at gauging the distance between people (or personal boundaries), and Raidou initially sensed some distance between the two of them. Then one day, when Raidou picked up the eraser that Aharen had dropped, the distance between them suddenly became uncomfortably close.

From "way too distant" to "way too close" ... Aharen is simply unpredictable.

1.title: EN - Aharen-san wa Hakarenai [MULTI SUB] - S01E01 - Isn't This Too Close?
1.plot: Raido spent middle-school isolated due to his unintentionally unfriendly appearance, and hopes that high school will be different. He decides the first step to being more social will be to get to know Aharen Reina, the girl who sits next to him. She seems distant at first, then a little too close, and before long Raido comes to understand that Aharen has more than a little trouble at gauging the distance between herself and others--in more ways than one.

1.title: EN - Aharen-san wa Hakarenai [MULTI SUB] - S01E02 - Are We Being Followed?

1.title: EN - Aharen-san wa Hakarenai [MULTI SUB] - S01E03 - We're Changing Seats, Huh?
1.plot: The periodic shift of the seating chart is approaching, threatening to put Aharen and Raido's friendship to the test.

meta.plot: Lingalind is a land enclosed by the Wall. The Wall covers, protects, cultivates, and nurtures the land. One day in Edger, a village on the outskirts of Lingalind, a mysterious man named Back Arrow appears. Arrow has lost his memory, but he claims that all he knows is that “I came from outside the Wall.”

1.title: EN - BACK ARROW [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Do Guys From the Sky Have Undies?

1.plot: Though Elsha discovers a hidden power, the village is ruined for good. To protect everyone and find a new home, a sacrifice must be made.

1.plot: Shu Bi has been scheming his rise to the top ever since he was little. In order to prove where his loyalties lie, he challenges Arrow with some hired help.

6.title: EN - My Hero Academia [MULTI-SUB] - S06E25 - No Man Is an Island

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E01 - The Story of Daigo
1.plot: In Japan's Warring States period, Lord Daigo Kagemitsu makes a pact with 12 demons, offering them his unborn son in exchange for the prosperity of his lands. Years later, young thief Dororo is attacked by a ghoul but rescued by a mysterious boy, whose body parts turn out to be almost entirely prosthetic.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E02 - The Story of Bandai
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru happen upon a village and are brought before its chief, Lady Bandai. However, Hyakkimaru inexplicably draws his sword in her presence, resulting in both him and Dororo being locked in a storehouse by the villagers. It turns out they are not the only ones confined there...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E03 - The Story of Jukai
1.plot: Jukai is a doctor who travels the land fitting prosthetic arms and legs to those who have lost their limbs in war. One day, on the riverbank he finds a baby missing most of its body parts. He decides to raise the child, who he names “Hyakkimaru”. Jukai provides the child with prostheses, but the time comes when Hyakkimaru sets out on a journey to recover his own body parts.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E04 - The Story of the Cursed Sword
1.plot: Dororo Onikimaru confronts Tanosuke, a manly slaughter. The sword he wields was a cursed decoy where the devil lives. Although barely dismissing Tanosuke, the military sword has passed over to the hands of the hands and the horsemans are manipulated by the weapon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E05 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 1
1.plot: Struggling to adapt to an unfamiliar world of "sound", Hyakkimaru is injured in a fight with a ghoul. He is taken in and nursed by a girl named Mio, who looks after children orphaned by war. However, after becoming aware of a demon nearby, Hyakkimaru heads out to fight it before he is fully recovered.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E06 - The Story of the Moriko Song, Part 2
1.plot: Hyakkimaru has regained his voice from the devil god, but one leg was stolen from him. After returning to the deserted temple and having his wounds taken care of, he again goes into battle with the demon. Meanwhile, in the abandoned temple where Mio and the children are waiting ...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E07 - The Story of the Jorogumo Silk Spider
1.plot: The spider-like ghoul Jorogumo is wounded by Hyakkimaru. To heal itself, it transforms into a woman and takes advantage of the hospitality of a young man named Yajiro. Having let Jorogumo slip through their fingers, Dororo and Hyakkimaru stop at a village where they hear rumors of a kidnapper at large.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E08 - The Story of Saru
1.plot: At a certain village, young girls are offered up as ritual sacrifices to appease a giant centipede demon that appears shrouded in black clouds. Hyakkimaru and Dororo team up with Saru, a boy whose older sister has been offered as a sacrifice, and together they confront the demon.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E09 - The Story of Mercilessness
1.plot: Dororo comes down with a high fever. While woozy from its effects, the youngster catches a glimpse of some red spider lilies, which stirs up memories of past days spent with parents Hibukuro and Ojiya.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E10 - The Story of Tahomaru
1.plot: A village within Daigo's domain is being terrorized by a ghoul that dwells in a nearby lake. Tahomaru, accompanied by his aides Hyogo and Mutsu, volunteers to exterminate the ghoul.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E11 - The Story of Banmon, Part 1
1.plot: After entering Lord Daigo's domain, Dororo and Hyakkimaru hear tales of Banmon, the huge wall that is the last remnant of a fort that once stood on the border. Hyakkimaru squares off against the fox demon that haunts the wall.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E12 - The Story of Banmon, Part 2
1.plot: Kagemitsu, who offered up his own son to the demons. Hyakkimaru, who is trying to get back the body parts that were taken from him. As if drawn together by fate, they face each other.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E13 - The Story of the Blank-faced Buddha
1.plot: Having left Daigo's domain, Dororo finds a statue of Fudo, one of the wisdom gods. But the statue is actually a demon that is harvesting humans' faces in an attempt to find one for itself.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E14 - The Story of Sabame
1.plot: Dororo and Hyakkimaru come across an abandoned, burnt-out temple, where they meet a man named Sabame who rules the surrounding area. Sabame invites the two of them to his residence and tells them the story behind the burnt-out temple and the ghoul that haunts it. However, Dororo and Hyakkimaru suspect that he might not be telling the truth.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E15 - The Story of the Scene from Hell
1.plot: Sabame has been feeding people to the demons to protect the village over which he rules. As Hyakkimaru once again confronts the demon moths, Dororo gets trapped in a storehouse.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E16 - The Story of Shiranui
1.plot: Dororo has been captured by Itachi and is being taken to the cape where Hibukuro supposedly hid the money. As Itachi and his men look for boats to get across to the cape, they are approached by a one-armed boy named Shiranui.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E17 - The Story of Questions and Answers
1.plot: Jukai is reunited with a bloodied Hyakkimaru at the site of a recent battle, and finds out the truth of how Hyakkimaru and the demons are connected. Hyakkimaru asks Jukai for a new prosthetic leg, but...

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E18 - The Story of the Cape of Impermanence
1.plot: The shark demon lets out a roar and attacks Dororo, who is tied up and unable to move. Meanwhile, a troop of soldiers commanded by Tahomaru is also approaching the cape.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E19 - The Story of the Amanojaku
1.plot: To fix Hyakkimaru's broken sword, he and Dororo travel to a village where a master swordmaker named Munetsuna lives. Upon arriving at Munetsuna's house, they are met by his daughter Okowa.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E20 - The Story of Nue
1.plot: While traveling along a mountain path in search of a demon, Dororo and Hyakkimaru encounter a young man named Dice-spot Saburota. The man says that he too is hunting the demon, and they set off to exterminate it together.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E21 - The Story of Breaking the Cycle of Suffering
1.plot: Daigo Kagemitsu continues to prepare for war with the neighboring land of Asakura. Upon receiving word that Hyakkimaru is approaching his domain, Kagemitsu sends Tahomaru to dispose of him.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E23 - The Story of the Demons
1.plot: Hyakkimaru comes face to face with Tahomaru, Mutsu and Hyogo, who have been possessed by the power of demons. Dororo, Lady Nui and Biwamaru hurry to the scene, where they witness a ferocious battle that will determine the future of the land of Daigo.

1.title: FR - Dororo - S01E24 - Dororo and Hyakkimaru
1.plot: Daigo's castle is engulfed in flames. Within, two brothers by blood are at the mercy of fate. Dororo, Jukai and Lady Nui also head for the castle, each with their own thoughts weighing down upon their hearts. For a life that began with a silenced cry, where will the path of destiny lead?

meta.plot: A samurai lord has bartered away his newborn son's organs to forty-eight demons in exchange for dominance on the battlefield. Yet, the abandoned infant survives thanks to a medicine man who equips him with primitive prosthetics—lethal ones with which the wronged son will use to hunt down the multitude of demons to reclaim his body one piece at a time, before confronting his father. On his journeys the young hero encounters an orphan who claims to be the greatest thief in Japan.

1.title: EN - Stillwater [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Gift of Compassion / Larger Than Life

1.title: EN - Stillwater [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Downward Dog / The Sleeping Moon

1.title: EN - Stillwater [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Race / Dressed Up
1.plot: Addy feels sad after losing a cross-country race. Karl is unwilling to give up his favorite shirt, even though he's outgrown it.

1.title: EN - Stillwater [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Haircut / Paper Wings
1.plot: Karl is afraid to visit a barber for the first time. Michael becomes determined to make the perfect paper airplane.

meta.plot: This immersive series follows the world's most magnificent creatures, capturing never-before-seen moments from the heartwarming to the outrageous.

1.plot: Majestic, powerful and dead, big cats were once thought to be solitary creatures.  But we're now realizing just how collaborative they can be.

1.title: EN - Animal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Dogs
1.plot: Be it foxes on city streets or wolves on the tundra, canines rely on sharp senses, athleticism and fierce determination to punch above their weight.

1.title: EN - Animal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Marsupials
1.plot: It's not all about the pouches.  These mammalian misfits are full of surprises, from flamboyant kangaroo showdowns to rattling koala mating calls.

1.title: EN - Animal [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Octopus
1.plot: In changing seas and oceans, cephalopods like the cuttlefish and the giant Pacific octopus must rely on their remarkable intelligence to survive.

meta.plot: A colony of German Christians with a charismatic and manipulative leader establishes itself in Chile and becomes instrumental to the dictatorship.

1.title: EN - A Sinister Sect: Colonia Dignidad [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Mission
1.plot: Post-World War II, German preacher Paul Schäfer establishes a youth home but is soon accused of abuse. He flees to Chile, where he starts a new colony.

1.plot: In Chile, word gets out about Schäfer, so he establishes a free hospital to win favor with the locals. But then Wolfgang Kneese runs away, telling all.

1.plot: When Allende comes to power, a scared Schäfer smuggles and manufactures arms. Meanwhile, he grows more cruel in how he treats the colony's young people.

1.title: EN - A Sinister Sect: Colonia Dignidad [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Untouchable
1.plot: Schäfer enlists the colonists to support Pinochet's activities. And even after Pinochet loses the presidency, Schäfer manages to keep going.

1.title: EN - A Sinister Sect: Colonia Dignidad [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Fall

meta.plot: A cast of quirky critters and Mother Nature herself narrate this funny science series, which peeks into the lives of Earth's most incredible animals.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Strangest Things
1.plot: Say hello to Mother Nature’s all-star cast of confounding beasts, featuring Madagascar’s own death-metal lizard: the satanic leaf-tailed gecko.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Raging Waters
1.plot: Dive into an undersea world that's swimming with flirty amphibians, fishy friends, and sea-slug vacuums that keep things clean.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Mate Expectations
1.plot: Time to talk about the birds, the bees and all the other animals with strange mating rituals. When two scorpions make love, it’s anything but lovely.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Cycle of Life
1.plot: For Earth’s largest rodent, life’s a beach. For mayflies, it lasts only one day. What counts isn’t quantity, but quality — and occasional cannibalism.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - H2 wOah
1.plot: Bizarre dramas unfold in the world’s wet and wild oceans, including a leopard seal and a crustacean that team up to ruin an octopus's day.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Extremeliest
1.plot: The miraculous Jesus Christ lizard and goo-spewing bombardier beetle stand out among nature’s oldest, fastest and just plain kookiest creatures.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Flight Stuff
1.plot: Take to the skies to discover amazing murmurations of starlings and adorably pudgy puffins. Don’t mind the flying snakes, those wingless weirdos.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Eat Prey Live
1.plot: A butterfly that drinks turtle tears is just one of many organisms with unusual appetites and even odder methods of hunting and digesting their food.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Fights Camera Action
1.plot: Get ready for a rumble in the jungle. Whether clawing, crashing or headbanging, animal gladiators like to fight if love or status is on the line.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Strangerer Things
1.plot: The parade of curiosities kicks off with a tiny lizard that fits on a fingertip and monkeys with huge noses. Some Hawaiian sand is fish poop — fact.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - We're All the Same
1.plot: Humans share a surprising number of traits with their critter kin, such as using tools, yawning, soaking in saunas and flipping real estate.

1.title: EN - Absurd Planet [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Absurd is the Word
1.plot: Did you know goats speak in different regional dialects? Incredible facts about everyday animals lead to one conclusion: being different is awesome.

meta.plot: Applying the laws of life on Earth to the rest of the galaxy, this series blends science fact and fiction to imagine alien life on other planets.

1.title: EN - Alien Worlds - S01E01 - Atlas
1.plot: On Exoplanet Atlas, dense gravity creates a thick atmosphere allowing airborne life forms to thrive - but also providing a lesson in adaptability.

1.title: EN - Alien Worlds - S01E02 - Janus
1.plot: Ants, scorpions and fireflies provide clues for biologists to conjecture about life on exoplanet Janus, including highly adaptable pentapods.

1.title: EN - Alien Worlds - S01E03 - Eden
1.plot: Twin stars create an oxygen-rich atmosphere on Eden, where a teeming biosphere may parallel seasonal cycles of predation and reproduction o Earth.

1.title: EN - Alien Worlds - S01E04 - Terra
1.plot: A hyperadvanced species makes their home on doomed exoplanet Terra, which orbits an aging star. Now they must colonize another world, using robots.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E01 - Are You Happy in Your Life?
1.plot: Physics professor and family man Jason Dessen is abducted from everything he loves.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E02 - Trip of a Lifetime
1.plot: Jason wakes to a life that makes no sense—he doesn't have a family and he's created something extraordinary.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E03 - The Box

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E04 - The Corridor

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E08 - Jupiter
1.plot: Panicked and cornered, Jason2 tells Daniela and Charlie they need to leave town immediately.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E09 - Entanglement
1.plot: The Dessens' world comes crashing down.

meta.plot: Un physicien, professeur et père de famille qui, alors qu’il rentre chez lui un soir à pied dans les rues de Chicago, est projeté dans une version alternative de sa propre vie. L’émerveillement se transforme rapidement en cauchemar quand il essaie de retourner à sa réalité perdue dans le paysage hallucinant des vies qu’il aurait pu vivre. Dans ce labyrinthe de réalités, il s’embarque dans un voyage éprouvant pour retrouver sa véritable famille et la sauver de l’ennemi le plus terrifiant et invincible : lui-même.
Inspired by the classic Brothers Grimm stories, this anthology features six fairy tales with a dark twist, exposing the shadowy side of human desire.

1.title: EN - The Grimm Variations - S01E01 - Cinderella

1.title: EN - The Grimm Variations - S01E03 - Hansel and Gretel

1.plot: The sheltered and precocious Maria is content with her bleak village life until her obsessed teacher shows her an illicit picture from the outside world.

1.plot: Heather meets Lali, a survivor of Auschwitz, who tells her his life story of love and survival in the camp.

1.title: FR - The Tattooist of Auschwitz VOSTFR - S01E02 - Episode 2

1.title: FR - The Tattooist of Auschwitz VOSTFR - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Lali desperately tries to get medicine for Gita as her condition deteriorates.

1.title: FR - The Tattooist of Auschwitz [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4

1.title: FR - The Tattooist of Auschwitz [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5

1.title: EN - Amend: The Fight for America [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Resistance

1.plot: Beginning his life as a vampire, Louis learns the rules of vampirism from his maker and companion Lestat. Louis discovers increasing differences between himself and Lestat. In Dubai, Louis reveals more of his modern day vampire lifestyle to Molloy.

1.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S01E03 - "Is my very nature that of the devil"
1.plot: Louis continues his life as a businessman of Storyville. When an old friend comes to town, Louis's relationship with Lestat is tested. Louis' business intertwines with growing tensions in New Orleans, leading to a new chapter in Louis' vampire life.

1.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S01E04 - " ... the ruthless pursuit of blood with all a child's demanding"
1.plot: Claudia's transformation into a vampire teen completely changes Louis and Lestat's lives. As Claudia asks more questions, Louis and Lestat are forced to confront questions about making a teen vampire. Claudia learns dark realities of her new life.

1.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S01E05 - "A vile hunger for your hammering heart"

1.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S01E06 - "Like angels put in Hell by God"
1.plot: Lestat attempts to make amends with Louis. The vampire family decides to live together once more. A surprising action from Lestat leads the family to decide to leave New Orleans, once and for all. In Dubai, Molloy has a shocking realization.

1.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S01E07 - "The thing lay still"
1.plot: The vampire family plans to leave town after a big Mardi Gras ball. Claudia and Louis operate outside of Lestat's knowledge. In Dubai, Louis reveals a new element to the interview that changes everything.

2.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S02E01 - "What can the damned really say to the damned"
2.plot: Louis recounts Claudia's quest to find Old World Vampires amidst the backdrop of WWII Europe.

2.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S02E02 - "Do you know what it means to be loved by death"
2.plot: Armand joins the interview; he and Louis tell Molloy how they met.

2.title: FR - Entretien avec un vampire - S02E03 - "No pain"
2.plot: Armand tells the history of the Theatre des Vampires; Louis tells of his reluctance to join.

meta.plot: L'histoire épique de Louis de Pointe, faite d'amour, de sang et des périls de l'immortalité, racontée au journaliste Daniel Molloy. Basé sur le roman d'Anne Rice.

Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father's murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he confronts the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all.

1.title: FR - Zorro - S01E01 - The Chosen One
1.plot: Diego de la Vega returns to California to avenge his father’s murder. After assuming the title of Zorro, he initiates his struggle against Nah-Lin, a Native American who he believes has stolen his inheritance. Diego will confront the Governor, the malevolent leader of the Chinese community and a secret society, placing the common good above all. In doing so, he will sacrifice his love for Lola.

1.title: FR - Zorro - S01E02 - Inheritance
1.plot: To attract Zorro's attention, Diego and Lolita are held hostage in a robbery at the loan office. Lolita gets injured and Diego questions whether he is up to the task of wearing the mask.

1.title: FR - Zorro - S01E06 - Mask Games

Right after attempting to avoid Andreyévich from making the auction, Diego is surprised by the visit of the Bear Clan. Lolita is confused with her feelings for Diego and her engagement with Monasterio.

1.title: FR - Zorro - S01E07 - The Myth
1.plot: Accounts of Zorro appear in The Californian, which helps Ivanova find the missing piece to her plans. Diego gets a final warning from one of Nah-Lin's men that puts at risk his secret identity.

1.title: FR - Zorro - S01E09 - Unmasked
1.plot: The Bear Clan asks Diego for a loyalty test. If he wants to prevent it, he must uncover the murderers before the established deadline. Lolita confronts Diego about Zorro’s identity.

1.title: FR - X-Men '97 - S01E03 - Fire Made Flesh

1.plot: The X-Men finds Sentinel inventor Bolivar Trask, realizing they've been played by a mastermind.

1.title: FR - X-Men '97 - S01E08 - Tolerance Is Extinction (1)
1.plot: The X-Men must unite to face a new threat.

1.title: FR - X-Men '97 - S01E09 - Tolerance Is Extinction (2)
1.plot: The X-Men work to settle the score before it is too late.

1.title: FR - Past Lies - S01E05 - The Storm

1.title: FR - Past Lies - S01E06 - Blood Pact
1.plot: The police closes the case. Rita is not satisfied and sets out for the truth.

meta.plot: A group of women's lives are suddenly shaken by the appearance of a high school classmate who disappeared twenty-five years earlier on their senior trip.

The six-person crew of a derelict spaceship awakens from stasis in the farthest reaches of space. Their memories wiped clean, they have no recollection of who they are or how they got on board. The only clue to their identities is a cargo bay full of weaponry and a destination: a remote mining colony that is about to become a war zone. With no idea whose side they are on, they face a deadly decision. Will these amnesiacs turn their backs on history, or will their pasts catch up with them?

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E01 - Episode One
1.plot: A spaceship crew awaken from stasis with no memory of their mission or their identities, but once they reach their destination, a mining colony, they begin to look for answers while working together to survive.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E02 - Episode Two
1.plot: The crew come to terms with revelations about their respective pasts and face the dilemma of helping the miners against insurmountable odds or abandoning them to certain death.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E03 - Episode Three
1.plot: Sabotage is suspected and the onboard paranoia surges when the ship mysteriously veers off course. To bring the systems back online, a perilous spacewalk is required. At the same time, Five makes a shocking discovery.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E04 - Episode Four
1.plot: The past comes back to haunt members of the crew during a stopover at a space station, during which Four makes a stunning discovery, while Two and Five learn that some games of chance come with surprising risks. Elsewhere, Six receives some unwanted attention at a local clinic; and One and Three's attempts to sell the weapons in their cargo hold lands them at a dangerous disadvantage.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E05 - Episode Five
1.plot: The crew are hired by their handler to salvage a seemingly deserted space freighter, a reclaim op that appears to be straightforward until a deadly cargo is uncovered and they are forced to fight for their lives.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E06 - Episode Six
1.plot: Chemical hypnosis and the ship's neural link are used to explore the memories secreted away in Five's subconscious, during which she uncovers the dark truth about Four and Six's violent pasts. She also learns about the circumstances that landed her on the ship and gains some insight into the idyllic childhood of a mysterious little boy.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E07 - Episode Seven
1.plot: The crew finally gain access to the secret room in the ship's underbelly and among the items they find inside are a sunny android and a desperately ill woman who reveals a connection to Three.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E08 - Episode Eight
1.plot: The crew stop at a space station to refuel and rest, but Six has a different agenda, which has to do with revenge. Meanwhile, One is taken aback by an unwelcome revelation.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E09 - Episode Nine
1.plot: Four abandons the ship to embark on a reckless mission to reclaim his past and the crew are left wondering whether they should rescue him or let fate run its deadly course.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E10 - Episode Ten
1.plot: The crew takes on a job stealing a device from a rival corporation, but another team of mercenaries have the same goal.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E11 - Episode Eleven
1.plot: The crew plots to reclaim the ship from the mercenaries that are determined to deliver them to the Galactic Authority.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E12 - Episode Twelve
1.plot: The team's handler sends the crew on another mission to retrieve a scientist being held against his will.

1.title: FR - Dark Matter - S01E13 - Episode Thirteen
1.plot: Crew members are targeted, and paranoia mounts as they search for the perpetrator; the person responsible for the mind-wipe makes a move.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E01 - Welcome to Your New Home
2.plot: The crew awakens to find themselves prisoners on the Hyperion-8 Maximum Security Galactic Detention Facility.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E02 - Kill Them All
2.plot: Imprisoned in Hyperion-8, the crew must negotiate attempted assassinations, extraditions, and behind-the-scenes machinations as they plot their escape.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E03 - I've Seen the Other Side of You
2.plot: The neural link triggers a dangerous glitch and the crew start to turn against each other while hiding out in empty space in an effort to lose the GA.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E04 - We Were Family
2.plot: Three manages to reconnect with his former crew. The Android ends up in some unique company.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E05 - We Voted Not to Space You
2.plot: The Android goes undercover to try and help the crew track a dangerous, yet familiar, foe.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E06 - We Should Have Seen This Coming
2.plot: Desperate for money, the Raza crew follow Nyx's lead on an op, only to discover that their target is a personal one.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E07 - She's One of Them Now
2.plot: Three crew members infiltrate a highly secure facility with the help of their handler.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E08 - Stuff to Steal, People to Kill
2.plot: A Blink Drive test goes awry, propelling the Raza to a parallel reality.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E09 - Going Out Fighting
2.plot: The crew takes a dangerous mission inside Dwarf Star Technologies in a desperate bid to save their ailing leader.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E10 - Take the Shot
2.plot: Mayhem on the ship sheds light on some crew members' dark pasts.

2.title: FR - Dark Matter - S02E11 - Wish I'd Spaced You When I Had the Chance
2.plot: While Five is kidnapped and Three comes to her rescue, the rest of the Raza crew must face the Galactic Authority.

3.plot: The crew of the Raza target an Ishida research station in an attempt to take back the Blink Drive.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E03 - Welcome to the Revolution
3.plot: After receiving a distress call from a former associate, the crew of the Raza find themselves in the middle of a colony's fight for independence.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E04 - All the Time in the World
3.plot: Unbeknownst to the rest of the crew, Three has been trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E05 - Give It Up, Princess
3.plot: The crew must rescue kidnapped royalty to retrieve a file which could halt intergalactic war.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E06 - One Last Card to Play
3.plot: It's Raza vs Raza when other dimensional alternates of the crew steal weapons, the real crew must get them back.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E07 - Wish I Could Believe You
3.plot: A familiar face returns as one of the Raza crew learns a game changing bombshell about their past.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E08 - Hot Chocolate
3.plot: While providing safe transport for some allies, the Raza comes under attack from within.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E09 - Isn’t That a Paradox?
3.plot: When the Blink Drive self activates during a diagnostic, the Raza and its crew are transported through space and time.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E10 - Built, Not Born
3.plot: A distress call from the Android's friend Victor leads to answers about Two's past.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E11 - The Dwarf Star Conspiracy
3.plot: One of the Android's newly discovered memories leads the crew to a suspicious Dwarf Star facility on Nova 17.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E12 - My Final Gift to You
3.plot: Ryo takes a hostage to trade for the Blink Drive, but his former crew are not his only opponents.

3.title: FR - Dark Matter - S03E13 - Nowhere to Go
3.plot: The Raza's crew attempt to unite Ferrous' enemies and put an end to the corporate war before the new fleet can be used.

1.plot: Mummy Pig gives Peppa a box, which has to be kept a secret.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E14 - Flying a Kite
1.plot: Peppa goes outside and plays with her kite.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E15 - Picnic
1.plot: Peppa and her family go on a picnic.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E16 - Musical Instruments
1.plot: Mummy and Daddy Pig find an old box in the attic. It is full of musical instruments.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E17 - Frogs & Worms & Butterflies
1.plot: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden. Peppa pretends to be a butterfly.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E18 - Dressing Up
1.plot:
Peppa, George, and her friends play dress up.

Peppa and George love dressing up, so one day they creep into Mummy and Daddy's room and dress up in their clothes.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E19 - New Shoes
1.plot: Peppa loses her shoes, but she gets new red ones, making her happy again.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E20 - The School Fete
1.plot: Peppa and her family go to the school fete. Peppa and George have their faces painted as tigers, and Daddy Pig makes a dinosaur out of a balloon.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E21 - Mummy Pig's Birthday
1.plot: Mummy Pig celebrates her birthday with her family. Peppa, George and Daddy Pig prepare a wonderful birthday surprise for Mummy Pig.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E22 - The Tooth Fairy
1.plot: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E23 - The New Car
1.plot: Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E24 - Treasure Hunt
1.plot: Granny and Grandpa Pig organise a treasure hunt in the garden for Peppa and George.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E25 - Not Very Well
1.plot: Peppa is ill and has red spots all over her face. Dr Brown Bear tells her she will be fine but she must stay in bed.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E26 - Snow
1.plot: Peppa and George go outside to play in the snow.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E27 - Windy Castle
1.plot: Peppa and her family go to Windy Castle, and when they get there, they see Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's house.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E28 - My Cousin Chloé
1.plot: Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E29 - Pancakes
1.plot: The cheeky piglet and her brother George discover how worms in Grandpa's compost heap transform vegetable peelings into fertiliser to help Granny's plants grow strong.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E30 - Babysitting
1.plot: Mummy and Daddy Pig go out for the evening, leaving Granny and Grandpa Pig to babysit an excitable Peppa and George.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E31 - Ballet Lesson
1.plot: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E32 - Thunderstorm
1.plot: Peppa and George get caught in a thunderstorm.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E33 - Cleaning The Car
1.plot: Daddy Pig is taking everyone for a drive in the country, but the car is very muddy and Mummy insists they wash it first.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E34 - Lunch
1.plot: When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E35 - Camping
1.plot: Peppa and family go camping, but soon realise that their tent is too small for everyone to fit in.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E36 - The Sleepy Princess
1.plot: It's bedtime but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur!

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E37 - The Tree House
1.plot: Grandpa Pig has a surprise for Peppa and George - a beautiful tree house in his garden.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E38 - Fancy Dress Party
1.plot: Peppa and George have a fancy dress party and all their friends are invited. Peppa dresses as a fairy princess and George as a scary dinosaur.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E39 - The Museum
1.plot: Peppa and her family visit the museum. Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E40 - Very Hot Day
1.plot: Daddy teaches the children how to play basketball, and it is not long before they are good enough to take on a team.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E41 - Chloe's Puppet Show
1.plot: Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E42 - Daddy Gets Fit
1.plot: Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E43 - Tidying Up
1.plot: Peppa and George are told to tidy their room, because it is so messy.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E44 - The Playground
1.plot: Peppa and George go to the playground, and Peppa's friends are also there.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E45 - Daddy Puts Up a Picture
1.plot: Daddy Pig decides to put up a picture of Peppa and George on the wall, but accidentally cracks the wall while doing it.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E46 - At The Beach
1.plot: Peppa and her family go to the beach, and they do lots of things there.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E47 - Mister Skinnylegs
1.plot: George finds a spider in the bathroom sink, and when Peppa sees it, she screams and runs downstairs to tell Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E48 - Grandpa Pig's Boat
1.plot: Peppa and George go for a ride in Grandpa Pig's boat, but Grandpa Pig and Grandpa Dog get into a fight.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E49 - Shopping
1.plot: Peppa and her family go to the shops for some tomatoes, spaghetti, onions and fruit, but Daddy Pig gets some chocolate cake too.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E50 - My Birthday Party
1.plot: It's Peppa Pig's birthday today. Peppa wakes up very early so she doesn't waste any of her special day.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E51 - Daddy's Movie Camera
1.plot: Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera, but has some difficulties with it.

1.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S01E52 - School Play
1.plot: Peppa and her friends take part in a school play.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E01 - Bubbles
2.plot: Peppa and George have fun blowing bubbles. When the mixture is used up, Daddy Pig makes his own.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E02 - Emily Elephant
2.plot: A new child visits the playgroup, and is a bit shy. Her name is Emily Elephant.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E03 - Polly's Holiday
2.plot: Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay. Peppa and George love her but Polly flies away. Can George get her back?

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E04 - Teddy's Day Out
2.plot: Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra. But when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E05 - Mysteries
2.plot: Inspired by their favourite television programme, Peppa and George want to be famous detectives too. Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E06 - George's Friend
2.plot: Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E07 - Mr Scarecrow
2.plot: Peppa and George help Grandpa Pig to make a scarecrow to stop the birds eating the flower seeds.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E08 - Windy Autumn Day
2.plot: It is a cold and windy day so Peppa, George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig wear their hats and scarves and coats to the park.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E09 - The Time Capsule
2.plot: Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule. They discover that their parents made a time capsule many years ago.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E10 - Rock Pools
2.plot: Peppa and George are at the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig. Peppa rescues a little fish and puts it back in the sea.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E11 - Recycling
2.plot: Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E12 - The Boat Pond
2.plot: Peppa, her family and friends are playing at the pond with their toy boats. Everyone has a boat to play with except Rebecca Rabbit.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E13 - Traffic Jam
2.plot: Granny and Grandpa Pig have invited Peppa and her family to lunch. On the way, Peppa's family get caught in a very long traffic jam.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E14 - Bedtime
2.plot: It's nearly time for bed. Peppa and George play outside then they are called in for their bath.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E15 - Sports Day
2.plot: It is Sports Day at Peppa's playgroup and lots of special events are due to take place.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E16 - The Eye Test
2.plot: Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses. Peppa thinks she might need glasses too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E17 - Granddad Dog's Garage
2.plot: Daddy Pig's car runs out of petrol but Granddad Dog's garage is not far away. With one phone call, Granddad Dog is on his way.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E18 - Foggy Day
2.plot: Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are taking Peppa and George to play in the playground when it suddenly gets so foggy they can't see anything.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E19 - Jumble Sale
2.plot: Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E20 - Swimming
2.plot: Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E21 - Tiny Creatures
2.plot: Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail. Then Grandpa also shows them his beehive.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E22 - Daddy Pig's Office
2.plot: Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E23 - Pirate Island
2.plot: Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure and they all build a big sandcastle.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E24 - George Catches A Cold
2.plot: Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining - but when George takes off his rain hat, he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E25 - The Balloon Ride
2.plot: Peppa and her family are at the school fete where the top prize in the raffle is a trip in a hot air balloon.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E26 - George's Birthday
2.plot: Today is George's birthday and Mummy and Daddy Pig have a special day planned. George gets a new Brontosaurus toy and the family go to the museum to see lots of different dinosaurs, including a robot dinosaur that actually moves and roars! The special day ends with a big cake and all of Peppa and George's friends having fun together.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E27 - The Long Grass
2.plot: The grass has grown so long that Peppa and George's ball gets lost in it. It falls to Grandpa to save the day with Betsy, his motorised lawnmower.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E28 - Zoe Zebra The Postman's Daughter
2.plot: Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George - an invitation to her birthday party.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E29 - Painting
2.plot: Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint - and all over their masterpiece.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E30 - Cuckoo Clock
2.plot: Daddy Pig winds up the old cuckoo clock in Peppa and George's bedroom. When the clock strikes the hour, a wooden bird pops out, flapping its wings and singing 'Cuckoo!'.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E31 - The Baby Piggy
2.plot: Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother, Alexander, for the first time.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E32 - Grandpa's Little Train
2.plot: Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude. When he takes Peppa and George for a ride on Gertrude, they meet their friends along the way. There is plenty of room on the train for everyone, so they all hop aboard. Peppa and George think that Gertrude is the very best train in the whole world!

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E33 - The Cycle Ride
2.plot: Peppa and her family go for a day's cycle ride. Peppa rides her little bicycle, while Mummy and Daddy Pig ride their tandem with George on the back. Peppa loves cycling downhill but is not so keen on peddling uphill, so she insists they should have a downhill race.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E34 - Ice Skating
2.plot: Peppa and George go ice skating, but they have never been before and Peppa keeps falling over.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E35 - The Dentist
2.plot: When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white - but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth-clean.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E36 - Dens
2.plot: Peppa decides that only girls can play in her treehouse, so Grandpa Pig builds the boys their own den. But when it starts to rain, the boys and girls rush out to play together in the muddy puddles.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E37 - Pretend Friend
2.plot: Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa cannot see Leo but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and he likes playing dressing up. Peppa decides that now she can see Leo. Even Mummy and Daddy Pig play along with the game. But Peppa's little brother George cannot see Leo and feels a bit left out.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E38 - School Bus Trip
2.plot: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E39 - Rebecca Rabbit
2.plot: Peppa and George go to Rebecca Rabbit's house where, instead of stairs and corridors, there are tunnels!

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E40 - Nature Trail
2.plot: Peppa and her family follow a nature trail in the countryside, discovering footprints left by little birds and ants.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E41 - Pen Pal
2.plot: Peppa has a new pen pal, a little donkey from France, named Delphine. Peppa receives letters from Delphine Donkey and speaks to her on the telephone. Although Peppa speaks English and Delphine speaks French, they discover that they love lots of the same things, especially jumping up and down in muddy puddles.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E42 - Granny & Grandpa's Attic
2.plot: Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out, because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything. Amongst the clutter, Peppa finds an old record player and some funny old records. The record player still works and soon everyone is dancing.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E43 - The Quarrel
2.plot: Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends. But one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends anymore. As time goes by they really miss each other but still they refuse to make up. Will they ever say sorry?

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E44 - The Toy Cupboard
2.plot: Peppa and George's toy basket is full and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat pack furniture.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E45 - School Camp
2.plot: Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E46 - Captain Daddy Pig
2.plot: Peppa and her family borrow Grandpa Pig's boat and head out for a day on the river. All is going well until the boat gets stuck in some long reeds - Daddy Pig to the rescue!

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E47 - The Powercut
2.plot: It is evening. Peppa and George are in the sitting room dancing to their favourite song.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E48 - Bouncy Ball
2.plot: Peppa and George are playing in the garden with their bouncy ball when Suzy Sheep turns up with two tennis rackets. She uses the bouncy ball to play a game of tennis with Peppa, making George feel left out. Will the job of ball boy cheer him up?

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E49 - Stars
2.plot: It is night time and the sky is fall of shining stars. Mummy and Daddy Pig let Peppa and George put their coats on over their pyjamas and go outside to look at the stars. With the help of a telescope, Daddy Pig teaches Peppa and George how to find the North Star.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E50 - Daddy Pig's Birthday
2.plot: Today is Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work. While he is away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E51 - Sleepover
2.plot: When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.

2.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S02E52 - Cold Winter Day
2.plot: It is a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play. All the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E01 - Work and Play
3.plot: When Peppa and Suzy learn that grown ups must work all day, they decide to play at working in a shop. But they quickly find it is very tiring!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E02 - The Rainbow
3.plot: Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E03 - Pedro's Cough
3.plot: Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E04 - The Library
3.plot: Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E05 - The Camper Van
3.plot: Peppa and her family go on holiday in a special van.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E06 - Camping Holiday
3.plot: Peppa and her family are on holiday in their special camper van. They decide to go to Duck Land, a park where they can see the ducks in the river.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E07 - Compost
3.plot: The cheeky piglet and her brother George discover how worms in Grandpa's compost heap transform vegetable peelings into fertiliser to help Granny's plants grow strong.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E08 - Richard Rabbit Comes to Play
3.plot: Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. They all end up jumping up and down in muddy puddles.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E09 - Fun Run
3.plot: Daddy Pig finds it hard work when he runs a race to raise money for the school roof. It is far easier to run when a wasp is chasing him.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E10 - Washing
3.plot: Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E11 - Polly's Boat Trip
3.plot: Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E12 - Delphine Donkey
3.plot: Peppa teaches her French friend Delphine a song when she comes to stay.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E13 - The Fire Engine
3.plot: Peppa and George go to the fire station to see Miss Rabbit's fire engine.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E14 - Princess Peppa
3.plot: Granny and Grandpa Pig come for a dinner party with Mummy and Daddy Pig. Peppa and George are too tired to go to bed, until they are told a story.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E15 - Teddy Playgroup
3.plot: Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E16 - Danny's Pirate Party
3.plot: It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E17 - Mr Potato Comes To Town
3.plot: All the people in Peppa's town are excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E18 - The Train Ride
3.plot: Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride, where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E19 - Granny Pig's Chickens
3.plot: Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E20 - Talent Day
3.plot: It is Talent Day at Peppa's playgroup. Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E21 - A Trip To The Moon
3.plot: Peppa's family go to the museum's moon exhibition with George's friend Edmond Elephant.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E22 - Grandpa At The Playground
3.plot: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa and George to the playground, but does not understand the children's rules.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E23 - Goldie The Fish
3.plot: Goldie the fish does not look happy and is not eating her food, so Peppa, George and Mummy Pig take her on a bus trip to visit Dr Hamster the vet.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E24 - Funfair
3.plot: Peppa and her family go to a funfair, but Mummy Pig is told she will not be able to win prizes in any of the competitions.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E25 - Numbers
3.plot: Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E26 - Digging Up The Road
3.plot: Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E27 - Freddy Fox
3.plot: Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E28 - Whistling
3.plot: Peppa tries to learn how to whistle after she realises that seemingly everyone but her can do it.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E29 - Doctor Hamster's Tortoise
3.plot: Doctor Hamster the vet comes to Peppa's playgroup to show the children her pets.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E30 - Sun, Sea and Snow
3.plot: Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E31 - Grandpa Pig's Computer
3.plot: Mummy Pig gives her old PC to Granny and Grandpa Pig. Will the elderly hogs be able to use it?

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E32 - Hospital
3.plot: Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E33 - Spring
3.plot: Grandpa Pig organises a chocolate egg hunt for Peppa and her friends. Will the piglets track down the treats?

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E34 - Miss Rabbit's Helicopter
3.plot: Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and her family for a ride in her rescue helicopter.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E35 - Baby Alexander
3.plot: Baby Alexander is too young to talk, until Peppa teaches him his first word.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E36 - Grampy Rabbit's Lighthouse
3.plot: Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E37 - Miss Rabbit's Day Off
3.plot: Miss Rabbit has hurt her ankle, so her sister and her friends offer to fill in for her at the ice cream stand, the supermarket - and everywhere else she works!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E38 - The Secret Club
3.plot: Suzy and Peppa start a secret club, but soon everyone wants to join!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E39 - Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard
3.plot: Grandpa Pig goes to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard to have his boat fixed.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E40 - Shake, Rattle and Bang
3.plot: Madame Gazelle brings lots of musical instruments into playgroup for the children.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E41 - Champion Daddy Pig
3.plot: Daddy Pig loses his title as champion puddle jumper.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E42 - Chatterbox
3.plot: Peppa tries to prove to Suzy Sheep that she is not a chatterbox.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E43 - Mr Fox's Van
3.plot: When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Mr Fox has everything in his van - even a chicken!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E44 - Chloe's Big Friends
3.plot: Peppa and George go to play with their cousin Chloe and her friends, but the older children don't want to play any childish games.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E45 - Gym Class
3.plot: Madame Gazelle takes the children to Grampy Rabbit's gym class, where they learn how to be real explorers.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E46 - The Blackberry Bush
3.plot: Peppa and her family collect apples and blackberries in Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden so that they can make a pie.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E47 - Pottery
3.plot: Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E48 - Paper Aeroplanes
3.plot: Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing - because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E49 - Edmond Elephant's Birthday
3.plot: Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they expected.

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E50 - The Biggest Muddy Puddle in the World
3.plot: Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island!

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E51 - Santa's Grotto
3.plot: Peppa and George pay a visit to Father Christmas. Peppa asks for a very special doll as a present, but will Santa be able to deliver it to her?

3.title: FR - Peppa Pig - S03E52 - Santa's Visit
