meta.plot: The coming-of-age story of basketball prodigy twins Filthy (aka Josh) and JB who learn that even though they have so much that binds them together growing up is all about discovering what makes us unique.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E01 - X's & O's
1.plot: Filthy and J.B. are superstars on the Hughes middle school basketball team, but find themselves drifting apart when J.B starts pursuing other interests. Chuck suffers an attack on the court and is taken to the hospital, leading to questions about his health and ability to coach. When a new girl arrives at Hughes, Filthy falls head over heels in love—only to see his brother make the first move.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E02 - The Cold Streak
1.plot: The Langston Lions are cursed with an epic losing streak. To make things worse, Filthy's long-time rival, Zuma, has been talking smack about his game performance on social media. Convinced that Voodoo is the solution for it all, Filthy travels to Congo Square with Maya, Vondie, and J.B. for answers—only to learn that there's no shortcut to winning and believing in yourself.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E03 - One-on-One
1.plot: It's Harlem Renaissance dance night at Hughes, and expectations are sky-high. Filthy's determined to make his last middle school dance a hit, but JB wants to dance away his problems—like an overdue essay he lied about writing. But even the best laid plans go awry when a thunderstorm hits, tensions between the twins rise to a boiling point, and family secrets are forced to come into the light.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E04 - Time Out
1.plot: In a bid to secure his spot at ultra-competitive Beacon Academy, Filthy takes up an invite from one of their most respected ballers to their Friday night hang spot—The Wheel House skating rink. A jealous J.B. loses his cool when their Beacon hits on Alexis. To avenge his brother, Filthy intervenes, which leads to an ugly public altercation.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E05 - Huddle Up
1.plot: A surprise visit from Grandma Barbara and Chuck's childhood best friend, Skinny sets the Bells on the right path. After a tense family game, Filthy and J.B. finally come to a truce. Chuck is inspired to make a call to someone he hasn't spoken to in years in a last-chance attempt to cure his disease. Crystal learns that a video of the kids' fight at the roller ink is making the rounds at school.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E06 - Full Court Press
1.plot: After the hijinks at The Wheel House, Filthy's status in school has elevated. Crystal is left to pick up the pieces after the school administration—and a parent from Beacon Academy—pressure her to remedy the situation, and fast. As principal and mom, she's forced to make a tough decision that Filthy can't fully accept.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E07 - Clutch
1.plot: Filthy, devastated by his suspension from the team, struggles to find meaning in his life without basketball. He seeks advice from a few unlikely sources, ultimately diving deeper into his love of language and poetry. He surfaces with an inspired speech to rally the team for the upcoming City Championship. Crystal has a secret meeting that may change Chuck's life—for better or worse.

1.title: EN - The Crossover - S01E08 - Rebound
1.plot: At the City Championship game against Lakeside, an unexpected family reunion sets the Bell family on a hopeful new trajectory. Filthy tries to reveal his feelings to Maya, but it may be too late. J.B. learns the devastating reason Alexis has been avoiding him. The Crew says their goodbyes to Hughes. Chuck must make a difficult choice that disrupts J.B. and Filthy's futures.

meta.plot: Skeptics and others discuss widely held conspiracy theories involving aliens, government cover-ups, secret assassinations and other intrigues.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Death of Hitler
1.plot: The first edition looks at unusual beliefs concerning the Nazis, including the idea that Adolf Hitler escaped death in 1945 and left the corpse of a double behind to fool the rest of the world. Plus, theories surrounding the whereabouts of gold looted by the Nazis and never seen again

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Nazi King
1.plot: The British Royal Family may have changed its name from Saxe-Coburg-Gotha to Windsor but some believe they didn't lose their allegiance to Germany. Was Edward VIII a Nazi sympathizer? Did his brother try to negotiate peace with Germany?

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Cold War Files
1.plot: Reinhard Gehlen was the head of Nazi Germany's intelligence operation against the Soviets. That made him invaluable to the West during the Cold War, but did he simply tell his new allies what they wanted to hear, fueling the arms race?

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Lord Lucan Dossier
1.plot: The case of John Bingham, 7th Earl of Lucan, who disappeared in November 1974, coinciding with the murder of his children's nanny Sandra Rivett. Lucan was never caught or tried for the crime, but in the four decades since he fled numerous sightings have been reported of him from around the world. Some people believe he escaped justice, while others think he too was later murdered. Other cases considered include the kidnapping and murder of aviator Charles Lindbergh's baby son in 1927 and the disappearance of American union leader Jimmy Hoffa in an act some people claim was a mob-sanctioned hit

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Hollywood Files
1.plot: Tinsel Town has always been a place where bad things are covered up, including the gruesome murder of Elisabeth Short aka the Black Dahlia, and the deaths of both Bruce Lee and his son Brandon.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Alien Files
1.plot: Did you know that alleged UFO sightings are as numerous in the UK as in the USA? This programme looks at three such cases from 1979 to the present day, including the only alien abduction actually investigated by the police, an incident regarded by many as the British Roswell, and claims that scientists at the European Space Agency are spending billions on making actual physical contact with extraterrestrials aboard a spacecraft with whom they have been communicating for the past 20 years.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Murder At The Vatican
1.plot: Documentary series that puts the world's biggest conspiracy theories under the spotlight. Is it possible that a future pope turned a blind eye to Nazi war criminals escaping to South America after the war? Is there any truth in the theory that a Vatican insider poisoned Pope John Paul I? Was the KGB really behind the attempt to assassinate Pope John Paul II in May 1981? And was Roberto Calvi killed because he had helped the Mafia to launder money through the Vatican bank?

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The CIA Kennedy Killing
1.plot: Perhaps the most famous assassination in modern times is that of President John F Kennedy. But there are those who claim that the murder of his brother Robert six years later was the next chapter of that chilling story. Although Bobby's assassin Sirhan Sirhan has spent almost 50 years in jail for the crime, Conspiracy reveals a theory which speculates that Sirhan was a pawn of the CIA - brainwashed like the character in 'The Manchurian Candidate'.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Faking the Moon Landings
1.plot: Bart Sibrel and journalist Marcus Allen claim to have evidence that proves that the American moon landings in the late 1960s and 70s were faked. Gary McKinnon, who hacked into the Pentagon computers in 2002, claims that he found information about a secret US space fleet in orbit and powered by alien technology.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Pearl Harbor Cover-Up
1.plot: There are claims that some governments have deliberately sacrificed their own people for political gain, including the landing of a British Airways passenger jet in Kuwait two hours after the Iraqi invasion of 1990, the Omagh bomb of August 1998, the attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941 and the 1951 outbreak of mass hallucinations in the small town of Pont-Saint-Esprit in southern France.

1.title: EN - Conspiracy [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Drugs, Pop, Punk and Death
1.plot: The Rolling Stones were jailed for drugs - was it a deliberate plot? The Sex Pistols never hit number one - were the charts rigged?

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E10 - Czeslaw Meyer is Forced to Rework His Tremble-Before-the-Specter-of-Immortals Strategy
1.plot: Newfoundland 1931, Senator Beriam goes to see Huey Laforet in prison, to inform him of the situation that is happening on board the Flying Pussyfoot but Huey seems to understand the situation seeing how his daughter Chane is there. Meanwhile Czeslaw is trying to make a deal with Ladd, in order for him to find an Immortal but Ladd declines. 1932 in New York, Eve escapes from Gustavo's clutches and is picked up by Elean from the Daily Days. She then tells him to go to the Gandor headquarters in order to get some info on her brother Dallas. In 1930, Isaac and Miria are plotting their next robbery when they see Dallas carrying the box of elixir and steal it from him. After discovering the contents of the crate and thinking it is just alcohol, they head to the Martillo's office.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E11 - Chane Laforet Remains Silent in the Face of Two Mysterious People
1.plot: 1931 on top of the Flying Pussyfoot, Chane is fighting Ladd but is forced to run away. After discovering this Goose orders his men to kill Chane if necessary and Ladd is able find out about this, after squeezing one of their men for information. Meanwhile Czeslaw is plotting his next move when all of a sudden Claire appears before him and enacts his one form of torture. After taking care of him, Claire goes on top of the Flying Pussyfoot to greet Ladd and Chane. New York in 1930, Maiza goes to the restaurant where he discovers Szilard who is waiting for him. Szilard reveals to Maiza what he's been getting up to and what he hopes to achieve, with the Immortal Elixir. In 1932, following all the commotion; Runorata enters the Gandor's office, desiring to know Dallas's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E12 - Firo and the Three Gandor Brothers Are Felled by Assassins' Bullets
1.plot: 1932 in the Daily Days news office, Rachel continues to give her account on what she did that led up to her leg injury. After rescuing the Mary and Natalie, she moves on to the next cart to risk her life by saving Nice and Nick. 1930 in New York, Firo and Ennis are held at gun point by Dallas when all of a sudden the Gandors arrive to return Dallas the favour. During all the commotion Maiza finds an opportunity to escape and when Szilard tries to pursue him he gets hit by a car that Isaac is driving. 1931 on board the Flying Pussyfoot, Claire forces Ladd to risk his life to save Lua, whilst Jacuzzi is trying save everyone on the train but gets caught in a fire-fight with Goose.

1.title: FR - Baccano! - S01E13 - Both the Immortals and Those Who Aren't Sing the Praises of Life Equally
1.plot: 1931 on top of the Flying Pussyfoot, Claire is thinking whether he should kill or not kill Chane but instead comes out and proposes to her. Meanwhile Jacuzzi is having a stand off with Goose when he finally gets an opportunity to use the gift Nice gave him early. Isaac and Miria are also on the train roof when they see something coming towards Czeslaw and try to protect him thinking it's the Rail Tracer. New York in 1930, Ennis betrays Szilard and just when he is about to finish Ennis off all the guys who were shot early, including Firo, suddenly emerge. It is time for Szilard to receive his retribution. New York in 2001, Isaac and Miria are up to their usual mishaps.

meta.plot: During the early 1930s in Chicago, the transcontinental train, Flying Pussyfoot, is starting its legendary journey that will leave a trail of blood all over the country. At the same time in New York, the ambitious scientist Szilard and his unwilling aide Ennis are looking for missing bottles of the immortality elixir. In addition, a war between the mafia groups is getting worse. On board the Advena Avis, in 1711, alchemists are about to learn the price of immortality. Takes place in the same universe as Durarara (2010).

Après s'être ignorés pendant 10 ans, Balthazar Picsou se réconcilie avec son neveu Donald Duck qui lui demande de surveiller ses trois neveux Riri, Fifi et Loulou. L'arrivée des trois jeunes canards réveille l'esprit d'aventures du multi-milliardaire qui décide de reprendre ses quêtes de trésors perdus, pendant que les trois garçons, avec l'aide de Zaza, la petite-fille de la gouvernante de Picsou, vont découvrir les raisons de la longue dispute entre Picsou et Donald.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E01 - Woo-oo!
1.plot: Donald Duck reluctantly takes his nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie to the home of their reclusive great-uncle Scrooge McDuck. Enthralled by their once legendary great-uncle and the wonder of McDuck Manor, the triplets and their newfound fierce friend Webby learn of long-kept family secrets and unleash totems from Scrooge's epic past, sending the family on an adventure of a lifetime to the Lost City of Atlantis.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E02 - Daytrip of Doom!
1.plot: The nephews take Webby to Funso's Fun Zone and have a dangerous run-in with the Beagle Boys.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E03 - The Great Dime Chase!
1.plot: Louie accidentally spends Scrooge's Number One Dime and turns to mad inventor Gyro Gearloose for help to get it back, while Dewey and Webby become entangled in a conspiracy.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E04 - The Beagle Birthday Massacre!
1.plot: After crashing Ma Beagle's birthday party, Webby and new mysterious friend Lena must fight their way through Beagle Boy turf to get back home.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E05 - Terror of the Terra-Firmians!
1.plot: Huey and Webby's disagreement over the existence of a mythic species leads the kids to explore an eerie abandoned subway tunnel, while Mrs. Beakley grows suspicious of Lena.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E06 - The House of the Lucky Gander!
1.plot: Donald competes with his cousin Gladstone Gander to impress Louie at a mysterious resort in Macaw, while Scrooge tries to lure the kids away from the resort’s endless distractions.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E07 - The Infernal Internship of Mark Beaks!
1.plot: Huey competes with Dewey for a coveted internship with Duckburg's newest tech billionaire, Mark Beaks, while Scrooge and Glomgold team up to take this new competitor down.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E08 - The Living Mummies of Toth-Ra!
1.plot: In a lost pyramid, Louie interprets a pharaoh's prophecy to his advantage, forcing Scrooge and Launchpad to convince a group of living mummies to rescue him.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E09 - The Impossible Summit of Mt. Neverrest
1.plot: Scrooge and Huey are determined to be the first to set foot atop an impossible summit, but the snow-capped mountain holds a treacherous secret that tests both their commitment and survival.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E10 - The Spear of Selene!
1.plot: Donald is dragged into a feud between Scrooge and Zeus, while Dewey and Webby search for an artifact that may provide the truth about Dewey’s mother.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E11 - Beware the B.U.D.D.Y. System!
1.plot: Brilliant young scientist Fenton Crackshell-Cabrera is recruited by Launchpad who is feeling menaced by tech genius Mark Beaks’ newest invention.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E12 - The Missing Links of Moorshire!
1.plot: Dewey’s natural golf abilities challenge Scrooge’s ego while, a seemingly innocent, mystical golf course leads the group into trouble.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E13 - McMystery at McDuck McManor!
1.plot: When Scrooge unexpectedly disappears during his birthday party, Huey, Dewey and Louie find themselves hosting a mystery party where everyone is a suspect.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E14 - JAW$!
1.plot: The kids and Launchpad work together to capture a mystical money shark while Scrooge attempts to better his public image with a televised interview.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E15 - The Golden Lagoon of White Agony Plains!
1.plot: Scrooge reteams with his conniving ex-partner and old flame, Goldie O’ Gilt, to find a long-lost golden lagoon, but Glomgold has other plans.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E16 - Day of the Only Child!
1.plot: When Dewey invents a holiday that allows the triplets to be only children for a day, each realizes they need their brothers more than they thought.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E17 - From the Confidential Casefiles of Agent 22!
1.plot: Webby learns how Scrooge and Mrs. Beakley first met while she helps Scrooge rescue her granny from the clutches of rival spy Black Heron.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E18 - Who is Gizmoduck?!
1.plot: As Fenton figures out how to be a hero, Mark Beaks offers to hire Gizmoduck and help him defend all of Duckburg.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E19 - The Other Bin of Scrooge McDuck!
1.plot: Lena’s loyalties are tested when Magica forces her to lead Webby on a raid to a facility full of Scrooge’s most dangerous artifacts to find his #1 Dime.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E20 - Sky Pirates...In the Sky!
1.plot: Feeling ignored, Dewey finds a new family: a band of singing and dancing pirates looking to rob Scrooge blind.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E21 - The Secret(s) of Castle McDuck!
1.plot: On a family trip to Scrooge’s ancestral castle, Dewey tries to hide the truth about his mom as his brothers search for family secrets.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E22 - The Last Crash of the Sunchaser!
1.plot: Stuck on a precarious peak, the kids secretly search the plane for the final clue about Della’s mysterious disappearance.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E23 - The Shadow War
1.plot: Magica De Spell is close to exacting revenge on Scrooge, so the family races against time to plan a dangerous rescue mission to save Scrooge and the city.

1.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S01E24 -

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E01 - The Most Dangerous Game...Night!
2.plot: A game night is anything but relaxing as the family faces shrink rays, a barbaric civilization and an unhealthy level of competitiveness.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E02 - The Depths of Cousin Fethry!
2.plot: Huey and Dewey are led on an adventure by their distant Uncle Fethry, who takes them to the depths of Scrooge’s deep‐sea laboratory.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E03 - The Ballad of Duke Baloney!
2.plot: After his disappearance, Glomgold resurfaces as anything but his ever-scheming self, while Webby and Louie try to uncover the truth behind who is Duke Baloney.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E04 - The Town Where Everyone Was Nice!
2.plot: The family visits a Brazilian town with a dark secret where Donald reunites with his old friends Jose Carioca & Panchito Pistoles, thus reuniting The Three Caballeros.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E05 - Storkules in Duckburg!
2.plot: Louie recruits Storkules for his professional monster extermination business, while Storkules faces his greatest challenge: being Donald’s roommate.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E06 - Last Christmas!
2.plot: Scrooge avoids the pressures of the holidays by traveling back in time with a trio of fun-loving ghosts to crash history's greatest Christmas parties; time-lost Dewey teams up with young Donald Duck to find his mother on Christmas.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E07 - What Ever Happened to Della Duck?!
2.plot: Della struggles for survival against dangerous elements of the Moon, as she looks for a way to get back to her family on Earth.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E08 - Treasure of the Found Lamp!
2.plot: As the boys track a missing artifact across Duckburg, Scrooge and Webby stall the warrior looking for it with a phony quest.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E09 - The Outlaw Scrooge McDuck!
2.plot: In the Old West, Scrooge and Goldie form a band of outlaws and stage a heist to save a small town from corrupt businessman John D. Rockerduck.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E10 - The 87 Cent Solution!
2.plot: The kids must stop Scrooge’s unhealthy obsession with a few missing coins to keep him from becoming the next Glomgold.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E11 - The Golden Spear!
2.plot: As Della rebuilds her ship, Penumbra becomes convinced Della’s planning an attack. Meanwhile, Donald’s nap keeps getting interrupted by adventure.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E12 - Nothing Can Stop Della Duck!
2.plot: Della Duck has faced every danger the moon has to offer to reunite with her family, but her greatest challenge is one she might not be able to fight her way out of.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E13 - Raiders of the Doomsday Vault!
2.plot: Dewey tries to prove himself by exploring a frozen fortress in search of a money tree seed, but Glomgold has kidnapped Scrooge in order to find it first.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E14 - Friendship Hates Magic!
2.plot: Stuck as a shadow, Lena tries to protect Webby from her suspicious new friend Violet during a supernatural Sleepover.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E15 - The Dangerous Chemistry of Gandra Dee!
2.plot: With Huey’s and Webby’s help, Fenton woos a punk-rock scientist, Gandra Dee, only to uncover her dangerous plans for Gizmoduck.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E16 - The Duck Knight Returns!
2.plot: After he and Dewey meet Darkwing Duck's original actor Jim Starling and then find out that Scrooge intend to make a gritty movie about Darkwing Duck with a new actor, both Launchpad and Jim are against it.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E17 - What Ever Happened to Donald Duck?!
2.plot: Donald and Penumbra must break out of a Moon Prison and send a warning to Earth about a looming invasion. Meanwhile, Dewey and Webby uncover a sinister conspiracy targeting their family.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E18 - Happy Birthday, Doofus Drake!
2.plot: Louie teams with Goldie to scam their way through Doofus' dangerous party. Huey pushes himself out of his comfort zone in his favorite online game.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E19 - A Nightmare on Killmotor Hill!
2.plot: The kids are pulled into a world made of their wildest dreams. Unfortunately, Lena’s worst nightmare comes true: Magica De Spell is back and coming to reclaim what’s hers.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E20 - The Golden Armory of Cornelius Coot!
2.plot: Webby leads the kids in a race against the Beagles to find a secret treasure while hiding a secret of her own. Della is forced to teach Launchpad how to actually fly a plane.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E21 - Timephoon!
2.plot: When Louie uses Gyro’s Time Tub to steal lost treasures from the past, a mysterious storm in the present sends all of space and time crashing down onto the mansion.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E22 - GlomTales!
2.plot: Glomgold forms his own family made of all of Scrooge’s greatest villains to defeat Scrooge’s family once and for all.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E23 - The Richest Duck in the World!
2.plot: Louie, Scrooge and Owlson must escape from an unstoppable monster cursed to hunt down and destroy the richest duck in the world.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E24 - Moonvasion!
2.plot: The moon invades Duckburg, forcing Scrooge to join forces with an unlikely ally in an effort to save the earth. Meanwhile, Della and the kids search the globe for reinforcements.

2.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S02E25 -

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E01 - Challenge of the Senior Junior Woodchucks!
3.plot: Huey races against Violet in a challenge to be named Senior Junior Woodchuck, while Scrooge and the family search for a secret Woodchuck treasure.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E02 - Quack Pack!
3.plot: The family is not quite themselves as they discover the planned family photoshoot might just be a part of a bigger “wish” gone wrong.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E03 - Double-O-Duck in You Only Crash Twice!
3.plot: A spy video game turns dangerously real as Launchpad and Dewey must stop F.O.W.L. agent Steelbeak’s plan to destroy Duckburg.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E04 - The Lost Harp of Mervana!
3.plot: The family joins a zen mermaid society to find a missing mystery, but Louie is convinced the seemingly innocent mermaids have a villainous agenda of their own.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E05 - Louie's Eleven!
3.plot: Louie plans a break-in at a high-class party hosted by Duckburg’s most popular tastemaker, Emma Glamour, so the Three Caballeros can play as Donald tries to get past the party’s no-nonsense planner, Daisy Duck.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E06 - Astro B.O.Y.D.!
3.plot: Gyro, Fenton and Huey take a malfunctioning B.O.Y.D. back to the lab where he was created in Japan, but as Huey bonds with the robot boy, a secret from Gyro’s past threatens to destroy the city and Gizmoduck.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E07 - The Rumble for Ragnarok!
3.plot: Dewey must embrace his inner heel to beat beloved Viking wrestling champ Jormungandr in a battle royale for the fate of the Earth.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E08 - The Phantom and the Sorceress
3.plot: When a mysterious magic thief arrives in Duckburg, Lena must confront her past and team with her treacherous aunt, Magica.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E09 - They Put a Moonlander on the Earth!
3.plot: Webby sets out to prove to a homesick Penumbra that Earth can be a lot of fun by riding Glomgold’s newest gift to Duckburg, the suspicious Flintferris Glomwheel.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E10 - The Trickening!
3.plot: The kids forego their usual trick-or-treat path and instead take on the most haunted house in Duckburg, while Launchpad confronts ghosts from the past.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E11 - The Forbidden Fountain of the Foreverglades!
3.plot: Scrooge and Goldie O’Gilt are turned into teenagers as they race Rockerduck to the Fountain of Youth, while the boys’ sibling rivalry uncovers danger at a spring break hotel.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E12 - Let's Get Dangerous!
3.plot: Darkwing gains an unlikely sidekick as he uncovers a dark conspiracy tied to the Missing Mysteries and one of Scrooge’s employees.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E13 - Escape from the ImpossiBin!
3.plot: With F.O.W.L. at their heels, Scrooge tests out the Money Bin’s new security system on Louie and Della, while Beakley and Webby train the others for an enemy attack.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E14 - The Split Sword of Swanstantine!
3.plot: The kids pair off to find the missing pieces of a mystical sword hidden throughout a marketplace, unless F.O.W.L. gets to them first.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E15 - New Gods on the Block!
3.plot: The kids try to prove themselves by auditioning to take Zeus' place amongst the Greek gods, while Storkules interferes with Donald and Daisy's date.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E16 - The First Adventure!
3.plot: Scrooge is forced to babysit young Donald and Della as they go on their first adventure to find a powerful artifact, unaware that Bradford is taking on this mission personally.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E17 - The Fight for Castle McDuck!
3.plot: A bitter feud between Scrooge and his sister, Matilda, spreads to the rest of the family as Phantom Blot attempts to steal a priceless artifact and destroy Castle McDuck once and for all.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E18 - How Santa Stole Christmas!
3.plot: Scrooge teams up with his archrival, Santa Claus, to save Christmas, while Webby discovers the true history behind their infamous feud.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E19 - Beaks in the Shell!
3.plot: Huey struggles to keep Fenton and Gandra’s top-secret experiment (and their relationship) hidden from the world. But, Mark Beaks is desperate for one last gizmo to steal.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E20 - The Lost Cargo of Kit Cloudkicker!
3.plot: Della, Dewey and Huey recruit a showboating pilot to take them to an island full of monsters in search of a missing mystery, unaware that Don Karnage is hot on their tails.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E21 - The Life And Crimes of Scrooge McDuck!
3.plot: Scrooge's enemies reveal a secret history to prove that he is responsible for turning them evil, forcing Louie to defend his uncle against their prosecutor, Doofus Drake.

3.title: FR - La Bande à Picsou - S03E22 - The Last Adventure!
3.plot: The future of adventuring hangs in the balance as the Duck family uncovers earth-shattering secrets in a final standoff with F.O.W.L.

meta.plot: Le Petit Nicolas est un garçon à la fois turbulent et rebelle, qui rêve de briller devant sa bande de copains, mais qui cherche en permanence à faire plaisir à ses parents et à sa maîtresse… Bon camarade, fils aimant parfois capricieux, il porte un regard étonné sur ce monde qu'il rêve, plus tard, de conquérir. Sur touche d'humour et de légèreté, Le Petit Nicolas nous laisse entrer dans son quotidien d'enfant dont le regard rendra extraordinaire les situations les plus anodines.

FR - Chuggington - S01E01 - Can't Catch Koko
1.plot: When Harrison breaks down, Koko volunteers to replace him on the night shift, but Vee insists that Wilson and Brewster go too. Koko protests that Brewster will slow them down and races off, but when Koko is stranded on her own, due to a power cut, Wilson and Brewster must find a way to rescue her.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E02 - Wilson and the Elephant
1.plot: Brewster, Koko and Wilson are taking the animals from the old Zoo to the new Zoo. Wilson is determined to get his animal transportation badge by taking Ebo the elephant safely to his new home. The naughty elephant has other ideas, however.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E03 - Clunky Wilson
1.plot: Brewster delivers some feed to the Safari Park and hurries back to practise picking up mail sacks, unaware that he has a naughty monkey stowaway on board!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E04 - Koko and the Tunnel
1.plot: The trainees are heading for a lesson with Dunbar in the training yard when an underground tunnel catches Koko's eye. She wants to explore it but Vee says she isn't ready yet. When no one is looking, Koko decides she's going to see where that tunnel goes, but ends up coming off the tracks.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E05 - Braking Brewster
1.plot: Wilson and Koko are having lots of fun racing each other until Wilson damages his bogie spring. He's scared of going to the repair shed to get it fixed, so he tries to put on a brave face and ignore the problem while delivering milk to the farmers' fair.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E06 - Hodge and the Magnet
1.plot: The trainees must learn how to do difficult emergency stops with mud, leaves and water on the rails. Wilson loves getting dirty but he'll do anything he can to avoid going through the automatic Chugwash!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E07 - Koko and the Squirrels
1.plot: Koko has her first big solo job, delivering timber to the paper mill, but she ignores Old Puffer Pete's advice to take it slow and ends up coming off the track and spilling her load!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E08 - Wilson Gets A Wash
1.plot: Mtambo is training Wilson and Brewster to help out as guides at the safari park. He tells them to pay close attention to what he tells them about the animals but, as usual, Wilson is impatient and slips away to take some children on a tour.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E09 - Brewster Goes Bananas
1.plot: The chuggers learn how to carry passengers comfortably using dummies specially made to wobble if the ride isn't smooth. When poor Wilson struggles to drive smoothly, Eddie has an idea that just might help him.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E10 - Bang Clang Wilson
1.plot: Part of the track is out and there is chaos in Chuggington! Vee needs Eddie to repair the track but he is late for work again. As Hodge prepares the magnetic crane, Wilson persuades him to do the repairs by himself.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E11 - Old Puffer Pete's Tour
1.plot: Eddie lives so far away from Chuggington that he just can't seem to get into work on time. After getting into trouble with Morgan yet again, Hodge and the trainees set out to find a new home for Eddie in Chuggington.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E12 - Late Again Eddie
1.plot: Brewster is in a hurry to get back from a job at the mountain quarry, and he doesn't believe Dunbar's lessons about braking. When his heavy load sends him downhill too fast, quick-thinking Wilson has to help his friend get stopped in time.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E13 - Wilson's Smooth Moves
1.plot: It is time for the annual Chugger Championship Race, and Koko is sure she can win. She spends hours practising and ends up arguing with Wilson. When Wilson breaks down during the race, Koko must choose whether to help him, or keep going and win.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E14 - Cool Wilson
1.plot: Koko is yearning for adventure and she just might get it, as today the chuggers are making deliveries out of town. Vee asks old Puffer Pete to join them and, during their travels, they come across a mysterious old track that leads to Old Chuggington, which is now a ghost town.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E15 - The Chugger Championships
1.plot: The trainees are learning how to use ice cream cars today, and the great Frostini is going to test them on their skills. When Wilson's car breaks down, Puffer Pete comes to the rescue, pulling out his old steam driven ice cream wagon.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E16 - Action Brewster
1.plot: Brewster is so excited about seeing the new Action Chugger movie, but Irving sends him to the foundry and Brewster worries he won't be back in time for the film unless he can be as speedy as his Super chugger hero.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E17 - Koko's Puppy Training
1.plot: Koko finds a lost puppy and wants to keep it. She is convinced she can look after him and practice the new task delivering newspapers, but Koko soon runs into trouble.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E18 - Zephie's Zoomaround
1.plot: Everyone loves Frostini, the cool Italian ice cream chugger. Wilson wants to be just like him, so he's especially excited to learn that Frostini needs a helper for the school holidays.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E19 - Koko on Call
1.plot: When Zephie gets lost on the way to the farm, she shouts for help but no one hears her. Morgan fits her with a siren for emergencies but Zephie can't resist setting it off at every opportunity!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E20 - Outward Bound Olwin
1.plot: Twiga the giraffe is having a baby. An excited Koko is given the important job of keeping watch overnight and fetching Doctor Gosling, the vet.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E21 - Brewster and The Dragon
1.plot: Olwin takes Brewster, Wilson and Koko on an outward bound training course, but when she treats them like babies, they hide in the Old Town. It's all fun and games until a heavy fog rolls in and the trainees realise they are trapped.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E22 - Wake Up Wilson
1.plot: A storm has left the safari park in a bit of chaos and some of the animals have escaped. Emery teases Brewster, saying one of the escapees is a dragon. The chuggers don't believe him, but when they hear a mighty roar coming from one of the tunnels, they start to think he might be right.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E23 - Brewster Knows Best
1.plot: Koko challenges Wilson to see if they can stay awake all night. When morning comes, Wilson declares himself the winner, but then he struggles to keep his eyes open whilst doing his work.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E24 - Koko Pulls It Off
1.plot: The trainees are doing a sign reading exercise and they're promised a wonderful surprise at the end. Koko and Wilson think Brewster is too slow, but Brewster's patience pays off when he meets his hero 'Action Chugger' at the ride in movie theatre.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E25 - Wilson and the Ice Cream
1.plot: Wilson is asked to take refrigerated cars to the ice cream fair, but when his hero Frostini offers him a tour of the ice cream factory, he forgets all about the important job he's supposed to be doing.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E26 - Wilson's Wacky Tour
1.plot: The trainees are taking their passenger test and Mr Simkins, from the Ministry of Chuggers, arrives to examine them. When a faulty machine startles Koko, she fails her test and is broken hearted.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E27 - Hodge's Secret
1.plot: Hodge longs to prove to Eddie that he can carry out his duties on his own. But when his attempts create all manner of confusion in the training yard, Hodge must set aside his pride and own up to his mistake.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E28 - Frostini's Fruit Fandango
1.plot: Wilson is sent to help Frostini at the ice cream factory, so that he can earn a 'helpers' badge. When he is left alone with the machinery he risks jeopardising Frostini's latest experiment.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E29 - Zephie Ace Reporter
1.plot: Zephie meets a newspaper reporter who is interviewing Morgan. She ends up with his press pass, and meets Super Chugger at his new film premiere. He has to fly off to save Old Puffer Pete and Zephie hitches a lift.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E30 - Famous Emery
1.plot: A television crew have come to make a documentary about Chuggington, and Emery is chosen to show them around the yard. He is desperate for a role in the film, but when the chance arises his cheeky sense of humour threatens to alienate him from his friends.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E31 - Watch Out Wilson
1.plot: Brewster, Koko and Wilson are training going backwards, and Wilson chooses the Fire truck. Wilson has trouble completing the task, and Harrison says to go slow. However, Wilson thinks it was the opposite and falls off the track. Morgan then fits Wilson with Wing Mirrors, and is thought off as being cool by Brewster and Koko.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E32 - Brewster's Hobby
1.plot: Brewster has a new hobby, watching people to see what strange things they do. Vee tells Brewster, Koko and Wilson to take a delivery out to the building yard, but Brewster and Wilson are arguing about who is the best at their new hobby, and forget to make the delivery.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E33 - Zephie's Monkey Business
1.plot: Vee asks for a spare engine, and Zephie arrives first. She is to take Dr Gosling on an inspection of all the animals in the Zoo. When Emery passes by, Zephie tells him what she is doing, and Emery scares her by saying the monkeys are mischievous and will steal her wipers. Zephie is upset by this and tries to stay away from the monkeys, but then wanders into the monkey enclosure and realises that the monkeys aren't as bad as Emery says. The trainees also practise using the crane cars.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E34 - Poor Old Puffer Pete
1.plot: Old Puffer Pete takes his wagon, called Terry, to Morgan to be repaired, but Zephie overhears Morgan talking to Lori and mishears him, and believes he will send Old Puffer Pete to the scrap yard. Brewster and Zephie then are busy all day doing his jobs and keeping him occupied. It is then found out that it's Terry that is going for scrap and Zephie and Brewster are relieved.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E35 - Inspector Emery
1.plot: Chuggington is getting ready for an inspection, and it's also Emery's day off; he has trouble finding things to do, so he tries helping out, but causes more problems, causing Irving to spill his load of rubbish, Dunbar to constantly re-organize the rolling stock yard, and Eddie to spill paint. Emery hides on the elevated rail station, and finds a passenger waiting, and takes her on a tour of Chuggington. She later reveals she is the inspector, thanks Emery for his honesty and passes Chuggington with flying colours.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E36 - Nurse Wilson
1.plot: The trainees are training to use the Ambulance Car, and are being taught by Nurse David. However, Dubar has been shouting to Caley previously over noise from machinery, and when he yells 'Quiet' at the trainees, he loses his voice! Wilson then decides to make Dunbar feel better.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E37 - Mtambo's Amazing Adventure
1.plot: Children's animation in which the trains talk, think and don't need drivers. Mtambo longs for adventure in his life so that he has new stories to tell.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E38 - Rock-a-Bye Chatsworth
1.plot: Chatsworth is tired after working hard, and goes to the depot to sleep. Olwen, meanwhile, is loading up at the quarry, and some rocks fall, and she runs off as she doesn't want to scratch her paintwork. She goes back to Chuggington and asks Vee for another chugger to do it instead. Vee asks Chatsworth to do it, but Harrison (followed by Wilson) has already taken a hopper to do the job, and Chatsworth does another job after Vee tells it to him. At the Quarry, Harrison bakes 'with style' and lodges rocks in his fuel filter. That night, nobody gets much sleep because of Harrison snoring. When Morgan fixes him, Vee said to Harrison that he would do their jobs while they slept.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E39 - Helpful Hodge
1.plot: Hodge and Koko challenge each other to do as many jobs as possible, with the chugger doing the most winning; however, Hodge only seems to be finding things that need fixing by Eddie that technically don't need fixing. At the end of the day, it's a draw; but Hodge magnetised Eddie's guitar, and now it's in tune; so Hodge wins!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E40 - Brewster to the Rescue
1.plot: Calley is training the Trainees for their Rescue Badge. Brewster and Zephie are practising using the crane car, and Zephie falls over, pretending to be hurt, but Brewster doesn't control the crane properly, and goes back to the depot sad. Chatsworth is on the mainline and his hopper brakes seize on a hill, and Brewster is the only one who can help - and rushes to Chatsworth's rescue with the water car.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E41 - Wilson & the Paint Wagon
1.plot: Dunbar is training the trainees to use the new Painting wagons, and Wilson can't paint properly, and accidentally paints a moustache on Dunbar! Old Puffer Pete takes him to Old Chuggington to practise. Wilson tries to find the others, but can't, so paints his shed door instead, painting a butterfly that landed on the roof. Chatsworth comes by, and says that he can't paint it. However, Chatsworth finds him something to paint - Dunbar, Koko, Wilson and Brewster on the depot wall!

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E42 - Eddie Finds Time
1.plot: The Depot Clock is broken and there is chaos in Chuggington. The Chug Scan is also broken, and Hodge is taking it to be repaired, while Eddie finds the spare cog in Old Chuggington's clock.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E43 - Mtambo's Royal Tour
1.plot: The King of Buffertonia has come to take a tour of the Safari Park; however, when the king is delayed, M'tumbo takes him on a night-time tour of the Safari Park.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E44 - Wilson & the Wild Wind
1.plot: Dunbar has a new weather training simulator, but Wilson messes with the controls and causes a massive storm which causes problems all over Chuggington.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E45 - Old Puffer Pete's Firebox
1.plot: Puffer Pete's firebox is completely worn out and he can't move without it.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E46 - Jet Pack Wilson
1.plot: The Trainees are spending the day with Action Chugger training to be rescue chuggers. He has them endurance training, cat rescuing, and lots more besides. Action Chugger is called away, and Wilson finds the jet wings which the trainees are going to practise on...

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E47 - Brewster's Little Helper
1.plot: Zephie admires the big chuggers, and wants to pull freight just like them. When she overhears Brewster being given his jobs for the day, she decides to do some of them for him, but wreaks havoc, and can't handle a van full of tiles, and crashes.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E48 - Bubbly Olwin
1.plot: A magazine photographer is coming to Chuggington to do a feature on steam trains, and Olwin is determined to look her best for her picture. But she doesn't notice when a bottle of soap for Ebo the elephant accidentally lands in her water tank.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E49 - Koko Takes Charge
1.plot: When Irving leaves Koko in charge of the recycling yard, she is keen to show how responsible she is, but she doesn't listen properly to his instructions.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E50 - Wilson's Paper Trail
1.plot: Wilson is sent to pick up a roll of special paper for the printers, but when he finds a broken pipe gushing water, he decides to play in it.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E51 - Puffer Pete's Big Show
1.plot: Old Puffer Pete has been working in Chuggington for 150 years, and the Mayor wants to commemorate his anniversary with a special show.

1.title: FR - Chuggington - S01E52 - Training Time Harrison
1.plot: Vee needs someone to pull the royal carriage for the Prince of Buffertonia and all the Chuggers race to get the job, but Harrison is first - thanks to cutting corners and going through a few red lights.

meta.plot: Koko, Brewster and Wilson are three young, adventurous trainee "chuggers", learning about working on the railway in the town of Chuggington, with the help of the railway controller, Vee, the older engines, and their human friends.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E01 - Tourist Trapped
1.plot: Twins Dipper and Mabel Pines visit their eccentric great-uncle for a summer in Gravity Falls, Oregon, where he operates the world's most bizarre museum. As soon as the twins arrive in Gravity Falls, they discover something amiss in the remote town.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E02 - The Legend of the Gobblewonker
1.plot: When Dipper and Mabel hear rumors of a sea monster that lives at the bottom of the local lake, they enlist Soos to take them on a boating expedition to prove it really does exist.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E03 - Headhunters
1.plot: When someone tampers with Mabel's life-size wax statue of Grunkle Stan, she and Dipper set out to find the culprit. Meanwhile, Grunkle Stan mourns over the loss of his wax doppelganger.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E04 - The Hand That Rocks the Mabel
1.plot: Dipper and Mabel discover that their seemingly cherubic new neighbor, Lil' Gideon, happens to be the town's adored psychic. But when Lil' Gideon guilts her into dating him, she and Dipper soon learn that his cuteness can fade all too quickly.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E05 - The Inconveniencing
1.plot: Dipper is invited by Wendy and her teen friends on a trek that leads to an abandoned convenience store that may be haunted.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E06 - Dipper vs. Manliness
1.plot: In a quest to attain manliness, Dipper ventures into the forest to battle the notorious Multi-Bear. Meanwhile, Mabel tries to teach Grunkle Stan how to be attractive to women, particularly the waitress in the local diner, Lazy Susan.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E07 - Double Dipper
1.plot: Stan throws a big weekend party to promote the Mystery Shack. Dipper makes clones of himself to impress Wendy. Mabel fights for the Party Queen title in honor of her two friends.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E08 - Irrational Treasure
1.plot: When Dipper and Mabel discover evidence that the reported town founder is a hoax, they set out to expose the historical cover-up and prove that Mabel's silliness is not a bad thing.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E09 - The Time Traveler's Pig
1.plot: Dipper wants to correct a mistake he made in the past with assistance from a time machine. Mabel is overjoyed when she wins a pet pig at a fair.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E10 - Fight Fighters
1.plot: After being challenged to a video game battle by Robbie, Dipper is shocked when his favorite playable fighter, Rumble McSkirmish, comes to life to defend him. But Dipper soon loses control over Rumble McSkirmish and has to find a way to stop him.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E11 - Little Dipper
1.plot: Dipper is self-conscious that Mabel is taller than him and seeks a magic solution. Meanwhile Lil' Gideon takes advantage of Dipper's and Mabel's height discrepancy.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E12 - Summerween
1.plot: Dipper and Mabel go trick-or-treating in the summer and encounter a candy-loving monster who threatens to devour them if they don't bring him sweet things to eat.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E13 - Boss Mabel
1.plot: Stan leaves Mabel in charge of the Mystery Shack while he is gone and the power goes to her head.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E14 - Bottomless Pit!
1.plot: While Stan, Dipper, Mabel and Soos are falling in a bottomless pit, they tell stories to pass the time.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E15 - The Deep End
1.plot: When Mabel befriends a cute merman trapped in the public pool, she's determined to help him out. Meanwhile, Dipper decides to volunteer as a lifeguard to see Wendy.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E16 - Carpet Diem
1.plot: The twins discover a hidden room inside the Mystery Shack and compete over who should have it.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E17 - Boyz Crazy
1.plot: When Mabel discovers that her favorite boy band is actually a bunch of imprisoned clones, she sets them free, only to decide on keeping them for herself. Meanwhile, Dipper is convinced that Robbie plans to brainwash Wendy with a secret message hidden inside one of his songs.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E18 - Land Before Swine
1.plot: When Waddles is snatched by a prehistoric beast, Dipper, Mabel, Stan, Soos, and Old Man McGucket must journey to a mysterious land trapped in time to rescue him.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E19 - Dreamscaperers (1)
1.plot: Dipper, Mabel, and Soos must travel through Grunkle Stan's mind to defeat a tricky dream demon summoned by Lil Gideon.

1.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S01E20 - Gideon Rises (2)
1.plot: Li'l Gideon swindles the Mystery Shack away, forcing Grunkle Stan and the kids to move in with Soos. While Stan weighs how he can still care for his grandniece and nephew, they decide to take on Gideon.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E01 - Scary-oke
2.plot: The Pines family is starting to get everything back to normal after the Lil' Gideon incident. They throw a “Mystery Shack Is Back” party, but some unwelcome guests intend to crash it.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E02 - Into the Bunker
2.plot: Dipper’s secret journal pages lead him and the gang to the author’s hidden bunker where they find themselves face-to-face with a mysterious figure from Gravity Falls’ lore.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E03 - The Golf War
2.plot: After being belittled by Pacifica one too many times, Mabel challenges her to a miniature golf-off which gets a tad out of control when some local residents offer their help.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E04 - Sock Opera
2.plot: Mabel decides to put on a sock puppet rock opera to impress a local puppeteer, but her show goes awry when Dipper's drive to uncover more of the journal's secrets leads to a supernatural disaster.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E05 - Soos and the Real Girl
2.plot: Soos needs a date for his cousin Reggie's engagement party and looks to a dating simulator game to help him talk to girls.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E06 - Little Gift Shop of Horrors
2.plot: In three separate mysterious tales, Stan is cursed by a Witch, Waddles accidentally eats a bowl of brain-enhancing jelly and builds a machine that allows him to speak, and Mabel faces her fear of claymation.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E07 - Society of the Blind Eye
2.plot: The kids, along with Old Man McGucket's help, discover there is a secret society in Gravity Falls.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E08 - Blendin's Game
2.plot: Blendin returns to face off with Dipper and Mabel in a futuristic battle that could trap them forever in time jail.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E09 - The Love God
2.plot: Mabel takes matchmaking too far when she steals a love potion from a real Love God.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E10 - Northwest Mansion Noir
2.plot: Pacifica enlists Dipper’s help to rid the Northwest Mansion of a ghost before he wreaks havoc on her fancy party.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E11 - Not What He Seems
2.plot: After agents Powers and Trigger take Stan into custody, Dipper and Mabel begin to wonder how much they actually know about their Grunkle Stan.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E12 - A Tale of Two Stans
2.plot: Cornered underneath the Mystery Shack, Stan must finally reveal the secrets of his past and his mysterious portal to Dipper and Mabel.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E13 - Dungeons, Dungeons, & More Dungeons
2.plot: Dipper finds an unlikely friend to join him with his newest obsession, a board game called “Dungeons, Dungeons & More Dungeons.”

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E14 - The Stanchurian Candidate
2.plot: When Grunkle Stan decides to run for mayor, Dipper and Mabel have their work cut out for them trying to turn their gaffe-prone uncle into the perfect candidate.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E15 - The Last Mabelcorn
2.plot: A new threat leads Mabel to venture into the enchanted realm of the unicorns. Meanwhile, Dipper learns an unexpected twist about the enigmatic Bill Cipher.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E16 - Roadside Attraction
2.plot: Grunkle Stan takes the kids with him on a road-trip to sabotage all the other tourist traps in Oregon.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E17 - Dipper and Mabel vs. the Future
2.plot: Mabel makes plans for her and Dipper's 13th birthday party; Dipper ventures below the town and discovers its most shocking secret.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E18 - Weirdmageddon Part I
2.plot: Bill has returned to take down the Pines family. But this time he has brought some of his friends with him.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E19 - Weirdmageddon 2: Escape from Reality
2.plot: Dipper, Soos and Wendy must save Mabel from a strange new world, while Bill's forces plan their next move.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E20 - Weirdmageddon 3: Take Back the Falls
2.plot: Ford discovers Bill’s true motives and a final confrontation with Bill leads to the Pines family’s ultimate fate and greatest sacrifice.

2.title: FR - Souvenirs de Gravity Falls - S02E21 -

meta.plot: Gravity Falls raconte les aventures des jumeaux Pines, Dipper le frère et Mabel sa sœur, âgés de 12 ans, dont les plans pour l'été sont anéantis lorsque leurs parents les envoient chez grand-tonton Stan à Gravity Falls.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E01 - One
1.plot: Goren and Eames are called in when a jewelry heist leaves behind three bodies. After ruling out mafia involvement, they realise that the thefts are directly connected to recent credit card thefts and stolen identities. They're led to an extremely charismatic thief, and their only hope is convincing one of his partners to turn on him.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E02 - Art
1.plot: When a museum curator and an art authenticator are found dead in what was set up to look like a murder-suicide, Goren and Eames follow the clues and realise that the deaths are linked to the sale of numerous art forgeries. Their investigation hits a dead end when they're unable to locate the forger until Goren seeks the help of another forger.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E03 - Smothered
1.plot: After the body of Lois Romney is found in a hotel room, Goren and Eames link her to Dale Van Acker, a junkie and the son of wealthy scion Priscilla Van Acker. Van Acker strongly disapproved of her son's pregnant fiancée, which leads Goren and Eames to suspect she may have wanted to get rid of the girl on a permanent basis.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E04 - The Faithful
1.plot: Goren and Eames investigate the death of church sexton Morris Abernathy but soon find their chief suspect, Kevin Donovan, dead in his apartment. After realising that someone performed last rites over Donovan's body, the police realise that a priest was involved in the murder, and are led to a priest who has been desperately trying to keep a twenty-year-old secret hidden. Goren risks the prosecution's case by protecting an innocent third party who could lose everything if their own secret comes out.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E05 - Jones
1.plot: The detectives become suspicious when an abusive lawyer's girlfriends keep turning up dead, but his wife stonewalls the investigation.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E06 - The Extra Man
1.plot: When a European con man is found beaten to death, the detectives look for the investors he swindled, learning quickly that the man also had relations with their wives.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E07 - Poison
1.plot: The detectives investigate a murderer who poisons hospital victims with cyanide. They suspect a nurse whose profile is typical, but when they discover more murders away from the hospital they have to widen their search.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E08 - The Pardoner's Tale
1.plot: The deaths of a reporter and his fiancée, gunned down on orders, leads the detectives to investigate political bribery involving the governor's office, which Deakins isn't pleased with.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E09 - The Good Doctor
1.plot: A plastic surgeon reports his drug-abusing wife missing, and ends up being the prime suspect after detectives learn he had good reason to want her out of his life.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E10 - Enemy Within
1.plot: The death of an eccentric banker in his nintieth floor apartment leads the detectives to investigate his professional contacts and family members.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E11 - The Third Horseman
1.plot: The killing of an abortion doctor who was shot in his own apartment sends the detectives on a search for the sniper before someone else becomes the next victim. Carver worries that the case will end up being all about abortion rights.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E12 - Crazy
1.plot: A psychiatrist who provides expert testimony at criminal trials lays down an insanity defense to hide his obsession for his younger girlfriend after revealing to her that he hired a corrupt detective to murder her brother-in-law at his son's Bar Mitzvah after alleged reports that her niece had been abused by him.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E13 - The Insider
1.plot: When the father of a young woman who has been out all night clubbing is found dead in his boat house, Goren and Eames investigate the mysterious club owner only to realise that he is an undercover FBI agent and that the Bureau will not risk their undercover operation even to stop a killer.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E14 - Homo Homini Lupis
1.plot: When an business executive's wife and two daughters are kidnapped for a loanshark because the loan hasn't been paid off, Goren and Eames are frustrated by the man's lack of cooperation, which stymies them further when the man's released daughter proves to have been sexually assaulted.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E15 - Semi-Professional
1.plot: The detectives investigate the murder of a judge's clerk, with their attention initially going to the judge himself, who had been having an affair with the young woman.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E16 - Phantom
1.plot: The detectives investigate a slain bank robber and check out his sister, who is involved with a bogus United Nations economist. As the detectives close in on the suspect, Goren learns the suspect wants his children's approval and must stop him before any more murders.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E17 - Seizure
1.plot: When the body of a bisexual young woman is found slain, Goren and Eames note the similarities between her death and a number of murders committed by a convicted serial killer, turning their attention to a human-behavior researcher.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E18 - Yesterday
1.plot: When the well-preserved body of a woman tortured and murdered twenty years earlier appears on the banks of the Bronx River, chemical residue on the body leads Goren and Eames to the basement of the house in which the body had originally been buried and to the junkie whose parents owned the home. When the junkie ends up murdered as well, their investigation focuses on his college classmate, a man with a history of drugging and sexually assaulting women.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E19 - Maledictus
1.plot: Goren and Eames investigate the murder of a Russian mob princess, initially believing she may have been slain in a revenge act against her father, but their attention later turns to a classmate who could be destroyed by the woman's upcoming tell-all book.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E20 - Badge
1.plot: When the murder of a city auditor and his family seems too perfect, Goren and Eames turn their attention towards law enforcement personnel after learning that the auditor was investigating a number of former cops upon suspicion of double-dipping.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E21 - Faith
1.plot: When a wealthy publisher is murdered to prevent him from exposing an elaborate confidence game that enveloped him, his company and one of his editors, Goren and Eames run their own con to extract a confession from the killer.

1.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S01E22 - Tuxedo Hill
1.plot: When Goren and Eames investigate the murder of a man linked to a corporate finance officer, they uncover a stock manipulation scheme which enriched the corporate executives by defrauding investors.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E01 - Dead
2.plot: The murder of a mortician and the discovery of corpses at a crematorium lead the detectives to a family man claiming to have a consulting business but suspected of being a contract killer with a penchant for perfection.  Goren attempts to prove this by setting up a scheme that puts his "fear of making a mistake" in jeopardy.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E02 - Bright Boy
2.plot: The double murder of a social services worker and a deputy mayor lead the detectives to suspect a couple who may have a grudge against the social worker for taking away their children.  When they learn that the social worker had taken special interest in a child prodigy being considered for admission to a prestigious, accelerated school, they examine both the boy and his obsessive father.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E03 - Anti-Thesis
2.plot: As Goren and Eames sift through the likely suspects in the murder of a university president and his assistant, they discover that the culprit is a wily adversary who has more than these crimes to hide.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E04 - Best Defense
2.plot: The detectives follow the trail when an assistant district attorney confronts and kills a hired gunman following a series of death threats. They first suspect his wife, a prominent defense attorney, through a convict whose case was being prosecuted by the A.D.A. and the rumors of her romantic affairs. When they realise that there are cracks in their seemingly airtight case, Goren has to keep Carver in the dark about some details to prove his theory.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E05 - Chinoiserie
2.plot: After a mother of two is shot dead in Chinatown, Goren and Eames first believe that her death may be connected to the Tianamen Square massacre, but then their investigation leads them to a smuggling ring dealing in antiquities.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E06 - Malignant
2.plot: A robbery that involved two fatalities leads to the discovery of a long-running case of tampering with drugs. Goren and Eames have to figure out a way of catching a pharmacist who has been diluting cancer medication without using the exhumated bodies of patients who had been given the medicine.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E07 - Tomorrow
2.plot: The detectives investigate a triple murder, including the son and daughter of a wealthy businessman, that occurred in his apartment. After investigating the childrens' stepmother (his second wife), they turn to a pair of nannies, one of whom works for the family. However, the detectives must reach back to the nannies' history as children, and a television soap opera, in order to better understand the motives for the crime.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E08 - The Pilgrim
2.plot: The detectives are called to investigate the adult daughter of a retired officer which takes them to a case of terrorism involving someone she knew that includes a shipment of explosives.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E09 - Shandeh
2.plot: The investigation into the murder of a Jewish woman turns towards her family once Goren and Eames find out about her husband's affair.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E10 - Con-Text
2.plot: Goren and Eames run a con of their own on a phony motivational speaker whom they suspect exploited a fragile disciple by convincing him to commit murder for profit.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E11 - Baggage
2.plot: When an airline baggage supervisor is found murdered in the trunk of her car, the detectives investigate the employees listed in a sexual harrassment complaint which leads them to a scam involving credit cards and credit reports with foreign links.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E12 - Suite Sorrow
2.plot: After the tyrannical owner of a Manhattan luxury hotel is found submerged in her bathtub, evidence seems increasingly to indicate that the woman's death was the work of her deeply frustrated, long-suffering daughter.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E13 - See Me
2.plot: Detectives Goren and Eames come to believe a doctor conducted shameful experiments on the residents of a halfway house.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E14 - Probability
2.plot: While probing the seemingly random murders of several homeless men, Goren and Eames uncover a scam involving a crooked insurance agent. However, an unsual twist leads the detectives to an unlikely suspect.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E15 - Monster
2.plot: The murder of a woman in her apartment results in her son, recently paroled after serving 15 years for murder, becoming the prime suspect. Having consulted with the lead detective on the old case, Goren and Eames discover he was involved in a cover-up to rush other cases to closure.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E16 - Cuba Libre
2.plot: After the trophy wife of a recently released prison inmate is murdered, Goren plays on the man's paranoia to find a connection to another inmate with a hit list.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E17 - Cold Comfort
2.plot: When a woman suing her brother over the disposition of their father's remains is found murdered, Goren and Eames discover a  concealed parentage and a man willing to go to any extremes to ensure his legacy.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E18 - Legion
2.plot: When a father and son have their throats slit, the detectives discovers that a group of adolescent boys have disappeared from the same neighborhood. When the locals don't cooperate with the investigation, the cops think the boys are being used by someone operating a bicycle theft ring. The cops are led to a studio owner who brainwashes the boys to prove their worthiness.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E19 - Cherry Red
2.plot: The detectives try to figure out a mystery after an old woman dies in a fire. The mystery gets deeper when a young woman who is left some of the old woman estate is killed. The case takes them to a state public administrator who has invented a form of grave-robbing. The detective suspects the administrator has a weakness for valuable cars, but to make his case work, he has to exploit his quarry's personal relationships.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E20 - Blink
2.plot: The detectives investigate a murder of a math student who worked in a poker club as a card-counter. Their case brings the detectives to a group of computer nerds, but later they discover a computer gambling system which has tougher suspects. The detectives discovers that even there own workstations are hit by the ringleader of the group, who had bigger plans for his horseracing and other scams.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E21 - Graansha
2.plot: Goren and Eames enter the closed world of a thieving Irish Traveller clan when they investigate the death of a Ann Lawson, a probation officer who was run over three times after meeting a friend at the bar. They soon learn that Ann, a probation officer, had been involved with Malcolm Bryce, the father of Paul, one of her charges. It appears as though Ann is also very close with the thieving Irish Travellers they are investigating, determined to save a young girl from their style of life.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E22 - Zoonotic
2.plot: The investigation into the murder of a crooked cop leads to a preening veterinarian and his friend, an obsessive doctor whose ex-girlfriends who have all been infected with a rare disease.

2.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S02E23 - A Person of Interest
2.plot: Goren and Eames investigate the murder of a former nurse and discover a possible anthrax terrorist plot. The case takes a turn for the worse when Goren is blamed for driving a suspect to commit suicide. Now disgraced, Goren learns that a cunning adversary from his past may be involved.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E01 - Undaunted Mettle
3.plot: A very pregnant Eames reveals that she has offered to be a surrogate mother and carry her sister's child; a famous architect's promiscuity becomes the key to solving the murder of a promising young designer who was his closest competitor for a prestigious commission.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E02 - Gemini
3.plot: When a schizophrenic obsessed with Marilyn Monroe and the cult of the blond and the blue-eyed commits a series of murders to eradicate those he feels are responsible for promoting the homogenization of appearance rampant in society, Goren and Eames suspect that a person close to the man may have taken advantage of his illness and his crimes to commit extortion.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E03 - The Gift
3.plot: Santeria cultists kill the son of a women that believed from them she had psychic powers.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E04 - But not Forgotten
3.plot: When a bookkeeper goes missing, Goren and Eames are led back to the death of her brother, a hitman, two years earlier. An imprisoned mobster seems to be their best bet, but when another body turns up it takes the case to a whole new level.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E05 - Pravda
3.plot: Goren gets an interim partner when Eames goes on maternity leave, and focuses his investigation of a murder on a star reporter whose past contains a history of plagarism.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E06 - Stray
3.plot: Tracking a modern-day Bonnie and Clyde, Goren deduces that one of his suspects has an injured foot. It isn't long before Goren and Bishop realise that the pair, who have already killed nine people including two undercover cops, are not the typical Bonnie and Clyde -- the female partner is obviously the one in control.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E07 - A Murderer Among Us
3.plot: The detectives try to link the suicide of an Argentine immigrant to her husband who has a history of violence.  While the subsequent investigation is not successful, they discover his hatred might be linked to a string of unsolved murders with the same MO.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E08 - Sound Bodies
3.plot: Goren and Bishop pursue a teenage Svengali who convinces three impressionable young girls to commit multiple homicides in the cause of a twisted philosophy.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E09 - Happy Family
3.plot: The bludgeoning of a rich family patriarch has the detectives investigating several suspects, each with their own motives: his estranged wife whom he was about to divorce, a male friend of hers who was a parolee, their childrens' nanny, the victim's brother in law who is a doctor, even the oldest son. Goren and Carver call the family of suspects together to sort it all out... in family court.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E10 - F.P.S.
3.plot: Goren reaches into his own experience working with a partner to solve the murder of a gamer who appears to be connected to a network of thieves using spyware to commit fraud. Eames gives birth.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E11 - Mad Hops
3.plot: The murder of a private investigator, who was tracking down the whereabouts of a prominent high school basketball player, has the detectives searching the local courts to discover a link to gamblers and college recruiters until they learn that several other prominent players were transferred to the same school - one with a championship tradition.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E12 - Unrequited
3.plot: Goren and Eames uncover how a rich woman's unrequited lust for fame and a professional fundraiser's desperation to pay off a loan shark may have contributed to the murders of the woman's husband and the fundraiser's mother.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E13 - Pas de Deux
3.plot: A terminally ill bank robber angered by the ravages of his illness exerts what little control he has left in life by manipulating the unwitting accomplices he enlists to assist him with committing his final robberies, forcing Goren and Eames into a race against time to foil his plan for a suicide-by-cop that will take both his life and that of his latest accomplice.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E14 - Mis-Labeled
3.plot: Goren and Eames stumble upon a web of corporate corruption involving fraud, bribery, identity theft, and a conspiracy to sell lethally-contaminated blood products as they investigate the murder of a pharmaceutical salesman.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E15 - Shrink-Wrapped
3.plot: The daughter of narcissistic psychotherapists takes desperate measures to exact her revenge for years of their abuse and neglect, leading to tragedy for a young man caught in the web of her parents' promiscuity, mind games and competitiveness.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E16 - The Saint
3.plot: A man commits fraud, forgery, and murder to discredit the organization that took advantage of his mentally ill mother, impoverished his family, and ruined his childhood.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E17 - Conscience
3.plot: A neurologist who believes that she can communicate with a woman in a persistent vegetative state is murdered by a family member who fears that the doctor will uncover the multi-million dollar motive which led to the woman's disability.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E18 - Ill-Bred
3.plot: A stable worker resorts to heroin smuggling, deception, extortion, and murder to finance the purchase of the farm and foundation stallion that will provide a leg up on the horse set social ladder.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E19 - Fico Di Capo
3.plot: After a protected witness is shot dead in a restaurant, Goren and Eames find themselves on the trail of a trio of young mobsters. They finally figure out that a young man named Chops is the key, but can't find anyone willing to turn on him. Goren seeks the help of a fig-loving don dying of cancer to trap Chops.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E20 - D.A.W.
3.plot: The investigation into the death of a woman searching for the whereabouts of her late mother's antique ring leads Goren and Eames to a physician serial killer who has cleverly concealed the murder of over two hundred of his patients.

3.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S03E21 - Consumed
3.plot: A police officer is framed for a triple homicide by a greedy woman who takes advantage of his sleepwalking and is enmeshed in a bitter divorce settlement and out for revenge.

4.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S04E01 - Semi-Detached
4.plot: The investigation into the deaths of a shock jock and the housekeeper who supplied the pain killers to which he was once addicted leads Goren and Eames to a detox clinic staff member whose mental illness hits Goren close to home.

4.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S04E02 - The Posthumous Collection
4.plot: The investigation into the death of a famous photographer leads to the discovery of multiple homicides committed by the collaborator on his latest project, who was attempting to exorcise demons from his past through an artistic expression the photographer soon found intolerable.

4.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S04E03 - Want
4.plot: After he gets into the head of an insane man driven to torture, murder, and cannibalism by overwhelming despair and loneliness, Goren surprises his colleagues with a passionate plea that the man be spared the death penalty, and engineers the confession that will save the man's life through a plea bargain.

4.title: FR - New York : Section criminelle - S04E04 - Great Barrier
4.plot: When Goren and Eames search for a jewel thief who murdered her accomplice, they discover that the clever larcenies are the brainchild of her lover, Nicole Wallace, Goren's long-standing nemesis. As the detectives delve into the personal and working relationships between the two women, they uncover a plot to cause the death of Wallace's ex-husband, the only person who can lead them to evidence of the very first murder Wallace committed.
