meta.plot: The Doctor and his companion travel across time and space encountering incredible friends and foes.

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - Space Babies
1.plot: Ruby learns the Doctor's amazing secrets when he takes her to the far future. There, they find a baby farm run by babies. But can they be saved from the terrifying bogeyman?

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - The Devil's Chord
1.plot: The Doctor and Ruby meet The Beatles but discover that the all-powerful Maestro is changing history. London becomes a battleground with the future of humanity at stake.

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - Boom
1.plot: Caught in the middle of a devastating war on Kastarion 3, the Doctor is trapped when he steps on a landmine. Can he save himself and Ruby, plus the entire planet... without moving?

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - 73 Yards
1.plot: Landing on the Welsh coast, the Doctor and Ruby embark on the strangest journey of their lives. In a rain-lashed pub, the locals sit in fear of ancient legends coming to life.

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - Dot and Bubble
1.plot: The world of Finetime seems happy and harmonious. But an awful terror is preying on the citizens. Can the Doctor and Ruby make them see the truth before it’s too late?

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - Rogue
1.plot: The Doctor and Ruby land in 1813, where guests at a duchess's party are being murdered and a mysterious bounty hunter called Rogue is about to change the Doctor's life forever.

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - The Legend of Ruby Sunday (1)
1.plot: The Doctor and UNIT investigate Ruby's past. But as the Time Window reveals horrifying secrets from Christmas Eve, the mysterious Triad Technology unleash the greatest evil of all.

1.title: EN - Doctor Who 2024 [Multi-Sub] - S01E08 - Empire of Death (2)
1.plot: The Doctor has lost, his ageless enemy reigns supreme, and a shadow is falling over creation. Nothing can stop the devastation... except, perhaps, one woman.

meta.plot: Miami, c'est d'un côté soleil, plage et fête, mais de l'autre, c'est drogue, corruption et autres trafics. Sonny et Ricardo sont deux policiers bien décidés à faire régner la justice dans cette ville. L'un vit sur un yacht et conduit une Ferrari, l'autre est venu de New York pour retrouver l'assassin de son frère.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E01 - Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Miami detective Sonny Crockett reluctantly teams with New York cop Rico Tubbs when both of them end up pursuing a drug dealer who killed their partners.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E02 - Heart of Darkness
1.plot: Investigating a porn baron, Crockett and Tubbs become involved with an undercover FBI agent who may have gone native and become a criminal, and may have murdered an underage porn starlet. Meanwhile, Zito and Switek pose as fences, and Elvis the crocodile feels unloved!

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E03 - Cool Runnin'
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs must enlist the help of an unreliable petty thief to bust a drug operation run by a trio of homicidal Jamaicans.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E04 - Calderone's Return: The Hit List - Part 1
1.plot: The team moves to protect Crockett and his family from an assassin, hired by Calderone to re-empty the void he left behind.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E05 - Calderone's Return: Calderone's Demise - Part 2
1.plot: While on the trail of Calderone in Bimini, Tubbs falls in love with a woman who forces him to consider his loyalties.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E06 - One Eyed Jack
1.plot: Crockett attempts to help an old flame free herself from a racketeer, then is framed for taking bribes. Martin Castillo becomes the squad's new lieutenant.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E07 - No Exit
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs reluctantly help government agents in their pursuit of a dangerous arms dealer.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E08 - The Great McCarthy
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs get involved in the world of offshore power boat racing and drug smuggling.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E09 - Glades
1.plot: Crockett & Tubbs have to recover a witness in a major drug dealer's trial, who has ran off to the Everglades and must testify in 48 hours.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E10 - Give a Little, Take a Little
1.plot: In court, Crockett refuses to identify an informant and spends more time in jail than the drug dealer he is trying to bust. Gina and Trudy infiltrate a prostitution ring. Gina is placed in a compromising position when they are suspicious that she is not a hooker.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E11 - Little Prince
1.plot: Crockett thinks that a wealthy industrialist's son nailed in a heroin bust could lead them to bigger connections in the supply network.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E12 - Milk Run
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs encounter two naive young men smuggling cocaine-filled statues for a murderous criminal.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E13 - Golden Triangle - Part 1
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs work undercover in a hotel. They uncover criminals that are an old enemies of Lt. Castillo and have also kidnapped Castillo's long-lost wife.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E14 - Golden Triangle - Part 2
1.plot: Lt. Castillo must bring down his old enemy, who has passed his organization to his grandsons. They have kidnapped Castillo's long-lost wife to ensure their escape from prosecution.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E15 - Smuggler's Blues
1.plot: Someone in law enforcement is murdering drug dealers and their families in cold blood. To find the culprit, Crockett and Tubbs go undercover and travel to Colombia with a laid-back pilot to pose as dealers.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E16 - Rites of Passage
1.plot: Sparks fly between Tubbs and an old flame who has come to Miami to rescue her sister from a life of prostitution.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E17 - The Maze
1.plot: A group of young punks kill a cop and then take hostages - including an undercover Tubbs - while negotiators try to end the situation without more bloodshed and a SWAT team closes in.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E18 - Made for Each Other
1.plot: Switek and Zito use two of their favorite informants to set up a transaction with a stolen goods dealer.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E19 - The Home Invaders
1.plot: The squad is assigned to assist Robbery with a string of brutal home invasions. Castillo is concerned the officer in charge - who was Crockett's mentor - is mishandling the investigation and the two clash, leaving Crockett torn between loyalty and a resolved case.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E20 - Nobody Lives Forever
1.plot: A passionate romance distracts Crockett to the point that it nearly derails the pursuit of three thugs on a rampage.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E21 - Evan
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs join forces with the Federal Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco and Firearms ... including Crockett's old partner Evan Freed. Tubbs tries to understand their troubled relationship.

1.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S01E22 - Lombard
1.plot: Crockett and Tubbs must protect a reluctant witness from his prior employers -- the Mafia family that wants to silence him.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E01 - The Prodigal Son (1)
2.plot: Crockett & Tubbs go to Manhattan to find a group of Colombian drug dealers who are killing federal agents.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E02 - The Prodigal Son (2)
2.plot: Crockett and Tubbs go to Manhattan to find a group of Colombian drug dealers who are killing federal agents.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E03 - Whatever Works
2.plot: Crockett, Tubbs & Castillo contact a Santerian priestess to help find the link between ritualistic killings of officers and a group of drug traffickers. Crockett and Izzy try to get the Ferrari back after a city accountant re-possesses it.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E04 - Out Where the Buses Don't Run
2.plot: Crockett and Tubbs question the sanity of a retired vice cop who wants them to chase after a coke dealer thought to be dead.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E05 - The Dutch Oven
2.plot: Trudy is torn between love and duty when she learns that her lover's friend is connected to a big-time cocaine dealer.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E06 - Buddies
2.plot: Crockett is forced to realize that an old Army buddy may be involved with a contract on a young mother's life.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E07 - Junk Love
2.plot: When Crockett and Tubbs bust the owner of a bordello (Miles Davis), they discover that one of his drug-addicted prostitutes is the object of a powerful drug dealer's twisted obsession.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E08 - Tale of the Goat
2.plot: Crockett and Tubbs escort a coffin containing a criminal to his final Miami resting place ... until its learned that he has risen from the dead and has a similar zombie fate scheduled for Tubbs.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E09 - Bushido
2.plot: Castillo is forced to choose between friendship and duty when Jack Gretsky, his best friend from his days in Vietnam with the CIA, reemerges from the criminal underground complete with a Russian wife who is being pursued by the KGB.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E10 - Bought and Paid For
2.plot: Gina's cleaning woman gets raped in Gina's home by the spoiled son of a wealthy man, who thinks he's above the law. Despite evidence being circumstantial, Gina wants to have the man arrested. Izzy steals Switek and Zito's bug van.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E11 - Back in the World
2.plot: Crockett flashes to his role during the Saigon evacuation as he and a war correspondent uncover heroin smuggled in body bags. Ten years later in Miami the H resurfaces and so does the reporter looking for the CIA connection.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E12 - Phill the Shill
2.plot: A British television personality who has dealings with a major cocaine dealer is targeted by Crockett and Tubbs.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E13 - Definitely Miami
2.plot: Crockett finds out first hand about Charlie Basset as a violent drug runner with an enticing wife that Sonny just can't get out of his mind.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E14 - Yankee Dollar
2.plot: When Crockett sees his stewardess girlfriend die from smuggling balloons of cocaine into the country, he and Tubbs go undercover to expose the ring.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E15 - One Way Ticket
2.plot: A district attorney is killed at a wedding for getting too close to a French-Canadian drug lord that's operating in Miami. Since the victim was a close friend of the criminal's lawyer, Sonny tries to make the lawyer do something about it.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E16 - Little Miss Dangerous
2.plot: Crocket and Tubbs visit Miami's kinky Sex World parlor when a sailor shows up murdered. The trail leads to a mysterious underage dancer Tubbs tries to straighten out - but is this more than social work?

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E17 - Florence, Italy
2.plot: A Grand Prix driver has a lot on his mind: first-time fatherhood, a race against his legendary dad --- and the fact that he is suspected of killing a teenage prostitute.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E18 - French Twist
2.plot: An interpol agent arouses Crockett's interest --- and Tubbs' suspicion as they search for an international drug dealing assassin.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E19 - The Fix
2.plot: A judge with heavy gambling debts tries to persuade his college all-star son to throw a game. Crockett suspects the judge let a drug dealer go free because of his money troubles.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E20 - Payback
2.plot: A reclusive drug supplier thinks Crockett has the $3 million stolen by the dealer's former employee.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E21 - Free Verse
2.plot: The team is assigned to protect a renowned poet who has come to the US seeking political asylum. With sexy Carmen in the mix, things get complicated.

2.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S02E22 - Trust Fund Pirates
2.plot: A Bolivian cruise ship is attacked by pirates leading Crockett and Tubbs to enlist the help of a renegade pilot in the contraband business to solve the case.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E01 - When Irish Eyes Are Crying
3.plot: Gina falls for an Irish pacifist who believes there is no point fighting fire with fire anymore - or so she thinks.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E02 - Stone's War
3.plot: Crockett's Vietnam journalist buddy, Ira Stone, is back--claiming to have footage of a secret U.S war in Nicaragua; the trail leads Stone, Crockett & Tubbs to Maynard a.k.a. the elusive Captain Real Estate.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E03 - Killshot
3.plot: Crockett and Tubbs are fingered as cops by a Customs agent who's being blackmailed by the drug kingpin the detectives are trying to nail.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E04 - Walk Alone
3.plot: Tubbs poses as a con to expose prison guards who are extorting drugs from inmates, and killing those who refuse.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E05 - The Good Collar
3.plot: A star high school athlete, arrested for delivering heroin, agrees to help Crockett trap a 15-year-old drug lord; it turns ugly.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E06 - Shadow in the Dark
3.plot: Crockett tries to nail a psychotic murderer by thinking like his quarry, despite the fact that another cop using that tactic wound up in a psych ward.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E07 - El Viejo
3.plot: Crockett & Tubbs keep tabs on a crusty old stranger who plans to cut a deal with a murderous Bolivian drug dealer.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E08 - Better Living Through Chemistry
3.plot: Tubbs' former partner frames him when he abducts a chemist for some drug dealers.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E09 - Baby Blues
3.plot: Unexpected contraband--babies and a stowaway mother seeking the child taken from her--puts the cops on the trail of an adoption ring.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E10 - Street Wise
3.plot: An undercover cop and his hooker lover help the detectives find the source of some pharmaceutical grade cocaine.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E11 - Forgive Us Our Debts
3.plot: New leads persuade Crockett that a man he put on death row might be innocent, but a campaign-conscious DA is reluctant to help.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E12 - Down for the Count (1)
3.plot: Zito reluctantly uses a boxer as bait to help the vice squad nail a former drug kingpin involved in bookmaking; it ends in tragedy and the loss of a comrade for the vice cops.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E13 - Down for the Count (2)
3.plot: Switek is outraged by Internal Affairs' findings; Crockett and Tubbs' TV gambit may prove fatal when a mobster reclaims the action lost to Guzman.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E14 - Cuba Libre
3.plot: Crockett & Tubbs stumble onto a plot by fanatical Cuban commandos to assassinate an important Cuban diplomat.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E15 - Duty and Honor (a.k.a. The Savage)
3.plot: Castillo is not the only one to realize that a series of prostitute murders matches the M.O. of killings in Vietnam in the early 70s; the cops get help on the case from a man claiming to be a Vietnamese inspector.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E16 - Theresa
3.plot: Crockett's romantic entanglement with a heroin-addicted doctor jeopardizes his case against a dealer.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E17 - The Afternoon Plane
3.plot: Tubbs finds out that his ""raffle prize"" --- a week in the Caribbean --- is set up by a vengeful con and the Calderones to lure him out of his jurisdiction.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E18 - Lend Me an Ear
3.plot: The electronics whiz providing Crockett & Tubbs with surveillance devices also outfits their drug-dealing quarry.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E19 - Red Tape
3.plot: Tubbs searches desperately for the source of information leaks about future busts.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E20 - By Hooker by Crook
3.plot: Crockett's latest romance with a respected businesswoman (Melanie Griffith) turns sour when it is revealed that the woman is actually a high-class madam with connections to a notorious money launderer (George Takei).

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E21 - Knock, Knock, Who's There?
3.plot: Crockett & Tubbs probe drug busts ruined by phony federal agents who disappear with the evidence.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E22 - Viking Bikers from Hell
3.plot: A motorcycle gang seeks to avenge a drug-dealing comrade's death by killing off his former customers.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E23 - Everybody's in Show Biz
3.plot: An actor/writer is in danger when he steals a drug dealer's briefcase and the vital information it contains.

3.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S03E24 - Heroes of the Revolution
3.plot: An East German spy seeks to avenge the murder of Gina's mother in Cuba 26 years earlier, and uses her to lure the killer out.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E01 - Contempt of Court
4.plot: By scaring the jury into a mistrial, a mobster hopes to buy time to find and silence the witness Crockett is protecting.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E02 - Amen... Send Money
4.plot: The fury of feuding TV evangelists hits Tubbs when he is accused raping a parishoner.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E03 - Death and the Lady
4.plot: An actress' on-screen murder propels Crockett & Tubbs to investigate the film's flaky director.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E04 - The Big Thaw
4.plot: Two factions fight for possession of a dead reggae legend's body.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E05 - Child's Play
4.plot: Crockett agonizes about shooting a child during a weapons investigation.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E06 - God's Work
4.plot: The return of a kingpin's financial wizard son sets off speculations in the Miami underworld.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E07 - Missing Hours
4.plot: A man's body disappears from the morgue. Trudy has an encounter with UFOs.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E08 - Like a Hurricane
4.plot: Crockett is assigned to guard a recording star who is a witness in a payola scandal, and ends up falling in love.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E09 - Rising Sun of Death
4.plot: An executive's murder alerts Castillo to Yakuza presence in Miami, but the arrival of a Japanese investigator is no help.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E10 - Love at First Sight
4.plot: Newlywed Caitlin fears Crockett's latest undercover assignment as bait for a killer at a dating service will make her a widow.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E11 - A Rock and a Hard Place
4.plot: Two music executives try to ruin Caitlin's comeback by exposing Crockett as drug kingpin Burnett.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E12 - The Cows of October
4.plot: A cowboy's larcenous attempt to improve his cattle attracts attention from the US government, Cuban Communists, and Izzy.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E13 - Vote of Confidence
4.plot: A prominent senatorial candidate is arrested during a raid of a mobile whorehouse.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E14 - Baseballs of Death
4.plot: Crockett & Tubbs suspect a Chilean police chief in a double murder.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E15 - Indian Wars
4.plot: Tubbs relates to American Indians trying to save their homeland.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E16 - Honor Among Thieves?
4.plot: Crockett & Tubbs want to bring in a serial killer, but fear that it may blow their covers to break too soon.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E17 - Hell Hath No Fury...
4.plot: The highly publicized release of a convicted rapist makes Trudy fear that the man's victim may have revenge on her mind.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E18 - Badge of Dishonor
4.plot: When a string of murders is linked to another unit, Crockett & Tubbs believe an undercover officer may be the killer.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E19 - Blood & Roses
4.plot: The mobster who killed Crockett's friend is released from prison.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E20 - A Bullet for Crockett
4.plot: Sonny and Rico work undercover with a big dealer, Ricque ""Loco"" Mendez. During the police intervention, Sonny shot Loco, and the girlfriend of Loco shot Sonny.   Members of the vice squad reminisce while Crockett lies close to death from the gunshot wound. We see why the other policemen love Sonny. At the end, we understand why Sonny is a cop.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E21 - Deliver Us from Evil (1)
4.plot: A murder case that hits close to home reunites Crockett with the man who used him to trick his way off Death Row.

4.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S04E22 - Mirror Image (2)
4.plot: A concussion leaves Crockett thinking he is his drug dealer alter-ego Burnett and goes to work for a Colombian crime boss.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E01 - Hostile Takeover (3)
5.plot: Still thinking he is really Sonny Burnett, Crockett starts a war between the crime family he has joined and a rival clan.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E02 - Redemption in Blood (4)
5.plot: As now drug-lord Crockett's memory returns, Tubbs feels his partner has gone bad and must be destroyed.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E03 - Heart of Night
5.plot: Castillo grapples with emotions while protecting his ex-wife from a drug kingpin trying to kill her current husband.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E04 - Bad Timing
5.plot: Ordered to take time off, Crockett's vacation is cut short when he is kidnapped by 3 homicidal prison escapees.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E05 - Borrasca
5.plot: Tubbs & Castillo attempt to intervene in a drug deal in which government agents want no police interference.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E06 - Line of Fire
5.plot: Crockett & Tubbs reluctantly comply with an FBI request to guard their key witness in a drug overlord's trial.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E07 - Asian Cut
5.plot: Crockett & Tubbs use Trudy as a decoy to lure a sadistic serial killer who preys on call girls.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E08 - Hard Knocks
5.plot: Switek sinks into drinking and gambling when thugs convince him to talk a friend's son, a major college quarterback, into throwing a game.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E09 - Fruit of the Poison Tree
5.plot: Crockett & Tubbs investigate an attorney who defends drug dealers, then steals and resells their drugs.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E10 - To Have and to Hold (a.k.a. Second Chance)
5.plot: While undercover, Tubbs falls for the widow of a slain drug kingpin. Crockett must leave to help his son deal with the pregnancy of his remarried mother.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E11 - Miami Squeeze
5.plot: The irresponsible son of a fierce, anti-drug-minded Congresswoman jeopardizes his mother's political career when he incurs the wrath of a British drug lord by stealing his shipment of drugs.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E12 - Jack of All Trades
5.plot: Crockett's cousin Jack, the black sheep of the family, gets him mixed up in a scheme. Jack must repay a $50,000 debt.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E13 - The Cell Within
5.plot: A dark, chilling episode in which Tubbs is held prisoner - along with a drug dealer, a young prostitute and a prison psychologist - in the personal dungeon (complete with electric chair) of a supposedly reformed, freed killer who he once put behind bars. One of the highlights of Season 5.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E14 - The Lost Madonna
5.plot: Crockett & Tubbs help an NYPD detective retrieve a stolen 15th century Madonna statue in the possession of a mob family.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E15 - Over the Line
5.plot: In the midst of working an undercover assignment, Crockett and Tubbs come across a clandestine vigilante group of frustrated law enforcement officers working within the department. Aware of Sonny and Rico's own frustration with how easily the bad guys seem to circumvent the law, the vigilante organization offers them an opportunity to join in. Lieutenant Castillo encourages them to accept the offer and work undercover in ferreting out the identities of everyone involved and to make sure that no one gets hurt. Unfortunately, that is too tall an order for his detectives to accomplish successfully.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E16 - Victims of Circumstance
5.plot: Holocaust survivors are being murdered in Miami. Crockett and Switek infiltrate a White-supremacist group that might be responsible.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E17 - Freefall
5.plot: Crockett & Tubbs embark on what they see as a suicide mission. They are recruited by a Special Drug Taskforce to escort the corrupt dictator of Costa Morada, a fictional Revolution ravaged Latin American country. Gen. Manuel Borbon has promised to reveal the members of the most powerful South American drug cartel. Crockett & Tubbs are faced with what might be their final showdown.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E18 - World of Trouble
FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E19 - Miracle Man
5.plot: A vigilante believes he is a superhero, Miracle Man. His efforts to rid Miami of ""drug dealing slim"" intefers with Tubbs & Switek's operations.

5.title: FR - Deux Flics a Miami - S05E20 - Leap of Faith
5.plot: Agent Joey Harden returns to assist Crockett as part of a new division, Youth Crime Unit, that was formed by a previous partner. The YCU investigates a college professor that has created a new designer drug, Bliss.

Return to the world of Thra, where three Gelfling discover the horrifying secret behind the Skeksis' power and set out to ignite the fires of rebellion and save their world.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E01 - End. Begin. All the Same.
1.plot: In the land of Thra, a young guard discovers a terrible secret about the Skeksis overlords who control the planet -- and its powerful Crystal of Truth.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E02 - Nothing Is Simple Anymore
1.plot: As Deet sets out on her quest, Aughra awakens from a long journey, Rian flees the castle, and Brea searches for the meaning of the mysterious symbol.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E03 - What Was Sundered and Undone
1.plot: Brea struggles with her unsavory new duties, Deet and Hup get a hostile welcome from the Stonewood clan, and Rian begs his Maudra for help.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E04 - The First Thing I Remember Is Fire
1.plot: While Brea races to solve a puzzle in a hidden room beneath the throne, the Chamberlain hatches a plan to catch Rian and win back the Emperor's trust.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E05 - She Knows All the Secrets
1.plot: A missing Landstrider herd and an unexpected visit from the Skeksis put the All-Maudra on edge. Aughra summons Rian and the others to Dream Space.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E06 - By Gelfling Hand ...
1.plot: Lore breaks out of his chamber to help Brea. As news of the General's deed spreads, Seladon calls the other Maudras to the Citadel.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E07 - Time to Make ... My Move
1.plot: At the Circle of the Suns, the weary travelers receive an unsettling surprise -- and a lesson in Thra's history. The Emperor recruits a new army.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E08 - Prophets Don't Know Everything
1.plot: While Deet leads Rian on a harrowing journey through the tunnels of Thra, Seladon visits the Castle of the Crystal and sees a new side of the lords.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E09 - The Crystal Calls
1.plot: Desperate to save one of their own, the Skeksis make a deal with Aughra. Rian and Deet continue their search for the Dual Glaive.

1.title: FR - Dark Crystal : Le temps de la résistance - S01E10 - A Single Piece Was Lost
1.plot: As the Gelfling and the Skeksis prepare for a fateful battle, the Scientist starts work on a new secret weapon.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E01 - Camelot
1.plot: When the army pillages ​Sinaloa, ​an ambitious pot farmer pitches a plan to build a drug empire in Guadalajara. A young DEA agent transfers to Mexico.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E02 - The Plaza System
1.plot: Félix tries to unite all of the plazas while Rafa searches for water for his seedless weed. Police corruption and the DEA’s complacency frustrate Kiki.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E03 - El Padrino
1.plot: Kiki flies solo on a risky undercover operation. Félix turns to his mentor for advice as conflict between the cops and the traffickers escalates.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E04 - Rafa, Rafa, Rafa!
1.plot: After months of frustration, Kiki seizes an opportunity. Rafa runs afoul of powerful government officials, putting Félix in a difficult position.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E05 - The Colombian Connection
1.plot: A threat leaves Mika shaken. Félix envisions a different kind of future for the Guadalajara cartel.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E06 - La Última Frontera
1.plot: A violent power struggle erupts between Falcón and Rafa. As Félix finds a footing in the cocaine business, the DEA tries to lure him into the U.S.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E07 - Jefe de Jefes
1.plot: María implores Félix to move back to Sinaloa. Kiki gathers evidence of the Guadalajara cartel’s pot fields. Neto mourns.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E08 - Just Say No
1.plot: After the DEA closes in on Rafa's enormous pot field, Félix tries to stop his associates from retaliating. Kiki and Jaime meet with investigators.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E09 - 881 Lope de Vega
1.plot: A desperate Jaime is stymied by bureaucratic paperwork. Mika worries about her husband. Félix urges Rafa to disappear.

1.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S01E10 - Leyenda
1.plot: As pressure mounts, Félix returns to Sinaloa. An enraged Jaime and Mika seek justice and answers.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E01 - Salva El Tigre
2.plot: While celebrating his 40th birthday, Félix worries about his associates' loyalty and confronts Pacho. Walt and his team plan retaliatory kidnappings.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E02 - Alea lacta Est
2.plot: Verdin taunts the DEA agents torturing him. Félix offers opium dealer Guerra a partnership deal. Benjamín's sister Enedina poses a new business idea.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E03 - Ruben Zuno Arce
2.plot: Multiple advisers counsel Félix to go into hiding as the Americans close in on the men involved in Kiki's murder. Amado helps Acosta resolve a feud.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E04 - The Big Dig
2.plot: Zuno testifies in front of a grand jury. Isabella tries to broker a deal with Enedina. Félix makes a daring offer to a U.S. contact.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E05 - AFO
2.plot: Calderoni briefs Walt on the tension between the plazas as Chapo continues construction of his tunnel. Félix's meeting with Pacho takes a turn.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E06 - El Dedazo
2.plot: Félix meets with a political leader. Benjamín takes a stand when the Sinaloa and Tijuana rivalry intensifies. Walt's team turns its attention to planes.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E07 - Truth and Reconciliation
2.plot: Félix proposes a new plan to help the PRI win the election and defeat Cárdenas. Promised intel on Félix, Walt takes an unexpected meeting in Ojinaga.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E08 - Se Cayó El Sistema
2.plot: Mexican authorities, the FBI and Félix all seek out Acosta after a newspaper publishes an interview with him. The presidential election begins.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E09 - Growth, Prosperity, and Liberation
2.plot: Félix stakes the future of his entire cartel on the delivery of 70 tons of cocaine as Walt and the DEA plan to topple the kingpin's empire.

2.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S02E10 - Free Trade
2.plot: After meeting with Pacho, Félix presents the plaza bosses with a new business plan. Walt receives a surprising invitation.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E01 - 12 Steps
3.plot: Walt's undercover mission takes a turn. Amado is released following three months in prison. Juárez police officer Victor looks for a missing girl.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E02 - Como La Flor
3.plot: Tijuana journalist Andréa takes an interest in the teen guests at the wedding between Enedina Arellano and a prominent attorney. Walt considers a move.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E03 - Los Juniors
3.plot: After a disappointing conversation with the Arellanos about purchasing land, the Sinaloa cartel reacts. Andréa continues investigating the narcojuniors.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E04 - GDL
3.plot: With the Tijuana and Sinaloa cartels at war, everyone wonders where Juárez stands, but Amado has other plans in Cuba. Ramón seeks revenge against Chapo.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E05 - Boots on the Ground
3.plot: Walt joins a Mexican task force led by Gen. Rebollo aimed at catching those responsible for the Guadalajara massacre and Cardinal Posada's death.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E06 - La Jefa
3.plot: Victor is shaken by a murder and takes action. Violence escalates in Tijuana. New boss Enedina develops a plan to challenge her cartel's rivals.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E07 - La Voz
3.plot: La Voz is targeted following its reporting on Colosio's assassins. Mayo and Chapo form an alliance against the Tijuana cartel. Victor asks questions.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E08 - Last Dance
3.plot: When torturing Alex doesn't work, Walt switches tactics. Andrea sifts through financial records tied to Hank and the PRI. Amado plans for the future.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E09 - The Reckoning
3.plot: Andrea uncovers a startling connection, instigating a cascade of events. With Alex's help, Walt closes in on Benjamín. Hank threatens Amado.

3.title: FR - Narcos: Mexico - S03E10 - Life in Wartime
3.plot: Mexican and US authorities search in earnest for Amado. While in prison, Chapo makes moves to show he's the boss. Enedina sends Ramón on a mission.

meta.plot: See the rise of the Guadalajara Cartel as an American DEA agent learns the danger of targeting narcos in 1980s Mexico.
Teens Charlie and Nick discover their unlikely friendship might be something more as they navigate school and young love in this coming-of-age series.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E01 - Meet
1.plot: Stuck in a secret relationship, shy Charlie starts to crush on Nick, the school's popular rugby star, and joins the team against his friends' advice.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E02 - Crush
1.plot: Elle struggles to settle into her new school as Charlie and Tao are convinced Nick is straight. Nick starts to question his unfamiliar feelings.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E03 - Kiss
1.plot: Sparks fly at a birthday party where Nick's friend Tara confides in him. Inspired, Nick shares his feelings with Charlie — and they grow even closer.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E04 - Secret
1.plot: Charlie and Nick agree to keep their relationship a secret at school while Nick figures things out. Nick's friend Imogen asks him out on a date.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E05 - Friend
1.plot: Nick decides whether he should skip his date with Imogen for Charlie's birthday. Tao vows to protect Charlie from Nick and his rude rugby friends.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E06 - Girls
1.plot: Tara makes her relationship official on social media, but she isn't ready for the side effects. The friends try to play matchmaker with Elle and Tao.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E07 - Bully
1.plot: After both Nick and Tao get into fights with Harry, Charlie worries that he's making Nick's life too difficult and straining his friendship with Tao.

1.title: FR - Heartstopper - S01E08 - Boyfriend
1.plot: As the boys and girls schools meet for a Sports Day, Charlie's on the brink of breaking it all off with Nick while Elle and Tao share a special moment.

2.title: FR - Heartstopper - S02E01 - Out
2.plot: As his relationship with Charlie matures, Nick considers coming out to Imogen — but it's a lot harder than he expected. Elle tries flirting with Tao.

2.title: FR - Heartstopper - S02E02 - Family
2.plot: With Charlie's grades slipping, his parents tighten the rules. Tao's jealous when Elle makes new friends. Nick's older brother invades his privacy.

2.plot: Nick tries to come out to some of his teammates at a bonfire party after exams. Tao plans the perfect date. Things get weird between Tara and Darcy.

2.title: FR - Heartstopper - S02E04 - Challenge
2.plot: On a school trip to Paris, Nick and Charlie try to keep their relationship under wraps. Elle and Tao reconnect at a museum. Imogen stands up to Ben.

2.title: FR - Heartstopper - S02E05 - Heat
2.plot: Rumors spread when Charlie wakes up with something on his neck. A group tour of the city's most famous sights reveals more than one major secret.

2.plot: On their last day in Paris, Nick introduces Charlie to his dad. Elle and Tao make it official. The truth comes out at a party that's full of surprises.

2.title: FR - Heartstopper - S02E08 - Perfect
2.plot: The gang comes together for a memorable prom with a fitting theme: "Summer of Love." But with someone important missing... it feels incomplete.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E01 - Love
3.plot: On a trip to the beach, Charlie's desperate to tell Nick how he feels — but Nick also has something he wants to discuss. Tao plans a summer of romance.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E02 - Home
3.plot: On holiday in Menorca, Nick worries about Charlie, who is struggling more than ever. Isaac starts to feel like a third wheel around Elle and Tao.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E03 - Talk
3.plot: It's a new term, and Tao misses Elle now they're at different schools. Charlie plans a birthday surprise for Nick, who's still worried for his boyfriend.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E04 - Journey
3.plot: Charlie seeks medical help and begins the long road to recovery. Nick starts keeping a journal, and Tao makes a video to support his absent friend.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E05 - Winter
3.plot: It's a tough Christmas for Charlie, and his family — except for Tori — isn't helping. Elle and Tao talk about sex, and sparks fly at a New Year's party.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E06 - Body
3.plot: Elle's art going viral on social media lands her an interview. Charlie tells Nick he's ready to go to the next level and Tara suffers a panic attack.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E07 - Together
3.plot: As the school year comes to an end and the students begin thinking about their futures, Charlie and Nick struggle to find a moment alone together.

3.title: FR - Heartstopper - S03E08 - Apart
3.plot: Nick and the girls go on a road trip to look at unis, as he tries to decide whether to stay near Charlie or move away. Sahar's band plays at a fete.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E01 - Down the Rabbit Hole
1.plot: Alice's tales of her adventures in Wonderland result in her father committing her to a mental asylum where she was about to be lobotomised to cure her supposed insanity, but the Knave of Hearts and the White Rabbit rescue her and bring her back to Wonderland when they reveal that her true love Cyrus is still alive. As Alice begins a quest to find him, the Red Queen and Jafar plot against her.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E02 - Trust Me
1.plot: Alice formulates a plan to rescue Cyrus by retrieving his bottle. Meanwhile, the Red Queen begins to question her role in Jafar's plan while they try to find the bottle as well. Also, the story behind how Cyrus got to Wonderland and how he fell in love with Alice is revealed.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E03 - Forget Me Not
1.plot: With the Genie's bottle in her clutches, the Red Queen sends the Bandersnatch after Alice since Jafar needs her in order to use Cyrus (who is discovered to have contacted her). Alice and the Knave of Hearts head to the house of the Grendel in the Whispering Woods to obtain the Forget-Me-Knot so that they can find out who stole Cyrus's bottle before Jafar could steal it. In the Knave of Hearts's flashback, it is shown that he joined up with Robin Hood's Merry Men back when he was Will Scarlet. It is also revealed that Wonderland's Red Queen was once his love Anastasia.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E04 - The Serpent
1.plot: When the Knave's life is in danger, Alice has to make the tough decision on whether to use one of her three precious wishes and what that would mean for her and Cyrus. Her new friendship with Lizard reveals some of the Knave's backstory and Cyrus plots to escape. Meanwhile, Jafar's plan to kill the Knave puts the Red Queen in a difficult position as she grapples with her feelings for him and her desire to get what she wants. In flashback, we explore Jafar's origins and find out what he truly wants from Cyrus.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E05 - Heart of Stone
1.plot: In a flashback, Will Scarlet and Anastasia jump through the looking glass to enter Wonderland against her mother's wishes, since she disapproves of Will. They both soon realize that life in Wonderland isn't exactly what they had both imagined. After being humiliated while attending a ball at the palace, Ana convinces Will to steal the crown jewels in order to get them out of poverty, but in an instant, Ana is caught red handed by the King who makes her a proposition she can't refuse – to marry him and be his Queen to avoid prosecution. Meanwhile, in current Wonderland, the Red Queen convinces Alice to help her acquire magic dust in exchange for information about Cyrus, who in turn has managed to skillfully escape Jafar's castle leaving the White Rabbit in a compromising situation.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E06 - Who's Alice
1.plot: Jafar heads to the asylum to find information on Alice; Alice travels to the black forest; Cyrus tries to avoid the Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E07 - Bad Blood
1.plot: When Alice discovers that her father is in Wonderland, they begin healing their broken relationship, which leads to her having to make a difficult decision. In flashback, a young Jafar is emotionally distraught after his mother dies and we find out what drove him to become the unforgiving villain he is today.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E08 - Home
1.plot: A flashback reveals Cyrus' origin; Alice wants answers from the White Rabbit; disdain between the Red Queen and Jafar comes to a head.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E09 - Nothing to Fear
1.plot: Cyrus and Alice reluctantly work with the Red Queen to find Will but must also be prepared to defend themselves from Jafar. Will has troubles of his own when the caterpillar finds the bottle.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E10 - Dirty Little Secrets
1.plot: Cyrus remembers the events that led to the binding price he and his brothers have to pay; the Red Queen and the Knave are faced with the Jabberwocky.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E11 - Heart of the Matter
1.plot: Cyrus and Alice uncover alarming information; the Knave must surrender information to Jafar in order to help the Red Queen.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E12 - To Catch a Thief
1.plot: In flashback, the Knave hunts Alice per Cora’s directive and he finds himself striking a deal to get his heart back, while in present day Wonderland, Alice and the Knave’s friendship is tested as he does Jafar’s bidding and steals from her. Meanwhile, the Jabberwocky attempts to free herself from Jafar’s control and Jafar is confronted by his former partner.

1.title: FR - Once Upon a Time in Wonderland - S01E13 - And They Lived...
1.plot: The all-powerful Jafar succeeds in making his father love him and forcing Anastasia into thinking she loves him. After Alice, Amara and Cyrus escape, Jafar imprisons the Jabberwocky and calls upon an army of dead soldiers to do his bidding. Meanwhile, Alice and the White Rabbit raise their own army to fight Jafar for the realm and a final confrontation between Alice and Jafar takes place at the Well of Wonders.

meta.plot: In Victorian England, the young and beautiful Alice tells a tale of a strange new land that exists on the other side of a rabbit hole. Thinking Alice insane, her doctors aim to make her forget everything. While Alice is ready to put it all behind her, she knows this world is real. In the nick of time, the Knave of Hearts and the White Rabbit save her from a doomed fate. Together, the trio tumble down the rabbit hole to Wonderland, where nothing is impossible.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E01 - I Hate This World
1.plot: Leon is reincarnated in the world of the "otome game" he was playing as the third son of an impoverished baron. While he's trying to find happiness as a "mob" or background character, he's offered a terrible marriage proposal.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E02 - Hey, Girl. Wanna Get Some Tea?
1.plot: Leon officially begins attending the academy. Though the romantic interests he saw in the game are present, for some reason the girl with them is not the protagonist of the otome game, but a girl he doesn't recognize. Leon feels there is something off about the situation...

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E03 - Let's Duel, Prince
1.plot: Marie is being bullied by Angelica's followers. Because events don't match what happened in the otome game, Leon attempts to gather information on Marie.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E04 - Mind If I Go Easy on You?
1.plot: Leon's Armor Arroganz is mocked for being old fashioned, and the weapon Luxion has prepared for him is... a shovel! The audience ridicules Leon, but will he be able to defeat his five opponents?!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E05 - It's Awesome
1.plot: Leon's duel against Julius and his kingdom's best Armor begins. Why does Julius choose Marie over Angelica? His feelings drive him to attack Leon...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E06 - A Cultural Festival? It'll Be My First
1.plot: Leon and his friends open a cafe at the school festival. However, Julius' posse open their own cafe, and a mysterious girl trying to get close to Leon appears before Olivia. It looks like there's trouble ahead at this school festival...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E07 - We Both Hate Hot Guys
1.plot: Jilk appears in the bike race held on the final day of the academy festival. However, he is obstructed by the followers of his ex-fiancee and is badly injured. The situation develops further, and Leon finds himself dragged into it...

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E08 - This Isn't a Game
1.plot: Olivia finds herself pushed into a corner by Stephanie. Meanwhile, while understanding Olivia should resolve the pirate hunting situation, he chooses to prioritize efficiency and gets involved.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E09 - She's a Doormat
1.plot: Leon's attempt to support Olivia backfires. He attempts to clearly define their relationship as one between mob and protagonist, but... Meanwhile, during a sword fight against Brad, he realizes the difference in their resolve.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E10 - Unlike You Wannabe Nobles
1.plot: The school trip begins, and Leon heads to the southern island where the item he seeks can be found. Once there, he runs into Angelica and Olivia at a shrine dedicated to marriage while things are still awkward between them.

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E11 - What I Can Do Now
1.plot: Leon weaves his way through the horde of monsters alone in order to rescue Angelica. Meanwhile, Chris and Olivia battle fiercely alongside the other students on the passenger ship, but they're surrounded by the duchy's fleet...!

1.title: FR - Trapped in a Dating Sim : The World of Otome Games is Tough for Mobs - S01E12 - No Matter How Tough the World of Otome Games Is
1.plot: Forced to face off against the Black Knight, Leon, through cunning tactics, manages to defeat his formidable opponent and bring the enemy forces to his mercy. This act gains him more fame and notoriety with the Holfort Kingdom, and he is appointed as Viscount.

meta.plot: An ordinary office worker is reincarnated as Leon into a particularly punishing dating sim video game, where women reign supreme and only beautiful men have a seat at the table. But Leon has a secret weapon: he remembers everything from his past life, which includes a complete playthrough of the very game in which he is now trapped. Watch Leon spark a revolution to change this new world in order to fulfill his ultimate desire...of living a quiet, easy life in the countryside!

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E01 - In this world where monsters are rampant...
1.plot: A knight and a foul-mouthed healer meet and are going to have a hard time together!

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E02 - Forced to travel with Carla, a healer...
1.plot: ...Alvin resumes his original quest to gather antidote herbs, but on the way he ends up getting attacked in a graveyard by ghosts which they manage to escape unexpectedly, but then he falls into a trap set by goblins and basically the first half of the episode is filled with great suffering but Carla's curse is still in effect so he can't get away from her and there's even more suffering in store nevertheless and anyway these titles are really long and kind of serve double-duty as next episode previews and we're pretty curious about how many people actually listen to the whole thing and that's the deal with episode 2.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E03 - Despite the terrible time he's been having...
1.plot: While trying to demonstrate their skills, Alvin and Carla encounter a delicious and dangerous enemy.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E06 - As usual, Alvin and Carla have to overcome a series of crises...
1.plot: Rejuvenated, the witch gives Alvin and Carla the herbs they need. The two leave for the guild and obviously have another problem.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E07 - This show is fairly unique in that Carla is the only recurring female character...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla decide to help a zombie get his revenge by confronting a powerful necromancer.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E08 - Thanks to Altargaia (reminder: this is the mushroom's name)...
1.plot: Released from prison, Alvin reunites with Carla, who has decided to help Maria summon a particular soul.

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E09 - This Episode Features Even More Female Guest Characters Hot on the Heels...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla meet in the forest the Medusa and Dryad. What are they planning to do with them?

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E10 - In the second half of this episode, we enter the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin and Carla visit the adventurers' guild and meet an old companion of Alvin's there, who isn't particularly fond of our party...

1.title: FR - Don’t Hurt Me, My Healer! - S01E11 - So, this is Part 2 of the "What Story Is This?" arc...
1.plot: Alvin once again finds himself in an awkward position from which he cannot free himself. Can Carla help him this time, or is she just making it worse?

However, after he sees the contents of the missing cook's trunk, he decides the case could prove to be worthy of his talents.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E02 - Murder in the Mews
1.plot: Within hours of the Bonfire Night fireworks beginning Poirot finds himself investigating a violent death in Hastings' mews garage.

1.plot: Country squire Marcus Waverly calls on Poirot for help in dealing with kidnap threats against his son. Hastings is appalled by the thought of someone going around kidnapping children and it becomes a race against time to find the identity of the mystery letter writer.

1.plot: At a London restaurant where he often eats, Poirot notices that another regular customer has diverted from his usual meal. As old Anthony Gascoigne lies dying in Brighton, his estranged twin brother, Henry, falls to his death. A tragic accident, or murder? Poirot begins to see connections and decides the answer to the mystery lies in a blackberry pie.

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E05 - The Third Floor Flat
1.plot: Poirot discovers a murder in his own block of flats, and goes on the trail of boisterous neighbours and strange nocturnal noises in the lift shaft.

1.plot: Poirot is on holiday at the Palace Hotel, Rhodes, when an Englishwoman, Mrs Valentine Chantry, is poisoned. Poirot unravels several complicated relationships between those staying at the Palace Hotel.

Prince Paul appeals to Poirot to save Valerie from police suspicion, and the great detective finds he has a conundrum to ponder on, 'When is a murder not a murder?'

1.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S01E10 - The Dream
1.plot: Millionaire business man Benedict Farley, a well known eccentric, consults Poirot about bad dreams he has been having. Mr. Farley has dreamed repeatedly of killing himself. Sadly, he does not follow Poirot's advice. When Farley is found dead, Poirot fails to believe that it is suicide and suspects a murder plot relying on hypnosis.

2.plot: Poirot and Hastings take a holiday in Cornwall, looking for peace and quiet. They meet Miss Nick Buckley, who lives near their hotel at End House, and she tells Poirot she has had three near-fatal accidents in a few weeks. He then finds a bullet hole in her hat, returns with her to End House and is drawn into a complex murder investigation.....

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E02 - The Veiled Lady

Lady Millicent is about to be married, but a mean blackmailer called Lavington has got hold of a love letter she wrote years before to another man. Lavington wants twenty thousand pounds, and Poirot makes up his mind to recover the letter himself, even if it means impersonating a Swiss locksmith.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E03 - The Lost Mine

The banker asks them to investigate the disappearance of a Mr Ling - a highly-valued customer who before he went missing had arranged to sell Lord Pearson a map showing the location of a long-lost silver mine. Ling is found murdered, a young stockbroker is implicated, and Poirot has to untangle a complicated plot.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E04 - The Cornish Mystery
2.plot: Poirot travels to Cornwall, summoned by a Mrs Pengelley, who suspects her dentist husband is poisoning her because he's fallen in love with his young assistant. Unhappily, Poirot finds Mrs Pengelley dead on his arrival, so he sets out to catch her killer.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E05 - The Disappearance of Mr. Davenheim

Poirot, who has developed an interest in conjuring tricks, bets Japp five pounds that he can solve the mystery without leaving his apartment.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E06 - Double Sin

On the way, Hastings befriends a young woman who is missing a collection of valuable miniatures. The case involves a famous writer and a beautiful woman in a sports car, and to the relief of Hastings Poirot's thoughts of retirement soon seem far away.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E07 - The Adventure of the Cheap Flat
