Burt dismisses Poirot as a gumshoe, and Poirot is likewise not impressed by the self-important G-man. Poirot is drawn into the case when it appears that the submarine plans will fall into the hands of the Fascist government in Italy unless they are recovered. When Poirot meets a young couple who've got an amazing bargain on a prime apartment, he sees a connection with the spy case.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E08 - The Kidnapped Prime Minister
2.plot: Poirot is called in when the British Prime Minister and his secretary are kidnapped in France on their way to a League of Nations conference - and he is given just a day and a half to solve the case.

2.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S02E09 - The Adventure of the Western Star
2.plot: Marie Marvelle, a Belgian film star, receives threatening letters from a chinaman which demand her famous diamond, the Western Star. Marie visits her old friend Hercule Poirot in London, seeking his help, and Poirot tackles the case with relish.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E01 - How Does Your Garden Grow?
3.plot: Suggestions of a Communist conspiracy cast suspicion on a murdered woman's Russian servant. Meanwhile, Poirot has a rose named after him, and a ceremony at the Chelsea Flower Show makes him the centre of attention. Hastings receives a packet of seeds and develops hay fever.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E02 - The Million Dollar Bond Robbery
3.plot: The London and Scottish Bank is sending a huge shipment of Liberty Bonds to New York on the liner Queen Mary. Poirot, who suffers terribly from sea-sickness, is asked to see the bonds safely across the Atlantic.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E03 - The Plymouth Express
3.plot: An Australian shipping tycoon wants Poirot to check out his daughter's suitors. Then the young lady takes a trip on the Plymouth Express, and Poirot finds himself investigating a jewel theft on the train.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E04 - Wasps' Nest
3.plot: Poirot  visits a garden fete, where a wasps' nest adds to the tension. He meets the son of an old friend who has his girl-friend, a fashion model, with him, and Poirot soon suspects that they are both in danger. He has to solve a mystery which includes cyanide, failing brakes and mixed-up love lives. Meanwhile, Hastings has a new hobby which Poirot finds helpful in cracking the case.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E05 - The Tragedy at Marsdon Manor
3.plot: Poirot is summoned to Marsdon by the owner of a country inn there to solve a murder. But the inn-keeper is a would-be thriller writer, and to Poirot's dismay the murder turns out to be fictional. Thankfully, though, there is soon a real (if seemingly supernatural) murder at the big house. Things get even more interesting when a young wife claims that a tree in her garden is haunted by a laughing ghost, and there are also signs of black magic from East Africa. Poirot lays a clever ambush to smoke out the killer,confident that he or she will turn out to be human.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E06 - The Double Clue
3.plot:
Japp (who is really worried that failure could cost him his job) seeks Poirot's help in investigating a series of jewel thefts, and two remarkable things happen. Poirot falls in love (with the beautiful and clever Countess Vera Rossakoff) and he also meets a criminal intellect which he finds worthy of him. As the countess is his main suspect, Poirot spends most of his time with her - which for once leaves Hastings and Miss Lemon to do most of the actual detective work.

In the end, this case may have to be put down as the one that got away.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E07 - The Mystery of the Spanish Chest
3.plot: Poirot is called in to help a woman who lives in fear of her husband, and he is invited to a dinner party which goes horribly wrong.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E08 - The Theft of the Royal Ruby
3.plot: Poirot prepares to spend a quiet Christmas on his own with a box of chocolates, but he has to give up his plans when the British government asks for his urgent help. Prince Farouk, a  young member of the Egyptian royal family visiting London, has lost a famous ruby, and this is deemed to be a matter of national security.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E09 - The Affair at the Victory Ball
3.plot: Poirot attends the Victory Ball, a costume party where you are expected to dress as someone famous, as himself. However, when two members of a party of six dressed as characters from classical Italian comedy are subsequently found dead, Poirot finds himself working with Chief Inspector Japp to solve the case. The solution to the deaths of Viscount Cronshaw and Coco Courtney is to be found in determining the correct time of death and identifying an impostor at the ball. Poirot takes to the airwaves and reveals the identity of the killer on a live BBC radio broadcast.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E10 - The Mystery of Hunter's Lodge
3.plot: Hercule Poirot accompanies his friend Captain Hastings on a weekend shooting party at the home of Harrington Pace, but he isn't having a very good time. He comes down with the flu and takes to his bed but when Pace is shot dead in his study, he rises to the occasion to assist Inspector Japp in solving the case.

3.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S03E11 -

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E01 - The ABC Murders
4.plot: Beside the bodies of three murder victims lies a copy of the ABC Railway Guide.

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E02 - Death in the Clouds
4.plot: On an airplane, flying from Paris to London, one of the passengers is killed by a poison dart while Poirot sleeps.

4.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S04E03 - One, Two, Buckle My Shoe
4.plot: Poirot believes his dentist was murdered and Japp thinks it was a suicide.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E01 - The Adventure of the Egyptian Tomb
5.plot: An archaeologist dies of a heart attack shortly after opening an ancient Egyptian tomb, but his widow thinks there is dirty work at the crossroads and calls Poirot.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E02 - The Underdog
5.plot: A wealthy industrialist is found dead in his study. Is his death related to a discovery made at his chemical factory? And is his wife all she seems?

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E03 - The Yellow Iris
5.plot: Friends and family gather at a dinner party to mark the second anniversary of a woman's death. Meanwhile, Poirot is caught up in a coup d'etat and arrested as a spy, which prevents him from solving a murder at a French restaurant owned by an Italian in Buenos Aires.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E04 - The Case of the Missing Will
5.plot: Poirot has to execute the final wishes of an old friend who has been killed.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E05 - The Adventure of the Italian Nobleman
5.plot: Poirot is drawn into the underworld of London's Little Italy when Captain Hastings looks for a new car, but instead finds murder.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E06 - The Chocolate Box
5.plot: Poirot returns to Belgium for the first time since the Great War. There he revisits a twenty-year-old murder mystery that was never officially solved.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E07 - Dead Man's Mirror
5.plot: When Poirot investigates the mysterious death of a despised art dealer, he finds that he has more than enough suspects from whom to choose.

5.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S05E08 - Jewel Robbery at the Grand Metropolitan
5.plot: Mrs. Opalsen's famous pearls are stolen and Poirot is happily on hand to investigate. A complex theft calls for a sophisticated solution. Unfortunately, Poirot is hindered everywhere he goes by being mistaken for 'Lucky Len'.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E01 - Hercule Poirot's Christmas
6.plot: Poirot's Christmas is interrupted by Simeon Lee, who believes his life is threatened. Simeon is soon killed and his diamonds stolen.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E02 - Hickory Dickory Dock
6.plot: A string of thefts at a student hostel run by Miss Lemon's sister ends in death and Poirot has a number of plots and sub-plots to untangle. A certain mouse is the only witness to a string of murders.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E03 - Murder on the Links
6.plot: Poirot and Hastings are on holiday in Deauville and receive a visit from Paul Renauld, who believes he's being cheated by Chileans. Renauld is kidnapped and his body is later found buried in a new golf bunker. French detective Giraud unwisely challenges Poirot to catch the killer before he can.

6.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S06E04 - Dumb Witness
6.plot: Poirot and Hastings are at Lake Windermere for an attempt on the world speed-boat record. An elderly widow is hurt by falling down stairs, then later killed by poisoning with phosphorus.

7.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S07E01 - The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
7.plot: Living quietly in the small village of King's Abbot, sleuth Hercule Poirot becomes involved in the murder of successful industrialist Roger Ackroyd. The number of potential killers is almost as great as the population of the village itself. As Poirot investigates he sees that there might be a connection to the suicide of a local woman, and the death the previous year of her husband.

7.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S07E02 - Lord Edgware Dies
7.plot: Lady Edgware has a dilemma in that her husband has consistently refused to give her a divorce. She asks Hercule Poirot to visit the man and see if there is any possibility of convincing him. When Lord Edgware is found dead, there is no great surprise, but there are a good number of suspects.

8.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S08E01 - Evil Under the Sun
8.plot: After collapsing with heart problems, Hercule Poirot visits a seaside health farm on Burgh Island. While there, the flirtatious heiress Arlena Stewart is found strangled on a secluded beach.

8.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S08E02 - Murder in Mesopotamia
8.plot: While accompanying his friend Hastings to a dig in Iraq, Hercule Poirot becomes involved in the murder of an archaeologist's wife.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E01 - Five Little Pigs
9.plot: Lucy Crale hires Poirot to solve the murder of her father sixteen years before, and Poirot finds a number of possible suspects who are still alive.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E02 - Sad Cypress
9.plot: Young Elinor Carlisle, engaged to marry the dashing Roddy Winter, finds herself charged with the fatal poisoning of Mary Gerrard, her rival in love. Poirot has the job of saving Elinor, but the evidence against her is overwhelming.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E03 - Death on the Nile
9.plot: A wealthy British heiress honeymooning on a Nile cruise ship is stalked by a former friend, whose boyfriend she had stolen before making him her new husband.

9.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S09E04 - The Hollow
9.plot: Poirot is spending a week-end with the Angkatells, at their country house called The Hollow.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E01 - The Mystery of the Blue Train
10.plot: After traveling on the Blue Train from Calais to Nice, Hercule Poirot is pressed into service to help solve the murder of heiress Ruth Kettering who is found savagely beaten in her compartment.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E02 - Cards on the Table
10.plot: Hercule Poirot finds himself investigating the murder of his dinner host, Mr. Shaitana, who was stabbed in the heart while his guests played bridge.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E03 - After the Funeral
10.plot: Hercule Poirot's solicitor, Gilbert Entwhistle, asks Poirot to help solve a riddle and a murder.

10.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S10E04 - Taken at the Flood
10.plot: Hercule Poirot finds himself trying to solve the mystery of the Cloade family

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E01 - Mrs McGinty's Dead
11.plot: James Bentley is arrested for the murder of old Mrs McGinty. It looks like an open and shut case, but Superintendent Spence is not convinced. He turns to Poirot for help, and together with Poirot's writer friend Ariadne Oliver they set out to find the real killer.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E02 - Cat Among the Pigeons
11.plot: Poirot finds a connection between a recent murder and a revolution in the Middle Eastern kingdom of Ramat.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E03 - Third Girl
11.plot: Three single girls share a London flat. The first works as a secretary; the second is an artist; the third, who comes to Poirot for help, disappears believing she is a murderer.

11.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S11E04 - Appointment With Death
11.plot: On holiday in Jerusalem, Poirot hears about an archaeological expedition to Syria led by the eccentric Lord Boynton and his son Leonard, who believe they are on the track of the head of St John the Baptist. Drawn to visit the dig, Poirot meets Boynton's dominating, fabulously rich, American-born second wife. However, events are overtaken by the discovery of Lady Boynton's dead body and revelations about her fortune.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E01 - Hallowe'en Party
12.plot: Novelist Ariadne Oliver calls in her old friend Poirot to investigate a drowning at a Hallowe'en party

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E02 - Murder on the Orient Express
12.plot: On the Orient Express from Istanbul, a ruthless American businessman is found dead. Poirot investigates and makes a life-changing decision.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E03 - The Clocks
12.plot: Four clocks surround an unidentified corpse in a blind woman's house, and a young typist is summoned to the crime scene. However, Poirot is convinced that the complicated setup is merely hiding a simpler solution.

12.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S12E04 - Three Act Tragedy
12.plot: Poirot is attending a dinner party when one of the guests chokes to death on a cocktail. With no trace of poison, and no apparent motive, can it be murder?

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E01 - Elephants Can Remember
13.plot: Poirot investigates a strange and gruesome murder of an elderly psychiatrist. Ariadne Oliver is pressed to try and uncover the truth behind two decade-old deaths. They soon find out that their separate investigations are linked and work together to try and solve the mystery.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E02 - The Big Four
13.plot: With the world on the brink of WWII, there is more political turmoil when it appears that the famous Peace Party is in fact a cover for the Big Four.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E03 - Dead Man's Folly
13.plot: Ariadne Oliver is asked to devise a murder hunt for a Devon fête, but her sense of foreboding summons Poirot to the scene. Her fears are realized when, during the fête, the girl playing her murder victim winds up well and truly murdered.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E04 - The Labours of Hercules
13.plot: In an effort to recover his confidence after a rare professional failure, Poirot sets off for the Swiss Alps in pursuit of a missing maid.

13.title: FR - Hercule Poirot - S13E05 - Curtain: Poirot's Last Case
13.plot: An ailing Poirot returns to Styles with Hastings nearly three decades after solving their first mystery together there in order to prevent an unscrupulous and ingenious serial killer from claiming more victims.

meta.plot: Hercule Poirot, ancien policier belge, a fui son pays pendant la Première Guerre mondiale. Désormais, il vit à Londres et exerce en tant que détective privé. Sa réputation d'enquêteur hors pair est internationale et de nombreuses personnes font appel à lui pour percer des mystères que la police n'a pas su résoudre.
At his father's auto shop, a hapless manager strives to improve customer service and drive profits while keeping his troublemaking cousin in line.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E01 - The Initiative
1.plot: At the Valley Forge Auto shop, manager Will pushes a new inclusion initiative and invites a reporter to cover it, but the interview goes off the rails.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E02 - Windows of Opportunity
1.plot: With sales down, Dave pressures Will to send a mechanic to another shop. Meanwhile, Shane reconnects with an old friend who proposes a tempting offer.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E03 - Sales Contest
1.plot: To beat Belmont's team in sales and win a gift card, the shop draws in customers with an oil change special, but Will's upselling attempts fall short.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E04 - The Rumor Mill
1.plot: Will tries to build a marketing campaign for his new idea — until devastating rumors about the store's future and his reputation throw him off-balance.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E05 - Bikini Car Wash
1.plot: Will and Shane prepare for a fun day on the job after hiring women for an attention-grabbing car wash but are forced to pivot when a visitor drops in.

1.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S01E06 - Dad
1.plot: Will hits a low point after clashing with his toughest critic over his life choices. An unlikely advocate steps in to help save his job — and the shop.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E01 - Bonus Money
2.plot: With business booming and morale high, Will seeks to expand Valley Forge's reach. Shane's questionable new purchase causes chaos at the shop.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E02 - HR
2.plot: A mandatory HR training becomes a trainwreck when Shane hijacks the curriculum and an unwanted visitor crashes the course.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E03 - Inspection
2.plot: When an inspection uncovers a health hazard in the garage, the crew goes into a tailspin. Will witnesses an image that cannot be unseen.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E04 - Shiny New Thing
2.plot: While rocking a new look, Will finds surprising common ground with a rookie sales rep. A contentious lunch with a relative resurfaces grudges for Shane.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E05 - Record High
2.plot: The search for a new manager takes a turn when Will hires a candidate who shatters sales records — and raises red flags.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E06 - The Tri-State Mid Market Tire Expo
2.plot: At a tire industry expo, Will rolls the dice on a risky business proposition, while Shane hustles for tickets to a sold-out event.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E07 - Free Fries
2.plot: A secret meeting could change the game for Will — if day-drinking doesn't tank it. Shane wrangles two teens into getting their hands dirty at the shop.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E08 - Retirement
2.plot: A retirement celebration gets out of hand as Shane questions the company's vision and Dave's reckless behavior catches up with him.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E09 - The Radio Ad
2.plot: A radio commercial for the shop becomes a free-for-all when the station's morning hosts expose Will's past live on the air.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E10 - Patriots and Traitors
2.plot: At a triumphant relaunch party, Will and Shane's costumes steal the show. But a brewing crisis threatens to spoil the festivities.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E11 - Misery Has Company
2.plot: When the shop's sales plan takes an unexpected turn, the gang finds renewed purpose in the unlikely form of Shane's childhood hero.

2.title: EN - Tires [Multi - Sub - Audio] - S02E12 - At What Cost
2.plot: Facing a crossroads, the Valley Forge team must find a way forward as Will and Shane combine their strengths to snag a potential lifeline.

meta.plot: Using highly advanced colourisation techniques, critical moments from World War II, from Stalingrad to The Battle of Britain, are shown in a whole new light.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Blitzkrieg
1.plot: The Lightning War was one of the most extraordinary events of the Second World War. Now, expertly restored footage from around the world shows the story in a new light.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Battle of Britain
1.plot: In 1940, France has fallen and Hitler orders Operation Sealion: the invasion of Great Britain. Rare, expertly-restored footage tells the story in a new light.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Pearl Harbor
1.plot: Japan's attack on Pearl Harbor was one of the greatest gambles in military history. Rare, expertly-restored footage recounts the extraordinary event.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Battle of Midway
1.plot: Expertly-restored colour footage retells the dramatic story of a Japanese attack on the US-held Pacific island of Midway which triggers an extraordinary chain of events.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Siege of Stalingrad
1.plot: The battle of Stalingrad was one of the bloodiest of the entire war and turned the tide for the Germans. Colourised footage retells the dramatic story.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - D-Day
1.plot: The D-Day invasion fleet was the largest in history and one of the most audacious events of WWII. But landing was just the beginning, as rare footage reveals.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Battle of the Bulge
1.plot: High on cocaine, Hitler hatched a daring plan to change the course of the war. Colourised archive depicts the Germans’ artillery barrage against the Allies.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Firestorm Over Dresden
1.plot: Pushing for a German surrender, Allied forces firebomb the city of Dresden, killing thousands of civilians and unleashing a storm of controversy.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Buchenwald Liberation
1.plot: Hitler's rise to power led to the slaughter of millions as concentration camps revealed the Nazi empire's true evil. Rarely-seen archive recounts the atrocities.

1.title: EN - Greatest Events of World War II in Colour [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Hiroshima
1.plot: The final hours of WWII changed the course of history with President Truman's fateful decision to use the deadliest weapon ever created: the atom bomb.

meta.plot: Millions in stolen cash. Missing luxury bourbon. Watch ordinary people almost get away with these extraordinary heists in this true crime series.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Sex Magick Money Murder (1)
1.plot: Heather Tallchief gives in to hypnosis and aids career criminal Roberto Solis in a plot to steal $3.1 million from an armored truck in Las Vagas.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Sex Magick Money Murder (2)
1.plot: FBI agent Joe Dushek heads a full-scale operation to track down the fugitives. Heather faces a personal dilemma as her forged passport expires.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Money Plane (1)
1.plot: Unable to cover the cost of adoption, Karls Mozon assembles a crew and plans a heist at the Miami International airport - by studying TV shows.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Money Plane (2)
1.plot: After Karls and his crew take off with $7.4 million, the FBI get an unexpected lead, and Jeffrey Boatwright becomes a kidnapping target.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Bourbon King (1)
1.plot: In 1999, family man Toby Curtsinger enlists his pals in a scheme to steal the world's most expensive bourbon and triggers a media-savvy investigation.

1.title: EN - Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Bourbon King (2)
1.plot: The sheriff's office receives a tip and finds key evidence. A surprise twist reveals the mystery behind the missing Pappy Van Winkle bottles.

meta.plot: As Nick and Rachel's crimes escalate to bigger and bigger stars, CCTV footage of the Hollywood Hills burglars begins to circulate the gossip blogs. Alexis and her family are on the brink of reality TV fame, but her drug issues spiral.

1.title: EN - Bling Ring: Hollywood Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Fame Game
1.plot: Los Angeles, 2008, in the land of fame, excess and reality TV, teenagers Alexis Neiers, Nick Prugo and Rachel Lee try to make a name for themselves by hatching a foolproof plan to burgle Paris Hilton.

1.title: EN - Bling Ring: Hollywood Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Fame, Fortune and Felony
1.plot: Just as CCTV footage of the Hollywood Hills burglars began to circulate the gossip blogs. Meanwhile, as Alexis and her family found themselves on the brink of reality TV fame her drug addiction led Alexis to become increasingly intertwined with Nick.

1.title: EN - Bling Ring: Hollywood Heist [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Fame and Misfortune
1.plot: The concluding part reveals how the Bling Ring's crimes eventually caught up with them, thrusting them into the centre of a high-profile court case. But the defendants were not the only ones benefiting from the spotlight.

meta.plot: Unknown histories take center stage as the hitmakers themselves - from ABBA to T-Pain - explore dimensions of pop music you never knew existed.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Auto-Tune
1.plot: Love it or hate it, Auto-Tune has changed pop music. From Cher's "Believe" to Kanye West's "Love Lockdown," the sound has penetrated the globe and revolutionized music since its invention in 1997. Some say the pitch-correction technology has ruined music, while others have found fame by using the tool creatively. Tracing Auto-Tune's roots to predecessors like the synthesizer, the good, the bad, and the ugly of this game-changing technology is revealed, grounded in a personal account of Auto-Tune's most famous user, T-Pain.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Hail Britpop!
1.plot: Britpop. The word can elicit an eye roll, an itch to get on the dance floor, or a sudden urge to cry and sing "Wonderwall." In the early ‘90s, when America was hooked on grunge, The Brits retaliated with a return to catchy, witty, and downright fun pop, speaking to their own stories and cultural roots. This musical zeitgeist known as "Britpop" went far behind the headlines of "Oasis vs. Blur" – bands like Elastica, Echobelly, Pulp, Lush, and Suede became international exports with a unique sound.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Stockholm Syndrome
1.plot: Since 1974, when a little-known group named ABBA won Eurovision's song contest with their track "Waterloo," Sweden has been a global force in exporting pop music. Cassette players and bedroom walls have been filled with the likes of Roxette, Ace of Base, and Robyn, and ‘90s playlists featuring Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys, and *NSYNC would be obsolete without the work of Swedes Denniz Pop and Max Martin.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Boyz II Men Effect
1.plot: Before Backstreet Boys, *NSYNC, and 98 Degrees, there was a "boy band" from Philadelphia called Boyz II Men that ruled the charts. With their incredible vocal harmonies and preppy-cool style, Boyz II Men became the "soundtrack to our lives" with hits like "End of The Road", "I'll Make Love To You", "Motown Philly," and "One Sweet Day" – heard at weddings, proms, karaoke bars, and funerals alike. Going back to the band's humble beginnings in Philadelphia, this episode pays homage to the influential R&B group who set the template for ‘90s boy bands.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - When Country Goes Pop
1.plot: It's a tale as old as time – a country song goes "pop" and country music fans protest. From Dolly Parton to Shania Twain to Lil Nas X, the scrutiny around what makes a song "country" has been a raging debate that shows no signs of slowing down.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Brill Building in 4 Songs
1.plot: New York City's Brill Building and pop music go together like bread and butter, or in this case, like King n' Goffin, Leiber n' Stoller, or Barry n' Kim. In the 1950s and 60s, songwriters, record producers, and wannabe pop stars flocked to 1619 Broadway in New York with dreams of churning out the next big hit. Full of small rooms with upright pianos, The Brill Building was labelled a "song-factory", but its true spirit grew out of a community that collaborated and challenged each other to achieve greatness.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - What Can A Song Do?
1.plot: For decades, musicians have been using music as their weapon of choice against social injustice, discrimination and marginalization. From Woody Guthrie's "This Land is Your Land" to Kendrick Lamar's "Alright," a song is one of the most powerful ways to transmit a message to a large audience.

1.title: EN - This Is Pop [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Festival Rising
1.plot: There is no rite of passage quite like the music festival. Millions of people attend them each year and now more than ever they infiltrate our culture from “festival wear” clothing lines to playlists. Taking a journey from ‘60s counterculture to modern-day "selfie" culture, the evolution of the music festival is explored to examine deeper ideas about the importance of collective experiences, and they act as a cultural mirror that reflect interests and ideals.

meta.plot: Follow the lives of a group of students at what is possibly the world’s worst community college in the fictional locale of Greendale, Colorado.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: When the legitimacy of his degree is challenged, lawyer Jeff Winger must return to school, where he meets a clan of misfit community college students.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Spanish 101
1.plot: While Jeff looks to use a Spanish class assignment to get close to Britta, Pierce has something altogether different in mind.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Introduction to Film
1.plot: Jeff struggles to get a good grade, and Britta's offer to bankroll his film class exposes a rift between Abed and his angry father.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Social Psychology
1.plot: As Annie recruits Abed and Troy for a psychology class experiment, Jeff and Shirley bond over their mutual fondness for gossip.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Advanced Criminal Law
1.plot: As Pierce volunteers to compose a new school song, a cheating episode in Spanish class leaves Jeff defending Britta before a disciplinary tribunal.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Football, Feminism and You
1.plot: Annie's dream of being the ex-football star's girlfriend is in jeopardy when Jeff is blackmailed into getting Troy to join Greendale's football team.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Introduction to Statistics
1.plot: Jeff sets his sights on an attractive professor, and Annie looks to boost her social standing by hosting a Day of the Dead party.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Home Economics
1.plot: Jeff is forced out of his condo and into Abed's dorm room, and Annie looks to get Troy's attention by helping him plan a romantic picnic.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Debate 109
1.plot: As Jeff is drafted to help lead Greendale's debate team against the formidable City College, Abed's film-class projects appear to predict the future.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Environmental Science
1.plot: Faced with an unreasonable amount of Spanish homework, Jeff's efforts to handle Señor Chang manage to help him, but not the rest of the class.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Politics of Human Sexuality
1.plot: With his high-price "escort" girlfriend on his arm, Pierce pressures Jeff into asking Dean Pelton's airhead secretary to double date at the STD Fair.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Comparative Religion
1.plot: Shirley's plans for a holiday party are in jeopardy when Jeff is drawn into a fight with a campus bully.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Investigative Journalism
1.plot: Jeff accepts an invitation to be the editor of the school paper as he and his friends fend off an interloper who wants to join their study group.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Interpretive Dance
1.plot: As Jeff and Prof. Slater try to keep their student-teacher romance under wraps, Britta and Troy tell everyone about their shared passion for dance.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Romantic Expressionism
1.plot: Jeff and Britta team up to derail Annie's fledgling romance with Greendale's resident hippie singer-songwriter, Vaughn.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Communication Studies
1.plot: As Valentine's Day finds Jeff struggling with his feelings for Britta and Professor Slater, Pierce and Troy are wrongly blamed for a prank.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Physical Education
1.plot: The study group helps Abed land a date with a girl, and Jeff squares off with a P.E. coach who insists that he wear gym shorts to a billiards class.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Basic Genealogy
1.plot: As Family Day lands Jeff in the middle of an affair with Pierce's sexy ex-stepdaughter, Shirley's unruly sons help liberate Abed's Afghani cousin.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Beginner Pottery
1.plot: A pottery class he takes for an easy A reveals Jeff's deep-seated need to succeed.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - The Science of Illusion
1.plot: When her April Fools' Day prank inadvertently sends a human cadaver out the anatomy lab window, Britta looks to place the blame on Jeff.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Contemporary American Poultry
1.plot: A scheme to replace a corrupt cafeteria employee transforms the study group into a criminal gang run by a power-hungry Abed.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - The Art of Discourse
1.plot: While a tasteless prank ends with Pierce being tossed out of the group, Britta and Jeff are forced to team up against some teen newcomers at school.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Modern Warfare
1.plot: The first prize of priority registration engulfs Greendale Community College in a Spring Fling paintball war.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - English as a Second Language
1.plot: On the eve of an important final exam in Spanish, everyone's grades are jeopardized when it is discovered that Señor Chang has a damaging secret.

1.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - Pascal's Triangle Revisited
1.plot: As the end of the school year finds Jeff at the apex of a romantic triangle, Annie ponders moving away with her hacky sack-playing boyfriend.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Anthropology 101
2.plot: When the semester starts, Jeff is stunned that his rejection of Britta has made her a campus star; Chang wants to be accepted into the study group.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Accounting for Lawyers
2.plot: When an old friend from Jeff's past appears unexpectedly, his friends discover that he was the one responsible for Jeff's disbarment.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Psychology of Letting Go
2.plot: A death provokes a fierce debate about Pierce's religious beliefs. Britta and Annie are at odds over tactics in the Gulf oil spill fund-raising drive.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Basic Rocket Science
2.plot: Jeff and the group must salvage an aging museum exhibit that Dean Pelton wants as the centerpiece of Greendale's proposed aerospace training program.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Messianic Myths and Ancient Peoples
2.plot: Shirley and Abed are at odds over his plan to direct and star in his own epic religious film.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Epidemiology
2.plot: Dean Pelton's army surplus party food sparks an outbreak of zombie-ism at the Greendale Halloween party.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Aerodynamics of Gender
2.plot: Abed endears himself to the girls after he offers to take down their enemies on campus; Jeff and Troy stumble onto a groundskeeper's secret paradise.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Cooperative Calligraphy
2.plot: Annie's missing pen leads to friction within the group.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Conspiracy Theories and Interior Design
2.plot: When Jeff tries to obtain credit for a fictitious class, the unintended consequences rock Greendale. Abed and Troy build an elaborate blanket fort.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Mixology Certification
2.plot: Troy's friends help him celebrate his 21st birthday.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Abed's Uncontrollable Christmas
2.plot: The meaning of Christmas is lost and Abed's intense fixation on the holiday concerns the group in this special stop-motion animation episode.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Asian Population Studies
2.plot: With Chang pressing for membership in the study group, Annie's latest crush has Jeff reeling as Shirley unveils some stunning news.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - Celebrity Pharmacology
2.plot: Pierce's efforts to bribe director Annie may undermine the theater group's antidrug play; Jeff's texting prank puts Britta in an awkward situation.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E14 - Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
2.plot: Abed invites "Fat Neil" to play a game of Dungeons & Dragons with the rest of the study group, hoping to boost his confidence, after Jeff becomes concerned about him being a loner. When Pierce finds out he was not invited, he joins anyway, disrupting their plans.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E15 - Early 21st Century Romanticism
2.plot: On Valentine's Day, Troy and Abed compete for the attention of an assistant librarian, while Britta tries to show she's open-minded about lesbians.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E16 - Intermediate Documentary Filmmaking
2.plot: Claiming that he is about to die, Pierce summons the study group to the hospital to bequeath his belongings to them.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E17 - Intro to Political Science
2.plot: For an upcoming vice-presidential visit, Glendale's Dean Pelton hastily organizes an election for student body president that pits Annie against Jeff.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E18 - Custody Law and Eastern European Diplomacy
2.plot: Although Shirley and Andre don't want Chang involved with her baby, he resolves to be a good dad. Abed and Troy's new friend may be a war criminal.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E19 - Critical Film Studies
2.plot: Jeff and the group arrange a Pulp Fiction birthday party for Abed, but he has his own plans, starting with an expensive dinner for himself and Jeff.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E20 - Competitive Wine Tasting
2.plot: Jeff is suspicious of Pierce's engagement to a pretty classmate. Troy invents a childhood trauma to impress Britta, and Abed challenges a professor.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E21 - Paradigms of Human Memory
2.plot: Working on their final anthropology diorama, Chang finds a cache of items stolen by Troy's monkey that dredge up unhappy memories for the study group.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E22 - Applied Anthropology and Culinary Arts
2.plot: As the semester ends, the anthropology final is disrupted when Shirley goes into labor and her husband, Andre, is summoned to school for the birth.

2.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S02E23 - A Fistful of Paintballs (1)
2.plot: A $100,000 paintball war prize pits members of the study group against one another, until they decide to join forces to stop a mysterious challenger.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E01 - Biology 101
3.plot: As Jeff tries to keep Pierce from rejoining the study group, Dean Pelton faces off with Vice Dean Laybourne for control of Greendale.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E02 - Geography of Global Conflict
3.plot: As Annie competes with an overachieving rival in a Model United Nations competition, Jeff wrestles with his feelings for his ambitious friend.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E03 - Competitive Ecology
3.plot: The study group struggles to incorporate a fellow classmate while working on a project for Professor Kane's class.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E04 - Remedial Chaos Theory
3.plot: When Jeff introduces an element of randomness into Troy and Abed's housewarming party, reality splits into six timelines.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E05 - Horror Fiction in Seven Spooky Steps
3.plot: When a personality test suggests that one group member is a homicidal maniac, they use a series of scary Halloween stories to expose the killer.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E06 - Advanced Gay
3.plot: When a drag queen's song makes Hawthorne Wipes an iconic gay product, Pierce embraces it, until his homophobic dad shows up to squelch the idea.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E07 - Studies in Modern Movement
3.plot: Annie has second thoughts about moving in with Troy and Abed once she realizes that they expect her to live in a blanket fort.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E08 - Documentary Filmmaking: Redux
3.plot: As Dean Pelton films a new commercial for Greendale, the production takes a wild turn once he discovers that a famous alum has agreed to appear in it.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E09 - Foosball and Nocturnal Vigilantism
3.plot: When Shirley agrees to coach Jeff in foosball, they realize that she bullied him mercilessly when they were kids.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E10 - Regional Holiday Music
3.plot: The study group is slowly convinced to fill in for the Glee Club at Greendale's Christmas pageant.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E11 - Urban Matrimony and the Sandwich Arts
3.plot: When Shirley's remarriage to Andre threatens to put her dreams of starting a business with Pierce on hold, Britta steps in.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E12 - Contemporary Impressionists
3.plot: The study group must work as celebrity impersonators at a bar mitzvah to pay off Abed's debt to a talent agency owner.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E13 - Digital Exploration of Interior Design (1)
3.plot: When Britta falls for the human embodiment of the Subway sandwich chain, Shirley and Pierce hope to use the situation to their advantage.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E14 - Pillows and Blankets (2)
3.plot: The students of Greendale are drawn into an epic pillow fight as Troy and Abed start a war that threatens to destroy their unique friendship.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E15 - Origins of Vampire Mythology
3.plot: When a carnival comes to Greendale, Annie goes to great lengths to make sure that Britta doesn't contact her carnival worker ex-boyfriend.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E16 - Virtual Systems Analysis
3.plot: After sending Troy and Britta on a date, Annie volunteers to keep Abed company in his Dreamatorium.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E17 - Basic Lupine Urology
3.plot: When the yam the study group was growing for biology class is killed, Troy and Abed are on the case.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E18 - Course Listing Unavailable
3.plot: After a classmate suddenly dies, the study group decides to host a memorial, but Jeff turns his speech into an angry anti-Greendale rant.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E19 - Curriculum Unavailable
3.plot: After Abed is caught trespassing at Greendale, he and his friends visit a psychiatrist.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E20 - Digital Estate Planning
3.plot: Pierce and his closest friends are summoned to Hawthorne Labs to play a video game that will determine who will inherit his father's fortune.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E21 - The First Chang Dynasty
3.plot: The study group stages an elaborate heist to break in to Greendale and free Dean Pelton from the clutches of Chang.

3.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S03E22 - Introduction to Finality
3.plot: Jeff agrees to represent Shirley in a case against Pierce to determine official ownership of their new sandwich shop.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E01 - History 101
4.plot: As Jeff competes for spots in an overbooked 'History of Ice Cream' class, Abed copes with the looming end of their time at Greendale by retreating into a surreal mental 'happy place', while Annie and Shirley engage in school-wide pranks.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E02 - Paranormal Parentage
4.plot: On the way to a Halloween party, the study group must free Pierce from his panic room and slowly comes to suspect that his mansion is haunted.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E03 - Conventions of Space and Time
4.plot: Troy worries about losing Abed to a fellow Inspector Spacetime fan at a convention for the show, while Annie fantasizes about being married to Jeff.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E04 - Alternative History of the German Invasion
4.plot: The study group contends with a group of German students who take over the study room. Chang makes his return to campus.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E05 - Cooperative Escapism in Familial Relations
4.plot: Britta joins Jeff to see his estranged father on Thanksgiving. Shirley invites the rest of the group to spend the holiday with her judgmental in-laws.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E06 - Advanced Documentary Filmmaking
4.plot: Greendale comes together to get to the bottom of Chang's amnesia, which Abed films as a documentary. Jeff, however, suspects Chang is faking it.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E07 - Economics of Marine Biology
4.plot: Dean Pelton enlists the study group to beautify the campus to woo a wealthy student to Greendale. A class on teaching P.E. pits Shirley against Troy.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E08 - Herstory of Dance
4.plot: Jeff sets out to embarrass Britta when she announces a dance for women's empowerment. Abed dreams of shuttling between two dates in one night.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E09 - Intro to Felt Surrogacy
4.plot: Dean Pelton prompts the study group to use puppets to relive the traumatic events of a recent adventure.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E10 - Intro to Knots
4.plot: Jeff organizes a lovely holiday gathering at his apartment, but Annie secretly invites Professor Cornwallis to get in his good graces.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E11 - Basic Human Anatomy
4.plot: When Annie and Shirley learn that Leonard is actually holding the spot as the class valedictorian, they join forces to bring him down.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E12 - Heroic Origins
4.plot: Abed's research into the study group's history uncovers an overlooked series of chance encounters that led each of them to Greendale.

4.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S04E13 - Advanced Introduction to Finality
4.plot: A plan to celebrate Jeff's early graduation is unexpectedly disrupted by the study group's evil doppelgangers from the Darkest Timeline.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E01 - Repilot
5.plot: With his law practice doomed, Jeff returns to Greendale to start a class action suit against the school, but a hologram of Pierce has him reconsider.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E02 - Introduction to Teaching
5.plot: Abed tackles a two-day crash course on Nicolas Cage, while a clueless Jeff begins his teaching career with Annie as his most demanding student.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E03 - Basic Intergluteal Numismatics
5.plot: With the mysterious Ass Crack Bandit back at Greendale, Annie and Jeff are on the case. As clues and suspicions mount, Shirley delivers shocking news.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E04 - Cooperative Polygraphy
5.plot: Pierce's funeral leaves the study group with mixed feelings, especially after their late tormentor leaves one last test to reveal everyone's secrets.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E05 - Geothermal Escapism
5.plot: For Troy's last day at Greendale, Abed holds a campus-wide "hot lava" fantasy game. With a comic book worth $50,000 as the prize, it's an all-out war.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E06 - Analysis of Cork-Based Networking
5.plot: While Annie and Hickey's fight to get a bulletin board repaired spirals out of control, Abed and Britta go to war over spoilers of his favorite show.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E07 - Bondage and Beta Male Sexuality
5.plot: Jeff counsels a smitten Duncan on how to get a date with Britta but is developing feelings of his own. An angry Hickey tries to teach Abed a lesson.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E08 - App Development and Condiments
5.plot: A new caste system takes over when Greendale beta tests an app that ranks everyone. Shirley loves her new status, but Jeff and Britta want it stopped.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E09 - VCR Maintenance and Educational Publishing
5.plot: Abed and Annie try to solve their new roommate dilemma with a retro VCR game, while Jeff, Shirley and Hickey hatch a plan to sell stolen textbooks.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E10 - Advanced Advanced Dungeons & Dragons
5.plot: To help Hickey be a more involved grandfather, which means patching up a bad relationship with his son, the gang creates an epic role-playing game.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E11 - G.I. Jeff
5.plot: Jeff's depression over turning 40 leads him to drink himself unconscious. In his dreams, he and the gang are part of the "G. I. Joe" cartoon team.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E12 - Basic Story
5.plot: The Save Greendale Committee's success is short-lived when the board votes for a corporate sellout, but Pelton, Annie and Abed might find a solution.

5.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S05E13 - Basic Sandwich
5.plot: To save Greendale from being sold, the gang searches for an eccentric computer science professor's legendary treasure hidden beneath the school.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E01 - Ladders
6.plot: New administrative consultant Frankie's strict — and sobering — changes split the group when Abed goes rogue to side with the enemy.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E02 - Lawnmower Maintenance and Postnatal Care
6.plot: When Dean Pelton loses himself — and a chunk of the college budget — in a virtual reality system, Jeff seeks help from its cantankerous inventor.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E03 - Basic Crisis Room Decorum
6.plot: A rival's attack ad puts the group into defensive mode — and a moral quandary. Britta and Chang find new ways to gross everyone out.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E04 - Queer Studies & Advanced Waxing
6.plot: Dean Pelton's sexuality gives him an uncomfortable edge for a school board seat. Chang scores a surprise win in a stage adaptation of "The Karate Kid."

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E05 - Laws of Robotics and Party Rights
6.plot: When prisoners roll into Greendale via telerobot, Jeff meets his match in a clever convict. Britta's plans for a raging house party backfire.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E06 - Basic Email Security
6.plot: A hacker angry over a racist comic's planned campus performance threatens to publish the activity committee's personal emails.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E07 - Advanced Safety Features
6.plot: Britta's ex-boyfriend, Rick, returns, reigniting her far-fetched dreams of a normal relationship. Annie goes to extremes to win Elroy over.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E08 - Intro to Recycled Cinema
6.plot: A commercial catchphrase catapults Chang to viral fame and a life-changing move. The group bands together to make movie magic for Abed.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E09 - Grifting 101
6.plot: Visiting Professor DeSalvo gives Jeff and his friends a master class in grifting and a bonus lesson on the art of revenge.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E10 - Basic RV Repair and Palmistry
6.plot: A 19-foot plaster hand guides the group on an emotional journey as they travel through mountains and flashbacks while aboard Elroy's RV.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E11 - Modern Espionage
6.plot: Heroes are born, promises are broken and the stakes are raised when paintball makes an explosive return to Greendale's campus.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E12 - Wedding Videography
6.plot: When two Greendale students get married, the wedding reception takes a turn after Jeff unwittingly exposes an inconvenient truth.

6.title: EN - Community [MULTI-SUB] - S06E13 - Emotional Consequences of Broadcast Television
6.plot: The former study group's future — and friendships — are put to a test when one chapter of their lives closes and a new one begins.

meta.plot: Discover Hack My Home! A new reality TV series on Netflix. Join eight families at a crossroads, creatively transforming their beloved homes to fit their changing lives. Premiered on July 7, 2023.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Secret Office Space Reveal
1.plot: To help a couple with four little boys find space for both work and play, the team picks up where a half-finished basement renovation left off.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - Open Concept Overhaul
1.plot: Two chefs fed up with their awkward kitchen layout and lack of storage turn to the experts to create a bigger room they'll actually love to cook in.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Make Room For Four
1.plot: With four granddaughters sharing one loft bedroom in a unique 1970s dome house, a couple looks for a new layout that will reflect their love and care.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - Homeschool Hacks
1.plot: A family about to welcome a new addition is struggling to fit home-schooling into their limited living space. Can the team dig up a solution?

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E05 - Quadruplet Mayhem
1.plot: The design squad's imaginations run wild in an underutilized garage, creating room to grow for a pair of parents and their quadruplet babies.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E06 - Toddler vs. Teenager
1.plot: A musical teen seeks privacy, while her parents long for a more space-efficient kitchen — and the team's hacks are about to make their dreams come true.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E07 - Surprise Bedroom
1.plot: Feeling cramped in a small house and even smaller camper, a travel-loving family of four needs innovations that will give everyone room to spread out.

1.title: Hack My Home [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E08 - Make Space For Family
1.plot: A couple's extended family moves into their home to help run their food truck business, but space is tight. Can the team cook up a better arrangement?

meta.plot: Get hitched or call it quits? Couples put their love to the test — while shacking up with other potential matches — in a provocative reality series.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - The Split
1.plot: Emotions are high--and sparks fly--as the couples part then embark on the ultimate love challenge. Can they pick a new partner, with real potential?

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - The Choice
1.plot: Will attraction evolve into deeper connection? Selecting a live-in match makes for flirty fun--and hurt feelings. Time for a life-changing choice.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - New Bed, New Partner
1.plot: One shock follows another as an honest, tearful outburst leaves everyone speechless. Later, the accelerated trial unions kick off with pillow talk.

1.title: EN - The Ultimatum: Marry or Move On [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - Girls & Guys Night Out

meta.plot: According to the Kuroshitsuji website, there are six OVAs included in the DVD releases. The second DVD features "Ciel in Wonderland (Part 1)," which reimagines the characters of Kuroshitsuji II in an Alice in Wonderland-esque tale inspired by Lewis Carroll. The third DVD, "Welcome to the Phantomhive's," provides a simulation game experience where Elizabeth invites a lady to attend a ball at the Phantomhive mansion. The fifth DVD, "The Making of Kuroshitsuji II," is a Hollywood-style documentary with behind-the-scenes interviews with Sebastian, Ciel, Claude, and Alois. "Ciel in Wonderland (Part 2)" again incorporates the characters of Kuroshitsuji II into a Lewis Carroll-inspired setting and is featured on the sixth DVD. On the eighth DVD, "The Tale of William the Shinigami" showcases William and Grell as they lead new shinigami training sessions and reminisce about their partnering years. To conclude, the ninth DVD, "The Spider's Intention," highlights the Trancy household and their care for Alois.

meta.plot: In Victorian London, 12-year-old business magnate Ciel Phantomhive thwarts dangers to the queen as he's watched over by his demon butler, Sebastian.

In his past life, he was known as Demon Lord Varvatos, an all-powerful magic user and ruler. But he was lonely after the loss of his friends and loved ones during his rise to power, so in his dying moments, Varvatos cast a reincarnation spell so that he'd get a second chance at just being a normal guy. At first it looks like that's going to work – he's reborn thousands of years later as villager Ard. Unfortunately for him, his memories are still intact and he's not aware just how much has been lost over the time he spent not existing, and it looks like that's going to cost him his normal life.
