3.plot: A team of improv teachers, a trio of best friends, and three roommates put their skills to the test in the hope of scoring the $10,000 prize.

meta.plot: Junkers turn into jewels when they're in the hands of these pros, who bring cars from Mexico to El Paso for radical restorations.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E01 - The Opel and the Bug
1.plot: With a $250K profit goal and only four months to reach it, the scouting team acquires three cars from Mexico that may be tougher than expected to flip.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E02 - Less Mustang, More Problems
1.plot: A seller has a secret reason for insisting on driving a '64 Comet. Scooter and Rabbit use high tech to eye a vintage Bronco, and get a shocking greeting.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E03 - Bronco No Bueno
1.plot: With the Bronco gobbling up their profit, Jenicio has a marketing idea for the '49 Cadillac. Rabbit and Scooter have a mystery on their hands.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E04 - Carryall, My Wayward Son
1.plot: Jaime and Wes bring a '63 Carryall into the 21st century and Scooter finds the perfect '80s car for his idol. Rabbit gets a game-changing lead.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E05 - Don’t Rocket ‘Til You Try It
1.plot: The Camaro IROC-Z gets a killer sound system, but Wes and Jaime have a few kinks to work out for their rock star buyer. Later, Jaime ponders her future.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E06 - Not Your Daddy's Oldsmobile
1.plot: After a team meeting, Mike adds extra help to turn a rotting Cutlass 442 into a hotrod. The hunt for a Rambler turns up a tip on a racing rarity.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - Rambler and a Gambler
1.plot: Scooter makes up for his blunder with a big score and Mike restores a Dodge van's retro vibe. A buyer proposes a newfangled way of paying for a car.

1.title: EN - Tex Mex Motors [Multi-Sub] - S01E08 - Should We Stay or Should We Go
1.plot: The shop needs a name before Rabbit and Scooter can make a TV ad. After the clock ticks down on the Porsche auction, Jaime reveals her big decision.

meta.plot: Talented designers from around the world compete for $250,000 and the chance to become the next big thing in fashion.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Red Carpet
1.plot: In it to win it, 18 designers pair up to concoct fabulous red-carpet looks. Will they go glam or "hooch-wench" for Monique Lhuillier and Eva Chen?

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Prints & Patterns
1.plot: Go big and bold -- or go home? Prints polarize the contestants as they break out new patterns and reflect on their origins with judge Prabal Gurung.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Suit
1.plot: Charged with making a chic suit in a day and a half, the designers scramble to realize their visions for judge Phillip Lim, despite some bloody drama.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Streetwear
1.plot: Urban reality meets next-level fantasy in a streetwear round. Just be careful not to trip on those great expectations in front of Kerby Jean-Raymond.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Underwear
1.plot: After a cliffhanger elimination, the hopefuls strip it down and amp up the seduction with lingerie and underwear. Model Adriana Lima judges.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Rock
1.plot: Goth, grunge, punk: Attitude is everything as the designers flirt with danger (read: leather) and flaunt fake fur for Christopher Kane and Beth Ditto.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Activewear
1.plot: Big changes call for major moves when the contestants design activewear that's fit for both workouts and runways. Josefine Aberg of Adidas judges.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Military
1.plot: With boots on the ground and the clock ticking, the designers march out military-inspired looks for Public School's Maxwell Osborne and Dao-Yi Chow.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Denim
1.plot: For the semifinals, the competition turns to a durable classic: denim. But the final four must stretch like never before to impress Tommy Hilfiger.

1.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Finale
1.plot: The ultimate: Create a dream collection of 10 looks in only three days. After a gauntlet of challenges and emotions, who will be named Next in Fashion?

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Royalty
2.plot: Twelve designers settle into the workroom to create royalty-inspired looks, hoping to be crowned the winner by fashion industry icon Donatella Versace.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Wear The Earth
2.plot: Two teams let their imaginations bloom to make living looks that incorporate flowers and plants for supermodel judge Helena Christensen.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Thrift
2.plot: In a whirlwind challenge, designers have only four hours to craft fresh designs from thrifted pieces. Internet personality Emma Chamberlain guest judges.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Childhood
2.plot: Producing grown-up looks inspired by their childhood photos proves emotional for some contestants in a challenge judged by designer Isabel Marant.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Collaboration
2.plot: The designers pair up to wow Balmain's Olivier Rousteing with coordinated looks, and learn that creative chemistry can make or break a collaboration.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Met Gala
2.plot: Riffing on the theme of camp, the designers create over-the-top ensembles worthy of a Met Gala red carpet for guest judge Bella Hadid.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Swimwear
2.plot: Pairs of contestants dive into a rapid-fire swimwear challenge to create two suits that will impress model and designer Candice Swanepoel.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - Everything Old Is New
2.plot: Tan and Gigi fire up their time machine, sending designers to past decades to find retro inspiration for contemporary looks. Hailey Bieber judges.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Transformation
2.plot: The final four pull out all the stops to design two-in-one pieces that can transform in an instant, with actor Ashley Park of "Emily in Paris" judging.

2.title: EN - Next in Fashion [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - The Finale
2.plot: Three finalists have a chance to showcase their artistry and talent with a full collection of new styles — but only one can walk off the runway a winner.

meta.plot: Follows the dangerous work of logger and sawmill owner Kevin Wenstob as he and his crew go to extremes to keep the family sawmill, and their way of life, alive.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Ain't No Mountain High Enough
1.plot: Kevin negotiates a deal with a new customer who drives a hard bargain while Erik struggles to fix the mill's broken log loader. Meanwhile, Sarah catches an interloper at the mill.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Bridge Over Troubled Water
1.plot: A sudden disaster threatens to shut down Kevin's timber claim and his sawmill.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Don't Rock My Boat
1.plot: Kevin faces a cavalcade of disasters when his logging operation is shut down, his main client threatens to walk and he argues with his right-hand man.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Should I Stay or Should I Go Now
1.plot: Kevin is forced to make a tough call to make up for lost time on his mountainside timber claim. Additionally, his barge Tetanus is slowly sinking.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Sink or Swim
1.plot: Kevin and his wife Sarah take on a special order to find a special fir tree for a sailing school that's rebuilding a rare replica of a schooner.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Gonna Build a Mountain
1.plot: Kevin finds himself in a battle of wits against an opposing crew that's trying to thwart his plans t expand his sawmill.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Have You Ever Seen the Rain
1.plot: Thunder and lightning threaten logger Kevin Wenstob’s crew, as they shift into high gear on his high mountain timber claim.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Hazy Shade of Winter
1.plot: Logger Kevin Wenstob gets terrible news as his crew struggles to bring the last of their 200 truckloads of logs off the mountain before winter shuts them down.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Hot Fun in the Summertime
1.plot: Spring is here, and with just weeks to finish logging before he has to give his timber claim back, Kevin invests money he doesn’t have on big plans to get the job done - but when everything starts to go wrong, he’s not sure he’ll make his deadline.

1.title: EN - Big Timber [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Best Laid Plans
1.plot: As the clock counts down on the end of Kevin’s timber claim, he’s pulling out all the stops and calling in favours from friends and family to get every last log off the mountain side before it’s too late.

meta.plot: 'Tis the season for five returning artists to fill the hot shop with festive designs. One will win cash for the stocking — a merry Christmas indeed!

1.title: EN - Blown Away: Christmas [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Santa's Elves
1.plot: Back in the hot shop, the challengers turn warm memories of past gifts into sculptures, including a charming nutcracker and a vibrant solar system.

1.title: EN - Blown Away: Christmas [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Festive Food
1.plot: The contenders re-create favorite holiday foods such as pumpkin pie and Japanese bento as mouthwatering masterpieces. It's a feast for the eyes.

1.title: EN - Blown Away: Christmas [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Oh Christmas Tree
1.plot: Time to trim the tree! The artists hustle to craft sets of unique, meaningful ornaments: some traditional, some minimal and some quite whimsical.

1.title: EN - Blown Away: Christmas [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Winter Wonderland
1.plot: The finalists fill the gallery with epic winter wonderland installations. It's the merry moment of truth: Who will be named best in glass?

meta.plot: Former NFL player and "Bachelor" star Colton Underwood embarks on a journey to embrace his new life as an out member of the LGBTQ community.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Family
1.plot: Colton’s next chapter begins as he opens up to his mom and plans for more conversations. Also, friend and Olympian Gus Kenworthy offers his advice.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Football
1.plot: As Colton preps to speak to his high school coach, former NFL players Michael Sam, David Kopay and Esera Tuaolo share their stories as gay athletes.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Friends
1.plot: In Nashville, Colton bonds with country radio host Cody Alan, but the pressure of mixing and mingling at a party gives him pause.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Church
1.plot: Colton reflects on his relationship with God, shares his truth with faith-based friends and connects with members of the Metropolitan Community Church.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Public
1.plot: After a series of private conversations, Colton decides to publicly come out on TV. In NYC, he visits the historic Stonewall Inn with his dad and Gus.

1.title: EN - Coming Out Colton [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Past & The Future
1.plot: A wave of backlash serves as a painful reminder of Colton's past choices. In response, he turns to friends and mentors to pave the way toward healing.

meta.plot: Paris Hilton can cook...kind of. And she’s turning the traditional cooking show upside down. She’s not a trained chef and she’s not trying to be. With the help of her celebrity friends, she navigates new ingredients, new recipes and exotic kitchen appliances.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Breakfast in the Clouds with Kim Kardashian West
1.plot: A heavenly brunch with a nod to classic cereals awaits. Longtime bestie Kim Kardashian West drops by to reminisce — and bring order to Paris' kitchen.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Taco Night with Saweetie
1.plot: An evening with rapper Saweetie flows with margaritas, shrimp tacos, flan-topped cake — and highlights the dangers of using a blender while drinking.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Vegan Burgers and Fries with Nikki Glaser
1.plot: Paris and comedian Nikki Glaser get down and dirty with meat-free burgers and vegan fries and milkshakes for an unforgettable diner experience.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Italian Night with Demi Lovato
1.plot: Singer Demi Lovato helps Paris dream up her own signature Italian dish. Disaster strikes, but pink and sparkly unicorn-inspired cannolis save the day.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Get Over It Holiday Feast with Lele Pons
1.plot: Brining and stuffing a traditional turkey sounds beyond disgusting, but the glitzy results are beyond rewarding for Lele Pons and her friends.

1.title: EN - Cooking with Paris [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Family Steak Night with Kathy and Nicky Hilton
1.plot: Truffles, gold flakes, caviar! Paris goes all out for a luxurious steakhouse dinner — gilded onion rings and all — with Kathy and Nicky Hilton.

meta.plot: Iwatani Naofumi, a run-of-the-mill otaku, finds a book in the library that summons him to another world. He is tasked with joining the sword, spear, and bow as one of the Four Cardinal Heroes and fighting the Waves of Catastrophe as the Shield Hero. Excited by the prospect of a grand adventure, Naofumi sets off with his party. However, merely a few days later, he is betrayed and loses all his money, dignity, and respect. Unable to trust anyone anymore, he employs a slave named Raphtalia and takes on the Waves and the world. But will he really find a way to overturn this desperate situation?

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Shield Hero
1.plot: College student Iwatani Naofumi is reading a book titled "The Records of the Four Cardinal Weapons" in the library when he is suddenly summoned to another world and told he has to save the world as the Shield Hero, one of the Four Cardinal Heroes. And one morning, he finds all his money and equipment gone.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Slave Girl
1.plot: Naofumi follows the slave merchant to his store, where he looks for a partner to act as his sword. But all he has the money to buy is a diseased demi-human girl named Raphtalia, whom he then forces into an incredibly harsh battle.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Wave of Catastrophe
1.plot: Naofumi has obtained a whole load of abilities and skills, and his teamwork with Raphtalia is reaching perfection, too. To prepare for the incoming Wave, he upgrades their equipment and heads to the dragon hourglass to find out exactly when it will arrive. But there, he runs into Motoyasu and the other heroes once again.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Lullaby at Dawn
1.plot: The Wave is gone, but Naofumi's relief is short-lived as Motoyasu challenges him to a duel in the middle of the celebratory banquet held in Melromarc Castle. Motoyasu insists that owning a slave is unbecoming for a hero and that Naofumi free Raphtalia at once.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Filo
1.plot: After Aultcray reluctantly offers Naofumi a paltry reward, he heads to the slave merchant to redo the slave crest as per Raphtalia's wishes. He also buys a monster egg there, which hatches a few days later and gives him a new party member. Meanwhile, Myne shows up in Lute Village, where they're staying.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - A New Comrade
1.plot: The mysterious girl that showed up out of nowhere was actually Filo. She's a filolial queen with an advanced transformation ability, and she can even take human form thanks to it. However, her clothes get ripped every time she transforms, meaning Naofumi has to get her some magic clothes if he doesn't want to go broke. The party leaves on a new adventure to gather the materials required.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - The Savior of the Heavenly Fowl
1.plot: After hearing of a village that's in immediate need of herbicide, Naofumi and his party head there to do business. The village has been overrun by plants that have turned into monsters, and its residents were forced to abandon it. These plants can even take root in humans, and apparently Motoyasu is the one who released them into the wild.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Curse Shield
1.plot: After hearing of a village in the East that's being ravaged by an epidemic, Naofumi and his party head there to deliver medicine. The epidemic was caused by the corpse of a dragon that had been killed a month before and left there to rot. Naofumi's party accepts a job request to clean the corpse and head to the mountains where it lies.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Melty
1.plot: In the Eastern village, Naofumi meets a girl named Melty. She instantly becomes friends with Filo and then requests to accompany the party on their journey. It seems she got separated from her guards. They travel together for a while, but when they reach the capital, they find...

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - In the Midst of Turmoil
1.plot: After refusing to hear Melty out, Naofumi switches to planning for the next Wave. When a bunch of young soldiers ask to join his party, he agrees, but on a certain condition. At the same time, he also tries to upgrade Raphtalia's class after she hits the level cap, but all he receives is harassment.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Catastrophe Returns
1.plot: Naofumi faces another Wave, this time in a remote village. With the help of the soldiers who volunteered to join him, he's able to secure the safety of the villagers, but the Wave shows no signs of letting up. He heads to fight with the other heroes, only to find a giant ghost ship floating in the sky.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Raven Invader
1.plot: A mysterious woman showed up out of nowhere and destroyed the second Soul Eater in a single blow. She then proclaimed the start of the "true battle of the wave" and blew away the other three heroes when they attacked her. With Naofumi's party proving ineffective as well, he decided to use the Rage Shield one more time.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Devil of the Shield
1.plot: Naofumi foils the attempt to take Melty's life and fights off the royal knights, but he's then framed for abducting Melty and killing several knights, so the party is forced to go on the run. With security tightened and checkpoints everywhere, the party receives a further blow that only makes things even worse.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Everlasting Memory
1.plot: Due to Myne recklessly starting a forest fire, Naofumi and his party are forced to flee to a village at the base of the mountain. However, it won't be easy to break through the knights' net. Melty suggests going to a noble she knows for help, and it just so happens that Raphtalia's past is linked to his domain.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Raphtalia
1.plot: Raphtalia corners Idol with vengeance in her eyes, her bloodthirsty blade reaching for his throat. Naofumi's words bring her back to her senses momentarily, but when Idol attacks her once again...

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Filolial Queen
1.plot: As Naofumi and his party try to get the weakened kids to safety, Tyrant attacks them. Once Naofumi realizes that he's actually after Filo, he hatches a plan to lure him outside the city, but they can't even put a scratch on its massive body.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - A Promise Made
1.plot: Fitoria tells Naofumi that she'll kill all Four Cardinal Heroes if they don't get back on the same page. She even takes Melty hostage, but Naofumi continues to refuse. Understanding where he's coming from, Fitoria instead proposes a one-on-one duel with Filo.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - A Conspiracy Linked
1.plot: Naofumi decides to go straight up to the checkpost in order to talk it out with the other heroes. But there, he finds the one guy least likely to listen to him, Motoyasu, who attacks Naofumi without bothering to listen to what he has to say. Why could Motoyasu be so intent on killing Naofumi, more than ever before?

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - The Four Cardinal Heroes
1.plot: The Pope holds in his hands the ultimate weapon, which possesses the properties of all four cardinal weapons. Faced with its attack skill, "Judgment," and its powerful defensive force field, Naofumi and gang are rendered helpless. As the crisis worsens, Motoyasu, who is now in line to be punished as a "fake" hero, makes a surprising decision.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Battle of Good and Evil
1.plot: Naofumi and gang stay on the attack despite being trapped in the Pope's Great Cathedral, but its sacred subspace nullifies his Curse Shield, leaving them one step short. Naofumi turns to another, newly unlocked Curse Shield, but the dragon's wrath threatens to swallow his mind whole.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Naofumi's Triumphant Return
1.plot: After Naofumi survives thanks to Mirelia's help, she comes to visit him and tells him the truth behind the summoning of the heroes and the discrimination against the Shield Hero. She also promises to clear his name, and holds a trial for Aultcray and Myne's crimes.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Four Heroes Council
1.plot: After being unable to for so long, Naofumi finally gets to upgrade his party's classes. He then takes part in a meeting of the Four Cardinal Heroes, held under the guise of a celebratory banquet. There, he learns of the existence of a bonus stage, with increased XP earnings. Meanwhile, Raphtalia gets into a fight at the party.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Cal Mira Archipelago
1.plot: On the ship to Cal Mira, Naofumi once again runs into L'arc, who keeps throwing him off. However, the strange man's friendly nature shines through, and Naofumi quickly takes a liking to him. After having a fun time grinding levels and a lively meal, Naofumi feels happy and fulfilled for the first time in this world.

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Guardians of Another World
1.plot: Melromarc brings a large fleet to fight the Wave out at sea. While the queen takes charge and leads the operation well, the other three heroes prove useless yet again, leaving Naofumi to do it all alone. Later, he gets help from L'arc and Therese to fend off the monsters, but then...

1.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S01E25 - The Rising of the Shield Hero
1.plot: It turns out that Glass, like L'arc, is also a hero from other world. Naofumi barely fights off their combo attacks and then corners Glass in a one-on-one battle, but is then faced with an all-important question: does he truly wish to protect this world?

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - A New Roar
2.plot: Mysterious monsters appear as Naofumi is preparing for the next Wave. At the same time they show up, the Wave countdown stops. The Queen summons the Four Cardinal Heroes, and tells them that the Spirit Tortoise has revived.

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Footprints of the Spirit Tortoise
2.plot: The leaders of all the nations’ militaries gather in the Spirit Tortoise Kingdom. Naofumi is there as well, and promises to offer his help as one of the heroes. But just before they decide on a plan, a mysterious woman appears…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - Shaking Land
2.plot: The Spirit Tortoise begins its march once more, appearing at the border of the kingdom bearing its name. Naofumi volunteers to lure away its familiars while the army tries to bring it to the mountains. The Spirit Tortoise’s familiar, Ost, fights alongside the humans…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Ruins in the Fog
2.plot: The Spirit Tortoise’s head was cut off, but Ost, its familiar, is still alive. It could revive at any moment. The allied armies need to get back into fighting shape, and fast. Naofumi makes the risky move of heading onto the Tortoise’s back with only a small group, and tries to find its true weak spot.

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Ost Hourai
2.plot: Naofumi is met by L’Arc, Glass, and Therese. They’re after the person who broke the Spirit Tortoise’s seal and is controlling it. L’Arc proposes teaming up again…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - Racing to Catch Up
2.plot: Fitoria appears when the Spirit Tortoise revives, and with her help, Naofumi attempts to destroy its heart and cut off its head at the same time. L’Arc arrives as well, but all of them are helpless before Kyo’s overwhelming power.

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Infinite Labyrinth
2.plot: Naofumi wakes up in a strange prison to find him and his party at level 1, and Filo missing. They start to raise their levels in order to escape, but things quickly turn against them when a dangerous monster suddenly appears…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - A Parting in the Snow
2.plot: Naofumi’s party heads for the Dragon Hourglass of Mikakage, in order to get to Sikul, the country that summoned Kizuna. Along the way, he sells rare healing items to make a hefty profit. He hears a rumor about a genius mage…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - Humming Fairy
2.plot: Naofumis party is teleported to Sikul, where Kizuna introduces the Vassal Weapon Hero, Ethnobalt. He soys he can use a piece of Raphtalia's hair and Naofumis blood as a catalyst that can create a shikigami to find her. He creates the shikigami, and they find.

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - Katana Hero
2.plot: Raphtalia is imprisoned in a Raybul Kingdom prison. She’s wary of L’Arc’s team, who is also imprisoned there, but asks them for help in escaping. Glass is weakened by the draining power of the prison. Raphtalia has a plan to escape, but…

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Kizuna
2.plot: Naofumi's party is overjoyed to be reunited with Raphtalia. Kizuna criticizes Glass for invading another world. Glass and L'Arc swear they won't fight Naofumi anymore, and instead find another way to solve their problem. Meanwhile, Kyo's plot proceeds.

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Reason to Fight
2.plot: The Wave appears before its scheduled time. Kizuna's group is teleported to it while Naofumi and his party head for Kyo's lab on Ethnobalt's ship. There, they see the true depths of Kyo's wickedness...

2.title: EN - The Rising of the Shield Hero  [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - Flowers Offered in Recollection
2.plot: Raphtalia recalls having to buy clothing for her smaller self. Kizuna remembers being alone for so long. Rishia remembers Ost trying to give advice.

meta.plot:
Ah, high school. Is there any better place to start fresh after a horrible middle school relationship? Nope! Not unless your ex ends up at the same school as you and is now your stepsibling. What was supposed to be a sanctuary of peace where I could avoid ever seeing her again has become a living nightmare! Everywhere I look, I see her—in my house, in my school, in my class. There's no escape! She even claims that she's the older sibling. Like hell she is!

But I won't lose to her. After all, I'm the older brother in this new family situation. That's right, we're family now. No matter how much we may have thought we loved each other before, we saw one another's true colors and realized we weren't meant for each other. That's why even though we may keep up a buddy-buddy sibling act for the sake of our parents, things will never go back to the way they used to be.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Former Couple Refuses to Say...
1.plot: Mizuto and Yume used to date, but now they've suddenly become stepsiblings. Both of them agree that they don't want to do anything that'd disappoint their newly remarried parents. However, neither of them can accept the other as being the eldest sibling in the relationship. So they both agree to settle the matter with a game. Whoever does something in conflict with what people might consider normal sibling behavior, loses. Making them the younger sibling.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - My Ex Needs Taking Care Of
1.plot: After entering high school, Yume was making an effort to change her personality and looks in an attempt to reinvent herself as a model student. It was all so far so good, but there was one thing she couldn't change about herself. She was never very athletic. On the day of the physical fitness test and body measurement check at school, a melancholy Yume is approached by Minami Akatsuki, a girl from the same class. Meanwhile, Mizuto is as disinterested as ever...

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - My Ex Has a Confession to Make
1.plot: It's nighttime at the Irido residence. Yume has somehow found herself with Mizuto's boxers in her possession. If Mizuto were to find out, it would almost certainly mean she would have to face the punishment of admitting to being the younger sibling. Hoping to avoid this outcome, Yume waits for Mizuto to fall asleep before heading to the bathroom to return his underwear to the laundry basket. But who does she pass in the hallway, but a bewildered Mizuto, mouth agape, with Yume's very own bra dangling from his grasp.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - That's Not What You're Supposed to Say
1.plot: As punishment for the underwear incident, Mizuto demands Yume go on a date with him. Yume is taken aback by the sudden development, but little did she know that it was all part of Kawanami Kogure's devious plan, a plan to shatter Minami Akatsuki's delusional dreams of marrying Mizuto only to become Yume's doting little sister. And how else to do it but to show her that Yume only has eyes for Mizuto?

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Former Couple Spends the Night
1.plot: It's Mother's Day, so Yume and Mizuto go out to buy a gift together. Their mother, Yuni, is overcome with happiness to receive a gift from the two of them. Seeing how happy it made her, Mizuto wonders if it'd be nice to give their parents some time to be newlyweds together. However, there isn't much they can do for them on a high schooler's budget. So Mizuto suggests that he and Yume spend the night somewhere instead.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The Former Couple Goes Head-to-Head
1.plot: The first midterms of the school year are upon them. Once the top scoring student in the school's entrance exam and now a talented student at the top of her year, Yume is anxious to defend her position as a model student. She is displeased, however, to discover Mizuto’s relaxed approach to studying. The two later butt heads again, over something Mizuto did during their Japanese exam. Yume berates Mizuto for his actions while Mizuto retaliates in kind.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Higashira Isana Doesn't Know What Love Is
1.plot: Due to their mutual interest in light novels, Isana considered Mizuto a dear friend. However, Yume and Akatsuki make her realize that her feelings for him may run much deeper than that. Now aware of her true feelings, Isana wishes to become Mizuto's girlfriend. Unfortunately, he doesn't seem to be reacting to her advances. Yume and Akatsuki try to give her advice, but it doesn't quite go according to plan.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - The Former Couple's On Edge "I've Already Been Rejected, So It's Fine."
1.plot: Isana is coming over to the Irido house this weekend to hang out with Mizuto. Suspecting that she may not know how to properly dress for the occasion, Yume and Akatsuki invite Isana out to go clothes shopping the day before. Unfortunately, however, every outfit she tries on ends up looking inappropriate due to the size of her breasts. Akatsuki suggests that she try on something with a softer silhouette similar to Yume's usual style, seeing this as an opportunity to pick out new clothes for Yume to try on too. Yume then reminisces about a date she had in middle school.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Youthful Indiscretion
1.plot: We are brought back in time to when Yume and Mizuto were once a couple. A time when neither of them could control their nerves in what was their first ever relationship. Having already held hands and kissed before, the young couple are eager to take the next step. Spring break passes, however, with neither able to make the first move. Upon entering their third and final year of middle school, the two are regrettably put into separate classes. Alas, unable to spend as much time together as before, they both begin to grow apart.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - The Former Couple Doesn't Know How to Act "Aren't You Two Acting a Little Awkward?"
1.plot: It's Yume and Mizuto's first summer together as stepsiblings. Their parents are unable to return home one night due to a typhoon. Now alone in the house together, trouble arises when Yume spots a certain creepy crawly in her room. On another day, Mizuto accompanies Yume clothes shopping for a swimsuit in preparation for an upcoming family trip to the countryside. It's in situations like these that the two seem to be finding themselves reminiscing about the past more and more...

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Former Couple Visits Relatives "I Guess You Could Say She Loved to Laugh"
1.plot: The Irido family go to the countryside to visit relatives. There, Mizuto shows Yume the first book he ever read on his own, his great-grandfather's autobiography. Reading it prompts Yume to ask him what kind of person his first love was. The description he gives, that she was someone who loved to laugh, leads her to believe his first love must have been none other than his second cousin, Madoka.

1.title: EN - Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Bestow Unto You My First Kiss
1.plot: Still in the countryside visiting relatives, Yume and Mizuto head to the local summer festival together. In high spirits from getting to see him in his yukata and seeing how Madoka and Chikuma interact as siblings, Yume boldly takes his hand in hers as they walk around the festival stalls. During their outing, Yume begins to get a picture of how Mizuto was as a child. And in doing so, realizes just what his meeting her meant to him.

meta.plot: At a high school full of unique characters, Tadano helps his shy and unsociable classmate Komi reach her goal of making friends with 100 people.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - It's just, I wish I could speak.
1.plot: It's Tadano's first day of high school and all he wants to do is blend into the background. He starts to get to know Komi, a quiet girl in his class.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - It's just a childhood friend. Plus more.
1.plot: To help Komi make more friends, Tadano tries to enlist the help of a talkative classmate who's friends with everyone, but they promptly turn him down.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - It's just stage fright. Plus more.
1.plot: A nervous girl named Himiko Agari's anxiety levels go through the roof when Komi starts silently staring at her in a very intense way.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - It's just a physical. Plus more.
1.plot: During the school health checkup, competitive classmate Yadano is determined to clock better results than Komi, whom she sees as her ultimate rival.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - It's just my summer uniform. Plus more.
1.plot: Komi wonders why everyone starts staring at her when, like the rest of the student body, she switches from her winter to her summer school uniform.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - It's just a joke. Plus more.
1.plot: When Tadano gets to school, he finds Komi waiting for him in the classroom. She then nervously hands him a letter.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - It's just the pool. Plus more.
1.plot: Komi spends a lot of time getting ready for her trip to the local pool with Tadano and Najimi. Once they're there, they bump into even more friends.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - It's just Obon. Plus more.
1.plot: It's the Obon holidays, and Komi is visiting her grandma's house. She can't help but feel a little awkward around her extended family.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - It's just a country kid. Plus more.
1.plot: It's the first day of the new semester and everyone is happy to see Komi again, but then a student named Inaka starts to follow her around.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - It's just sports day. Plus more.
1.plot: On the school sports day, Komi isn't sure how to properly cheer for her classmates, but she does her best. Then, it's her turn to run the relay race.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - It's just a performance for the culture festival. Plus more.
1.plot: The students of class 1-1 have to decide what they're going to do for the culture festival — a task they're all taking way too seriously.

1.title: EN - Komi San Wa Komyushou Desu [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - It's just the culture festival.
1.plot: At the culture festival, Najimi is up to something. They try to rope Komi and Tadano into their scheme.

meta.plot: Hyakkaou Private Academy. An institution for the privileged with a very peculiar curriculum. You see, when you're the sons and daughters of the wealthiest of the wealthy, it's not athletic prowess or book smarts that keep you ahead. It's reading your opponent, the art of the deal. What better way to hone those skills than with a rigorous curriculum of gambling? At Hyakkaou Private Academy, the winners live like kings, and the losers are put through the wringer. But when Yumeko Jabami enrolls, she's gonna teach these kids what a high roller really looks like!

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Woman Called Yumeko Jabami
1.plot: Reigning class gambling champion Mary attempts to hustle unsuspecting transfer student Yumeko Jabami into a high-stakes game of rock-paper-scissors.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - The Boring Woman
1.plot: Mary is relegated to the lowest levels of the gambling hierarchy after her loss. Student board member Itsuki challenges Yumeko to a game of pairs.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Slit-Eyed Woman
1.plot: To regain her status, Mary duels student board member Yuriko in a game of "life or death." With Mary's crushing defeat, Yumeko offers to play next.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Woman Who Became Livestock
1.plot: Yumeko and Mary square off against two others in a game of Indian poker after being given a chance to minimize their colossal gambling debts.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Woman Who Became Human
1.plot: Kiwatari continues to lose as Yumeko and Mary bluff their way through the game, but the final outcome all comes down to Tsubomi.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Tempting Woman
1.plot: Yumeko must face Beautification Committee Chair Midari in an ESP card game involving Russian roulette before playing the student board president.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Refusing Women
1.plot: Deeply engaged in their deadly ESP card game, Midari tells Yumeko about her heated match against student board president, Kirari.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Love-Dancing Woman
1.plot: In Kirari's absence, pop idol sensation Yumemi offers to play against Yumeko, asking her to wager total control of her life.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Dreaming Woman
1.plot: With her pop idol career on the line, an enraged Yumemi seeks to ruin Yumeko after a scandalous voice recording is used as a bargaining chip.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Selective Woman
1.plot: Yumeko's odds are stacked against her when she challenges the well-funded student board treasurer, Manyuda, in an original game of poker.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - The Woman Who Bets Her Life
1.plot: Itsuki, no longer wanting to be under Manyuda's control, offers to bankroll 100 chips after Yumeko goes all-in and loses on the previous hand.

1.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Gambling Woman
1.plot: Yumeko and student board president Kirari both wager self-expulsion from the academy as Ryota becomes the key to the final outcome of their game.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E01 - Compulsive Gambling Girls Redux
2.plot: Erimi challenges Yumeko and Midari to a brutal game involving a sadistic finger-slicing contraption.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - The Momobami Clan Girls
2.plot: The Momobami clan becomes upset when Kirari announces that the election winner will take over as leader of their family.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - The Untouchable Girl
2.plot: With election committee chair Runa Yomotsuki presiding, former Vice President Ririka pits Miyo and Miri against Yumeko.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - The Connected Girls
2.plot: Playing in Yumeko's place, Mary orders Ryota to show his cards; Miyo tries to convince Ryota to keep his cards to himself.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - The Changing Girl
2.plot: To gain more chips, Yumemi ropes Yumeko into joining her; a Hollywood star's entry raises the stakes.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - The Hollywood Girl
2.plot: Outwitted by Kawaru Natari during the first round, Yumemi goes all-in for the second round.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - The Traitorous Girl
2.plot: With Kirari rapidly collecting votes, Yumeko and the other players gamble amongst themselves to boost their chip count, or lose it all.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Undefeatable Girl
2.plot: Accused of treachery, Yumeko threatens to throw the game; to test Manyuda, Itsuki decides to take a major risk.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - The Adjacent Girl
2.plot: With everything they each hold dear on the line, Sayaka challenges Yumeko to a game.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - The Logical Girl
2.plot: Sayaka uses logic to advance; Yumeko's curiosity sways her to take an alternate route.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - The X Girl
2.plot: A select group of contestants are invited to bid in an auction; Yumeko changes the rules by offering the unimaginable.

2.title: EN - Kakegurui [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - The Zero Girl
2.plot: A hostile Rei declares that she will win the election and take over, but Yumeko stands in her way.

meta.plot: All thanks to the special ability that he developed, Yuu was able to  cheat his way into a very prestigious high school. With his power, he  thought nothing was going to stand in his way, until he met a mysterious  girl named Nao Tomori and other students with special abilities just like him. It was the beginning to a new life.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Think of Others
1.plot: A small percentage of adolescents have onsets of special abilities. Yu Otosaka deftly uses an ability that takes over a target's body for five seconds to live the school life of an honor student, and gets accepted into a prestigious high school. Just when Yu is about to live a stable life in high school, a girl named Nao Tomori appears before him...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Melody of Despair
1.plot: Yu unwillingly acts together with the student council and runs amok to secure individuals with special abilities. This brings to light why Tomori is determined to fulfill student council duties in face of danger - a past involving a cruel destiny that awaited an ability wielder.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Love and Flame
1.plot: Information concerning a new ability wielder reaches Yu and the active student council members. In their search of an individual with two abilities of soul possession and pyrokinesis, Yu and company comes across a particular pop idol.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Moment of Earnest
1.plot: The information of an ability wielder that Kumagami relays to the student council on the day Yusa transfers into Hoshinoumi Academy points to a high school baseball pitcher that Tomori already had her eyes on. His ability is telekinesis. Against a pitcher that uses his ability to pitch what could be called diabolical balls, the Hoshinoumi Academy student council challenges him to a game of baseball to make him stop doing so.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Sound Heard Sometime In the Past
1.plot: With the information from Kumagami as a hint, the student council members continue a stakeout in the middle of the mountains where a wielder of a special ability supposedly hangs out. As they spend their time barbecuing and fishing, Yu comes across the music of ZHIEND through Tomori's music player. And, the one that appeared in front of them as they continued the stakeout...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Happiness Never Noticed
1.plot: The location of the new ability wielder according to Kumagami was the condo where Ayumi was currently home with a cold. Ayumi tells Yu and Tomori who came to see how she was doing about the nightmare that she had. Tomori, thinking that the dream's details can be a hint in figuring out Ayumi's ability, tells Yu to draw out the contents of Ayumi's dream from her...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Beyond the Escape
1.plot: Yu, crestfallen by the fact that he lost his little sister Ayumi, shuts himself alone inside his home and cuts all communication with the outside world. Denying even the worried student council members that came to check on him, Yu leads a dissolute life only to find appearing before him...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Chance Meeting
1.plot: Yu, starting to accept Ayumi's death, attends school for the first time in a while. There, he finds comfort in a school life that has not changed from before. Then, he ends up having to attend a ZHIEND live gig alone with Tomori, but on the way back home from school that day, he bumps into a foreign-looking woman carrying a white cane.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - A World That Doesn't Exist Here
1.plot: Yu ends up heading to a ZHIEND live gig alone with Tomori. The gigs starts and the audience heats up, but Yu feels a strange feeling within his heart...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Plunder
1.plot: Yu's big brother Shunsuke has the power to leap through time, but has lost his eyesight from utilizing this ability repeatedly, and is no longer able to use his power. So, now Yu must take his big brother’s place and save Ayumi.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Charlotte
1.plot: Kumagami and Medoki appear before Yu Otosaka after he successfully rescues Ayumi. Within the laboratory facilities that they take the siblings to, Yu finds out the reason behind the outbreaks of special abilities. Kumagami then gains information regarding a new ability wielder and heads to Hoshinoumi Academy, but...

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Promise
1.plot: The friends from student council and Ayumi come visit Yu who is hospitalized from his injuries. Among them is Tomori. During his conversation with Tomori, Yu makes a certatin decision.

1.title: EN - Charlotte [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Memories to Come
1.plot:
The decision that Yu makes is to plunder the ability of every last wielder of a special ability on Earth.

It is a choice that provides salvation to every ability-wielder, but at the same time, it is a choice that makes Yu pay a huge price in return.

meta.plot: Young Tatsumi travels to the capital of the Empire in order to earn money for his starving people and encounters a world of unimaginable depravity, dominated by the ruthless Prime Minister who controls the child Emperor. Tatsumi is recruited by Night Raid, a group of assassins dedicated to eliminating corruption by mercilessly killing officials and privileged nobles.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Kill the Darkness
1.plot: Tatsumi leaves his village in pursuit of wealth and success in the Imperial Capital. He attempts to join the army, however it isn't as easy as it seems. When all of the sudden, a large breasted woman shows up at the local bar and offers to help him get recruited.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Kill the Authority
1.plot: Tatsumi is taken by the Night Raid. They realized his potential as an assassin and asks him to join, but Tatsumi is conflicted. Though after learning more about each of Night Raid's team members, he learns of their objectives to defeat evil and corruption and eventually decides to join.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Kill Your Cares
1.plot: The Night Raid's hideout is invaded by intruders! The assassin clan was able to drive out the enemy without a problem. Tatsumi experiences the true intensity of the Night Raid for the first time and he is thrilled.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Kill the Imperial Arm Users
1.plot: The target this time is the capital's rumored phantom serial killer known only as Zank the Executioner. Just like the Night Raid, he is an Imperial Arms user as well.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Kill the Dream
1.plot: Sheele, who has no particular role in the hideout is assigned as Tatsumi's trainer. She explains how and why she chose assassinating as her career. Tatsumi, who still doesn't have an Imperial Arm of his own, tests out the Imperial Arm taken from Zank.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Kill the Absolute Justice
1.plot: Night Raid is tasked with the eradication of a drug trafficking organization within the Imperial City. Tatsumi and Leone head towards the red light district. The two learn of the horrific details of the organization and their rage is apparent. Meanwhile, Sheele and Mine go after the Tybil, former leader of the organization when they suddenly feel an alarming presence.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Kill the Three (1)
1.plot: General Esdeath arrives at the capital and is brought to the Emperor to discuss annihilating Night Raid. The Emperor wants to reward her for her services but her request is somewhat surprising.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Kill the Three (2)
1.plot: Tatsumi and Bulat stand before the Three. Among them is Bulat's former leader, Liver. The battle quickly turns into a one-on-one combat between Bulat versus Liver and Tatsumi versus Nyau.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Kill the Battle Fanatic
1.plot: Tatsumi inherits Bulat's Imperial Arms Incrusio after defeating the Three and vows to become even stronger. Mine's attitude towards Tatsumi seems to show a change after seeing his dedication during training... Meanwhile, General Esdeath receives news of the Three being defeated and in order to reinforce the army's strength she organizes a special police force of Imperial Arms users known only as the Jeagars.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Kill the Temptation
1.plot: Esdeath has taken Tatsumi after winning the combat tournament. And the reason being... love at first sight?! That being said Tatsumi has not only been forced to become Esdeath's lover but also an auxiliary member of the Jaegers. Tatsumi and Esdeath observe as the Jaegers raid the bandits' hideout; he witnesses how powerful the Jaegers truly are. All the while Tatsumi tries to find an opportunity to escape and return to the Night Raid's hideout...

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Kill the Mad Scientist
1.plot: Dr. Stylish discovered Night Raid's hideout as he followed Tatsumi. A battle quickly commenced between Night Raid and Dr. Stylish's fortified army who struck with a surprise attack. Tatsumi and Mine are enraged as they see Kakusan equipped with Sheele's Imperial Arms Extase. A fierce battle continues within the hideout when suddenly something came down from the Sky...

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Kill the Newcomers
1.plot: After dealing with Dr. Stylish's attack Night Raid leaves their base and hides in the mountains. After welcoming the newly joined member, Night Raid experienced a brief moment of peace, even amid training. Mine, who has been teased relentlessly Chelsea, the newcomer, tells Tatsumi and Lubbok that she wants revenge.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - Kill the Nuisances
1.plot: A new species of Danger Beasts have emerged and has been terrorizing the vicinity of the capital. Minister Onest has ordered Esdeath to seize and defeat them. Esdeath leads the Jaegers to go to deal with them. But something suspicious in the shadow is keeping an eye on their actions. Meanwhile, after Night Raid settles into their new hideout, they're also on the move to deal with the new Danger Beasts.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - Kill the Giant Danger Beast
1.plot: Tatsumi and Esdeath meet again by chance while exterminating Danger Beasts. Esdeath is pleasantly surprised at the unexpected reunion while Tatsumi is overwhelmed. Even while fully immersed in the joy of their reunion, Esdeath notices that a man's been watching them from the shadows.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Kill the Religious Organization
1.plot: A widely accepted religious organization among the civilians known as the Path of Peace is quickly gaining more followers. It is rumored that they will cause an armed uprising in an attempt to fight against the corrupt government.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Kill the Puppets
1.plot: In order to combat the Jaegars, Night Raid is separated into two groups. Tatsumi and Akame are to deal with Bols, Kurome, and her puppets. The battle proves to be difficult as Kurome's Imperial Arms Yatsufusa has the ability to freely control the dead.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Kill the Curse
1.plot: After being cornered by Akame and Leone, Bols sets off an explosion and flees. While he is trying to get back to his comrades, he runs into a hurt girl who is crying. Meanwhile, Kurome's medicine starts wearing off and she starts remembering her days with Akame as well as their sad goodbye, while stumbling through the mountain. While leaning against a tree eating snacks, someone approaches her...

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - Kill the Demon
1.plot: Borick is scheming to take over a religious faction, and Night Raid heads to Kyoroch, where that religion has its headquarters. The Jaegars also head to Kyoroch to act as bodyguards for Borick. Wave is worried about Kurome, who still hasn't healed from her wounds. Night Raid safely infiltrates Kyoroch, however they must now face Borick's own appointed guards, the Four Koukenji Rakshasa Demons.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - Kill the Fate
1.plot: Night Raid continues to work on their plan to assassinate Borick in Kyoroch. Tatsumi and Mine wander around the city, but then end up running into Seryu, who is responsible for Sheele's death. Mine decides to end things once and for all with her, while Tatsumi fights Suzuka from the Four Demons.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Kill the Carnage
1.plot: Kyoroch is freed because of Night Raid, which strengthens the Revolutionary Army's power. In this dire situation, Commander-in-chief Budoh and the minister's son, Shura, join the fight against Night Raid. Meanwhile, Night Raid infiltrates the capital yet again. Tatsumi and Lubbock go after Minister Onest in the palace by sneaking in with the help of one of the Revolutionary Army's spies.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Kill the Despair
1.plot: In order to instill fear into the hearts of those among the Rebel Army, the capital has spread the word that Tatsumi will be executed publicly. Night Raid receives notice of this and intends to rescue him.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Kill the Little Sister
1.plot: Following Tatsumi's capture, Night Raid successfully defeated Commander-in-Chief Budou but at the cost of Main and Susanoo's lives. The Revolutionary Army surrounds the capital as the civilians start to riot. Wave is confounded by what he sees as Ran calmly observes how everything unfolds. Meanwhile, Kurome senses that the end of her life is drawing near and seeks to settle things with her older sister once and for all.

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - Kill the Emperor
1.plot: The Revolution finally reaches its final phase; Night Raid is en route to assassinate Minister Onest, the root of the problem. All goes according to Najenda's plan as the Revolutionary Army successfully invades the city. Night Raid arrives at the Palace where the Emperor and Minister are located. Unlike the panicked Emperor, the Minister is composed and confident as they prepare to unleash their trump card. As the palace trembles, something appears from below...!

1.title: EN - Akame ga Kill! [MULTI-SUB] - S01E24 - Akame ga Kill!
1.plot: The empire's army has been defeated and all that remains is the empire's strongest, General Esdeath. Akame and her sword stand in Esdeath's way as she desires to continue breeding war. The two face one another. The final battle begins. What will the result bring forth? A new kingdom where the citizens can live in peace or will there be more bloodshed...?

meta.plot: Fourteen-year-old Iruma Suzuki has just been abandoned and sold to a demon by his irresponsible parents! Surprisingly, the next thing he knows he's living with the demon who has adopted him as his new grandson and has been transferred into a school in the Netherworld where his new demon grandfather works as the principal. Thus begins the cowardly Iruma-kun's extraordinary school life among the otherworldly as he faces his true self, takes on challenges, and rises to become someone great.

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Iruma-kun from Demon School
1.plot: Suzuki Iruma is too nice and just doesn’t know how to say no. One day, he somehow gets dragged into the netherworld where the demons live. He arrives at the great demon Sullivan’s mansion where he is asked to do the unthinkable... and ends up becoming Sullivan’s grandson! He is quickly enrolled into the Demon School Babyls where Sullivan serves as chair-demon. Iruma begins his super exciting school life at demon school while trying to conceal the fact that he’s a human!

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Familiars Summoned!
1.plot: Iruma, who is going to Babirusu, wants to spend calmly so that he will not be noticed by humans. However, the entrance ceremony and a case with the entrance examination chief Asmodeus Alice have already attracted the attention of the students! First-year students Iruma and others decided to participate in the "Familiar Summoning Ceremony" event to determine the rank of the devil. The person in charge is Naverius Caluego, an extremely strict instructor in Babiru's. What kind of familiar is Iruma summoned?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Iruma and Clara / Demon Friends
1.plot:
Part A: Iruma and Asmodeus encounter a rather strange girl named Valac Clara. Because of her friendly yet strange demeanor, some students seem to be taking advantage of her...

Part B: Iruma had become closer to both Asmodeus and Clara. They started picking him up from his house to walk to school together and Iruma was still trying to get used to demon life. One day at lunch, some kids try to pick on Iruma, but...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - The Misfit Class
1.plot: Iruma, Asmodeus, and Clara end up in the Misfit Class. As the name suggests, the class is filled with a bunch of misfits and Sabnock Sabro, who wants to become the next Demon King, declares Iruma his rival. Their classes start and their first lesson is a flying race. The race was to take place in the Warbling Valley and the Cutthroat Valley. Apparently, there’s also a demon bird that lives there...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The One Who Wants to Be Demon King
1.plot: The Misfit Class is in the middle of a flying race in order to determine their ranks. Since Iruma is human, he can’t fly, so he’s riding on the back of the giant baby demon bird, but it seems to be flying off course. Meanwhile, Sabnock decides to go through the treacherous Cutthroat Valley and ends up having to battle it out with the Guardian there. Sabnock is obsessed with becoming the next Demon King, but why is he so obsessed? Are Iruma and Sabnock going to be able to make it out of Cutthroat Valley alive?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Ameri's Theory
1.plot: Iruma obtains the Gluttonous Feeder ring which feeds upon the magical powers of others. Iruma is still doing everything he can to not stand out at school, but an incident occurs in class involving the ring, which ends up bringing even more attention to him again. Meanwhile, a certain demon was wondering if Iruma was actually human. That demon just happens to be the student council president, Azazel Ameri. But there’s a very unique reason that makes her think Iruma is human...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - First Love Memories
1.plot: The one who had bumped into Iruma in the hallway was Ameri, who had been convinced that Iruma is human. When they bump into each other, Iruma finds out that Ameri has a shojo manga from the human world called “First Love Memories.” “First Love Memories” is considered forbidden texts in the netherworld. Ameri desperately wants to know what they’re saying in the manga so she asks Iruma to read the text for her, which would also prove that he’s human. Thus, began Iruma and Ameri’s live readings!

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Head Over Heels for Clara
1.plot: Clara isn’t amused at the fact that Ameri keeps summoning Iruma. To try to get Iruma to pay attention to her again, Clara starts to take succubus charming lessons with the succubus teacher Raim. Clara wants to get Iruma’s attention again, but apparently her sexiness is almost nonexistent. Even then, Clara sets out to charm Iruma. Will she be able to win Iruma over?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Iruma's Decision and Hard Work
1.plot: After making a promise with Ameri, Iruma sets out to try to move up a rank. Iruma finds out that there is a promotion exam in a week where they would play execution cannonball, and he also finds out it’s rather similar to a game they play in the human world. Iruma decides to train after he realizes he’s far weaker than anyone else in his class. Iruma decides that he’s not going to use magic, so he starts an intense training regimen with Opera. What does Iruma gain at the end of all this training?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Fierce Battle, Execution Cannonball!!
1.plot: The day of the rank promotion test involving execution cannonball had arrived. Iruma is ready for the match, but then ends up on different teams with Asmodeus. Despite that, the game continues with all his other classmates using their various forms of magic to play the game. Will Iruma be able to show off the results of his training?! And who will win? Iruma or Asmodeus?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Together with Familiars!
1.plot:
Part A: A new teacher named Balse Robin, who is quite innocent and fearful of nothing, arrives! His first lesson involves interacting with familiars. Iruma turns pale at the thought of this lesson since his familiar happens to be Kalego, but...

Part B: Iruma decides his next goal now that he’s moved up a rank. Apparently, there are groups at Babyls where like-minded demons gather called Battlers. Iruma shows some interest in Battlers, but then is greeted by a terrifying sound...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - The Rookie Hunt!!
1.plot: The Battlers’ recruiting operation, the Rookie Hunt, had begun. The seniors all come out to try to find worthy first-years to join their groups. What takes place is an immense battle! Iruma and his friends somehow make it through, but then decide to check out the various Battlers on campus. But then suddenly, Iruma’s ring goes berserk, causing him to run into a senior...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - The Magical Apparatus Battler
1.plot: Iruma runs into his senior Amy Kiriwo in front of the Magical Apparatus Battler again. The Magical Apparatus Battler room is filled with all kinds of strange gadgets. There, Iruma hears about Kiriwo’s dreams. Babyls is about to hold their annual Battler Party where all the new students get to promote the Battler they joined. Sullivan looks forward to seeing Iruma-kun but while he’s at the Thirteens’ Dinner...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E14 - The Battlers' Presentation
1.plot: Sullivan is apprehended by the Demon Border Patrol on suspicions of unlawfully entering the human world. He still hopes to somehow make it to the Battler Party to see his precious Iruma-kun... Meanwhile, Iruma had no idea what was going on with Sullivan and was preparing for his presentation for the Battler Party. After going through several ideas, they decide to create things called fireworks that are supposedly from the human world and they spend the night at school to create them. And so, began the fun sleepover for the MagiApp Battler kids.

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E15 - Kiriwo's Secret Room
1.plot: Iruma and the others continue to prepare for the Battler Party. The launchpad for the fireworks is almost complete, so Iruma goes to look for Kiriwo. Suddenly, Iruma’s ring starts dragging him and is led all over Babyls until he finds a mysterious hidden room. Kiriwo was behind those doors planning a certain project. We also find out exactly who Kiriwo had been talking to on the phone. What does Iruma find in the mysterious room?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E16 - Party Eve
1.plot: Kiriwo’s dream: To make a world where all demons would be equal, even if they didn’t have that much magical powers. Iruma completely agreed with this statement, so he proposed they shoot for the grand prize at the Battler Party. If they’re able to get the grand prize, everyone, including high-ranking demons, would see how hard Kiriwo and the Magical Apparatus Battler worked. All the Battlers are getting their presentations ready for the Battler Party on the day of the Party Eve. But suddenly, the fireworks shell that Iruma and others prepared suddenly goes missing...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E17 - Run, Iruma, to Kiriwo!
1.plot: Suddenly, all of Babyls is surrounded by invisible walls! On top of that, they are unable to get a hold of the outside and there are invisible walls that popped up all over the school. Amidst all the chaos, Kalego and the other teachers have the students take shelter in the central plaza. Since Kiriwo is missing, Iruma decides to go look for him with the help of Asmodeus and Clara. Will Iruma be able to find Kiriwo?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E18 - What I Want More Than Anything
1.plot:
Kiriwo’s plan to destroy Babyls continues to move forward. Iruma somehow made it to the hidden room. Kiriwo looks completely different than what Iruma is used to, and Kiriwo proclaims that he’s going to use the fireworks that the Magic Apparatus Battler created to blow Babyls up...

Kiriwo then tells Iruma about his childhood. Iruma sees the true demon side of Kiriwo. Will he be able to save Babyls from this crisis?

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E19 - I Want to Pick Everything Up
1.plot:
Part A: When Iruma woke up, most of the ruckus was already over. Sullivan tells Iruma that Kiriwo had been arrested. What happened when the giant fireworks went off?

Part B: The ordeal at Babyls comes to an end. The Battler Party is finally about to start! The students all do their best in order to get the Grand Prize, and the students' families come by to enjoy the festivities!

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E20 - Glorious Award / Treatment of Humans
1.plot:
Part A: The ceremonies to give out the prizes for the Battler Party has now begun. Iruma and the other members of the MagiApp Battler hope to get the Grand Prize! That was also what Iruma had promised Kiriwo. Who will the prize go to?

Part B: Iruma happens to stand out more after the incident with the fireworks. The head of the Demon Border Patrol, Azazel Henri, begins to suspect that Iruma may actually be human and he visits Babyls. Wait, this all seems rather familiar...

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E21 - Dem-dol Kuromu-chan!
1.plot: One of the most popular idols in the netherworld, Kuromu-chan, holds an all-day concert at the Makubari Dome. Dem-dols have the important job of helping demons release the stress and evil desires they feel during their Evil Cycle. Kuromu was considered a shining new star in the field, and her tickets would usually sell out in one day. But she actually had a secret that she couldn’t tell anyone... Iruma just happened to be lucky enough to get tickets for her concert and takes Asmodeus and Clara with him!

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E22 - Sparkling Shock
1.plot: Kuromu’s true identity happened to be Crocell Keroli from the Misfit Class! The more Keroli talked to Iruma, the more she became jealous about how popular he is, and she ends up collapsing. There was no way that Keroli could continue with the concert, but she had a reason she could not cancel the concert. In order to somehow still make the concert at Makubari Dome a success, Iruma and his friends do something rather surprising!

1.title: EN - Mairimashita Iruma kun [MULTI-SUB] - S01E23 - You Fit Right In Now, Iruma-kun
1.plot: Iruma had finally started getting used to his life in the netherworld. As he continues having fun with his classmate, he begins to wonder if he should really be allowed to stay in the netherworld. Seeing that Iruma seems troubled, Asmodeus and Clara decide to cook for him. But Clara’s mother’s recipe is filled with items that even Asmodeus doesn’t know about. The two end up having a cooking competition. Which dish will Iruma choose?

meta.plot: The world's number one assassin has been reincarnated as the eldest son of a family of aristocrat assassins. In exchange for being reincarnated in another world, a goddess has imposed upon him one condition. "Kill the Hero who is prophesied to destroy the world." This was to be the mission in his new life. The synergistic effect of the vast knowledge and experience he gained that made all manner of assassinations possible in the modern world, and the secret techniques and magic of the fantasy world's most powerful family of assassins turn him into the greatest assassin of all time.

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Quantum of Trust
1.plot: Pretty young girls have been captured and are being sold off at an illegal auction. Marquess Collide is engaging in human trafficking, and all her buyers are evil nobles as well. By royal order, Lugh the assassin, Dia the mage, his assistant Tarte, and Maha the intelligence expert begin their investigation of Marquess Collide. However, Dia is captured by Marquess Collide and put up for auction--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Deal of Reincarnation
1.plot: The world's finest Assassin accepts the Goddess' request to assassinate the Hero. After defeating the Demon Lord and saving the world, the Hero will then use his power to destroy the world. The Goddess wants the Assassin to be reincarnated in another world and assassinate the Hero in order to save it. After being betrayed and killed by his client in his previous life, the Assassin accepts her offer in order to relive his life in a new world, but--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Magic of Bonds
1.plot: Lugh's magic teacher is a pretty girl named Dia. Being a few years older than Lugh, Dia treats him like a younger brother and sneaks into his bed every night in order to sleep next to him. Because he needs her to teach him magic, Lugh can't complain, but gradually he and Dia grow closer--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Plan of Goddess
1.plot: The goddess is formulating a plan to stop the Hero's rampage. After defeating the Demon Lord and saving the world, next he will use his power to destroy the world. The goddess has decided to summon the souls of professionals from other worlds and reincarnate them. She summons the soul of the world's finest special forces soldier who excels in combat and asks him to defeat the Hero, but--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Qualifications of Assassins
1.plot: Officially a family of renowned doctors and assassins behind the scenes, the house of Tuatha Dé is the right hand of the kingdom. Trusted to become his father's heir, Lugh assists his father with his mission. However, there are those who are displeased by Lugh's success. Lugh defends his status in a challenge against them--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Residence of Girls
1.plot: A group of girls were toughing it out despite their impoverished circumstances. Though they had nowhere to live, they ran a business and enjoyed their lives together. However, an orphanage captures the girls and forces them to move into the facility. Motivated by subsidies, the orphanage puts the girls to work and even has them work as ladies of the night--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Life of Falsehoods
1.plot: Lugh heads to the neighboring kingdom of Swoigel. Once a month, he travels to the Viekone region in order to visit Dia. During his visit, together Lugh and Dia develop new spells. Meanwhile, left back home by themselves, Tarte and Maha hold a tea party together. While Lugh is gone, they have a fun time preparing a special meal together, but--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Rites of Choice
1.plot: With the success of his cosmetics brand Orna, by acquiring financial power and the Balor Trading Company's information network, Lugh has gained even greater strength as an assassin. However, since being reincarnated in this world, Lugh still has not completed a proper assassination. Then, Lugh's father Cian tells him that he doesn't have to become an assassin--

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Compensation of Assassination
1.plot: Lugh receives a request for assassination. He takes Talt with him and goes to a commercial city, Pisaal. He decides to gather information beforehand to justify whether the target needs to be assassinated. Once there, Lugh saw the suffering of the people that was caused by his target. It's a tragic sight as a young child is forced to sell drugs while her mother was emaciated and was also addicted to it. Thus, Lugh formulates an assassination plan based on the information that Maha had collected. He was successful in killing for the first time in this life, though he soon felt the weight of his action and became emotional after witnessing the wife of the target grieving.

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - First of Dates
1.plot: In front of Lugh and Talt who've just finished a magical training camp in a deserted island, Maha appeared with information. It's about Swoigel kingdom being engulfed in a civil war. Lugh heads toward Dia, but Viecone territory seemed peaceful as always. Lugh was still worried, but Dia ignored him and suggested to go on a date instead.

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Choice of Betrayal
1.plot: Lugh got a assasination request for Dia. And the principal is Count Viecone, who is Dia's father and Cian's old friend. Cian expects Lugh can finish the assasination. But if he refuses it, Cian will do it with his own hands.

1.title: EN - Sekai Saikou no Ansatsusha [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Battle of Assassin
1.plot: Lugh and Dia's father come up with a plan to fake Dia's death and safely sneak her into to the Tuatha Dé region. Unfortunately, the arrival of Setanta MacNess thwarts the plan before they can enact it. As Setanta is the wielder of Gae Bolg, Lugh knows that he will not survive a direct confrontation with him, so he fires a magnetically propelled tungsten projectile into the atmosphere and stalls Setanta long enough for it to obliterate him. Afterwards, the Tuatha Dé family adopts Dia under the guise of being Lugh's younger sister, completing the mission. Sometime later, Lugh receives word that the Hero, Lord Epona Rhiannon, has arrived in the Alvan Kingdom.

meta.plot: Holmes, a young man whose family runs an antique shop in Kyoto, has the unique ability to read people and instantly distinguish genuine and high value antiques. When a local high school student, Aoi Maki, starts working alongside Holmes, together they begin to unravel the many mysteries surrounding the antiques brought to the shop.
