2.plot: The Soul Society is observing a sudden surge in the number of Hollows being destroyed.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E02 - Foundation Stones
2.plot: Arrancars Nel Tu and Pesche Guatiche have come to seek Ichigo’s help explaining that Hueco Mundo is under attack by an unknown enemy. Unable to ignore the situation, Ichigo and his friends decide to set out for Hueco Mundo.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E03 - March of the Starcross
2.plot: Ichigo and his friends arrive in Hueco Mundo to confront Quilge Opie and learn that their latest enemy are Quincies.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E04 - Kill the Shadow
2.plot: The Wandenreich mobilizes its elite force, the Stern Ritter, to annihilate the Soul Society. Creating massive flaming pillars of Reishi as a distraction, the Stern Ritter easily enter the Soul Society to bring carnage to the Soul Reapers.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E05 - Wrath as a Lightning
2.plot: Quilge Opie uses his power to imprison Ichigo inside the Garganta. As he tries to break free, Ichigo begins to hear, through his Soul Phone, the screams of the Soul Reapers falling to the enemy's onslaught.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E06 - The Fire
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto confronts Yhwach for the first time in a thousand years. As Yhwach finally draws his sword against Genryusai, the Soul Reapers notice an abnormal change taking place across the Seireitei.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E07 - Born in the Dark
2.plot: Shigekuni Genryusai Yamamoto learns that the Yhwach he defeated was an impostor. The real Yhwach then reveals himself and easily kills Genryusai, sending a wave of shock and devastation across the Soul Reapers.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E08 - The Shooting Star Project [Zero Mix]
2.plot: Rescue efforts are being made across the Seireitei to find and help those who've survived the Stern Ritter attack. Meanwhile, Ichigo meets with Mayuri Kurotsuchi about fixing his broken Tensa Zangetsu.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E09 - The Drop
2.plot: Squad Zero brings Ichigo back to the Royal Palace to prepare for the coming battle. Meanwhile, Kyoraku is appointed as the new Head Captain to lead the Thirteen Court Guard Squads.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E10 - The Battle
2.plot: Kenpachi Zaraki removes his eye patch to fight Retsu Unohana, a.k.a. Yachiru Unohana, “The First Kenpachi.” Meanwhile, Ichigo and Renji head to Hoohden to meet Oh-Etsu Nimaiya, the man who is said to have created the Zanpakuto.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E11 - Everything but the Rain
2.plot: Ichigo is kicked out of the Royal Palace by Oh-etsu Nimaiya for failing his test. When Ichigo next opens his eyes, he finds himself standing in front of his house in the World of the Living.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E12 - Everything but the Rain: June Truth
2.plot: Squad 10 Captain Isshin Shiba of the Thirteen Court Guard Squads decides to not report his encounter with the Quincy named Masaki Kurosaki in the World of the Living to the Head Captain.

2.title: EN - Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War [MULTI-SUB] - S02E13 - The Blade Is Me
2.plot: Ichigo learns that he is the child born of a Soul Reaper and a Quincy. Finally understanding the truth behind his heritage, Ichigo decides to return to Hoohden with a renewed resolve to finish what he has started.

meta.plot: Rejoignez Gobo, Maggie, Wembley, Béa, Boubeur et de nouveaux amis fraggle dans des aventures drôles et épiques où l'enchantement naît de la passion et de l'amour pour notre monde interconnecté.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: To prove he's brave enough to accompany Uncle Matt to Outer Space, Gobo leads the gang on a daring adventure to the Crevice of Solitude.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E02 - Red and the Big Jump
1.plot: During a diving game, Red pressures Wembley to the point that he's literally frozen in fear. A run-in with Junior Gorg changes Red's perspective.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E03 - The Merggle Moon Migration
1.plot: After a bizarre dream, Mokey decides to follow her “inner map” to a once-in-a-generation event, only to land in the dangerous Echo Chamber.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E04 - The Glow
1.plot: Boober feels painfully different after discovering his baloobius glows, but a visit from the majestic Archivist helps him embrace his uniqueness.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E05 - Four Wembleys and a Birthday
1.plot: Wembley tries to make everyone happy on his birthday by doing the activities they suggest all at once, causing him to split into multiple Wembleys.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E06 - The Legend of Icy Joe
1.plot: During the First Frost, Gobo and Wembley retrace the trek of a heroic adventurer and learn she may not be quite what they expected.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E07 - Flight of the Flutterflies
1.plot: Jamdolin and the Troubadours visit the Rock for New Day's Day. Boober wrestles with his anxiety when he finds himself at the center of the action.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E08 - Craggle Lagoon
1.plot: The gang heads to Craggle Lagoon for their first vacation, but the lagoon's water is gone. Inspector Red springs into action to find the culprit.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E09 - The Giggle Gaggle Games
1.plot: Determined to make the displaced Craggles feel at home in Fraggle Rock, Mokey insists on playing wild games with their new guests.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E10 - Wembley the Spokesfraggle
1.plot: Fast-talking Doozer Jack Hammer picks Wembley as the spokesfraggle for the new Doozer sticks. Wembley finds himself at a crossroads.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E11 - Deep Dive
1.plot: Red finds the pond is too full of goo to dive, so she tries zip-vining and hurts her baloobius. Mokey tries to help Red find a new outlet for her energy.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E12 - Into the Trash
1.plot: When Marjory falls ill, Boober is called to a special task: venture into the deep mountain of trash in order to heal her.

1.title: FR - Fraggle Rock : l’aventure continue - S01E13 - All of Us
1.plot: To bring water back to Fraggle Rock and set things right, Gobo convinces the gang to work with an unlikely ally.

meta.plot: At Eden Hall, each glass has a story. A quiet bar lies tucked away in the streets of Tokyo, and it seems only the most desperate souls burdened by their own troubles manage to find its doors. But after a glass of God poured by the brilliant bartender Ryu, they leave renewed. Ryu has a gift—he knows how to soothe the soul with the perfect drink. Who will he meet next?

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - A Gentle Perch
1.plot: The workers of the Business Planning Division for Hotel Cardinal are desperate to find a bartender. The chairman has declared that they must find someone capable of making the "Glass of God." This is no simple task when they have no idea what that means.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Old Pal / One for the Road
1.plot: Ryu encounters an impossibly difficult-to-please customer while he's helping out at another bar. When a foul-mouthed customer wanders into Edenhall, Ryu will have to think outside the box and even the bar to serve her.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - The Perfect Taste
1.plot: Award-winning bartender Kuzuhara Ryuichi finds himself in an impromptu bartending competition with Sasakura Ryu at the prodding of Chairman Taizo. A young woman comes to Edenhall, determined to see how Ryu mixes a B&B.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - A Bar's Secret Ingredient / The Face of a Martini
1.plot: Desperate to recruit a chef of French cuisine with unreasonable standards, Kamishima turns to Ryu for help. Kyoko returns to Edenhall for bartending advice once again. This time, Ryu takes her to a bar he visited as an apprentice.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The First Drop
1.plot: Ryu, Kyoko, Yuri, Miwa, and Chen get together to visit the "holy ground of Japanese whisky," Yamazaki Distillery. While they're there, they learn about Chen's past and his relationship to the area.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - The True Face
EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Bartender's Resolve
1.plot: In the wake of the trip to Yamazaki Distillery, Chen decides he wants to spend his life as a bartender. However, his father is still determined to make him his heir. Chen turns to Ryu for help.

1.title: EN - BARTENDER Glass of God [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - A Challenge
1.plot: The Cocktail Award finals have come, and the bartenders have gathered to test their mettle. Each of the competitors brings not only their cocktails to compete but their stories as well.

meta.plot: Takumi, a gifted chef, just landed a new job. He works at the Astro Manor apartment building that offers breakfast, and there he encounters the beautiful landlady—Mira. It’s love at first sight, and he hopes to charm her, but the quirky tenants and bizarre phenomena don’t make it easy. He even learns by pure chance that Mira is secretly an alien! Will their love survive these unearthly oddities?

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Takumi reports to his job interview venue, expecting it to be a fancy restaurant. What he finds there, however, is a rundown share house and its wacky inhabitants.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Takumi tries to make sense of what he heard Mira say, but his efforts to figure it out only make the confusion worse. Meanwhile, Astro Lodge gets a pair of mysterious visitors.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Shoin's appearance causes a big fuss among all the residents of Astro Lodge, except Ren, who is more worried about his field trip.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Takumi hatches a plan to catch the breakfast thief, only to fish up more than he bargained for!

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Takumi can't get over the shock of what he saw, while Tomihiro has concerns about the magazine Ren's hiding from him.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The letter from Mira's mother tells all about her connection with Shimotakaido Tasuke, which leads the gang to try to learn more about him in earnest.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Takumi and Aoi head to the Insect Festival, only to be roped into an unexpected event supposedly involving the key Mira's looking for.

1.title: EN - Astro Note [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Ren is on the prowl for proof of Naosuke’s deception, and the Hubby spy is on the prowl for keys of all kinds! How will the gang navigate these two crises?

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Rabbit Town
1.plot: Michiru can't prove she was human without her stolen student ID, so she heads to Rabbit Town to retrieve it. Shirou meets with the mayor.

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Rhino Melancholy
1.plot: The mayor asks Shirou to investigate a series of bombings. Michiru talks her way into joining him, with the goal of protecting a medical center.

1.plot: Using an illegal SIM card, Michiru befriends influencer Nina, who's fascinated by humans. The two of them sneak out to a party in the human world.

1.plot: After a visit from Boris, Yaba morphs into an uncontrollable beast form. The mayor tells Michiru the true history of the silver wolf.

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Human Scapegoat
1.plot: While Shirou investigates what happened to Yaba, Michiru sneaks into the Sylvasta medical center after seeing Nazuna kidnapped once again.

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Rabid Wolf
1.plot: Shirou and Michiru set out to subdue another monstrous beastman. After Sylvasta's machines interfere, Alan tells them about Nirvasyl Syndrome.

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - A Beastly Feast
1.plot: Nazuna decides to reveal she's human during her concert. While the mayor escapes detention in Japan, Shirou and Flip put their own plans into action.

1.title: EN - BNA [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Anima-City
1.plot: The mayor proves that a serum based on Michiru's blood cures Nirvasyl Syndrome, but Alan moves forward with his plan to "solve" the beastman problem.

meta.plot: After 25 years of his record-breaking solo career, Robbie looks back on his younger self and reflects on a lifetime spent in the spotlight.

1.title: EN - Robbie Williams [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Part One: Let's Get Wrecked
1.plot: After achieving fame with Take That at just age 16, Robbie struggles with addiction as he records the solo album that transforms him into a superstar.

1.title: EN - Robbie Williams [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Part Two: Nobody Someday
1.plot: Stardom and success wreak havoc on Robbie's personal life. As the paparazzi track his every move, his relationships and mental health suffer.

1.title: EN - Robbie Williams [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Part Three: Close Encounters
1.plot: At the peak of his career, Robbie sets out on a massive European tour — but back home, the British tabloids continue to wage war against him.

1.title: EN - Robbie Williams [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Part Four: Cut The Circuit
1.plot: Having hit rock bottom, Robbie finds redemption where he least expects it. An emotional reunion with old friends reignites his passion for performing.

meta.plot: Kyotaro Ichikawa, a boy barely clinging to the bottom rung of his school's social ladder, secretly believes he’s the tortured lead in some psychological thriller. He spends his days dreaming up ways to disrupt his classmates' peaceful lives and pining after Anna Yamada, the class idol. But Kyotaro's not nearly the troubled teen he pretends to be…and it turns out Anna's a bit odd herself!

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - I Was Stolen Away
1.plot: At first glance, he’s just the disturbed boy, and she’s just the popular girl. But people are more than the sum of their parts, as both Kyotaro and Anna are about to discover.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - I Died
1.plot: Despite his misgivings, Kyotaro keeps helping Anna the more they interact. He may be a better person than he believes.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - I Want to Hug You
1.plot: Anna and her friends keep their guard up around the boys; it’s obvious what they want. But Kyotaro’s different. Each brief interaction brings him and Anna closer together.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - I Have a Problem
1.plot: Like many people his own age, Kyotaro has a tendency to overthink everything. Anna, however? She has her own way of approaching life.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - We Got Split Up
1.plot: It’s not like Kyotaro wants to join Anna’s group or anything. But when a certain other classmate tries to join the group, Kyotaro just gets swept up in events. That’s all!

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - I Melted It
1.plot: As Kyotaro wrestles with his feelings, he notices Anna’s been acting differently. Could it be that she—? No, he shouldn’t read too much into it. She’s just being nice. Right?

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - We Swapped Places
1.plot: Kyotaro can no longer deny he likes Anna. He tells himself it’s not like he wants to be her boyfriend, but there’s a detail he hasn’t considered: maybe Anna wants him to be.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - I Had a Dream
1.plot: Parent-teacher day mortifies Kyotaro. Not only is his mother at school, but she’s bonding with Anna! Things couldn’t get any worse.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - I Hate Yamada
1.plot: Despite all the hints Anna throws at him, and others beginning to notice, Kyotaro refuses to believe that she could actually like him. He is his own worst enemy.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - We Walked Slowly
1.plot: It’s Japan’s most romantic time of the year, and Kyotaro and Anna are not-on-a-date. Kyotaro is keeping a running tally of all his screw-ups, but Anna is enjoying herself.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - We’re a Bit Alike
1.plot: Distance separates Kyotaro and Anna, but their thoughts are of each other. However, their budding relationship faces a threat: Haruya still has his eyes set on Anna.

1.title: EN - The Dangers in My Heart[MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - I Wanted to Be Seen
1.plot: Kyotaro didn’t think his cunning plan for New Year’s all the way through. Anna showed up early, and now his sister is trying to be his wingwoman.

meta.plot: The young adventurer Belgrieve retires to a quieter life after losing his leg to a beast. While gathering herbs in the woods one day, he rescues an abandoned child. Angeline trains with her father and later achieves S-Rank in the capital’s adventurer guild. Five years later, she decides to return home. Will Belgrieve get another chance at being an adventurer? Will Angeline return home unscathed?

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - The Melancholy of Angeline
1.plot: Angeline, the Black-Haired Valkyrie, longs for nothing more than a vacation to return to her home in the countryside and visit the father who taught her everything she knows about adventuring...but getting there will be an adventure all its own.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Belgrieve the Red Ogre
1.plot: Although Angeline has yet to make it home, tales of her deeds are reaching her father in the countryside. The noble Bordeaux family is also eagerly seeking out Belgrieve to show their gratitude after Angeline rescued their youngest sister.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Welcome Home, Angeline
1.plot: Angeline still hasn't been able to make it home to see her father. So when the local guild master tells her all that's standing between her and some time off is a potentially legendary monster, you can bet she's up for the challenge.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Quiet Days in Turnera with the Occasional Family Spat
1.plot: Angeline finally makes it back home with her friends in tow, but Belgrieve can hardly believe his ears when he hears how she introduces him. If Angeline says he's the Red Ogre and he says he's not, then which story is really true?

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - The Road to Bordeaux
1.plot: Father and daughter are finally reunited after five long years, so Angeline isn’t ready to be separated from Belgrieve just yet when a job comes in for him. She and her friends thus decide to tag along to Bordeaux, where an unexpected problem awaits.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Rebels Acting in Secret
1.plot: Belgrieve has caught wind of a plot brewing in Bordeaux, and the dark clouds roiling over the estate are a portent of things to come.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - A Long Night and a Bright Dawn
1.plot: The attack on the Bordeaux estate has been suppressed for now, but the aftermath haunts the entire town. Has the danger truly passed? More dark clouds rolling in suggests otherwise...

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Meeting the Inhabitants of the Woods
1.plot: Belgrieve is back at home, but trouble abounds even outside of Bordeaux. This "trouble" just happens to be a rogue elven princess who's out for demon blood.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Father and Daughter Meet New People
1.plot: Belgrieve continues to handle the trouble that's cropped up in the countryside. Meanwhile, Angeline stumbles upon trouble of her own in the city.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - Wriggling Malice
1.plot: After their encounter in the city, Angeline takes on two surprising wards. Protecting people she cares about, however, turns out to be much harder than she ever expected.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Belgrieve's Decision
1.plot: Belgrieve and Angeline begin to enjoy the changes in their lives, but there's change on the horizon for them both. Will they cross paths again as they set out on new journeys?

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Confronting the Past
1.plot: Angeline makes her grudging journey to the capital and quickly learns nobles are not to be underestimated. Meanwhile, Belgrieve has begun looking for something he thought he lost long ago.

1.title: EN - My Daughter Left the Nest and Returned an S-Rank Adventurer [MULTI-SUB] - S01E13 - I'm Home, Dad
1.plot: Angeline is in the capital to be honored, but she continues to struggle with the very idea. Belgrieve also continues to grapple with his past.

1.title: FR - Close Enough - S01E01 - Quilty Pleasures
1.plot: While working on Candice's class quilt, Josh and Emily get trapped in the underbelly of the Los Angeles fabric district, while Alex and Bridgette prove to be incompetent babysitters.

1.title: FR - Close Enough - S01E02 - The Perfect House

meta.plot: I am a dull otaku who lost consciousness after eating raw pork liver. When I awoke, it seemed that I had been reincarnated into another world... but I had also become a pig! As I was rolling around in a pigsty covered in mud, Jess, a kind, angelic, beautiful girl, came to my rescue. "Oink!!" "Um, you don't have to force yourself to talk. I'm able to... understand you." This girl who was devotedly caring after my pig-self was a member of the Yethma, and her people have the ability to read minds. "This is bad! That means she can see through all of my lustful delusions!" Now in Mesteria, a world run by swords and magic, a pig and a mind-reading beauty set off on their lovey-dovey fantasy adventure! ... Or do they?

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Otakus Enjoy Being Treated Like Pigs
1.plot: After collapsing from eating raw pig liver, I've been reincarnated as a pig in Mesteria, a world run by swords and magic. The beautiful girl who saved me worked as a servant and was a member of the Yethma, a race of girls with the ability to read minds. Despite being able to hear all of the lustful fantasies of this ex-dirty, scrawny, four-eyed virgin, Jess always responded with a soft smile. Hold on, why is this girl being so nice to me...!?

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Even a Pig Will Dance If You Flatter Them Enough
1.plot: Jess and I have begun preparations to make our way to the royal capital. However, despite knowing that there is a man inside this pig body, this beautiful girl doesn’t seem to have even a hint of wariness! While being enthralled by the innocent girl's every move, Jess takes Pig with her to the lively city of Kiltyrie to buy something... Hold on Jess, why are you going into such a suspicious-looking alleyway?

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - You Must Not Fall in Love with Your Oshi
1.plot: After seeing my astonishing dance performance, which is a skill I developed through training in rhythm games, I was purchased by a ristae shop. However, while waiting for my turn to perform at the festival, I realized something. I am an ex-dirty, scrawny, four-eyed virgin who has never once received attention from large groups of people before. But it doesn't matter. Jess is wearing a maid outfit and is cheering me on. Dance for your Oshi, Pig!

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Be Careful How You Ride a Pig
1.plot: After being stabbed by a man with a sword wound, I lost consciousness. When I awoke, I found myself in an unfamiliar forest with Jess sleeping soundly while using my stomach as a pillow. It seems she's really tired. I decided we should start moving and that Jess should ride on my back but... Cutie-pie Jess, you can't sit on me like that! As we go on our love comedy journey, Jess reveals a shocking truth to me...

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Nearly All Handsome Guys Are Scumbags
1.plot: Jess and I met a young Yethma named Ceres in a town we stopped by amidst our travels. Upon Jess's request, she guided us to the site of a monastery that burned down five years ago. As we were setting down some flowers at the site, a young man wielding double blades suddenly appears before us accompanied by a dog. He's cool, strong and handsome... I don't like him, he's like my natural enemy... Who on earth is this guy?

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Honest Feelings Should be Shouted Out Loud
1.plot: After hearing my appeal, Naut has agreed to join us on our journey. We set off to the royal capital along with Naut's companion, the perverted dog Rossi, by our side and Ceres's prayers on our backs. But in the next city that we arrive at, I learn about an incomprehensible truth about Yethmas... It seems I'm going to have to interrogate Naut about that incident. It's about what you were doing when you were alone with a drunken Jess last evening...

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E07 - No Two Flowers Are the Same
1.plot: Jess and I hear the voice of a young girl Yethma named Blaise calling for help. After finding out about this, Naut takes Rossi and rushes in the direction of the voice. Chasing after him, the two of us also scramble to the source of the voice... However, my human senses smell something fishy about all of this. Will we be okay jumping in like this?

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E08 - Don't Laugh at Someone's Prayers
1.plot: After Blaise has joined us on our journey, we made our way to the Impaling Stones. Thanks to Naut, our travels have been going well, but I can feel danger levels are steadily rising as we approach the royal capital... I must come to a decision. What am I capable of doing to help Jess, and what should I prioritize? That night, Blaise quietly pulled me aside and opened up to me about...

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E09 - Live and Go Set Your Feet on That Ground
1.plot: After I became aware that Blaise's body was in critical condition, it became clear that we must reach the royal capital as soon as possible, for her sake, as well. However, as we hurry along our journey, the thing we've been fearful of this whole time finally appears – Yethma hunters. Outnumbered, we find ourselves in an overwhelmingly disadvantageous position. Using our wits to battle against them, we must find a way out of this predicament no matter what...

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E10 - There's Always a Reason Why Things Are the Way They Are
1.plot: Separated from our travel companions, Jess and I make our way to the royal capital, just the two of us. As we continue walking through the Needle Woods, we reach the towering cliffs of the royal capital, not knowing the most important thing – how to get in. At a loss of what to do, Jess and I are forced to wander in the most dangerous of places as Jess's body gradually grows weaker and weaker. As her chabirone, it is my duty to escort her to the royal capital, no matter what.

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E11 - Keep Rewards for When They Really Count
1.plot: We finally understood what Blaise meant when she said to "Appeal to the king" and have made it into the royal capital. However, there are still many unanswered questions... Why do all the Yethma girls have collars on their necks? Why do their lives meet such a horrible fate? It's finally time to learn the truth and what it will take for me to return to my human body...

1.title: EN - Butareba -The Story of a Man Turned Into a Pig- [MULTI-SUB] - S01E12 - Heat the Pig Liver
1.plot: After hearing the truth from the king, Jess and I were spending the remaining time we had together. At this time, she opened up to me the "true reason" why I was brought here to this isekai (Mesteria). My fellows, please watch through to the end. To the end of a pig and a beautiful girl's lovey-dovey fantasy adventure, that could not be retold without shedding tears.

meta.plot:
Legend says, when the Evil God awakens from the deepest of darkness, the god of fate will summon Six Braves and grant them with the power to save the world. Adlet Mayer, self-proclaimed "Strongest Man in the World," has arrived at the continent of Piena in hopes of becoming a Brave. Although it doesn't go as smoothly as he had planned, Adlet is ultimately chosen as one of the six heroes shortly after being greeted by Nashetania Loei Piena Augustra, crown princess and fellow Brave.

This story follows the two as they embark upon their destined journey to fight the Demon God, intending to meet up with their fellow heroes. However, when they finally unite, seven heroes are present, and soon the others begin to suspect Adlet to be a fraud. Now on the run, Adlet must utilize his unique skill set and wit in a fight for his life to identify which member of the group is the true impostor before it's too late!

meta.plot: Mauro Larrea and Soledad Montalvo are two strangers whose destinies cross in the second half of the 19th century, leading to their lives changing forever. A history of glories and defeats, of silver mines, family intrigues, vineyards, wineries, and fascinating cities whose splendor faded over time.

Ultimately, he decides that he will betray Carola and collaborate with the abolitionists so that the slaves cannot be sold. For her part, Soledad will have to face her stepson, Alan from whom she must hide Edward's mental illness.

1.plot: Luis's death has a profound impact on all the characters, both in Cuba and in London. Mauro and Gustavo engage in a game of billiards, on which their respective futures depend. Sol decides that she and Edward must flee from London to Jerez before Alan declares her husband legally unfit and takes the entire family fortune.

On the other hand, to protect Edward from her son, Soledad finds a perfect hiding place for her husband: the convent where Inés lives in seclusion. But Sol does not imagine that she has placed her husband in the hands of greater risk, since the flames of an old love will be rekindled with unforeseeable consequences.

Will they succeed... or will they pay with their lives in the attempt?

1.plot: Jeter wins his 5th and final World Series and celebrates his 3000th hit, but it’s not all smooth sailing for this aging superstar. As his career begins to come to an end, he goes through a very public and difficult contract negotiation that changes his relationship with the Yankees. For the first time ever, Jeter’s wife Hannah gives us the backstory of their relationship and a behind the scenes look at Jeter’s recovery from a career altering injury.

1.title: EN - The Captain [Multi-Sub] - S01E07 - A Star in the Fabric
1.plot: Jeter and Hannah share intimate details of their difficult journey on the way to parenthood. Jeter achieves another dream by becoming the owner of the Miami Marlins, but his journey is fraught with criticism and unfinished business.

meta.plot: Pauline gets pregnant after a one-night stand with Lukas. Something is very wrong with the pregnancy. When Luke reveals that he is the son of the devil incarnate and heir to hell, nothing is ever the same again. Between the fronts of demons and angels, Pauline's pregnancy also gives her supernatural abilities. She becomes the decisive force in the epic battle between good and evil.

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E01 - Nothing Special
1.plot: Pauline just wants to go to university. A pregnancy is the last thing she needs.

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E02 - Are You Ready?
1.plot: While Pauline tries to get rid of her problems, she gets the feeling that she is going crazy.

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E03 - Chaos and Control
1.plot: Pauline has to get her new power under control. Only Lukas can help her.

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E04 - Who Was My Father?
1.plot: Pauline flees to her father's forest cabin. However, she is not alone there.

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E05 - Trust
1.plot: Pauline finally gets help. But can she trust the Sonnenseite people?

1.title: EN - Pauline[MULTI-SUB] - S01E06 - Team Pauline
1.plot: To get her old life back, Pauline comes to an arrangement with Lilith.

meta.plot: Rebellious Brooklyn teen Summer Torres is sent to live with family friends in the tiny town of Shorehaven on the Great Ocean Road, Victoria, AUS. Despite her best efforts, Summer falls in love with the town, the people and the surf.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E01 - Exile
1.plot: Wild child Summer tries to settle into sleepy Shorehaven and meets young surfer Ari, who's on the mend from a serious injury but ready to compete again.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E02 - Big Plans
1.plot: Summer plots her escape. Tensions between Ari and frenemy Marlon boil over after a competition. Summer helps Ari through a side effect of his accident.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E03 - Training Day
1.plot: Surf coach Manu finds a way for Ari to train and get him back in the waves. Despite their differences, Poppy and Summer somehow bond on their boards.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E04 - Shame
1.plot: The crew heads to Jackson Bay for a major competition. Summer stirs up drama with a revealing game that brings Ari and Marlon's friendship to the brink.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E05 - Keep the Sponsors Happy
1.plot: Bodhi might catch her big break with a new sponsor — if Marlon doesn't ruin her shot. Poppy and Ari share a moment after a late-night training session.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E06 - No Pressure
1.plot: Ari and Bodhi try to hold their own against surfing pros — and among VIPs at a party. Summer helps Ari with his secret but wants him to seek real help.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E07 - For Laynah
1.plot: Poppy, with her mother's memory in mind, serves as the team captain during an event against rival surf clubs. Marlon starts to weigh his options.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E08 - Stairway
1.plot: Marlon wants to impress his new pals by surfing a notorious break, and Ari joins him. Summer gets desperate after getting an update about her stay.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E09 - Go
1.plot: Poppy mingles with a rival surfer. Ari and Summer sneak into the Jarrah Island competition together. Marlon must decide where his loyalty lies.

1.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S01E10 - Stay
1.plot: Margot arrives to bring Summer home, while the crew tries to qualify for the state team. Bodhi gets in trouble during her heat. Ari makes a choice.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E01 - Selection
2.plot: Ready to show off new skills, Summer returns to Shorehaven on the eve of state team tryouts. But she finds she's not the only one bringing surprises.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E02 - Team Bonding
2.plot: Tough new coach Elo puts the team through their paces. When Summer hosts a barbecue, a few impulsive decisions turn a quiet night into a rager.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E03 - Wait For It
2.plot: With her plans at risk, Summer buckles down to show how serious she is about competing. Bodhi goes on a date with an intriguing surfer from out of town.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E04 - A Seat at the Table
2.plot: Ari faces new anxieties after signing a sponsorship deal. At a glam Subtropix shoot in Byron Bay, a photographer's approach rubs Bodhi the wrong way.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E05 - Purge
2.plot: A kiss gives Poppy a lot to think about while Bax tries to get Summer's mind off her problems. Tensions boil over among the team at surf camp.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E06 - I Promise
2.plot: Struggling to be honest with Wren, Ari ends up throwing her a birthday party, where a pitcher of special punch gets Poppy and Summer into trouble.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E07 - Suck It Up
2.plot: Unexpected truths emerge at Nationals, where the team fights to move past their drama and ride into the finals. Wren lays her cards on the table.

2.title: EN - Surviving Summer [Multi-Sub/Audio] - S02E08 - Send It
2.plot: As pressure builds at the competition, Summer waits for the perfect wave. But with love on the line, winning on the water is only half the battle.

meta.plot: Mayhem and mishaps follow young witch Mildred Hubble wherever she goes. She just can't help it! But with her friends' help, Mildred always manages to avoid disaster just in time.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E01 - Selection Day Part 1
1.plot: Mildred Hubble's world changes when a witch crashes into her balcony. She visits Cackle's Academy where she is amazed by everything - the magic, the potions, and that every student gets their own cat.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E02 - Selection Day Part 2
1.plot: After she visits Cackle's Academy with her new witch friend Maud Spellbody, Mildred attempts to enrol by taking the magical exam.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E03 - Tabby
1.plot: Mildred learns that having a scaredy cat makes life at witching school tough - especially when Ethel Hallow is determined to see her fail.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E04 - New Girl
1.plot: Everyone's excited at the arrival of Enid, a young witch from the famous Nightshade family. Enid sees that Mildred is the local unwitting troublemaker and immediately latches onto her - it's the last thing Mildred needs.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E05 - Pond Life
1.plot: Mildred is having fun jumping high into the air with Enid, using pirated magic to make the grass bouncy. Maud is getting fed up with Enid constantly distracting Mildred - Maud knows Mildred needs to knuckle down if she's going to stand a chance at the academy and can't bear the thought of losing her.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E06 - The Great Wizard's Visit
1.plot: Miss Cackle isn't herself when the Great Wizard visits, leaving her job in jeopardy.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E07 - The Best Teacher
1.plot: Mildred learns not to take shortcuts when a wisdom spell goes wrong.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E08 - Maud's Big Mistake
1.plot: Maud’s panic about parent’s evening pushes her to use a forgetting powder, meanwhile Mildred wonders if her mum is a witch after all.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E09 - The First Witch
1.plot: Mildred goes on a hair-raising journey while looking into her magical heritage, meanwhile Ethel thinks she's queen bee when she grows a wart.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E10 - Spelling Bee
1.plot: There is more than just the Spelling Bee at stake when Miss Hardbroom's rival comes to Cackle's Academy. Meanwhile, Maud and Enid try to help Tabby to catch mice but make things much worse.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E11 - The Mists of Time
1.plot: Mildred learns about Cackle's history when she and Ethel accidently slip into the Cackle's of the past.

1.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S01E12 - Out of Bounds
1.plot: As the end of year exams loom, Miss Cackle’s secret is still weighing heavy on Mildred’s mind.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E01 - Tortoise Trouble
2.plot: It's the first day of term and Mildred stumbles upon something very important.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E02 - The Friendship Trap
2.plot: Mildred and Ethel are more at odds than ever, so Miss Cackle sets a friendship trap on them, pushing them too close for comfort.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E03 - Ethel Everywhere
2.plot: Ethel’s clone spell spirals out of control.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E04 - The Extraordinary Esper Vespertilio
2.plot: Miss Mould helps Mildred with her magic, and Beatrice reveals the source of her sneezing. A famed chantress's biggest fan has an even bigger secret.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E05 - Mildred’s Family Tree
2.plot: A lesson on family trees gets Mildred thinking about finding her dad. Ethel can’t resist making a cruel joke at Mildred’s expense. Sports Day pushes Maud to take desperate measures.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E06 - Bat Girl
2.plot: Enid takes a practical joke too far and is threatened with expulsion. Mildred turns herself into a bat but can’t remember how to turn herself back. Clarice struggles to understand the appeal of practical jokes.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E07 - Hollow Wood
2.plot: Mildred can't understand why the girls are so scared of collecting potions ingredients in the woods until she comes face to face with an unusual creature.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E08 - Miss Cackle's Birthday
2.plot: Mildred and Enid try to help Maud but accidentally turn her into a baby.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E09 - Miss Softbroom
2.plot: Miss Cackle goes to find out her fate at the Magic Council.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E10 - A New Dawn
2.plot: Miss Pentangle teaches modern witching workshops.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E11 - Love at First Sight
2.plot: Mildred meddles in Miss Bat and Mr Rowan-Webb’s relationship.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E12 - All Hollows' Eve (1)
2.plot: The girls ask their ancestors for help reigniting the Founding Stone. Meanwhile, at the school Halloween party, magic's misfiring in every direction.

2.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S02E13 - The Big Freeze (2)
2.plot: With the academy in crisis -- and her friends trapped in a deep freeze -- Mildred considers a selfless sacrifice to save the day.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E01 - The Wishing Star
3.plot: When Miss Cackle refuses Mildred's request to make her mum Julie magical, angry Mildred enters the Great Wizard's broomstick-flying contest. She's determined to win a Wishing Star so she can give Julie magic herself. But Mildred is thwarted by bitter rival Ethel Hallow, and both girls are disqualified - only for Mildred to make a surprising discovery.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E02 - Double Hubble
3.plot: Some witches are more welcoming than others when Mildred's nonmagical mother, Julie, reports for duty as the school's new art teacher.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E03 - Magic Mum
3.plot: After turning her mother into a witch, Mildred worries she's made a mistake. Beatrice trains under Miss Tapioca and bakes up a revealing recipe.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E04 - The Swamp Troll
3.plot: Julie's newfound magic is a little out of control. Elsewhere, Ethel's so full of rage that she turns herself into a Swamp Troll.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E05 - The Owl and the Pussycat
3.plot: A wise owl holds the key to solving two different problems: Beatrice needs help passing a potions exam, and Maud's cat is slowly disappearing!

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E06 - The Game
3.plot: An addictive new game has the whole school under its spell -- with serious side effects. Meanwhile, students and teachers are going missing.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E07 - Bad Magic
3.plot: When a guilty Mildred confesses her theft to Miss Hardbroom, it stirs up memories of a fateful friendship -- and a terrible mistake.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E08 - The Cackle Run
3.plot: Indigo Moon returns to the academy, unaware that 30 years have passed since she turned into stone. Clarice wakes up with a bothersome boil.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E09 - Star Struck
3.plot: Enid casts a spell on her famous mother so they can spend more time together. Indigo's trying -- but failing -- to fit in, so she runs away.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E10 - Finding Joy
3.plot: Mildred gets creative to stop Indigo from feeling so sad. Tension brews between Miss Tapioca and her daughter on the day of the Midsummer meal.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E11 - The Broomstick Uprising
3.plot: Faced with a mess before Indigo's examination, Mildred bewitches a broom -- and sparks a revolution. A mysterious witch comes looking for her dog.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E12 - Ethel Hallow to the Rescue (1)
3.plot: On the day of Miss Bat's wedding, Mildred and Ethel team up to steal a priceless gift, and Beatrice, Sybil and Clarice bungle an important assignment.

3.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S03E13 - Ethel Hallow to the Rescue (2)
3.plot: An unlikely hero steps forward on the last day of school when an evil presence takes to the skies and threatens to destroy the academy.

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E01 - The Three Impossibilities
4.plot: When a botched potions experiment leaves Mildred with a whole new look, can she complete three impossible challenges and reverse the spell before the sun goes down?

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E02 - Gertrude the Great
4.plot: Enid's attempt to help Mildred win her first head girl challenge backfires.

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E03 - Happy Birthday, Indigo Moon
4.plot: Indigo discovers that her mother has been searching for her for 30 years.

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E04 - Enid Nightshade, Superstar
4.plot: When Mistress Nightshade makes a surprise visit, Enid is left in a terrible dilemma - complete her studies at Cackle’s or join the family magic show? Will Mildred’s great debate challenge help her make up her mind?

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E05 - The Forbidden Tree
EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E06 - Maud's Magical Make-over
4.plot: Neglected Maud discovers Felicity uses a secret coolness potion.

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E07 - The Crystal Lake
4.plot: When Mildred’s new friend Jessica lures her to the Crystal Lake, Mildred breaks all the rules to go and meet her, and she discovers that all is not what it seems!

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E08 - Enid's Last Race
4.plot: Betrayed by Miss Hempnettle, will Enid’s dreams of sprint stardom at the Witch World Games qualifiers end in tatters?

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E09 - Mildred the Detective
4.plot: With a magical prankster at large in Cackle’s, Ethel and Mildred are tasked with finding the culprit as their next head girl challenge. Who or what is causing the mayhem?

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E10 - A Witch in Time
4.plot: Desperate to win the Head Girl Triathlon and stop her terrible future vision from coming true, Mildred embarks on a dangerous gambit to rewind time with a stolen loop spell from Mr Daisy.

4.title: EN - The Worst Witch [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S04E11 - Grounded
4.plot: Mildred is horrified to find her magic is broken when visiting Izzy’s farm. Izzy’s dad, Spike, sets out to help her create a grounding stone to reboot it, with more than a few stars aligning.
